全矩阵100万参数，分解为1000×8和8×1000，共1.6万，不含基础W。.en: The full matrix has 1,000,000 parameters; factored into 1000×8 and 8×1000 it is 16,000 in all, not counting the base W.

round后为3，恢复0.3；省表示成本但引入误差。.en: After rounding it is 3, recovering 0.3; the representation cost falls, but an error is introduced.

把过程连起来。</strong>先定位失败发生在数据、接口、行为还是计算资源，再.en: Join the steps up. Locate first whether the failure is in the data, the interface, the behavior or the compute resources, and only then choose RAG, constrained output, adaptation or compression.

边界与反例。</strong>参数账本是原理计算，不是训练时间或精度收益预测；Q.en: Limits and counterexamples. The parameter ledger is a calculation from first principles, not a prediction of training time or accuracy gain; a complete scheme such as QLoRA also involves quantization and training details.

Adding several adapters together is also no guarantee that their behavior in the business will not conflict. 组织模型输入、工具、状态、权限和反馈的外围程序。 例：模型提出读文件，Harne.en: The surrounding program that organizes the model's input, tools, state, permissions and feedback. Example: the model proposes reading a file; the harness runs it and fills the result back in.

；大量无关上下文应改选择。若不定位根因就微调，可能把易过期知识烙进参数，仍解决不.en: ; a great deal of irrelevant context means changing the selection. Fine-tuning without locating the root cause can burn knowledge that goes stale quickly into the parameters and still not solve the tool or data-permission problem.

Every comparison states explicitly which variables are held fixed; a result from a different temperature or different weights must not be taken for a cache bug.

推理分为先处理已有输入，再逐个产生新Token。输出分数不是词表编号，概率也不是.en: Inference splits into processing the input you already have and then producing new tokens one at a time. The output scores are not vocabulary IDs, and the probabilities are not the accuracy of the answer; sampling picks an ID out of the distribution, and decoding turns that ID back into text.

Q089｜Prefill与Decode有什么区别？第一个输出Token何时产生？.en: Q089｜What is the difference between prefill and decode? When is the first output token produced?

这题先认识什么</span>prefill先处理已经知道的前缀，decode利用.en: What to know first for this question Prefill processes the prefix that is already known, and decode uses it to generate new tokens. Both stages use the model parameters; what differs is how the input is organized and which results can be reused.

第57课 · 从最后一排数到一个Token，再到一句回答</a><a class.en: Lesson 57 · From the last row of numbers to one token, and on to a whole answerLesson 58 · KV cache explained from scratch

处理当前已经知道的一段输入前缀。 例：得到各层表示及可复用的K/V。.en: Processing the stretch of input prefix that is already known. Example: it yields the representations at each layer and reusable K/V.

处理整个已知输入前缀并建立各层缓存；输入最后一个位置的.en: : it processes the whole known input prefix and builds the cache at every layer; the scores at the last input position (

已经能够预测第一个新Token。采样得到这个Token后，下一次Decode才把.en: ) can already predict the first new token. Once that token has been sampled, it is the next decode that sends it through all the layers as input and predicts the token after that. The output is not thought out in one go and then sent in installments.

按时间和位置走完三步生成.en: Three generation steps, followed through by time and position

，长度P=4。我们要生成.en: , of length P=4. What we want to generate is

本次输入网络的Token.en: Tokens fed into the network this time

用哪个输出选下一Token.en: Which output picks the next token

位置3的logits采样y0.en: Sample y0 from the logits at position 3

位置4的logits采样y1.en: Sample y1 from the logits at position 4

位置5的logits采样y2.en: Sample y2 from the logits at position 5

表里已经采样出y2，但y2还没有作为输入经过网络；此时缓存还不包含它。若继续生成.en: In the table y2 has been sampled, but y2 has not yet passed through the network as input, so the cache does not contain it yet. If generation continues, y2 is only processed at the next step. This "one-step offset" affects the cache length, the stopping condition and the recovery logic. Do not read "how many tokens have been emitted" as "how many output tokens have entered the KV". A particular service may wrap these steps up, but the underlying dependency on these conditions remains.

为什么Prefill能把多个位置一起算？因为输入Token已经全部已知，各层通过.en: Why can prefill compute several positions together? Because the input tokens are all known already, so each layer handles many positions at once through matrix operations, and the causal mask then forbids any dependence on the future. Why can standard decode not produce the next 100 real tokens in one go? Because y1 depends on the sampled y0 and y2 depends on y1; a token that has not been selected yet is unknown and cannot be used directly as the next layer's input.

生成时所有模型层仍要执行。KV缓存省的是旧位置的重复计算，不是新Token只经过.en: Every model layer still runs during generation. What the KV cache saves is the repeated computation for old positions; it does not mean that a new token passes only through the last layer. Each new position has its own Q/K/V at layer l and reads from that layer's own history cache.

刚选出的Token，还没进入自己的那一轮计算.en: The token just selected has not yet entered the turn of computation that is its own

本例条件：</strong>教学序列先输入[我,爱]，随后人为规定解码器依次选择.en: Conditions for this example: the teaching sequence takes [我, 爱] as input first, after which the decoder is told, by construction, to select [学习, ！, EOS] in turn. The figure only checks the timing and the cache length; it does not pass this chosen sequence off as a training result.

这个Token已通过Embedding与全部层。.en: This token has already passed through the embedding and every layer.

从上一轮分布选中，但未必做过自己的前向。.en: Selected from the previous turn's distribution, but it has not necessarily had a forward pass of its own.

已经处理的历史位置数。.en: The number of past positions already processed.

放大图解：刚选出的Token，还没进入自己的那一轮计算.en: Enlarged figure: the token just selected has not yet entered its own round of computation

本次送入模型.en: Sent to the model this time

前向结束后的状态.en: The state after the forward pass finishes

EOS不再送入模型.en: EOS is not fed into the model again

缓存保持4；终止续写.en: Cache stays at 4; the continuation stops

第一行结束时界面可能已经显示“学习”，但缓存仍只有“我、爱”。选择与处理发生在相.en: By the end of the first row the interface may already be showing 学习, but the cache still holds only 我、爱. Selection and processing happen between two neighboring rounds.

下一轮只送“学习”时，旧信息从各层KV中来；并不是模型只看这一个Token就猜下.en: When only "学习" is sent on the next turn, the old information comes from the KV in each layer; it is not that the model guesses the next token from this one token alone.

EOS被选中后通常直接停止，本例没有再把EOS处理一轮。输出数量、可见文字数量和.en: Once EOS has been selected, generation usually stops right there; this example does not put EOS through another round. The number of outputs, the amount of visible text and the cache length can therefore all differ.

不要混淆：</strong>把新Token计入缓存后又把它当新输入送一次，会重复.en: Do not conflate: counting a new token into the cache and then sending it in again as new input appends it twice; go by the actual processing log, not by where the character count on screen updates.

Prompt长3，再生成2个Token，逐轮列出长度.en: A prompt of length 3, two more tokens generated, with the lengths listed round by round

输入与条件。</strong>请求只需生成两个新Token，原Prompt是.en: Input and conditions. The request needs only two new tokens, and the original prompt is

。选出的Token依次为4、5，这是教学给定输出。.en: . The tokens selected are 4 and then 5; this is a teaching-given output.

本轮算3个位置，缓存长3。.en: Three positions are computed this round; the cache is 3 long.

Prefill末尾预测.en: Prediction at the end of prefill

可见序列长4，已计算缓存仍长3。.en: The visible sequence is 4 long; the computed cache is still 3 long.

仅输入[4]并带KV.en: Only [4] is fed in, together with the KV

缓存长4，避免把1、2、3再算一遍。.en: The cache is 4 long, which avoids computing 1, 2 and 3 all over again.

Decode末尾预测.en: Prediction at the end of decode

已生成2个新Token，达到本例max_new_tokens=2。.en: Two new tokens have been generated, reaching this example's max_new_tokens=2.

最终可见序列长5、缓存长4；这不是少算错误，而是最后Token无需再用于下一次预.en: The final visible sequence is 5 long and the cache 4 long; this is not a missed computation — the last token simply is not needed for another prediction.

把过程连起来。</strong>第一个输出来自Prefill最后有效位置的log.en: Join the steps up. The first output comes from the logits at the last valid position of prefill; after that, each decode consumes the token that was just generated and has not been processed yet.

边界与反例。</strong>某些服务会在内部继续处理或管理缓存；这里是明确停止.en: Limits and counterexamples. Some services go on processing internally or managing the cache; what is shown here is the minimal generation loop under an explicit stopping policy.

追问：训练为什么能够并行预测一整段？.en: Follow-up: why can training predict a whole stretch in parallel?

标签是要比较的正确目标；下一Token训练让输入位置对准后一Token。Teac.en: A label is the correct target to compare against; next-token training lines each input position up with the token after it. Teacher forcing computes with the real prefix from the data rather than replacing it with what was just sampled.<span class="concept-micro">Independent example: for the full sequence [a,b,c,d] the input [a,b,c] can be paired with the labels [b,c,d]. When the interface already shifts them, do not shift them a second time outside it.

训练使用真实前缀进行teacher forcing，位置i的目标已知，可以同时计.en: Training uses the real prefix for teacher forcing: the target at position i is known, so the conditional probabilities at different positions can be computed at the same time. Inference uses the model's own generated prefix, where the previous choice changes the input that follows. This is also one source of the possible gap between the training distribution and the generation distribution; it does not mean that copying labels during training buys reliable inference.

追问：每次Decode只输入一个Token，模型如何知道完整问题？.en: Follow-up: if each decode takes only one token as input, how does the model know the whole question?

这个Token通过每层Q读取该层历史K/V，而这些缓存包含对原始前缀的上下文化计.en: That token uses its Q at each layer to read that layer's historical K/V, and those caches hold the contextualized computation of the original prefix. A short input tensor does not mean short conditioning information. If the cache is lost, the service has to rebuild the prefix or use some other supported state; handing over one isolated token and expecting the same distribution will not work.

追问：流式显示是否意味着每个屏幕字符对应一次Decode？.en: Follow-up: does a streaming display mean that every character on screen corresponds to one decode?

不一定。Token可覆盖多个字符或不完整字节，服务可能批量发送增量，网络chun.en: Not necessarily. A token can cover several characters or an incomplete byte sequence, a service may send increments in batches, and network chunks have nothing to do with token boundaries. The visible text may also leave out internal reasoning tokens. The granularity of the UI display, of network events and of the model's token generation must be kept apart.

给了attention_mask，为什么右补齐生成仍可能读错logits？.en: With attention_mask supplied, why can right-padded generation still read the wrong logits?

第57课</a>。阅读顺序：先确认运行契约，再看反例与修复，最后检验边界。.en: Lesson 57. Reading order: confirm the runtime contract first, then look at the counterexamples and the fix, and finally test the limits.

掩码与输出采样地址解决不同问题.en: The mask and the address the output is sampled from solve different problems

attention_mask限制Key侧读取；.en: attention_mask limits reading on the key side;

选的是输出张量最后一列。这两步没有逻辑蕴含关系。右补齐时最后一列可能对应PAD查.en: picks the last column of the output tensor. There is no logical entailment between the two steps. With right padding the last column may correspond to a PAD query, and the mask will not automatically turn index −1 into the last valid token. The Transformers tutorial on decoder-only generation therefore requires left padding on that path.

本地固定两条序列的有效表为.en: Two sequences are fixed locally with validity tables

，最后有效索引应为1、2。构造候选分数后，正确选取得到类别.en: , so the last valid indices should be 1 and 2. With the candidate scores built, the correct selection yields classes

，无条件取末列得到.en: , while taking the last column unconditionally yields

。这证明错误来自地址选择，不是softmax算错。.en: . That shows the error comes from choosing the address, not from softmax computing wrongly.

不要把长度减一写成万能公式.en: Do not write length-minus-one as a universal formula

只对“有效项从0开始连续排布”的右补齐布局给出最后有效索引。左补齐.en: gives the last valid index only for a right-padded layout in which "the valid items sit contiguously from 0". For left padding,

的和为2，但最后有效下标是2而不是1。更通用的检查是用位置索引与有效标记求最后有.en: sums to 2, but the last valid subscript is 2, not 1. A more general check derives the last valid position from the position indices together with the validity flags; a real generator also has to get the position encoding and the cache right at the same time.

这是教学自定义采样逻辑，不是建议绕过库的prepare_inputs_for_g.en: This is custom sampling logic written for teaching; it is not a recommendation to bypass the library's prepare_inputs_for_generation. When plugging into a ready-made generate, follow the padding convention that the model supports.

EOS作为PAD，为什么不会一开始就结束？.en: EOS used as PAD: why does generation not stop right at the start?

某些decoder-only模型缺少独立PAD，推理可把EOS用作左侧补齐项。<.en: Some decoder-only models have no separate PAD, so inference can use EOS as the left padding item. That ID appearing in the input and that ID being newly generated this round and triggering a stop are different events; the validity mask decides the input's role. During training it is more dangerous: clearing labels by "setting −100 everywhere the ID equals EOS" also erases the end target that really has to be learned. The distinction should follow the padding positions, not the ID value alone.

追问：单条输入正常、batch后异常，先查什么？.en: Follow-up: a single input works but a batch misbehaves — what should be checked first?

先检查左右padding、真实长度、最后有效位置、position_ids、EO.en: Check left and right padding, the real lengths, the last valid position, position_ids, EOS/PAD sharing and the cache offset. Running the same sample alone and then mixed into a batch of long and short sequences locates the problem better than blaming GPU nondeterminism. Do not let a synthetic test give every sentence the same length, or these bugs will never show up.

追问：右补齐永远不能用于decoder模型吗？.en: Follow-up: can right padding never be used with a decoder model?

不是。训练和自定义前向可以正确使用右补齐，只要掩码、标签和输出索引一致。问题发生.en: No. Training and a custom forward pass can use right padding correctly, as long as the mask, the labels and the output index agree. The problem arises when a particular piece of generation code assumes that the last tensor column is the last valid one; turning one call chain's convention into a mathematical law about models creates a new misunderstanding.

E07：怎样读这份结果，而不是只看“通过”.en: E07: how to read this result, rather than only looking at "pass"

mask控制读取关系，但最终从哪个位置取logits是另一步。索引记录指出每条样.en: The mask controls the reading relationships, but which position the logits are finally taken from is a separate step. The index record states the last real position for each sample; one cannot uniformly take the end of the array, which is occupied by PAD.

自检：</strong>mask=[0,1,1]时，用sum(mask)-1取得.en: Self-check: with mask=[0,1,1], what goes wrong if sum(mask)-1 is used to get the last valid token?

和为2，减一得到1，但实际最后有效位置是2。该公式隐含右补齐假设；左补齐或稀疏有.en: The sum is 2 and minus one gives 1, but the actual last valid position is 2. The formula carries a hidden right-padding assumption; with left padding or sparse valid positions, the last position has to be derived from the indices together with the mask.

追问：为什么训练多个位置可并行，生成仍逐个来？.en: Follow-up: why can many positions be trained in parallel while generation still goes one at a time?

训练所有真实前缀已知，各行在mask约束下可同时计算；生成下一轮输入来自这轮实际.en: In training every real prefix is known, so all rows can be computed at once under the constraints of the mask; in generation the next round's input comes from this round's actual choice and does not exist yet. Do not read training's one row of logits per position as predicting several unknown future words at once.

Q090｜Temperature、Top-k、Top-p怎样改变输出？为什么温度.en: Q090｜How do temperature, top-k and top-p change the output? And why is a temperature of 0 still not a hundred percent reproducible?

这题先认识什么</span>温度先改分数尺度，top-k按个数筛选，top-p按.en: What to know first for this question Temperature changes the scale of the scores first, top-k filters by count and top-p filters by cumulative probability; after filtering, renormalization is still needed, and which candidate gets drawn is not fixed for ever.

第44课 · 概率、指数与softmax</a><a class=\"pill\.en: Lesson 44 · Probability, exponentials and softmaxLesson 57 · From the last row of numbers to one token, and on to a whole answer

Top-k保留概率最高的k项；Top-p按概率降序保留累计概率达到阈值的候选前缀.en: Top-k keeps the k items with the highest probability; Top-p sorts by descending probability and keeps the leading candidates until the cumulative probability reaches a threshold. When used for sampling, the kept candidates have to be renormalized over the remaining total mass.<span class="concept-micro">Here k is a number of candidates and p a cumulative-probability threshold; k is not the attention Key table K, nor the representation width d_k.

模型先给词表logits，解码策略再把它们变成候选分布并选择Token。温度缩放.en: The model gives vocabulary logits first; the decoding strategy then turns them into a candidate distribution and selects a token. Temperature scales how sharp the distribution is,

分别按候选个数或累计概率保留候选的策略。 例：筛选后通常还要重新归一化。.en: Strategies that keep candidates by their number or by cumulative probability. Example: after the filtering, the result usually has to be renormalized.

限制候选数量，.en: : a cap on the number of candidates,

限制高概率候选的累计概率范围。它们影响探索和多样性，不为事实正确性提供保证。.en: : a cap on the cumulative probability covered by the high-probability candidates. They affect exploration and diversity; they provide no guarantee of factual correctness.

用同一组logits比较.en: Comparing with one and the same set of logits

假设三个候选的logits为.en: Suppose the logits of the three candidates are

温度降低让已有最大项更占优势，并没有重新核验A是否真实。若最高概率项恰好是流畅的.en: Lowering the temperature gives the existing maximum more of an advantage; it does not re-verify whether A is true. If the highest-probability item happens to be a fluent falsehood, a low temperature only emits it more consistently.

Top-k先保留概率最大的k项，再归一化。Top-p先按概率排序，取累计概率达到.en: Top-k keeps the k items with the highest probability and then normalizes. Top-p sorts by probability first, takes the smallest prefix set whose cumulative probability reaches the threshold, and then normalizes. For example, with probabilities

、p=0.8，常见实现保留前两项；p=0.9则还要保留第三项。边界、最少保留数量.en: , p=0.8, a common implementation keeps the first two items; with p=0.9 the third has to be kept as well. The boundary cases, the minimum number kept and the order relative to other processors all depend on the implementation.

温度为0在.en: A temperature of 0, in an interface (

中通常表示某种贪心选择约定，不是直接计算除以0。贪心每步选择最大logit，是局.en: ), usually denotes a convention for some kind of greedy selection, not a literal division by 0. Greedy selection takes the largest logit at each step, which is a local decision; it does not guarantee the highest probability over the whole sequence, let alone the best task quality. Beam search explores several candidate prefixes, but for an open-ended answer it can also lead to repetition or unnatural text, so search width is no universal quality knob.

同一分数，不同采样处理顺序会给出不同候选集合.en: With the same scores, handling the sampling steps in a different order gives a different set of candidates

本例条件：</strong>始终使用A/B/C分数[2,1,0]。基准温度1；对.en: Conditions for this example: the A/B/C scores [2,1,0] are used throughout. The baseline temperature is 1; the comparison changes only the temperature, to 2. The top-p threshold is 0.8: in descending order, take the smallest set whose cumulative probability reaches the threshold, then renormalize.

先把logits除以τ；不是乘概率。.en: Divide the logits by τ first; this is not multiplying the probabilities.

按当前分布累计概率选候选集合。.en: Choose the candidate set by cumulative probability over the current distribution.

删除候选后剩余概率再除以剩余总和。.en: Once candidates have been removed, the remaining probabilities are divided by the remaining total.

若阈值改为0.9，独立对照.en: If the threshold becomes 0.9 — independent comparison

τ=1时AB够；τ=2时AB不够.en: At τ=1, A+B is enough; at τ=2 it is not

前者2项，后者3项.en: Two items in the first case, three in the second

先看最后一行：相同logits，仅温度不同，Top-p的候选数量就可能不同。因此.en: Start from the last row: with the same logits and only the temperature changed, top-p can already keep a different number of candidates. So one cannot filter on the original probabilities one moment and on the post-temperature probabilities the next, and still claim it is the same algorithm.

保留A、B后，还要重新归一化。τ=1时A约0.731059、B约0.268941.en: Once A and B are kept, they still have to be renormalized. At τ=1, A is about 0.731059 and B about 0.268941; the original probabilities, which no longer sum to 1, are not carried on with.

贪心选择只取最大项；温度零通常是接口选择贪心模式的约定，不是把公式真的除以0。.en: Greedy selection takes only the largest item; a temperature of zero is usually an interface convention for choosing greedy mode, not a formula literally divided by 0.

不要混淆：</strong>随机种子相同也不能抹掉不同候选处理顺序、并行数值误差.en: Do not conflate: an identical random seed still does not erase a different order of candidate processing, parallel numerical error or differences in service configuration. Do not treat a low temperature as a complete reproducibility plan.

相同logits经过温度、Top-k和Top-p后怎样重新分配.en: How the same logits are redistributed by temperature, top-k and top-p

温度1为基线；温度2只作独立对照。下面Top-k、Top-p两步分别回到温度1的.en: Temperature 1 is the baseline; temperature 2 is only an independent comparison. The top-k and top-p steps below each start again from the temperature-1 baseline distribution, filtering and normalizing on their own; the result of one row is not fed into the next.

，只做Top-k=2；保留前两个，丢第三个.en: , with only top-k=2 applied; keep the first two, drop the third

再次独立回到温度1的原概率（不接续Top-k），按降序累计0.665241、0..en: Again independently back to the temperature-1 probabilities (not continuing from top-k), accumulating in descending order: 0.665241, 0.909969

必须保留前两个，不能只留第一项。.en: The first two have to be kept; keeping only the first item is not allowed.

先过滤再温度缩放，或不同相等值排序.en: Filter first and scale by temperature afterwards, or sort ties differently

可能改变边界集合，所以要记录完整生成配置。.en: This can change the set at the boundary, which is why the full generation configuration has to be recorded.

把过程连起来。</strong>温度改变候选相对概率；Top-k/p改变支持集合.en: Join the steps up. Temperature changes the relative probabilities of the candidates; top-k and top-p change the support set. Note that rows 2, 3 and 4 of this table are independent comparisons, not a sequence of executions. Turning sampling off does not remove the underlying floating-point and service differences either.

边界与反例。</strong>不把“温度0”代入除法；贪心是单独策略。显示值舍入.en: Limits and counterexamples. "Temperature 0" is never substituted into the division; greedy is a separate strategy. The displayed values are rounded, while the computation uses full precision.

追问：固定seed为什么仍可能不同？.en: Follow-up: why can results still differ with a fixed seed?

seed控制随机采样的一部分。模型版本、请求模板、工具内容、并行kernel、浮.en: The seed controls part of the random sampling. A change in the model version, the request template, tool content, parallel kernels, the order of floating-point reduction or the service configuration can still change the logits. Candidates that are nearly tied can swap places over a tiny numerical difference; once one token changes, the prefix that follows changes too and the difference grows. Fix the conditions you can control first, and only then discuss how reproducible things are.

追问：重复惩罚能解决复读吗？.en: Follow-up: can a repetition penalty solve repetitive output?

它可调整已出现Token的选择倾向，但复读也可能来自Prompt、停止条件、训练.en: It can adjust the tendency to select tokens that have already appeared, but repetition can also come from the prompt, the stopping condition, the training distribution or the task itself. Repeated symbols and variables in code may be the correct output, and too strong a penalty will break the code. First establish whether the repetition is a content problem or a protocol loop, then choose where to fix it: in decoding, or in the host framework (

追问：是否应该同时调很多采样参数？.en: Follow-up: should many sampling parameters be tuned at once?

不宜从多个维度同时改起，否则很难归因。先选任务所需的输出稳定性与探索程度，固定基.en: Changing several dimensions at once is a poor idea, because attribution then becomes very hard. Decide first how stable and how exploratory the output needs to be for the task, fix a baseline, then change one key parameter and watch the real success rate. APIs and models support parameters differently, so an example from one open model cannot be applied unchanged to every inference service.

工程深挖 · E08 · 接续Q014.en: Engineering deep dive · E08 · continues Q014

温度、Top-p、禁词：为什么“参数都一样”也可能不是同一采样算法？.en: Temperature, top-p and banned words: why may "the parameters are all the same" still not be the same sampling algorithm?

要比较顺序，不只比较参数值.en: Compare the order, not just the parameter values

生成的选择器往往是一串分数处理器：重复惩罚、约束掩码、温度、Top-k/Top-.en: A generator's selector is usually a chain of score processors: repetition penalty, constraint mask, temperature, top-k/top-p, renormalization and sampling. They are not naturally interchangeable functions. If a version upgrade changes the order, the defaults or an inherited generation_config, a different strategy may run even though the two parameters you wrote by hand are the same. What has to be recorded is <strong>the effective configuration and the actual order of processing

固定[2,1,0]，看一次非交换反例.en: With [2,1,0] fixed, one counterexample to commutativity

本例不更换F09的候选或分数。温度1下概率约.en: This example does not change F09's candidates or scores. At temperature 1 the probabilities are about

。若Top-p阈值0.6，第一项已够，只保留A。若先把温度改为2，概率约.en: . With a top-p threshold of 0.6 the first item is already enough, so only A is kept. If the temperature is changed to 2 first, the probabilities are about

，阈值0.6需要保留A与B。.en: , and a threshold of 0.6 then requires keeping both A and B.

所以“先温度后Top-p”与“先按原分布截断再升温”有不同候选集合。后一种若已只.en: So "temperature first, then top-p" and "truncate on the original distribution first, then raise the temperature" give different candidate sets. In the second case, once only A is left, raising the temperature will not bring the discarded B back. This is a mathematical counterexample, not a claim that every library uses the wrong order. When debugging, print the number of surviving candidates, the top items and the probability sum after each processor.

约束把所有候选禁掉怎么办.en: What to do when constraints forbid every candidate

结构化语法、禁词、长度和EOS规则可能同时作用。某一步全是负无穷时，不能继续普通.en: A structured grammar, banned words, length and EOS rules can all apply at once. When one step is negative infinity everywhere, it is not acceptable to go on with an ordinary softmax and then sample after turning NaN into 0. Spell out which constraint may be relaxed, whether to terminate as a failure, and whether to request a regeneration. Constraint priority is a product policy; silently breaking a permission or grammar rule is not an acceptable numerical fallback.

精度误差与策略差异要分开.en: Keep precision error and strategy differences apart

若两个候选分数非常接近，浮点后端差异可能改变argmax；若输入本就相差很大仍大.en: If two candidate scores are very close, a difference of floating-point backend can change the argmax; if the outputs diverge widely even though the inputs were far apart to begin with, check the tensors, the mask and the processors first. PyTorch notes that the numerical result of fused attention can differ slightly between backends.

不要把任何结果不一致都叫“随机”，也不要要求所有硬件输出字符串逐字相同才能算正.en: Do not call every inconsistent result "random", and do not require every piece of hardware to produce a string identical word for word before it counts as correct.

追问：temperature=0等于softmax除以0吗？.en: Follow-up: is temperature=0 the same as dividing softmax by 0?

不能这么实现。产品通常用它表达确定性选择或单独分支；数学上的除0不是合法温度缩放.en: It cannot be implemented that way. Products usually use it to express a deterministic choice or a separate branch; division by 0 is not a legitimate temperature scaling in mathematics. When using an API, check whether that model allows 0 and what it means there; when implementing it yourself, take an explicit argmax and define the rule for ties at the maximum.

追问：怎样给采样模块写稳定测试？.en: Follow-up: how can a stable test be written for a sampling module?

分别测试候选集合、分布归一化、给定随机数的区间选择，以及频率统计是否落在合理范围.en: Test the candidate set, the normalization of the distribution, the interval selected for a given random number, and whether the frequency statistics fall in a reasonable range — each of them separately. A fixed random seed is for replay, but one draw that happens to pick A is no proof that the distribution is right. Comparing distributions across implementations, and one deterministic step worked out by hand, localize a problem better than a snapshot of a whole sentence.

E08：怎样读这份结果，而不是只看“通过”.en: E08: how to read this result, rather than only looking at "pass"

各概率向量共享原始logits，但温度或筛选顺序不同。先核对被改动的条件，再比较.en: The probability vectors share the same original logits but differ in temperature or in the order of filtering. Check which condition was changed first, then compare the sets of surviving candidates; identical parameter names do not guarantee an identical order of operations.

自检：</strong>Top-p=0.6，分数[2,1,0]，为什么先温度2再.en: Self-check: with top-p=0.6 and scores [2,1,0], why does applying temperature 2 before truncating leave two items?

升温后A概率约0.50648，不足0.6，需加B；原温度1时A约0.66524已.en: After the temperature is raised, A has a probability of about 0.50648, short of 0.6, so B has to be added; at the original temperature of 1, A was about 0.66524, which was already enough. A candidate set that has been truncated cannot be restored by a later temperature change.

模型分数和解码策略是两个层次.en: The model's scores and the decoding strategy are two different levels

模型训练后固定地给当前前缀产生logits；生成器决定怎么把它变成下一项。基础课.en: After training, the model produces logits for the current prefix in a fixed way; the generator decides how to turn them into the next item. Lessons 57–58 of the Foundations course fix greedy selection; this lesson explains the strategies with an independent three-candidate worked example and does not treat it as the real probabilities of the worked model. The scores of candidates A/B/C are fixed at

，与基础softmax章节的约定一致。.en: , in line with the convention of the softmax section in Foundations.

先完整算出基准概率.en: Work the baseline probabilities out in full first

贪心选A。抽样用0—1均匀随机数u，按累计区间选择：A.en: Greedy picks A. Sampling uses a uniform random number u in 0–1 and selects by cumulative interval: A

；C其余。u=0.70落在B。选择B不表示算法错误，它正是在按分布允许非最大项。.en: ; C takes the rest. u=0.70 falls in B. Choosing B does not mean the algorithm is wrong; this is exactly the distribution allowing an item that is not the maximum.

温度τ&gt;0时先算.en: When the temperature τ>0, first compute

再softmax。τ=2把分数改为[1,0.5,0]，分布更平缓；τ=0.5改.en: and then softmax. τ=2 turns the scores into [1,0.5,0], making the distribution flatter; τ=0.5 turns them into [4,2,0], making it sharper. It updates no parameter, and it adds no factual evidence. "The lower the temperature, the more correct" has no general guarantee.

τ=0通常被产品解释为某种确定性选择设置，不能把数学式直接除0。本例贪心直接取a.en: τ=0 is usually interpreted by products as some setting for deterministic selection; the formula cannot simply be divided by 0. This example takes the argmax directly for greedy selection, with no division by 0 to simulate it.

Top-k与Top-p不是同一个筛选.en: Top-k and top-p are not the same filter

Top-k保留分数最高的k个候选，再在这些候选中归一化。k=2时基准A/B保留，.en: Top-k keeps the k candidates with the highest scores and then normalizes among them. With k=2 the baseline keeps A and B, and the probabilities become about [0.731058579,0.268941421,0].

Top-p先按概率由大到小排序，选择累计达到阈值的最小候选集，再归一化。阈值0..en: Top-p sorts by probability from large to small, chooses the smallest candidate set whose cumulative probability reaches the threshold, and then normalizes. At a threshold of 0.8, A is short of 0.8 and adding B goes past it, so A and B are kept. At a threshold of 0.6 only A is kept. The threshold does not mean "keep only the words whose individual probability exceeds p".

独立三候选对照：每一步都说清输入.en: Independent three-candidate comparison: the input is stated at every step

固定[2,1,0]，不从其他章节拿未说明的logits。.en: Fixed at [2,1,0]; no unstated logits are taken from other chapters.

除以τ；本基准τ=1，因此分数不变。.en: Divide by τ; in this baseline τ=1, so the scores do not change.

k=2时保留A/B，C设为不允许；重新归一化。.en: With k=2, A and B are kept and C is set to disallowed; then renormalize.

贪心取A；按筛选后的概率抽样时，u=0.70也落入A，而不是原始分布的B。.en: Greedy takes A; when sampling from the filtered probabilities, u=0.70 also falls in A, not in B as it would under the original distribution.

同一个随机数遇到不同分布会选不同项。不能把筛选前区间沿用到筛选后。.en: The same random number picks a different item under a different distribution. The pre-filter intervals cannot be carried over to the filtered distribution.

处理顺序为什么重要.en: Why the order of processing matters

先改变温度再执行Top-p，会改变达到累计阈值所需候选数量。先做重复惩罚、约束筛.en: Changing the temperature before running top-p changes how many candidates are needed to reach the cumulative threshold. Applying a repetition penalty, constraint filtering or length handling first also changes the distribution downstream. An implementation must state the order; recording only "temperature=1, top_p=0.8" may still not be enough to reproduce every product behavior.

四种停止原因分开记录.en: Record the four stop reasons separately

EOS是模型选择了结束Token；长度上限是宿主不再允许生成；停止字符串是在解码.en: EOS means the model chose the end token; the length cap means the harness no longer allows generation; a stop string is a rule matched in the decoded text; cancellation means something outside asked it to stop. A stop string can span tokens and network fragments, so the boundary has to be buffered. A finished model response does not necessarily mean a finished agent task either: once a tool call has been emitted, it still has to be executed and the result filled back in.

流式显示拆成三层：模型选Token、分词器将编号解码为字符/字节、网络将消息分片.en: A streaming display splits into three layers: the model selecting a token, the tokenizer decoding IDs into characters or bytes, and the network transmitting the message in fragments. One Chinese character appearing is no guarantee that it corresponds to exactly one token or one SSE event.

Q091｜模型怎么知道答案结束？EOS、停止字符串、长度限制和工具调用结束有什么.en: Q091｜How does the model know the answer has ended? What is the difference between EOS, a stop string, a length limit and the end of a tool call?

这题先认识什么</span>结束Token、文本停止串、输出长度上限和取消信号来.en: What to know first for this question The end token, a textual stop string, the cap on output length and a cancellation signal come from different mechanisms; whether generation really finished has to be judged from the returned status as well.

第57课 · 从最后一排数到一个Token，再到一句回答</a><a class.en: Lesson 57 · From the last row of numbers to one token, and on to a whole answerLesson 07 · APIs and streaming protocols

结束可能来自模型采样到结束标记，也可能由服务达到长度上限、命中停止条件、产生需要.en: The end may come from the model sampling an end marker, or from the service terminating because it reached the length cap, hit a stop condition, produced output that has to be handed to a tool, was canceled or raised an error. <strong>"No more text arriving" does not mean "the answer is complete", still less "the task is done".

第一层是Token序列结束。模型可对.en: The first layer is the end of the token sequence. The model can assign a probability to the end-of-sequence token (

或消息结束Token给概率并采样，具体标记取决于模板。结束标记也经过训练，不是一.en: ) or to a message-end token and sample it; which marker that is depends on the template. The end marker is trained as well; it is not an independent prover that knows every user requirement has been met.

第二层是模型响应结束。服务可能因为最大输出预算终止；这种情况常有incomple.en: The second layer is the end of the model response. A service may terminate because of the maximum output budget; that case usually carries an incomplete status or one related to length. A half-finished payload (

、未闭合代码块或未完成工具参数不能因连接关闭就当作有效结果。停止字符串一般由解码.en: ), an unclosed code block or unfinished tool arguments cannot be treated as a valid result just because the connection closed. A stop string is usually detected by decoding or by post-processing in the service; it can span several tokens, so the boundary has to be maintained.

这些是不同层对象的标识：工具调用、输出项、请求或响应。用来把增量和结果配回正确对.en: These are identifiers for objects at different layers: a tool call, an output item, a request or a response. They match increments and results back to the right object; they are not the token IDs of the model input, and they are not business idempotency keys by nature.<span class="concept-micro">Two read_file calls can carry c1 and c2; when the results come back in the reverse order they are still paired by call identifier, not guessed by tool name.

第三层是工具交接。模型生成一个完整调用项后，当前推理可能暂停，把控制交给宿主。工.en: The third layer is the tool handoff. Once the model has generated one complete call item, the current inference may pause and hand control to the harness. When the tool is done, the result is appended and the next inference is started. This is one stage of a loop finishing, not the user's task finishing. The returned

就是为了关联哪个调用得到了哪个结果。.en: exists precisely to tie which call got which result.

第四层是业务完成。编码任务的结果主要是当前文件和测试证据，而不是一段“已修复”的.en: The fourth layer is business completion. The result of a coding task is mainly the current files and the test evidence, not a sentence saying "fixed". If the final answer appears but the tests were never run, the files were never written, or the outcome of an external operation is unknown, the task may still not be done.

“输出停止”与“任务成功”要画在不同状态线上.en: "Output stopped" and "task succeeded" have to be drawn on different state lines

本例条件：</strong>独立工具任务：模型先要求写入文件，再需要测试验证。下.en: Conditions for this example: an independent tool task: the model first asks to write a file, then needs a test to verify it. Several stop events are listed below; they are not consecutive steps on one timeline.

本次模型输出不再继续到来。.en: No more of this model output is arriving.

获准动作已产生可核验结果。.en: The granted action has produced a result that can be verified.

用户要求的验收条件已成立。.en: The acceptance conditions the user asked for now hold.

你不能据此确认.en: What you cannot confirm from it

本次序列选择了终止标记.en: This sequence selected the end marker

文件一定已正确修改.en: The file must already have been modified correctly

生成预算用完.en: The generation budget is used up

JSON完整、答案正确.en: The JSON is complete and the answer correct

工具参数生成完.en: The tool arguments are fully generated

可以尝试解析/校验.en: Parsing and validation can be attempted

测试通过并绑定当前版本.en: The test passed and is bound to the current version

本组检查对当前工件有效.en: This set of checks is valid for the current artifact

没覆盖的需求也自动满足.en: Requirements that are not covered are met automatically too

把“模型结束、工具结束、任务完成”设成不同字段，才能避免结束标记触发假成功。.en: Only by making "model finished", "tool finished" and "task complete" separate fields can an end marker be kept from triggering a false success.

长度限制可能把JSON截在半个字段，应该记录不完整而不是把收到的文本强行当合法调.en: A length limit can cut the JSON off in the middle of a field; record it as incomplete instead of forcing the text received to count as a valid call.

工具调用响应结束后，外层Agent仍可能要执行、回填、再次调用模型。内外两种循环.en: After the response carrying the tool call ends, the outer agent may still have to execute, fill the result back in and call the model again. The stopping conditions of the inner and the outer loop are different.

不要混淆：</strong>取消请求不证明远端副作用已取消；取消后仍应核对在途操.en: Do not conflate: canceling a request does not prove the remote side effect was canceled; after canceling, the state of the operations in flight still has to be checked.

四种停止信号在同一段输出中意味着不同事情.en: Four stop signals mean different things within one stretch of output

输入与条件。</strong>教学生成器可能输出文字、EOS或一个工具调用。用户.en: Input and conditions. The teaching generator may emit text, EOS or one tool call. The user wants a file read and the result explained, with a cap of 100 new tokens.

模型选择了结束Token.en: The model chose the end token

文本生成可结束；宿主还需确认业务任务是否完成。.en: Text generation may end; the harness still has to confirm whether the business task is done.

输出匹配预先配置的字符串“END”.en: The output matches the preconfigured string "END"

是界面/服务截断约定，不是模型天然的任务证明。.en: This is a convention of the interface or service for cutting off, not any inherent proof from the model that the task is done.

第100个新Token后仍没有结束.en: Still not finished after the 100th new token

标记达到限制或不完整，不能伪装成自然完成。.en: Mark it as having hit the limit or as incomplete; it must not be passed off as a natural completion.

完整产出read_file参数.en: The read_file arguments are produced in full

只是模型暂停把控制交给执行器，整个用户任务并未结束。.en: The model has merely paused and handed control to the executor; the user's whole task is not over.

才能解释文件；工具参数生成完不能直接向用户宣称读到了内容。.en: Only then can the file be explained; finishing the tool arguments does not let anyone tell the user that the content has been read.

把过程连起来。</strong>生成阶段结束、工具调用项结束、用户任务完成是三种.en: Join the steps up. The end of a generation stage, the end of a tool-call item and the completion of the user's task are three different boundaries.

边界与反例。</strong>具体API的结束原因字段不同；示例描述语义，不绑定.en: Limits and counterexamples. The field that carries the stop reason differs between APIs; this example describes the semantics and does not commit every interface to the same field name.

追问：输出被截断后，直接说“继续”安全吗？.en: Follow-up: after output has been truncated, is it safe to just say "continue"?

对纯文字可以尝试，但必须防止重复和结构损坏。对工具调用不能把半截参数拼成一个未经.en: For plain text it can be tried, but repetition and structural damage have to be prevented. For a tool call, half-finished arguments must not be stitched into an action that is executed without full validation; for a write operation, check as well whether a side effect has already happened. Structured state should be restored through the continuation the protocol supports, rather than by relying on the model to fill the missing fields in from memory.

追问：为什么有时“回答很短”仍花了很多输出预算？.en: Follow-up: why does a "short answer" sometimes still spend a lot of the output budget?

推理型服务可能包含不可见于最终答案的推理Token，且接口对它们的预算和使用量有.en: A reasoning service may include reasoning tokens that are not visible in the final answer, and the interface has its own semantics for their budget and usage. The number of characters visible at the end does not stand for all of the model's output computation. Read the actual usage fields and the response status instead of estimating the bill or the remaining context from the length of a chat bubble.

追问：合理的完成检查是否会让简单任务复杂化？.en: Follow-up: does a sensible completion check make simple tasks complicated?

检查应与任务对应。解释概念不需要跑测试；修改一行配置只需相关验证；有外部副作用的.en: The check should match the task. Explaining a concept needs no test run; changing one line of configuration needs only the relevant verification; only a task with external side effects needs more explicit confirmation and reconciliation. The principle is to verify the result the user actually cares about, not to wrap every task in the same heavyweight workflow.

独立结构对照：另一台七词表微型模型.en: An independent structural comparison: a second miniature model with a seven-item vocabulary

本节主线使用F16训练保存的八词表模型：输入[6,1,2]，结束编号为7。下面的.en: The main thread of this section uses the eight-item-vocabulary model saved by the F16 training run: the input is [6,1,2] and the end ID is 7. The independent structural demonstration below uses a second model with a seven-item vocabulary, EOS ID 6 and a different forward structure; it serves only as a comparison for generation timing, and its probabilities, IDs and cache lengths must not be joined onto the training record above. On a first reading you can skip this comparison.

相关动态过程：<a href=\"../visual/F15.html\">一次.en: Related step-by-step process: How one input connects to prediction, all the way to the end. The rest of this section goes on to show the computation and the engineering limits in more detail.

Q092｜推理模型“多想一会儿”到底发生了什么？与多Agent、CoT有什么关系.en: Q092｜What actually happens when a reasoning model "thinks a while longer"? And how does that relate to multi-agent setups and CoT?

这题先认识什么</span>推理计算预算可能超出最终展示答案长度。更多计算是否有.en: What to know first for this question The reasoning compute budget can exceed the length of the answer that is finally shown. Whether more computation helps should be judged by the task success rate, not by how long the answer is.

第57课 · 从最后一排数到一个Token，再到一句回答</a><a class.en: Lesson 57 · From the last row of numbers to one token, and on to a whole answerLesson 54 · The math that comes before post-trainingLesson 05 · The denominator of an evaluation metric

推理型模型可通过额外推理时计算改善某些任务表现；具体内部机制与状态公开程度因产品.en: A reasoning model can improve its results on some tasks with extra inference-time computation; how much of the internal mechanism and state is published varies from product to product. An ordinary multi-turn loop (

则通过外部工具和多次模型调用增加信息与执行步骤。CoT、搜索、自洽、多Agent.en: ) goes about it differently: it adds information and execution steps through external tools and repeated model calls. CoT, search, self-consistency, multi-agent setups and the reasoning budget sit at different levels and cannot all be lumped together as "thinking more".

区分四种额外计算.en: Four kinds of extra computation, distinguished

第一种是在同一次生成中产生更多中间推理。后续Token可利用前面的中间结果，但错.en: The first is producing more intermediate reasoning within the same generation. Later tokens can use the earlier intermediate results, but an error can be carried along too. More length does not automatically guarantee valid reasoning; how the model was trained and how the task is structured both matter.

第二种是重复采样多个答案，再通过一致性或验证器选择。它使用多条生成路径，需要可靠.en: The second is sampling several answers repeatedly and then choosing among them by consistency or with a verifier. It uses several generation paths and needs reliable aggregation; if every path rests on the same wrong fact, the majority vote is still wrong. Aggregation is a completely different problem for a programmatically checkable question than for an open research question.

第三种是搜索候选状态，例如Tree of Thoughts类方法显式生成、评价、.en: The third is searching over candidate states: Tree of Thoughts-style methods, for instance, generate, evaluate, keep or prune explicitly. What it gains depends on whether the evaluator can recognize the better branch, and the number of branches and the depth both raise the cost. Without a reliable evaluator, the search may prune the correct path too early.

第四种是Agent调用外部工具：读当前源码、运行测试、查询数据库。这不是单纯增加.en: The fourth is an agent calling external tools: reading the current source, running the tests, querying a database. This is not simply more internal reasoning; it brings in new evidence the model did not have. For "why does the current code fail", one correct test run or file read can be worth more than ten times as much reasoning without evidence.

内部推理预算、外部搜索和多Agent不在同一层.en: An internal reasoning budget, external search and multi-agent are not on the same layer

本例条件：</strong>独立设计比较：都要修复一个测试失败。图中一次“模型请.en: Conditions for this example: an independently designed comparison in which each case has to fix one failing test. In the figure, one "model request" and one "tool execution" are counted separately, and nothing is guessed about the internal token content of a closed-source model.

模型服务在一次请求内消耗的推理资源。.en: The reasoning resources a model service spends within one request.

工具执行带回的新事实。.en: New facts brought back by a tool execution.

多个外围执行上下文及其交接。.en: Several surrounding execution contexts, and the handoffs between them.

同一次请求增加推理预算.en: Raise the reasoning budget within the same request

未读文件不会自动出现.en: An unread file does not appear by itself

读文件再发第二次请求.en: Read the file, then send a second request

新增实际源码证据.en: Adds real evidence from the source

仍需要推断与验证.en: Inference and verification are still needed

不同检索方向可并行.en: Different search directions can run in parallel

交接、合并与权限仍由宿主管理.en: Handoff, merging and permissions are still managed by the harness

如果失败来自漏发测试日志，内部多算几步不等于获取那份日志。先定位缺的是证据还是计.en: If the failure comes from a test log that was never sent, a few more internal steps are not the same as obtaining that log. Work out first whether what is missing is evidence or computing capacity.

两次模型请求之间有工具执行，信息集合发生了变化；一次请求内生成更长文本不具备这种.en: Between two model requests a tool runs, so the set of information changes; generating longer text within one request brings no such increment of external fact.

可观察指标包括请求次数、服务报告的用量、工具结果和成功率；不能把模型写的自我解释.en: The observable metrics include the number of requests, the usage the service reports, the tool results and the success rate; the model's own written explanation must not be taken for a real record of internal execution.

不要混淆：</strong>要求模型输出冗长“思考过程”既不是可靠内部可观测性，.en: Do not conflate: asking the model to emit a verbose "thought process" is neither reliable internal observability nor a guarantee of better quality.

更多推理、外部搜索和多Agent：同一问题的三种增加工作量.en: More reasoning, external search and multi-agent: three ways of adding work to the same problem

输入与条件。</strong>任务是找出测试失败原因。候选原因有“配置错”和“测.en: Input and conditions. The task is to find why a test fails. The candidate causes are "wrong configuration" and "wrong test environment", and information about the run environment is missing.

同一上下文内让推理模型投入更多推理预算.en: Have the reasoning model spend more reasoning budget within the same context

可能更认真比较已有线索，但缺失的环境变量不会凭空出现。.en: It may compare the existing clues more carefully, but the missing environment variable will not appear out of nowhere.

工具读取环境与依赖版本.en: A tool reads the environment and the dependency versions

新事实可能排除“配置错”。.en: The new fact may rule out "wrong configuration".

一个读配置，一个读环境.en: One reads the configuration, the other reads the environment

只有两部分确实可独立调查时才可能有并行收益。.en: There can be a gain from parallelism only if the two parts really can be investigated independently.

分别比较模型计算、工具调用与交接开销.en: Compare model computation, tool calls and handoff overhead separately

不能把它们都写成“多想一会儿”。.en: They cannot all be written down as "thinking a while longer".

用相同失败案例和结果标准对照.en: Compare against the same failure case and the same result criterion

多生成文字不等于根因更准确。.en: More generated text does not mean a more accurate root cause.

把过程连起来。</strong>内部推理预算、外部信息和多Agent编排分别改变.en: Join the steps up. The internal reasoning budget, external information and multi-agent orchestration change the computation, the evidence and the organization respectively.

边界与反例。</strong>没有声称可见文本等于模型内部推理，也没有公开或编造.en: Limits and counterexamples. Nothing here claims that the visible text equals the model's internal reasoning, and no hidden reasoning process is disclosed or invented.

贪心第一步最好，不等于两步序列概率最大.en: The best first greedy step does not make the two-step sequence the most probable

输入与条件。</strong>第一步P(A)=0.6、P(B)=0.4。若已选A.en: Input and conditions. At the first step P(A)=0.6 and P(B)=0.4. If A has been chosen, the second step has P(E|A)=0.51 and P(F|A)=0.49; if B has been chosen, P(D|B)=0.99 and P(F|B)=0.01. Only a fixed length of 2 is compared.

第一步先选A，再选E.en: Choose A at the first step, then E

AE联合概率0.6×0.51=0.306。.en: The joint probability of AE is 0.6×0.51=0.306.

宽度2的束在第一步保留A和B.en: A beam of width 2 keeps both A and B at the first step

第二步必须分别使用各自条件概率，不能混用。.en: The second step has to use each one's own conditional probabilities; they cannot be mixed.

两步内最高的是BD，而不是贪心得到的AE。.en: The highest over two steps is BD, not the AE that greedy selection produces.

保留两条前缀就要维护对应状态.en: Keeping two prefixes means maintaining the state for each

缓存、候选扩展与排序增加；这个两步例子没有证明固定束宽能找任意长度的全局最优。.en: The cache, the candidate expansion and the sorting all grow; this two-step example does not prove that a fixed beam width finds the global optimum at any length.

把过程连起来。</strong>生成策略改变怎样选择模型给出的概率，不会凭空改变.en: Join the steps up. A generation strategy changes how the probabilities the model gives are selected from; it does not change the model's own conditional probabilities out of thin air.

边界与反例。</strong>固定长度避免了EOS与长度惩罚；这些机制加入后，排.en: Limits and counterexamples. The fixed length avoids EOS and length penalties; once those mechanisms are added, the ranking objective has to be stated afresh.

追问：推理Token是不是模型真实思维的完整记录？.en: Follow-up: are reasoning tokens a complete record of the model's real thinking?

不能这样推断。可见的解释、推理摘要与模型内部计算不是一一对应的完整审计轨迹。隐藏.en: That cannot be inferred. The visible explanation, a reasoning summary and the model's internal computation are not a complete audit trail in one-to-one correspondence. The exact form of the hidden content and the training mechanism behind it may not be public. Engineering diagnosis should work from observable inputs, tools, outputs, state and tests, and must not take a self-report for the whole causal explanation.

追问：复杂任务是不是一定选择最高推理强度？.en: Follow-up: does a complex task always call for the highest reasoning effort?

先看瓶颈。证据缺失、工具不可用、权限错误不会因强度更高而自动解决。高强度可能适合.en: Look at the bottleneck first. Missing evidence, an unavailable tool or a permission error will not resolve themselves at a higher effort. High effort may suit a complex derivation or a comparison of approaches, but it adds latency and cost; measure the gain on real tasks of the same kind. For a simple, low-risk task, piling on reasoning and extra rounds of review in the name of "rigor" is usually wrong.

追问：模型在当前对话中纠正错误，算学习了吗？.en: Follow-up: if the model corrects a mistake within the current conversation, has it learned?

可以称上下文内适应或行为修正，但普通推理并没有因此更新参数。结束会话后能否保留，.en: It can be called in-context adaptation or a behavior correction, but ordinary inference has not updated any parameter as a result. Whether it survives the end of the session depends on an external memory or a training system. Writing feedback into the history, persisting experience and fine-tuning the weights are three different operations, each needing its own design for storage, permissions and verification.

筛选后剩余概率总和0.91，是否可以直接在[0,1)抽样，不重新归一化？.en: The probabilities left after filtering sum to 0.91 — can one sample directly in [0,1) without renormalizing?

不可以按原样使用完整单位区间；候选概率需要重新归一化，或等价地在正确总质量区间采.en: No: the full unit interval cannot be used as it is. The candidate probabilities have to be renormalized, or equivalently the sampling has to happen over the interval of the correct total mass. Otherwise a random number in the tail has no candidate to match, or the result comes out biased.

FlashAttention：改变中间数据存取方式.en: FlashAttention: changing how intermediate data is stored and read

通过分块和在线归一化等方式，避免把完整注意力分数/权重矩阵长期写到较慢显存；目标.en: By means such as tiling and online normalization, it avoids keeping the full attention score/weight matrix in slower VRAM for long; the target is still the same attention computation, and floating-point rounding can vary with the order of operations.<span class="concept-micro">It does not compress tokens permanently, and it does not skip any Key. Keep "not writing the whole table to VRAM" apart from "not doing this arithmetic at all".

PagedAttention：分页管理K/V存储.en: PagedAttention: managing K/V storage in pages

把逻辑连续的K/V序列存到多个物理块，通过块表定位。它主要改变存储管理与共享方式.en: Store a logically contiguous K/V sequence in several physical blocks, located through a block table. It mainly changes how the storage is managed and shared; it does not replace the attention formula with an algorithm that means something else.<span class="concept-micro">Independent example: logical positions 0—3 are in physical block 7 and 4—7 in block 2; logical position 4 need not physically follow position 3.

缓存保留可复用的旧计算；FlashAttention减少中间数据搬运；分页缓存改.en: A cache keeps old computation that can be reused; FlashAttention moves less intermediate data; a paged cache changes how storage is managed. All three can improve efficiency, but they are not the same algorithm, and none of them should be understood as compressing meaning.

和归一化作用于原有相同输入，残差结果不变。因此第l+1层旧状态不变，归纳成立。.en: , together with normalization, acts on exactly the same inputs as before, so the residual result does not change. The old state at layer l+1 therefore does not change, and the induction holds.

本例条件：</strong>独立两层、严格因果、推理模式例：先处理a,b,c，再.en: Conditions for this example: an independent two-layer, strictly causal, inference-mode example: a,b,c are processed first, then d is input. The parameters, the old prefix and the position rules are unchanged; each layer's cache holds its own K/V.

证明从第一层向后做：旧位置看不到新d，因此第一层旧表示不变；第二层的旧输入也就不.en: The proof runs forward from the first layer: the old positions cannot see the new d, so the old representations in the first layer are unchanged; the old inputs to the second layer are therefore unchanged too, and so it holds layer by layer.

模型参数、模板或旧位置改变会破坏复用前提。“同一个会话”不是缓存有效性的数学条件.en: Changing the model parameters, the template or the old positions breaks the premise for reuse. "The same session" is not a mathematical condition for cache validity.

不要混淆：</strong>双向注意力中旧位置可能看见新增内容，不能无条件套用这.en: Do not conflate: with bidirectional attention an old position may see newly added content, so this causal-cache argument cannot be applied unconditionally.

因果依赖前提已破坏，需要从改动处重算。.en: The premise of causal dependency is broken; recomputation has to start at the change.

把过程连起来。</strong>缓存成立是依赖关系结论，不是因为历史发生过就自动.en: Join the steps up. The cache holds because of a conclusion about dependency, not because something happened in the past and is therefore valid for ever.

边界与反例。</strong>双向模型、跨位置统计或动态位置变换需另行证明；本例.en: Limits and counterexamples. A bidirectional model, statistics computed across positions or a dynamic position transform each need their own proof; this example is limited to standard fixed causal layers.

追问：编辑Prompt第100个Token后，哪些缓存还能用？.en: Follow-up: after the 100th token of the prompt is edited, which caches can still be used?

在相同权重、模板、位置与运行约束下，第0至99个Token对应的缓存仍可能复用；.en: Under the same weights, template, positions and runtime constraints, the caches for tokens 0 through 99 may still be reusable; the 100th and everything that depends on it have changed and need recomputing. What is meant here is the model's actual token prefix, not the identical characters a human eye sees. Changing the system instruction, the tool definition (

、adapter或位置规则可能在更早处改变前缀。不能只把编辑的那个Token缓存.en: ), the adapter or the position rules can change the prefix earlier than that. One cannot simply replace the cache for the edited token and keep every contextualized state after it.

追问：为什么训练通常不直接复用跨优化步的KV？.en: Follow-up: why does training usually not reuse KV across optimization steps?

权重更新后，原K/V不再是新参数对原前缀的计算结果；而且训练需要相应计算图和梯度.en: Once the weights have been updated, the old K/V are no longer what the new parameters compute for the old prefix; and training needs the matching computation graph and gradients. Using an old cache in a forward pass with new weights breaks the consistency of the objective. At inference time,

和固定参数是常见缓存前提，不应把推理优化直接套到普通训练循环。.en: and fixed parameters are the usual premises for caching, so an inference optimization should not be dropped into an ordinary training loop.

追问：哪些模型不能按这个证明直接缓存？.en: Follow-up: which models cannot be cached directly by this proof?

双向编码器中旧位置可依赖后面Token，追加输入会改变旧状态；某些跨Token归.en: In a bidirectional encoder an old position can depend on later tokens, so appending input changes the old states; some architectures that normalize across tokens, transform positions dynamically or modify the history also need their own analysis. Sliding windows, recurrent state and hybrid models each have their own state mechanism. The proof in this chapter applies to standard causal layers with a fixed prefix and fixed parameters; it cannot be stretched into a claim that every model caches the same way.

工程深挖 · E13 · 接续Q025.en: Engineering deep dive · E13 · continues Q025

缓存共享的两个危险：身份不完整与可变对象别名.en: Two dangers in sharing a cache: an incomplete identity, and aliasing of mutable objects

第26课</a>。阅读顺序：先确认运行契约，再看反例与修复，最后检验边界。.en: Lesson 26. Reading order: confirm the run contract first, then look at the counterexamples and the fix, and finally test the limits.

缓存命中必须证明“算过的是同一个函数”.en: A cache hit has to prove that "what was computed is the same function"

K/V来自前缀和模型计算，不是Token字符串的固有属性。同样Token在不同权.en: K/V come from the prefix and the model's computation; they are not an inherent property of the token string. The same tokens can give different K/V under different weights, adapters, position configurations or multimodal features. vLLM's block cache design uses a prefix chain plus extra identity information, and offers a per-request salt to confine reuse to one trust domain.

因此缓存key不是“今天这个问题的字符串哈希”就够。至少明确计算身份、精确前缀、.en: So a cache key is not just "a string hash of today's question". At a minimum, state the computation identity, the exact prefix, the representation layout and the valid positions; fields the server already isolates by namespace need not be repeated in every key, but the isolation condition has to really exist. A tenant salt that limits sharing is not an authentication system: knowing the salt must not grant access to the data.

共享内存如何制造跨请求污染.en: How shared memory creates cross-request contamination

让两请求持有同一个可变列表。A追加4后，B也“看到”4。真实KV是更大块数组，但.en: lets two requests hold the same mutable list. Once A appends 4, B "sees" 4 as well. Real KV are larger block arrays, but the aliasing problem is the same: a shared complete prefix can be reused read-only, while the appendable tail block needs copy-on-write, exclusive ownership or reference management, depending on the implementation.

本书用真实Python对象复现该问题，再用独立尾副本使B仍为[1,2,3]。这个.en: This book reproduces the problem with real Python objects, then uses a separate copy of the tail so that B is still [1,2,3]. The experiment explains the risk of mutable sharing; it does not claim to reproduce any particular vLLM bug. Sharing a full block, appending to a partially filled block, and the lifecycle of release should each be verified separately.

无法仅靠哈希解决的问题.en: Problems a hash alone cannot solve

即便key正确，仍可能发生过期指针、块被回收后继续读、写者遗漏锁、布局改版而消费.en: Even with the right key there can still be a stale pointer, a read that continues after a block has been reclaimed, a writer that misses a lock, or a layout revision that consumers have not picked up. Hash collisions are a separate level; a cryptographic hash can lower the collision risk, but it cannot fix reference counting or a concurrency race.

追问：为什么缓存通常强调连续前缀？.en: Follow-up: why do caches usually insist on a contiguous prefix?

自回归层中某位置的表示依赖之前可见内容。中间改一个Token后，后续很多位置即使.en: In an autoregressive layer the representation at a position depends on the visible content before it. Change one token in the middle and the K/V of many later positions can change, even where the IDs did not. Reusing "the same fragment" without regard for the prefix dependency is wrong; what has to be proved is that the context depended on is the same, not merely that a repeated piece of text has been found.

追问：共享前缀有安全副作用吗？.en: Follow-up: does a shared prefix have security side effects?

可能。命中与未命中的响应时间差可能泄露共享状态存在性；vLLM的cache_sa.en: It can. The difference in response time between a hit and a miss can leak the existence of shared state; vLLM's cache_salt is one design for isolating by trust domain. It brings a trade-off between sharing rate and isolation. Do not assume a performance optimization is inherently unrelated to security, and do not claim that one salt solves every side channel.

记录命中长度、计算身份、块引用生命周期和缓存关闭时的对照结果。敏感Prompt不.en: Record the hit length, the computation identity, the lifecycle of block references, and the comparison result with the cache turned off. A sensitive prompt should not be logged in clear text for the sake of diagnosis. When cross-request inconsistency appears, reproduce "two branches sharing a prefix and each appending a different token" first, rather than only running sequential generation for a single request.

E13：怎样读这份结果，而不是只看“通过”.en: E13: how to read this result, rather than only looking at "pass"

首先核对缓存键是否包含模型、适配器、前缀及位置等身份，再检查两个请求是否意外共享.en: First check that the cache key carries the identity of the model, the adapter, the prefix and the positions; then check whether two requests are accidentally sharing a mutable object. Reuse under an identical key that should not have been reused, and cross-writing caused by object aliasing, are two independent kinds of cache bug.

自检：</strong>Token序列相同但LoRA不同，是否能直接复用同一KV.en: Self-check: if the token sequence is the same but the LoRA differs, can the same KV be reused directly?

不能仅凭Token相同判断。适配器改变投影或前层表示，可改变K/V；缓存身份需体.en: Identical tokens alone are not enough to decide. An adapter changes the projections or the representations of earlier layers and so can change the K/V; the cache identity has to reflect the adapter, or the service has to isolate the corresponding computation space explicitly.

从手算走到API，先核对接口语义.en: Going from hand calculation to an API, check the interface semantics first

公式描述目标计算；API还规定张量布局、mask约定、缩放、dropout与位置.en: A formula describes the target computation; an API also prescribes the tensor layout, the mask convention, scaling, dropout, positions and other details. Many mistakes raise no exception and merely push the result off course. This lesson checks with small, explicit counterexamples instead of judging by a generated sentence that "looks fine".

非方阵自动因果掩码可能对齐错误.en: An automatic causal mask on a non-square matrix can align wrongly

独立反例：已有3个历史位置，新Query有2行，总Key有5行。把q/k设为0，.en: An independent counterexample: there are 3 historical positions, the new query has 2 rows and the keys total 5 rows. With q and k set to 0, every allowed score is equal; taking Value as [1,2,3,4,5] makes the output the average of the allowed items.

正确绝对位置mask第一行读1—4得到2.5，第二行读1—5得到3.0。若错误用.en: With the correct absolute-position mask, the first row reads 1–4 and gives 2.5, and the second reads 1–5 and gives 3.0. Wrongly using a local upper-left triangle, the first row reads only 1 and the second reads 1 and 2, giving 1.0 and 1.5. The two have exactly the same shape.

允许表差异会直接改变结果.en: A difference in the table of what is allowed changes the result directly

采用相应左上对齐约定，不能在所有带缓存情形下直接套用。本实验使用显式正确mask.en: follows the corresponding upper-left alignment convention, which cannot simply be carried over to every case that involves a cache. This experiment uses an explicitly correct mask and compares it with the negative control above.

输入前缀改变会使后缀缓存失效.en: A change in the input prefix invalidates the cache for the suffix

放大图解：输入前缀改变会使后缀缓存失效.en: Enlarged figure: a change in the input prefix invalidates the cache for the suffix

前缀中途变化时，变化处及后缀的缓存需要重算.en: When the prefix changes partway through, the cache at the change and in the suffix has to be recomputed

两个mask，三个位置概念.en: Two masks, three notions of position

attention mask控制可读Key；loss mask控制训练哪些目标被.en: The attention mask controls which keys can be read; the loss mask controls which targets are scored during training. position_ids controls the position encoding while a cache slot is a storage arrangement, and with left padding, a sliding window or paging the two are not necessarily the same number.

本M无PAD的缓存长度可直接用来产生新绝对位置；把这条方便条件推广到所有生产模型.en: This model has no PAD, so its cache length can be used directly to produce the new absolute position; generalizing that convenient condition to every production model leads to errors. With left padding one often has to derive the semantic position by accumulating over the valid tokens, and the details are still decided by the model's interface.

最后一个“物理位置”不一定是最后一个“有效Token”.en: The last "physical position" is not necessarily the last "valid token"

如果批中某句右补了PAD，直接用logits[:,−1]可能取到占位项。不能说反.en: If one sentence in the batch is right-padded with PAD, using logits[:,−1] directly may pick up the placeholder. One cannot argue that it is masked anyway so the result is the same: a PAD position can still have its own query and output. Common generation interfaces therefore require suitable left padding or correct length tracking. The test for this model compares the last valid position with the last physical position explicitly, and refuses to treat them as the same thing.

缩放一次、softmax一次、shift一次.en: Scale once, softmax once, shift once

手写QKᵀ已除sqrt(d)后再交给会自动缩放的API，可能除两次。把softm.en: Dividing a hand-written QKᵀ by sqrt(d) and then handing it to an API that scales automatically can divide twice. Handing softmax probabilities to a cross entropy that expects logits computes a different loss altogether. Shifting during data preparation and then letting the model shift internally puts the target two places out. All three problems often "run", which is why one specific cell has to be checked against its expected number.

训练模式的陷阱不是只有Dropout.en: Dropout is not the only trap in training mode

本M没有Dropout，但真实模型还可能有缓存开关、随机重计算、混合精度、非确定.en: This model has no dropout, but a real model may also have a cache switch, stochastic recomputation, mixed precision, nondeterministic kernels and a different attention implementation.

和权重冻结不是同一个开关。每个需要实际确认它控制哪一步。.en: and freezing the weights are not the same switch. For each one, confirm in practice which step it controls.

全遮蔽、过期缓存和边界长度.en: Full masking, a stale cache and boundary lengths

所有Key都不允许时，本实现直接报错；加载新参数后继续旧缓存，测试会观察到与完整.en: When no key is allowed at all, this implementation raises an error outright; when an old cache is carried on with after new parameters have been loaded, the test observes a mismatch against the full forward pass; when new input exceeds the position table's length of 8, this model refuses to go out of range. None of these semantic problems is papered over with "just truncate it".

前缀logits不变.en: The prefix logits do not change

最后logits近似一致.en: The final logits agree to within a tolerance

混入旧版本KV.en: Mix in KV from an old version

输入/目标错开一项.en: Input and target offset by one

CE与手算负log一致.en: Cross entropy matches the hand-computed negative log

先softmax再CE.en: Apply softmax first and cross entropy after

追问：为什么旧KV能复用，旧梯度图却不能无限复用？.en: Follow-up: why can old KV be reused when an old gradient graph cannot be reused indefinitely?

KV复用依赖固定参数和因果前缀；训练step改变参数，旧激活与新参数不再同一次计.en: Reusing KV depends on fixed parameters and a causal prefix; a training step changes the parameters, so the old activations and the new parameters no longer belong to one and the same computation. The backward pass is further constrained by what the graph saves, by lifetimes and by whether the graph is retained. Transplanting the idea of an inference cache into ordinary full-sequence training misses these premises.

Q094｜KV缓存到底节约多少计算，又占多少显存？.en: Q094｜How much computation does a KV cache actually save, and how much VRAM does it take?

这题先认识什么</span>缓存总量要数K和V两份、层数、位置数、KV头数、每头.en: What to know first for this question The total cache size counts both K and V, the number of layers, the number of positions, the number of KV heads, the width per head and the bytes per element. Do not put the number of query heads in place of the shared KV head count.

第36课 · 一排数、一张表和一叠表</a><a class=\"pill\".en: Lesson 36 · A row of numbers, a table and a stack of tablesLesson 40 · What "putting it on the device" meansLesson 58 · KV cache explained from scratch

它避免对整个历史反复执行投影、FFN和旧查询的attention；新查询仍需读取.en: It avoids running the projections, the FFN and the old queries' attention over the whole history again and again; a new query still has to read the historical K/V. The attention in one decode still grows with the cached length, and the generation process as a whole is not unconditionally linear. The memory footprint comes from the number of layers,

、KV头数、长度、头维度和.en: , the number of KV heads, the length, the head dimension and the element type (

O(·)：随规模增长的数量级.en: O(·): the order of growth with size

大O用于表达规模增长时的上界量级，常省略常数及较小项。必须说明哪些变量在增大、是.en: Big O expresses an upper bound on the order of growth with size, usually leaving constants and smaller terms out. It has to be said which variables are growing, and whether the count is for a single step or for the whole sequence. O here is not the attention output matrix. <span class="concept-micro">When the length doubles, the leading term T² becomes four times as large; but the time actually taken also depends on fixed overhead, memory and hardware utilization, so big O alone is no promise of a measured speed.

设模型宽度d、前缀P、生成M个Token。忽略常数，单层对长度T全量前向的线性投.en: Let the model width be d, the prefix P, and M the number of tokens generated. Ignoring constants, the linear projections and FFN of a full forward pass over length T for one layer cost about

。没有缓存，每生成一步都重做越来越长的前缀。.en: . Without a cache, every generated step redoes an ever longer prefix.

仍处理P个位置；每个decode只做新Token的投影/FFN约.en: , as before, still processes P positions; each decode does only the new token's projections and FFN, about

，以及新Q对T个K/V的attention约.en: , plus the attention of the new Q against T cached K/V, about

。M步attention合计近似.en: . Over M steps the attention comes to roughly

的层内计算。相比反复全量前向大幅减少，但不能表述为“KV让attention从平.en: of in-layer computation. That is far less than repeating full forward passes, but it cannot be stated as "KV turns attention from quadratic into linear for ever". Any discussion of complexity has to say whether it is one step or the whole stretch, and whether P is fixed or P and M grow together.

缓存字节数的常用估算是：.en: The usual estimate for the cache size in bytes is:

前面的2来自K和V。教学例：L=32，B=1，T=32768，H_kv=8，Dh.en: The 2 in front comes from K and V. Teaching example: L=32, B=1, T=32768, H_kv=8, Dh=128,

每元素2字节，结果是4GiB；每多一个Token约增加128KiB。若改为32个.en: , 2 bytes per element: the result is 4GiB, and each extra token adds about 128KiB. Changing to 32 KV heads with everything else the same makes it 16GiB. The estimate excludes the weights, page fragmentation, workspace and service metadata. How many concurrent requests a device can really take cannot be found by dividing total VRAM by this number alone.

缓存用字节计数，计算节省另算一笔.en: A cache is counted in bytes; the compute it saves is a separate account

本例条件：</strong>独立配置：batch=1、层数2、KV头数2、历史长.en: Conditions for this example: an independent configuration: batch=1, 2 layers, 2 KV heads, a history length of 3, a width of 4 per head, and 2 bytes per number. One copy each of K and V; cache-block metadata and alignment are not included.

真正保存的KV头数，不是Query头数。.en: The number of KV heads actually stored, not the number of query heads.

已处理、实际占缓存的历史位置数。.en: The number of historical positions already processed and actually occupying the cache.

放大图解：缓存用字节计数，计算节省另算一笔.en: Enlarged figure: the cache is counted in bytes, and the computation saved is a separate account

逐个因子说出含义，比直接背公式更能避免把Query头数填进KV头数。最后乘每数的.en: Saying what each factor means, one by one, does more to keep the query head count out of the KV head count than memorizing the formula does. Multiply by the bytes per number last.

缓存减少旧位置的投影和层内重算，但新Query仍需读取历史Key/Value。序.en: The cache reduces the projections and in-layer recomputation for old positions, but a new query still has to read the historical keys and values. The longer the sequence, the more work reading the cache usually becomes.

因此“开启缓存后生成每个Token耗时完全恒定”不是正确结论；缓存占用还会限制同.en: So "with the cache on, every token takes exactly the same time to generate" is not a correct conclusion; what the cache occupies also limits how many requests can be served at once.

不要混淆：</strong>上述是裸张量大小；真实显存还包括参数、临时张量、分页.en: Do not conflate: the figures above are the bare tensor sizes; real VRAM also holds the parameters, temporary tensors, paging, fragmentation and framework overhead, so 192B cannot be used to extrapolate the whole model's memory.

把一条长上下文的K/V字节数从单位算出来.en: Working out the K/V bytes of one long context from the units up

输入与条件。</strong>L=32层，B=1，T=32768，Hkv=8，D.en: Input and conditions. L=32 layers, B=1, T=32768, Hkv=8, Dh=128, FP16 at 2 bytes per number.

K和V大小相同.en: K and V are the same size

KV头从8增到32，其余不变.en: KV heads go from 8 to 32, everything else unchanged

缓存16GiB，但这不是整个模型显存。.en: The cache is 16GiB, but that is not the model's total VRAM.

把过程连起来。</strong>公式前面的2来自K/V两份，最后的2来自FP16.en: Join the steps up. The 2 at the front of the formula comes from having both K and V, and the 2 at the end from the bytes of FP16; neither may be lost by confusing it with the other.

边界与反例。</strong>按GiB=2³⁰计算；不含权重、页表碎片、工作区和.en: Limits and counterexamples. The arithmetic uses GiB=2³⁰, and excludes the weights, page-table fragmentation, workspace and service overhead.

追问：为什么长上下文decode可能受显存带宽限制？.en: Follow-up: why can long-context decode be limited by memory bandwidth?

新查询计算量相对有限，却需要逐层读取大量历史K/V；若计算强度低，搬运速度限制总.en: The new query needs relatively little computation but has to read a great deal of historical K/V layer by layer; if the arithmetic intensity is low, transfer speed sets the total time. A larger batch can improve the reuse of some weight reads, but it also increases the total KV and the service latency.

峰值算力高不意味着单请求长上下文一定更快，需看实际内核和内存访问。.en: -level peak throughput being high does not mean that a single long-context request is bound to be faster; that depends on the actual kernels and memory access.

追问：KV量化与权重量化是同一种优化吗？.en: Follow-up: are KV quantization and weight quantization the same optimization?

量化对象不同。权重量化主要减少模型参数存储和读取；KV量化主要减少随上下文与并发.en: They quantize different objects. Weight quantization mainly reduces the storage and reading of model parameters; KV quantization mainly reduces the dynamic state that grows with context and concurrency. Error in K changes the attention scores and error in V changes the aggregated result, and both can affect how long-range information is used. Evaluate across different lengths and tasks instead of looking only at the quality of short answers.

追问：Prompt Cache与KV Cache什么关系？.en: Follow-up: how are a prompt cache and a KV cache related?

KV是计算状态形式；Prompt Cache是服务对重复前缀复用计算的一种产品/.en: KV is the form the computation state takes; a prompt cache is a product or system capability by which a service reuses the computation for a repeated prefix, and underneath it may draw on state such as KV. A cache hit has to satisfy the service's rules; a persistent session does not make a hit automatic.

里的cached tokens计费与具体KV物理驻留不是一一可见映射。.en: -level billing for cached tokens is not a one-to-one visible mapping onto where the KV physically resides.

Q095｜FlashAttention为什么省内存？不存完整注意力矩阵怎样算so.en: Q095｜Why does FlashAttention save memory? And how is softmax computed without storing the full attention matrix?

这题先认识什么</span>FlashAttention仍计算同一注意力目标，主.en: What to know first for this question FlashAttention still computes the same attention objective; what it mainly avoids is writing a huge intermediate matrix back to VRAM. Before taking on online normalization, be sure you can shift softmax by its maximum.

第42课 · 模型最常做的算术</a><a class=\"pill\" hre.en: Lesson 42 · The arithmetic a model does mostLesson 44 · Probability, exponentials and softmaxLesson 46 · Attention step by stepLesson 62 · Computing fast and fitting in memory

通过分块和更有效内存访问计算注意力的一类实现。 例：不是稀疏注意力，也不是把旧历.en: A family of implementations that compute attention by tiling and more efficient memory access. Example: it is not sparse attention, and it does not summarize old history away.

把attention计算按块组织，利用更快的片上存储，避免将完整T×T分数和概率.en: : the attention computation is organized in blocks and the faster on-chip memory is used, so the full T×T score and probability matrices are not written back to high-bandwidth memory over and over. It keeps per-query normalization statistics with an online softmax and computes the same kind of exact attention; it is not an approximate retrieval that drops low-weight items.

对一个固定查询，一批分数为s_j、值向量为v_j。维护三个量：当前最大值m，指数.en: For one fixed query, take a batch of scores s_j and value vectors v_j. Three quantities are maintained: the current maximum m, the sum of exponentials l, and the unnormalized weighted sum u.
