，新块分数最大值为m_b。令.en: , the maximum score of the new block is m_b. Setting

关键是当最大值变化时，旧统计必须同步缩放。否则不同块使用不同归一化基准，结果就不.en: The key point is that when the maximum changes, the old statistics have to be rescaled along with it. Otherwise different blocks use different normalization baselines and the result no longer equals the full softmax. For each query, walk the K/V blocks and divide by l at the end. A matrix kernel processes query blocks in parallel and fuses operations such as the mask and the scaling; the backward pass in training can recompute the blocks it needs from a small amount of saved statistics instead of storing the entire probability matrix.

举例：旧块只有分数1和值2，则m=1,l=1,u=2。新块分数3、值10，合并后.en: An example: if the old block has only score 1 and value 2, then m=1,l=1,u=2. With a new block of score 3 and value 10, after merging m=3 and l=

指数函数，将数值转换为正数；e约2.71828。 例：exp(0)=1，exp(.en: The exponential function, which turns a number into a positive one; e is about 2.71828. Example: exp(0)=1 and exp(ln2)=2.

(−2)+1，u=2exp(−2)+10，输出约9.0464。若忘记给旧u乘ex.en: (−2)+1 and u=2exp(−2)+10, giving an output of about 9.0464. If the old u is not multiplied by exp(−2), the output is plainly wrong.

不存完整softmax表，也能把前后块合成同一答案.en: The earlier and later blocks can be combined into the same answer without storing the full softmax table

本例条件：</strong>独立标量Value例：分数s=[0,ln2]，值v=.en: Conditions for this example: an independent scalar-value example: the scores are s=[0,ln2] and the values v=[10,20]. One term is handled at a time; the running maximum m, the sum of exponentials l and the weighted sum o are kept, and o/l is output at the end.

当前已看部分的最大分数。.en: The largest score in the part seen so far.

以当前m为基准的指数和。.en: The sum of the exponentials taken against the current m.

同一基准下指数乘Value的和。.en: The sum of the exponentials times Value, on the same basis.

加入块2，m变ln2.en: Add block 2 and m becomes ln2

旧l缩半=0.5；旧o缩半=5.en: Old l halved = 0.5; old o halved = 5

换基准时两份统计一起缩放.en: When the reference changes, both running statistics are rescaled together

最容易漏的是第二行：最大值变了，旧指数统计也必须改到同一基准。只加新项而不缩放旧.en: The second row is the easiest to miss: once the maximum changes, the old exponential statistics must be moved to the same basis as well. Adding the new term without rescaling the old one does not end up as the same softmax.

l只要一个标量，o按Value宽度保存一排数，不必把每个位置的完整概率都写到外部.en: l needs only one scalar, and o keeps a row of numbers as wide as the value, so the full probabilities for every position need not be written out to external VRAM.

FlashAttention利用分块和在线归一化减少IO；这不表示少看几个Tok.en: FlashAttention cuts IO with tiling and online normalization; that does not mean it looks at fewer tokens, and it is not the same as approximate sparse attention.

不要混淆：</strong>本例证明合并恒等式，不是GPU性能测量；实际速度取决.en: Do not conflate: this example proves the merge identity, it is not a GPU performance measurement; the actual speed depends on the kernel implementation, the shapes, the dtype and the hardware.

两块分数如何不存完整概率表也得到同一结果.en: How two blocks of scores give the same result without storing the full probability table

输入与条件。</strong>固定一个查询，第一块只含score=1、value.en: Input and conditions. One query is fixed; the first block contains only score=1, value=2, and the second score=3, value=10. The maximum m, the sum of exponentials l and the unnormalized weighted sum u are maintained.

旧统计需乘exp(1−3)=exp(−2)。.en: The old statistics have to be multiplied by exp(1−3)=exp(−2).

约9.046377，与对[1,3]做全量softmax再加权相同。.en: About 9.046377, the same as a full softmax over [1,3] followed by the weighting.

只更新m却不给旧u、l缩放.en: Update m but leave the old u and l unscaled

不同块不在同一指数基准，结果错误。.en: The blocks are then on different exponential baselines and the result is wrong.

把过程连起来。</strong>在线统计保留的是计算所需的充分数值状态，不是对文.en: Join the steps up. What the online statistics keep is numerical state sufficient for the computation, not a summary of the text. FlashAttention uses blocking and fusion to reduce intermediate reads and writes.

边界与反例。</strong>这只实现一个查询的在线softmax核心，不是GP.en: Limits and counterexamples. This implements only the online-softmax core for a single query; it is not a GPU FlashAttention kernel, and it proves no speedup factor.

追问：既然是精确算法，结果为什么可能不逐bit相同？.en: Follow-up: if the algorithm is exact, why can the results differ bit for bit?

实数数学上等价，浮点加法次序、累加精度和内核融合会造成微小误差。“exact a.en: They are equivalent in real-number mathematics, while the order of floating-point additions, the accumulation precision and kernel fusion introduce tiny errors. "Exact attention" is mainly a contrast with sparse or low-rank approximation; it is not a promise of bit-for-bit agreement across different hardware. Verification should set a reasonable numerical tolerance and distinguish randomness from numerical rounding.

追问：FlashAttention能代替KV Cache吗？.en: Follow-up: can FlashAttention replace a KV cache?

不能。前者优化一次attention如何计算与搬数据，后者避免下一步重算历史状态.en: No. The first optimizes how one attention is computed and how its data is moved; the second avoids recomputing historical state at the next step. The two are usually complementary. Fast attention without KV still recomputes; KV with an inefficient kernel can still move too much data.

追问：它是否把时间复杂度从O(T²)变成O(T)？.en: Follow-up: does it turn the time complexity from O(T²) into O(T)?

标准密集attention的配对数量仍是平方量级，只是减少内存流量和中间存储。不.en: The number of pairs in standard dense attention is still quadratic; what is reduced is memory traffic and intermediate storage. The speedup differs with hardware and length. Carrying one experimental speedup figure from a paper straight over to your own model and GPU is not rigorous; benchmark prefill and decode separately for real.

工程深挖 · E14 · 接续Q027.en: Engineering deep dive · E14 · continues Q027

在线softmax为什么必须重标定旧累积量，而不是平均各块答案？.en: Why must online softmax rescale the old running totals instead of averaging each block's answer?

真正困难的地方不是“把大矩阵切小”.en: The real difficulty is not "cutting the big matrix into small pieces"

分块后仍要得到同一行softmax的全局归一化结果。每块独立softmax再平均.en: Even after blocking, the globally normalized result for the same softmax row still has to come out. Taking a separate softmax per block and then averaging is equivalent to forcing every block to carry the same total weight, so a block with very high scores and one with very low scores are treated alike. Exact attention implementations of the FlashAttention kind have to maintain normalization statistics across blocks rather than change the attention objective. Different kernels may still end up differing by floating-point rounding.

对已经处理的分数s与Value v，维护：m=当前最大分数，l=Σexp(s−m.en: For the scores s and values v already processed, maintain: m=the current maximum score, l=Σexp(s−m), o=Σexp(s−m)v. o is the unnormalized content sum, not the final output. When the new block's maximum moves the baseline to m′, every old term has to be multiplied by

，因为它们原来按旧基准计数。.en: , because they were counted against the old baseline.

若只更新最大值而不缩放旧l/o，就把不同计量基准的数直接相加，得到错误分布。这是.en: Updating the maximum without rescaling the old l and o adds numbers measured against different baselines and gives the wrong distribution. This is an invariant of the normalization state, not an implementation detail to be dropped at will.

固定高分数反例.en: A counterexample with fixed high scores

使用分数[1000,1001,1008,1007]，Value依次[1,0]、[.en: With scores [1000,1001,1008,1007] and values [1,0], [0,1], [2,0], [0,2] in order, the whole-row result is about [1.461030,0.538059]. Normalizing the two blocks separately and then averaging gives [0.865529,0.634471], which is plainly not equivalent.

本书程序以块长1、2、3、4分别累计，均与全行稳定softmax在1e−12范围.en: The program shipped with this book accumulates with block lengths of 1, 2, 3 and 4, and each agrees with the stable whole-row softmax to within 1e−12. The test deliberately uses input whose per-block maximum grows sharply from one block to the next; if every block had the same maximum, a missing rescaling could stay hidden.

掩码和混合精度还要额外检查.en: Masking and mixed precision need extra checks

含全遮蔽块时不能把无穷差变成NaN；须明确这块不贡献统计。最终全遮蔽行仍按E04.en: When a block is fully masked, the difference of infinities must not be allowed to become NaN; it has to be stated that this block contributes nothing to the statistics. A row that is fully masked in the end is still handled as in E04. With FP16 or BF16 input, the precision used for the intermediate statistics affects both the result and the cost; do not infer bit-for-bit agreement on a GPU from this book's double-precision Python results.

追问：正确分块一定更快吗？.en: Follow-up: is correct blocking always faster?

不。CPU小数组上的解释性实现可能更慢。加速依赖设备存储层级、并行组织和内核融合.en: No. An interpreted implementation on small CPU arrays can be slower. Speedup depends on the device's memory hierarchy, on how parallelism is organized and on kernel fusion; verifying correctness and benchmarking performance are two different jobs. A report has to list the device, the dtype, the length, the batch, the mask, the forward and backward passes and the memory together, not just "n times faster".

追问：既然不保存完整权重，反向怎么求梯度？.en: Follow-up: if the full weights are not stored, how does the backward pass obtain its gradients?

实现可保留必要统计并在反向重算局部块，换取更低中间存储。必须查看所用内核保存了什.en: An implementation can keep the necessary statistics and recompute local blocks on the backward pass, trading that for lower intermediate storage. You have to look at what the kernel you use saves and how it restores things; "no big matrix" does not mean there is too little gradient information, nor that the backward pass needs no extra computation.

E14：怎样读这份结果，而不是只看“通过”.en: E14: how to read this result, rather than only looking at "pass"

不同块的指数可能使用不同最大值作为基准。合并前要把旧的分母和加权和一起换到新基准.en: The exponentials in different blocks may use different maxima as their baseline. Before merging, move the old denominator and the old weighted sum onto the new baseline together; averaging the blocks' answers directly ignores how much probability mass each block really has.

自检：</strong>新块把最大分数从1提高到10时，旧l/o是否可以原样保留.en: Self-check: when a new block raises the maximum score from 1 to 10, can the old l and o be kept as they are?

不能。旧累积量按exp(s−1)计数，新块按exp(s−10)计数；必须将旧l/.en: No. The old accumulations are counted as exp(s−1) and the new block as exp(s−10); the old l and o have to be multiplied by exp(1−10) so that both are on one baseline before they are added.

Q096｜PagedAttention的“分页”具体分页什么？为什么能提升并发？.en: Q096｜What exactly does PagedAttention "page"? And why does it raise concurrency?

这题先认识什么</span>分页让逻辑连续的缓存放在物理分块中；页表记录映射，共.en: What to know first for this question Paging puts a logically contiguous cache into physical blocks; a page table records the mapping, and a shared prefix has to take copy-on-write into account. It is not a summary that deletes historical tokens.

第40课 · “放到设备”是什么</a><a class=\"pill\" hr.en: Lesson 40 · What "putting it on the device" meansLesson 58 · KV cache explained from scratchLesson 62 · Computing fast and fitting in memory

分页把每条序列逻辑上连续的KV分为固定大小块，映射到物理KV块池。序列增长时按需.en: Paging divides each sequence's logically contiguous KV into fixed-size blocks mapped onto a pool of physical KV blocks. Blocks are allocated on demand as the sequence grows, so no large contiguous stretch of VRAM has to be reserved; several requests and a shared prefix can use memory more flexibly. It mainly changes how KV is stored, managed and addressed; it does not change the order of tokens the model sees.

一个块大小为4的例子.en: An example with a block size of 4

请求A已有10个Token，需要3个逻辑块。块表可能是.en: Request A already has 10 tokens and needs 3 logical blocks. The block table might be

，分别指向物理块7、2、19。逻辑位置5位于逻辑块1、块内偏移1，实际访问物理块.en: , pointing at physical blocks 7, 2 and 19 respectively. Logical position 5 lies in logical block 1 at offset 1 within the block, and the access actually goes to offset 1 of physical block 2. Appending A's 11th and 12th tokens fills block 19; only the 13th token needs a new block.

请求B可以使用物理块3、15，完全不必与A连续。请求结束时释放引用，块回到池中。.en: Request B can use physical blocks 3 and 15, with no need to be contiguous with A at all. When a request ends, its references are released and the blocks return to the pool. The last block may have internal fragmentation, but that is usually easier to control than reserving a large stretch per request for the maximum length. The kernel uses the block table to access K/V along the logical sequence, and the positions, lengths and mask all have to stay correct.

若A、B有完全相同前缀，可在满足实现规则时共享前缀块并增加引用计数。对共享的未满.en: If A and B have exactly the same prefix, the prefix blocks can be shared with an increased reference count wherever the implementation's rules allow. Writing a new token into a shared, partially filled last block may require copy-on-write; otherwise A's append contaminates B. The prefix hash also has to carry enough information to distinguish the effective identity — the model, the token prefix, the adapter and so on — and sharing must not go by the human input text alone.

分页改变物理存放，不改变Token的逻辑次序.en: Paging changes physical placement, not the logical order of the tokens

本例条件：</strong>独立KV分配例：每块容纳2个位置，序列有5个位置；逻.en: Conditions for this example: an independent KV allocation example: each block holds 2 positions and the sequence has 5 positions; logical blocks 0/1/2 map to physical blocks 6/1/9 respectively.

Token在这条序列里的顺序。.en: The token's order within this sequence.

显存里实际可分配的存储单元。.en: The unit of storage that can actually be allocated in VRAM.

一个Token在当前块的第几格。.en: Which slot in the current block a token sits in.

放大图解：分页改变物理存放，不改变Token的逻辑次序.en: Enlarged figure: paging changes the physical placement, not the logical order of the tokens

逻辑块 + 块内偏移.en: Logical block + offset inside the block

物理块9，第0格；另一格闲置.en: Physical block 9, cell 0; the other cell is idle

按位置2读取时，先算整除2得到逻辑块1，再查映射得到物理块1。物理编号小并不表示.en: To read position 2, first divide by 2 as integers to get logical block 1, then look the mapping up to get physical block 1. A low physical number does not mean it came earlier.

这条序列不需要占一整段连续大空间；结束后可以按块释放。共享前缀还需要引用计数和写.en: This sequence does not need one large contiguous stretch of space; once it ends, it can be released block by block. A shared prefix also needs semantics such as reference counting and copy-on-write.

分页主要改内存管理。位置规则、可见范围和Key/Value内容仍必须对应原序列，.en: Paging mainly changes memory management. The position rules, the visible range and the Key/Value contents must still match the original sequence; tokens must not be reordered because the storage is scattered.

不要混淆：</strong>最后一块只用了半块，仍有内部碎片。分页不是零浪费，也.en: Do not conflate: the last block is only half used, so there is still internal fragmentation. Paging is not zero waste, and it is not ordinary disk swap standing in for VRAM.

页表把逻辑位置5映射到哪个物理格子.en: Which physical slot the page table maps logical position 5 to

输入与条件。</strong>每块容纳4个Token。请求A已有10个位置0—9.en: Input and conditions. Each block holds 4 tokens. Request A already has 10 positions, 0–9, and its logical blocks map to

A的逻辑块1对应物理块2.en: A's logical block 1 corresponds to physical block 2

访问物理块2、偏移1，而不是物理位置5。.en: Access physical block 2 at offset 1, not physical position 5.

填满物理块19的偏移2、3。.en: They fill offsets 2 and 3 of physical block 19.

这时才分配新块。.en: Only now is a new block allocated.

A/B共享未满末块后各写不同Token.en: A and B share a partially filled last block and then each writes a different token

需按实现复制共享块或分离写入，不能互相覆盖。.en: Depending on the implementation, the shared block has to be copied or the writes separated; they must not overwrite each other.

把过程连起来。</strong>页表改变存放位置，不改变模型逻辑上的Token顺.en: Join the steps up. The page table changes where things are stored; it does not change the model's logical token order or its causal positions.

边界与反例。</strong>物理块号是假想编号；块大小、共享粒度、内核访问策略.en: Limits and counterexamples. The physical block numbers are imaginary; the block size, the granularity of sharing and the kernel's access strategy all depend on the implementation.

追问：为什么块越小不一定越好？.en: Follow-up: why is a smaller block not necessarily better?

小块减少尾部碎片，却增加块表、寻址和管理成本；大块减少元数据但浪费更多尾部空间。.en: Small blocks reduce tail fragmentation but raise the cost of the block table, of addressing and of management; large blocks reduce metadata but waste more space at the tail. The best size depends on the length distribution, the kernel and the device. Paging is not free operating-system magic; it is a concrete trade-off in data layout.

追问：内存不够时，服务可以怎样处理？.en: Follow-up: what can a service do when memory runs short?

可以暂停/抢占部分请求、把状态移到其他存储、重新计算前缀，或拒绝新请求。每种策略.en: It can pause or preempt some requests, move state to other storage, recompute the prefix, or refuse new requests. Each policy affects tail latency and throughput. Simply raising the maximum concurrency can trigger repeated swapping out and recomputation, making everything slower overall. Watch KV occupancy, the number of preemptions, queuing time and the rate of successful completion.

追问：PagedAttention是否等于Prefix Caching？.en: Follow-up: is PagedAttention the same as prefix caching?

分页提供适合共享与管理的基础设施，前缀缓存决定何时识别、保留和复用相同前缀。二者.en: Paging provides infrastructure suited to sharing and management, while prefix caching decides when an identical prefix is recognized, retained and reused. The two are related but distinct: one can page without caching across requests, and prefix reuse can be implemented with other memory management as well. Do not credit one mechanism's gains to the other's name.

一项测试与同一个错误实现计算出的“预期值”一致，能证明正确吗？.en: If a test agrees with an "expected value" computed by the same faulty implementation, does that prove correctness?

不能。预期值要有独立依据。本包采用手写解析反向、autograd、有限差分与标准.en: No. An expected value needs an independent basis. This package uses several paths — a hand-written analytic backward pass, autograd, finite differences and the standard library's forward pass — and adds negative controls that are deliberately misaligned, but the coverage is still limited to the structures and inputs explicitly tested.

Parallelism may save wall-clock time and it may also add communication; higher throughput is no guarantee that any one person's response comes back faster.

模型前向只是服务的一部分。一个请求在队列等待多久、与谁一起执行、KV是否被抢占、.en: The model's forward pass is only one part of serving. How long a request waits in the queue, which other requests it runs with, whether its KV gets preempted, and when the output comes back all decide the speed the user feels.

先把单个请求的等待时间和整个服务的吞吐分开。下图用相同服务槽位、相同请求长度比较.en: Separate one request's waiting time from the throughput of the whole service first. 延迟、后续Token间隔和总体吞吐。.en: , the interval between later tokens and overall throughput.

A需要生成100Token，B只需5Token。静态batch中B很快完成，但A.en: A needs to generate 100 tokens, B only 5. In a static batch B finishes quickly, but it may go on holding its fixed batch slot while A has not finished. Iteration-level scheduling lets C in once B finishes; C completes its prefill first and then joins the later decode steps. If D suddenly arrives with an extremely long prompt, doing its prefill in one go may occupy a fairly long amount of

时间，使A/C的Token输出停顿。.en: time, stalling the token output of A and C.

Chunked prefill把D的输入分块处理，使调度器可在块间安排已有请求D.en: Chunked prefill processes D's input in chunks, so the scheduler can fit decode steps for existing requests between the chunks. This reduces some blocking, but D needs more scheduling rounds to build its complete prefix, and scheduling and cache management become more complex. How a particular engine blends prefill with decode, and how large the token budget per round is, are version and configuration behavior, not one algorithm shared by every service.

调度器常同时受最大batch Token数、KV容量、队列优先级和请求长度约束。.en: A scheduler is usually constrained at the same time by the maximum batch token count, KV capacity, queue priority and request length. Limiting by the number of requests alone is not enough: a 100-token request and a 100k-token request cost very different resources. It also has to keep short tasks from jumping the queue forever and starving the long ones.

连续组批把空出来的槽给新请求，但调度步不等于等长时间.en: Continuous batching gives a freed slot to a new request, but a scheduling step is not an equal length of time

本例条件：</strong>独立离散调度例：两个decode槽；A还需1个Tok.en: Conditions for this example: an independent discrete scheduling example: two decode slots; A still needs 1 token, B still needs 3 tokens, and C is ready and needs 2 tokens. This figure compares by scheduling step only and does not simulate prefill time.

某次调度可一起处理的一条序列位置。.en: One sequence position that a single scheduling step can process together with the others.

满足这条请求的停止条件。.en: This request's stopping condition is satisfied.

不必等待同批所有请求都结束。.en: There is no need to wait for every request in the batch to finish.

放大图解：连续组批把空出来的槽给新请求，但调度步不等于等长时间.en: Enlarged figure: continuous batching gives a freed slot to a new request, but a scheduling step is not an equal span of time

A生成最后一项，结束.en: A generates its last item and finishes

固定整批策略在A结束后可能让槽0等B；连续组批让C利用这个空档，提高设备利用率。.en: With a fixed whole-batch policy, slot 0 may wait for B after A finishes; continuous batching lets C use that gap, which raises device utilization.

这里故意把C设为已经完成prefill，否则加入C还要处理长输入，可能挤占正在d.en: C is deliberately set here to have finished prefill; otherwise admitting C would also mean handling a long input, which could crowd out B while it is decoding. Real scheduling has to deal with that interference.

比较性能要同时看吞吐、首Token等待与每Token间隔；总体多做了任务，某个短.en: Comparing performance means looking at throughput, the wait for the first token and the interval per token together; more tasks may be done overall while one short request is still slowed by queueing.

不要混淆：</strong>图中三步等高是示意，不表示每步毫秒数相同，更不是产品.en: Do not conflate: the three steps being drawn the same height is schematic; it does not mean each step takes the same number of milliseconds, still less that this is a measured speed-up of a product.

请求B结束后，下一轮怎样把空位交给C.en: After request B finishes, how the free slot is handed to C in the next round

输入与条件。</strong>教学调度器最多同时放2个请求。A还要生成3个Tok.en: Input and conditions. The teaching scheduler holds at most 2 requests at a time. A still has 3 tokens to generate, B has 1 left, and C is in the queue. In each decode round every active request generates at most 1 token.

A剩2个，B生成完并退出。.en: A has 2 left; B finishes generating and exits.

释放B的请求槽位和不再需要的缓存.en: Release B's request slot and the cache that is no longer needed

C可以进入，不必等A结束。.en: C can enter without waiting for A to finish.

处理A及已完成prefill的C.en: Process A, and C whose prefill is done

A剩1个，C取得自己的第1个输出。.en: A has 1 left; C gets its own 1st output.

若C的prefill一次占用很长时间.en: If C's prefill occupies the device for a long time in one go

A的下一个输出可能等待，形成prefill对decode的干扰。.en: A's next output may have to wait, which is prefill interfering with decode.

把C的prefill分段，并在合适边界调度.en: Split C's prefill into segments and schedule at suitable boundaries

可控制等待，但会引入调度与吞吐取舍。.en: The waiting can be controlled, but it brings in a scheduling and throughput trade-off.

把过程连起来。</strong>连续批处理更新的是轮间活跃请求集合，不能把不同请.en: Join the steps up. What continuous batching updates is the set of active requests between rounds; it must not mix the past context of different requests together.

边界与反例。</strong>轮次示例省略硬件耗时与prefill实现，不能直接.en: Limits and counterexamples. The round-by-round example leaves out hardware timing and the prefill implementation, so real throughput cannot be computed from it directly. Chunking and priority are not an unconditional gain.

追问：吞吐高是否意味着单个用户更快？.en: Follow-up: does high throughput mean an individual user is served faster?

TTFT是请求到首个输出Token的延迟；TPOT描述后续每Token时间的统计.en: TTFT is the latency from the request to the first output token; TPOT describes the statistics of the time per token after that; p95 is the quantile that about 95% of observations in a given window do not exceed; throughput is the amount completed per unit of time. Say where the timing starts and stops.<span class="concept-micro">A fast first character does not mean a fast task: tool execution may still take a long time. Nor does theoretical peak throughput equal the latency one user sees.

不一定。更大batch可能提高总Token/s，但增加排队与每步等待。在线交互通.en: Not necessarily. A larger batch may raise total tokens/s, but it adds queuing and waiting at every step. Interactive online use usually cares about the tail quantiles of

首个Token延迟，以及95%样本不超过的分位数等运行指标。 例：平均值正常仍可.en: Runtime metrics such as time to first token and the percentile that 95% of samples stay under. Example: a healthy average can still sit alongside a very bad tail latency.

和Token间隔的尾分位数；离线批处理更重视单位成本和总吞吐。必须先确定服务目标.en: and of the token interval; offline batch processing cares more about unit cost and total throughput. The serving goal has to be fixed first, and only then the scheduling parameters chosen.

追问：能否一次把所有请求Prefill完再Decode？.en: Follow-up: could every request be prefilled first and only then decoded?

这样可能减少某些调度复杂度，却会让已准备好的请求等待后续长输入。相反，完全优先D.en: That might reduce some scheduling complexity, but it would leave requests that are already ready waiting for later long inputs. Conversely, giving decode absolute priority would leave new requests without a first token for a long time. Scheduling allocates waiting under limited compute and KV capacity; there is no single fixed rule that is optimal for every load.

追问：为什么客户端重试可能让服务更慢？.en: Follow-up: why can client retries make a service slower?

若超时请求在服务器仍运行，客户端重试可能创建重复任务，增加队列和KV负担，再造成.en: If a timed-out request is still running on the server, a client retry may create a duplicate task, add to the queue and the KV load, and so cause still more timeouts. Request identity, cancellation semantics and the server's ability to deduplicate have to be made explicit, together with backoff and an overall deadline. A retry is not a free fault-tolerance button.

工程深挖 · E15 · 接续Q029.en: Engineering deep dive · E15 · continues Q029

吞吐下降但GPU很忙：可能是KV抢占重算，而不是算力不够.en: Throughput falls while the GPU is busy: it may be KV preemption and recomputation, not a shortage of compute

第33课</a>。阅读顺序：先确认运行契约，再看反例与修复，最后检验边界。.en: Lesson 33. Reading order: confirm the run contract first, then the counterexamples and the fix, and test the limits last.

请求数不是缓存容量的充分指标.en: The number of requests is not a sufficient measure of cache capacity

同样3个请求，长度[4,4,3]占11个位置；下一步每个追加1个就变成14。若容.en: The same 3 requests with lengths [4,4,3] occupy 11 slots; appending one token to each at the next step makes 14. If capacity is only 12, "it fits" now does not mean it will still fit at the next step. Real capacity is also multiplied by the number of layers, the number of K/V heads, the width per head and the dtype, and is affected by paging, prefix sharing and other VRAM use.

vLLM官方调优文档明确讨论KV不足时的抢占和重算，它可保持系统推进，但增加端到.en: The official vLLM tuning documentation discusses preemption and recomputation when KV runs short explicitly; they can keep the system moving forward, but they add end-to-end latency.

这是检查服务时应该看的具体机制，不应把每次高延迟都归为“模型推理慢”。.en: This is the concrete mechanism to look at when inspecting a service; not every instance of high latency should be put down to "the model is slow at inference".

看见哪个现象，就沿哪个因果链追.en: Follow the causal chain that matches the symptom you see

若请求到达后长时间无首Token，先拆排队、prefill和首次输出；若已经开始.en: If there is no first token for a long time after a request arrives, start by separating queuing, prefill and the first output; if output has started but keeps stalling, look at decode scheduling, the preemption count, the currently active tokens and recomputation. If GPU utilization is high but useful output is low, repeated prefill may be eating the work. Looking only at total tokens/s can also hide the cost of recomputation.

分块prefill不是无代价魔法.en: Chunked prefill is not costless magic

长Prompt一次占住设备，会拖累已有流式请求。把prefill切块可与deco.en: A long prompt occupies the device in one go and holds back streaming requests that are already running. Splitting prefill into chunks lets it interleave with decode, and the current vLLM design describes the priority policy involved.

但块太小增加调度开销，过度偏向decode又会让新长请求TTFT变差。至少同时.en: But chunks that are too small add scheduling overhead, and leaning too far toward decode makes TTFT worse for new long requests. Look at TTFT, inter-token latency, completed-request throughput and tail waiting at the same time, at the very least; one average cannot optimize every experience.

先固定负载中的输入长度/输出长度分布、到达率和取消率，记录容量与抢占；再改变一个.en: First fix the input-length/output-length distribution, the arrival rate and the cancellation rate in the load, and record capacity and preemption; only then change one budget or concurrency parameter. Raising GPU memory utilization, reducing concurrency, adjusting the token budget and widening parallelism each carry risk, and should not all be changed at once followed by "it got faster". Keep OOMs, timeouts and failed requests in the denominator.

追问：直接提高max_num_seqs会更快吗？.en: Follow-up: does simply raising max_num_seqs make things faster?

它提高可并发上限，不凭空增加KV容量或带宽；过高反而触发抢占。若原来设备空闲，有.en: It raises the ceiling on concurrency; it does not create KV capacity or bandwidth out of nothing, and set too high it triggers preemption instead. If the device was idle before, throughput may improve; if it was already cache-limited, things may get worse. Judge by the actual active tokens and capacity, not by the apparent growth in the request count.

追问：前缀缓存命中是否减少每个decode步骤读取历史？.en: Follow-up: does a prefix-cache hit reduce the history read at every decode step?

它减少重复构建前缀K/V的工作；新Query通常仍需读取相关历史K/V。缓存不把.en: It reduces the work of rebuilding the prefix K/V; a new query usually still has to read the relevant past K/V. A cache does not turn long-context attention into constant time. The longer the history, the more storage and reading remain the critical resources.

E15：怎样读这份结果，而不是只看“通过”.en: E15: how to read this result, rather than only looking at "pass"

把请求追加后的总位置需求与容量比较。装不下后发生的抢占和重算会消耗算力，所以GP.en: Compare the total slot requirement after the requests are appended to with the capacity. The preemption and recomputation that follow once it no longer fits consume compute, so a busy GPU does not mean all the work is advancing useful output.

自检：</strong>3个请求当前总长度11、容量12，每请求再长1，为什么不.en: Self-check: three requests currently total 11 in length against a capacity of 12, and each grows by 1 — why can safety not be judged from "there are only 3 requests"?

未来总位置变14，超出容量。内存取决于活跃Token及每TokenKV大小、共享.en: The future total becomes 14 slots, beyond capacity. Memory depends on the active tokens and the KV size per token, on sharing, paging and so on, not on the number of requests alone. The growth from generation and the scheduling budget have to be taken into account.

参数存储、临时激活、梯度/优化器状态、KV缓存是不同对象。训练常为反向保存激活并.en: Parameter storage, temporary activations, gradient/optimizer state and the KV cache are different objects. Training often saves activations for the backward pass and maintains gradients and Adam state; generative inference usually needs no optimizer state, but a long context may take up a great deal of KV.

对于贯通模型，236个float64参数的原始数值为1888字节；同大小梯度再1.en: For the worked model, the 236 float64 parameters are 1888 bytes of raw values; gradients of the same size add another 1888 bytes, and one copy each of Adam m/v adds a further 3776 bytes. This is array bookkeeping only: it excludes activations, framework objects, the allocator and temporary memory, and it is certainly not a measured process RSS.

KV Cache：用内存换历史重复计算.en: KV cache: trading memory for repeated computation of the history

它保存已算的历史K/V，前提是相应前缀和参数有效。长上下文缓存增长会增加显存与读.en: It keeps the past K/V that has already been computed, on the condition that the corresponding prefix and parameters are still valid. As the cache grows with a long context, VRAM use and the amount read grow with it. Do not look only at the 1 new token fed in at each step and assume the reading work is independent of history length too.

FlashAttention：不改变目标，改变中间存取.en: FlashAttention: the same objective, different intermediate storage access

常规概念实现显式形成整张T×T分数和权重；分块算法在更适合的存储层处理局部块，维.en: A straightforward conceptual implementation forms the whole T×T table of scores and weights explicitly; the blocked algorithm handles local blocks in a more suitable level of storage, maintains online softmax statistics, and avoids writing large intermediate tables back to VRAM over and over. It is not Top-k sparse attention, and it is not "looking at only a few positions".

独立在线统计公式：已有最大值m、指数和l、加权Value和o；新块最大值m_b，.en: An independent online-statistics formula: there is already a maximum m, an exponential sum l and a weighted sum of values o; with a new block maximum m_b, take m'=max(m,m_b), multiply the old statistics by exp(m−m') first, and accumulate the new block's contribution as exp(s−m'). At the end o/l corresponds to the result of the full softmax weighting. Concatenating each block's local probabilities directly, without reconciling the normalization constant again, gives the wrong answer.

PagedAttention与连续组批：管理存储和调度.en: PagedAttention and continuous batching: managing storage and scheduling

分页管理把逻辑连续的KV切成物理块，减少为不同增长长度预留连续空间造成的浪费；并.en: Paged management cuts logically contiguous KV into physical blocks, reducing the waste caused by reserving contiguous space for different growth lengths; it does not change the mathematical definition of attention. Continuous batching can let a new request join as soon as one completes, raising device utilization; it also brings in trade-offs between scheduling, prefill/decode interference and tail latency.

量化：近似需要可测的误差.en: Quantization: an approximation needs a measurable error

独立例：scale=0.1，x=0.26，舍入到q=3，还原0.3，误差0.04.en: Independent example: scale=0.1, x=0.26, rounds to q=3, restores to 0.3, error 0.04. A value outside the representable range also has to be clipped, and the error is then no longer as small as rounding alone. Quantizing weights, activations and KV each affects a different object; one cannot infer from "a 4bit model" that all of its runtime memory is 4bit.

量化不保证一定更快：低精度内核、反量化、矩阵尺寸和硬件支持决定实际收益。质量也应.en: Quantization is no guarantee of more speed: low-precision kernels, dequantization, matrix sizes and hardware support decide the actual gain. Quality should also be evaluated on the target task, not judged by watching the error of a single tiny dot product.

激活检查点：方向恰好与KV缓存相反.en: Activation checkpointing: exactly the opposite direction from the KV cache

训练时少保存某些前向激活，反向需要时重算，属于用计算换内存；KV缓存则用内存换重.en: Training saves fewer of the forward activations and recomputes them when the backward pass needs them, which trades compute for memory; the KV cache instead trades memory for repeated inference computation. Recomputation has to match the random state and the side-effect semantics of the original forward pass: the recompute function must not casually write an external file one more time or update state twice.

推测解码：草稿必须验证才能保持目标分布.en: Speculative decoding: the draft has to be verified for the target distribution to be preserved

独立概率对照：草稿分布q提出候选，目标分布p决定接受比例min(1,p/q)。被.en: An independent probability comparison: the draft distribution q proposes a candidate, and the target distribution p decides the acceptance ratio min(1,p/q). On a rejection, the extra sample is drawn from the normalized positive part

补采，配合正确流程才能保持目标分布。直接接受草稿的多个Token不具备这种保证。.en: , and only in combination with the correct procedure does this preserve the target distribution. Accepting several draft tokens outright carries no such guarantee.

验证开销、草稿速度、接受率决定收益；不是多给一个小模型就必然更快。完整算法还要明.en: The verification overhead, the draft speed and the acceptance rate decide the gain; adding one small model does not by itself make things faster. A complete algorithm also has to specify the accepted prefix, the cache rollback after the rejection point, and how an extra target token is handled.

历史重复表示计算.en: Repeated computation of the history representation

缓存内存、过期与位置错误.en: Cache memory, staleness and position errors

大中间表读写.en: Reads and writes of a large intermediate table

相同输入下容差比较＋目标硬件计时.en: Tolerance comparison on the same input + timing on the target hardware

长度分布下的内存与延迟指标.en: Memory and latency metrics under a length distribution

适配容量限制、合并部署.en: Adapter capacity limits, merging for deployment

同数据对照质量与显存.en: Compare quality and VRAM on the same data

目标逐步串行开销.en: The target model's step-by-step serial cost

分布/序列边界正确＋吞吐实测.en: Distribution and sequence boundaries correct + measured throughput

本书没有做哪些性能结论.en: Which performance conclusions this book does not draw

贯通模型只在CPU运行，时间太短、规模太小，不能代表GPU部署性能。图中的形状和.en: The worked model runs on the CPU only; its time is too short and its scale too small to represent GPU deployment performance. The shapes and byte counts in the figures serve to explain the formulas; "how many seconds can be saved" has to rest on a measurement with the corresponding hardware and load. This package verifies some numeric equivalences and state boundaries; it does not pass them off as conclusions about production speed.

Q098｜TTFT、TPOT、端到端延迟怎样拆？怎样用Roofline定位瓶颈？.en: Q098｜How are TTFT, TPOT and end-to-end latency taken apart? How is Roofline used to locate the bottleneck?

这题先认识什么</span>算术强度比较计算量与搬运量，带宽上限与计算上限不同。.en: What to know first for this question Arithmetic intensity compares the amount of computation with the amount of data moved, and the bandwidth ceiling is not the compute ceiling. Latency to the first character and the latency of each later token have to be diagnosed separately.

第40课 · “放到设备”是什么</a><a class=\"pill\" hr.en: Lesson 40 · What "putting it on the device" meansLesson 42 · The arithmetic a model does mostLesson 62 · Computing fast and fitting in memoryLesson 33 · Reading a production run

TTFT是请求到首个输出Token的时间，包含排队和Prefill等；TPOT描.en: TTFT is the time from the request to the first output token, including queuing, prefill and so on; TPOT describes the average or a quantile of the latency for generating later tokens; the total time for a task also includes retrieval, tools and multi-turn calls. Roofline uses the amount of computation and the amount of data moved to estimate whether something is compute-bound or bandwidth-bound, but it is only an upper-bound model and does not replace measurement.

写出一条请求的时间账.en: Write out the time account for one request

在单次生成中，可粗略写.en: For a single generation one can write roughly

，但实际decode步耗时会随长度、batch变化，并可能夹杂抢占。首Token.en: , but the real time per decode step varies with length and batch, and preemption may be mixed in. The first token may come from the prefill's final

，不应重复多算一个完整Decode。流式传输改善感知等待，但不会自动减少总计算。.en: , so a whole extra decode step should not be counted on top of it. Streaming improves the perceived wait, but it does not automatically reduce the total computation.

HBM在此指GPU较大容量的高带宽显存；SRAM相关片上存储通常更小、访问更近。.en: HBM here means the larger high-bandwidth memory on a GPU; the related on-chip SRAM is usually smaller and closer to the computation. Bandwidth is how many bytes can be moved in a given time; arithmetic intensity is the ratio of computation to data moved. <span class="concept-micro">Independent accounting: 100 operations against 10 bytes moved is about 10 operations per byte. It is not a measurement of real hardware performance.

Roofline的简化估算：给F次浮点操作、R字节内存传输、设备有效算力C和带宽.en: A simplified Roofline estimate: given F floating-point operations, R bytes of memory transfer, an effective device compute rate C and a bandwidth B, the time is not less than

小于硬件C/B，更可能受带宽约束。Prefill大矩阵乘通常更能利用算力；低ba.en: is smaller than the hardware's C/B, bandwidth is the more likely constraint. The large matrix multiplications of prefill usually make better use of the compute; low-batch decode often involves a great deal of weight/KV reading and may be more affected by bandwidth. In practice communication, scheduling, kernel launches and cache hits have an effect as well.

教学例：某步需读取20GB数据，有效带宽1TB/s，仅搬运下界就是约20ms；即.en: A teaching example: one step needs to read 20GB of data at an effective bandwidth of 1TB/s, so the data-movement lower bound alone is about 20ms; even doubling the theoretical compute rate would not necessarily improve that term. This example is a unit calculation, not a measurement of any product.

先拆等待、首项、后续项，再问为什么慢.en: Separate the wait, the first item and the later items before asking why it is slow

本例条件：</strong>独立计时例：排队0.2秒，prefill到首Toke.en: Conditions for this example: an independent timing example: 0.2 s of queuing, 0.3 s from prefill to the first token, then 4 more tokens at 0.05 s each. Network and display overhead are ignored.

从请求开始到首个Token的时间。.en: The time from the start of the request to the first token.

后续Token间隔的口径，须说明是否含网络。.en: The basis used for the interval between later tokens; it has to state whether the network is included.

从提交到最后结果的总耗时。.en: The total time from submission to the final result.

放大图解：先拆等待、首项、后续项，再问为什么慢.en: Enlarged figure: separate the wait, the first item and the later items before asking why it is slow

不能把TPOT当整个请求延迟.en: TPOT must not be taken for the whole request latency

若用户抱怨很久没有第一个字，先看前两段；只优化后续decode，可能对这种体验没.en: If a user complains that the first character takes a long time, look at the first two segments; optimizing only the later decode steps may do nothing for that experience.

算力与带宽下界也要分开：计算量/算力和移动字节/带宽只能给粗略约束，不是把峰值F.en: The compute and bandwidth lower bounds also have to be kept apart: computation/compute-rate and bytes-moved/bandwidth can only give a rough constraint; peak FLOPS does not convert directly into real elapsed time.

Trace应包含排队，不然模型调用内部看似很快，却无法解释用户端慢。.en: A trace should include queuing, or the inside of the model call will look fast while the slowness at the user's end goes unexplained.

不要混淆：</strong>一次日志的时间线只解释该次请求；要做容量规划还需并发.en: Do not conflate: one log's timeline explains only that one request; capacity planning also needs the concurrency distribution, the length distribution and tail latency.

首字慢、后续快和总任务慢可以同时发生.en: A slow first character, fast later ones and a slow task overall can all happen at once

输入与条件。</strong>假设一次请求排队40ms、prefill 60ms.en: Input and conditions. Assume one request queues for 40ms and prefills for 60ms, the 1st token then needs another 20ms, each later token comes 20ms after the previous one, and 4 tokens are output in all.

首Token时刻.en: The moment of the first token

只看后续3个间隔.en: Look only at the 3 later intervals

生成结束后还等待数据库800ms.en: After generation ends, another 800ms is spent waiting on the database

用户任务延迟至少980ms，改善decode未必最有效。.en: The user's task latency is at least 980ms, so improving decode is not necessarily the most effective change.

定位反例.en: A counterexample for locating the problem

TTFT从120变500，后续间隔仍20.en: TTFT goes from 120 to 500 while the later intervals stay at 20

优先分开检查排队和prefill，不把所有延迟归因于模型输出速度。.en: Check queuing and prefill separately first, rather than attributing all the latency to the model's output speed.

把过程连起来。</strong>先确定测量起止点，再比较延迟；服务时间、排队时间.en: Join the steps up. Fix where the measurement starts and ends before comparing latencies; service time, queuing time and tool time cannot stand in for one another.

边界与反例。</strong>数值是确定的教学时间线，不是硬件基准。不同平台TT.en: Limits and counterexamples. The numbers are a fixed teaching timeline, not a hardware benchmark. On different platforms the start of TTFT timing may include different network segments.

追问：减少输入Token一定比减少输出Token更省时间吗？.en: Follow-up: does cutting input tokens always save more time than cutting output tokens?

不一定。输入可在Prefill中并行处理，输出存在自回归依赖；短输出节省多步de.en: Not necessarily. Input can be processed in parallel during prefill, while output has an autoregressive dependency; shortening the output saves many decode steps and is often very effective. But the prefill and the later KV reading that an extremely long input brings can also dominate. Cache hits matter too: editing a prefix may force a recomputation of content that could have been reused. Optimization should be checked against the actual

一次任务的执行轨迹与其中有开始结束的操作跨度。 例：并行跨度的耗时不能直接全加成.en: The execution trace of one task, and the operation spans inside it that have a start and an end. Example: the durations of parallel spans cannot all be added up into wall-clock time.

，而不是只数总Token。.en: , rather than by counting total tokens alone.

追问：为什么平均延迟下降，用户仍抱怨？.en: Follow-up: why do users still complain when average latency has fallen?

/P99恶化，长任务被抢占，或者工具偶发超时。平均值掩盖尾部和不同请求类型。应分.en: /P99 has got worse, long tasks are being preempted, or tools occasionally time out. An average hides the tail and the differences between request types. Slice by context length, output length, tool type, cache hit, tenant/region and so on, while watching the sample size and privacy.

追问：哪些优化只是把工作移到了别处？.en: Follow-up: which optimizations only move the work somewhere else?

离线预计算、缓存预热、额外压缩模型、并行检索都可能降低交互等待，但增加后台计算、.en: Offline precomputation, cache warming, an extra compression model and parallel retrieval can all reduce the interactive wait, but they add background computation, storage or load on other requests. The total cost and resource use per successful task should be counted, rather than only watching some local

Q099｜Speculative Decoding为什么能更快，还能保持目标分布.en: Q099｜Why can speculative decoding be faster and still preserve the target distribution?

这题先认识什么</span>草稿先提候选，目标模型验证。保持目标分布需正确的接受.en: What to know first for this question The draft proposes candidates first and the target model verifies them. Preserving the target distribution needs the right acceptance probability and a correction after a rejection; it is not just a matter of whether the two models agree.

第44课 · 概率、指数与softmax</a><a class=\"pill\.en: Lesson 44 · Probability, exponentials and softmaxLesson 57 · From the last row of numbers to one token, and on to a whole answerLesson 62 · Computing fast and fitting in memory

先由便宜草稿模型提出多个候选Token，再由目标模型一次验证这些位置；接受足够多.en: A cheap draft model first proposes several candidate tokens, and the target model then verifies those positions in one pass; when enough of the draft is accepted, the serial calls to the target model are reduced. Standard stochastic speculative decoding uses an acceptance probability and residual sampling after a rejection, so that the final distribution matches the target sampling distribution instead of blindly adopting the draft.

从单步分布推导正确性.en: Deriving correctness from the single-step distribution

目标分布p，草稿分布q，先采样.en: With a target distribution p and a draft distribution q, first sample

；拒绝时从这一残差归一化分布采样，就补回目标缺口。.en: ; on a rejection, sampling from this residual distribution once normalized puts the target's shortfall back.

，三个候选接受率分别为.en: , so the acceptance rates of the three candidates are

，总拒绝概率0.2；残差全在第一个候选，所以最终仍是.en: , the total rejection probability is 0.2; the residual sits entirely on the first candidate, so the final result is still

。本包计算脚本核对了这个等式。.en: . The calculation script in this package checks this identity.

多Token情况下，草稿按自己的已生成前缀提出K个Token，目标模型并行算这些.en: With several tokens, the draft proposes K tokens from the prefix it has generated itself, and the target model computes the distributions at those conditioned positions in parallel. They are checked in order, and after the first rejection the rest of the draft cannot be kept, because the conditioning prefix has changed. The corresponding cache has to be rolled back and generation continued from the corrected position. When everything is accepted, an extra token can also be taken from the target distribution; the exact protocol depends on the implementation.

拒绝草稿时的补偿，才保证目标分布不被带偏.en: It is the compensation when a draft is rejected that keeps the target distribution from being skewed

本例条件：</strong>独立两候选分布：草稿q=[0.8,0.2]，目标p=.en: Conditions for this example: two independent candidate distributions: draft q=[0.8,0.2], target p=[0.5,0.5]. One candidate is proposed from q and then accepted with min(1,p/q); on rejection, a replacement is sampled from the normalized max(p−q,0).

提出概率乘接受概率。.en: The proposal probability times the acceptance probability.

目标比草稿缺少的概率质量。.en: The probability mass the target has and the draft lacks.

最终分布相同，不承诺同一随机种子逐Token一致。.en: The final distribution is the same; it does not promise that the same random seed matches token by token.

放大图解：拒绝草稿时的补偿，才保证目标分布不被带偏.en: Enlarged figure: it is the correction on rejecting a draft that keeps the target distribution from being pulled off course

拒绝补偿后的总质量.en: Total mass after the rejection correction

归一化后只能选B.en: After normalization only B can be chosen

只看接受步骤，B还只有0.2，距离目标0.5差0.3。拒绝补偿正好把草稿过度给A.en: Looking at the accepted steps alone, B still has only 0.2, 0.3 short of the target 0.5. The rejection compensation moves exactly the part the draft over-gave to A back to the B that was short.

若拒绝后直接按原目标p再抽，会错误地又给A一部分概率，因此不是同一保证。.en: Resampling from the original target p after a rejection would wrongly give A some probability again, so that is not the same guarantee.

真实推测解码把多个候选交给目标模型批量验证；收益还依赖接受率与验证成本。这里只核.en: Real speculative decoding hands several candidates to the target model for batch verification; the gain also depends on the acceptance rate and the cost of verification. Here we only check that the probabilities of a single step are preserved.

不要混淆：</strong>省去修正采样可能更简单，却会改变生成分布；不能同时声.en: Do not conflate: leaving the correction out of the sampling may be simpler, but it changes the generated distribution; one cannot claim both "rejections handled however you like" and "the target distribution strictly preserved".

草稿错了仍可保持目标分布：三种Token逐项对账.en: A wrong draft can still preserve the target distribution: three kinds of token reconciled one by one

输入与条件。</strong>目标分布p=[0.6,0.3,0.1]，草稿分布q.en: Input and conditions. Target distribution p=[0.6,0.3,0.1], draft distribution q=[0.2,0.5,0.3]. Only one draft position is studied here; a whole block of parallel verification is not abbreviated into the same formula.

只有第1项有0.4，重采样分布为[1,0,0]。.en: Only the 1st entry has 0.4, so the resampling distribution is [1,0,0].

直接接收质量加0.4乘重采样分布.en: The mass accepted directly plus 0.4 times the resampling distribution

拒绝后直接从p采样.en: Sampling straight from p after a rejection

结果为[0.44,0.42,0.14]，反而不等于p。.en: The result is [0.44,0.42,0.14], which ends up not equal to p.

把过程连起来。</strong>分布保持来自“接收规则＋残差分布”共同成立，不是.en: Join the steps up. Preservation of the distribution comes from the "acceptance rule + residual distribution" holding together; it does not hold of itself just because a large model does the verifying.

边界与反例。</strong>这是单位置精确算例，不含草稿生成开销、全段验收调度.en: Limits and counterexamples. This is an exact single-position calculation; it leaves out the cost of generating the draft, the scheduling of whole-block acceptance and any speed-up gain. Components where q is 0 need the support set handled correctly.

追问：为什么草稿越长不一定越快？.en: Follow-up: why is a longer draft not necessarily faster?

草稿生成本身有成本，后面的Token更可能在前面拒绝后作废；验证长块也消耗计算和.en: Generating the draft itself has a cost, and later tokens are the more likely to be discarded once an earlier one is rejected; verifying a long block also consumes compute and KV. The best length depends on the acceptance rate, the draft/target speeds and the hardware. A shift in the task distribution can cost a draft model that was effective before its advantage.

追问：温度、Top-p应在哪个分布上处理？.en: Follow-up: on which distribution should temperature and Top-p be handled?

接受与残差公式必须对应实际希望采样的目标分布，以及实际草稿分布。若目标已应用.en: The acceptance and residual formulas have to correspond to the target distribution one actually wants to sample from, and to the actual draft distribution. If the target has already had

但比值还使用原始.en: applied but the ratio still uses the original

，就可能破坏分布一致性。贪心推测有相应更简单的匹配规则，不能把随机采样公式和贪心.en: , distribution consistency may be broken. Greedy speculation has its own simpler matching rule, and the stochastic sampling formula and greedy verification must not be mixed at will.

追问：保持分布为什么不保证逐字输出与普通生成一样？.en: Follow-up: why does preserving the distribution not guarantee the same token-by-token output as ordinary generation?

相同分布不意味着用同一随机种子得到同一路径。随机数消耗顺序、浮点和实现可能不同。.en: The same distribution does not mean the same path from the same random seed. The order in which random numbers are consumed, the floating-point arithmetic and the implementation may all differ. The correct promise is equivalence of distribution under the algorithm's conditions, not a bit-for-bit identical string under arbitrary settings, and certainly not that the answer is factually correct.

工程深挖 · E16 · 接续Q031.en: Engineering deep dive · E16 · continues Q031

推测采样拒绝草稿后，为什么不能直接按目标分布再抽一次？.en: After speculative sampling has rejected a draft, why can it not simply draw again from the target distribution?

分布保持是算法约束，不是草稿正确率高就够.en: Preserving the distribution is an algorithmic constraint; a high draft accuracy is not enough

设目标模型分布为p，草稿分布为q，草稿提出x后以.en: Let the target model's distribution be p and the draft distribution be q; once the draft proposes x, it is accepted with probability

接受。若拒绝，需要按与.en: . On a rejection, resampling has to follow a residual distribution proportional to

成正比的残差分布重采样；还要正确处理支持集与总和。这里讨论随机推测采样，不是逐T.en: ; the support set and the total also have to be handled correctly. What is discussed here is stochastic speculative sampling, not token-by-token greedy verification. The original research describes an exact sampling method that preserves the target distribution.

只用两个候选就能揭穿错误.en: Two candidates are enough to expose the error

固定p=[0.8,0.2]，q=[0.2,0.8]。A草稿概率0.2，总被接受；.en: Fix p=[0.8,0.2] and q=[0.2,0.8]. Draft A has probability 0.2 and is always accepted; draft B has probability 0.8 but is accepted with only 0.25, an accepted mass of 0.2. The accepted part is therefore [A:0.2,B:0.2], leaving a rejection probability of 0.6.

正确残差为[0.6,0]归一化，即全给A，所以最终为[0.8,0.2]。若拒绝后.en: The correct residual is [0.6,0] normalized, that is, all of it goes to A, so the final result is [0.8,0.2]. If a rejection is followed by drawing straight from p, the final A is 0.2+0.6×0.8=0.68 and B is 0.2+0.6×0.2=0.32. That is still a legitimate distribution, but it is no longer the target model. The program enumerates the probability mass to verify these two results, so it does not depend on random sampling error.

多Token草稿还带来状态回滚.en: A multi-token draft also brings state rollback with it

若草稿提出k个Token、只接受前r个，目标KV与草稿KV必须裁到正确前缀，再处.en: If the draft proposes k tokens and only the first r are accepted, both the target KV and the draft KV have to be trimmed to the correct prefix before the replacement token is handled. The K/V of the draft after the rejection must not be left in the visible cache. If a multi-token batch is used for verification, check which successor token each position predicts, to avoid an off-by-one.

加速收益从哪里来，又何时消失.en: Where the speed-up comes from, and when it disappears

目标模型可以并行验证若干已知草稿位置，减少昂贵串行轮次。但草稿生成也要成本，接受.en: The target model can verify several known draft positions in parallel, reducing expensive serial rounds. But generating the draft costs something too, and there may be no gain when the acceptance rate is low, the target verification is expensive or the batch scheduling does not suit it. A correctness proof concerns only the distribution; it does not automatically prove the latency got better. Real throughput and latency have to be compared under the same target distribution and task constraints.

追问：只比较最终句子一致就能验收吗？.en: Follow-up: is comparing the final sentences for a match enough to accept it?

对随机采样不行，两次同分布本来就可生成不同句子。应先用有限词表做精确概率质量校验.en: Not for stochastic sampling: two draws from the same distribution can perfectly well give different sentences. Use a finite vocabulary for an exact probability-mass check first, then measure the empirical distribution, and check the cache trimming and the stopping separately. Greedy mode has its own dedicated equivalence condition, and the verification rules must not be mixed.

追问：q(x)=0时p/q怎么办？.en: Follow-up: what about p/q when q(x)=0?

草稿不可能按q提出该x，接受比只需在草稿支持集上的实际提议点计算；目标中草稿覆盖.en: The draft cannot propose that x under q, so the acceptance ratio only has to be computed at the proposal points that actually lie in the draft's support set; the target mass the draft cannot cover is corrected through the residual and the like. An implementation should still check explicitly for floating-point underflow and invalid probabilities, rather than passing a division-by-zero nan further down.

E16：怎样读这份结果，而不是只看“通过”.en: E16: how to read this result, rather than only looking at "pass"

分别看目标分布、草稿分布和拒绝后的补偿质量。这里的输入只属于E16，不沿用其他推.en: Look at the target distribution, the draft distribution and the compensating mass after a rejection separately. The input here belongs to E16 alone and does not carry over from the other small speculative-decoding examples; the compensating distribution has to put back exactly the missing mass, not draw from the target distribution unconditionally a second time.

自检：</strong>p=[0.8,0.2]、q=[0.2,0.8]，拒绝后错.en: Self-check: with p=[0.8,0.2] and q=[0.2,0.8], if a rejection is wrongly followed by redrawing from p, what is the final probability of A?

接受A质量0.2，拒绝总质量0.6；错误重抽贡献0.6×0.8=0.48，总计0.en: The accepted mass for A is 0.2 and the total rejected mass is 0.6; the wrong redraw contributes 0.6×0.8=0.48, giving 0.68 in all rather than 0.8. The correct residual gives all of the rejected mass to A.

Q100｜DP、TP、PP、ZeRO和Prefill/Decode分离分别切什么.en: Q100｜What do DP, TP, PP, ZeRO and prefill/decode separation each split?

这题先认识什么</span>数据并行复制模型处理不同样本；张量并行拆运算；流水线.en: What to know first for this question Data parallelism replicates the model to handle different samples; tensor parallelism splits the operations; pipelining splits the layers; sharding the state reduces duplicated storage. Communication is a cost too.

第40课 · “放到设备”是什么</a><a class=\"pill\" hr.en: Lesson 40 · What "putting it on the device" meansLesson 42 · The arithmetic a model does mostLesson 53 · One training run end to endLesson 62 · Computing fast and fitting in memory

Data Parallel复制模型处理不同数据；.en: Data Parallel replicates the model to handle different data;

Parallel拆层内张量计算；Pipeline Parallel按层分段；.en: Parallel splits the tensor computation inside a layer; Pipeline Parallel segments it by layer;

类技术拆分训练状态冗余；Prefill/Decode分离让不同资源承担两种推理阶.en: -style techniques split redundant training state; prefill/decode separation lets different resources take on the two inference phases. They act on different objects with different communication patterns, so one should not simply memorize "spread the model across several cards".

用一次前向说明TP与PP.en: Explaining TP and PP with one forward pass

可以按W的输出列拆到多个设备，各卡计算部分输出；后续层若需要完整Y，就要通信或配.en: can be split across several devices by the output columns of W, with each card computing part of the output; if a later layer needs the complete Y, that takes communication or a matching sharded layout. Splitting along the input dimension instead produces several partial sums, which have to be reduced.

中间维度如何切分决定何时all-reduce/all-gather，而非所有层都.en: intermediate dimension: how these are split decides when all-reduce/all-gather happens, and not every layer can simply concatenate the results.

PP把前几层放设备A、后几层放B。一个micro-batch先经过A，再把激活送.en: PP puts the first few layers on device A and the later ones on B. A micro-batch goes through A first, and its activations are then sent to B; several micro-batches can form a pipeline, but there are bubbles at the start and the end. Unbalanced computation across the stages makes the fast device wait for the slow one; and inference on a single autoregressive sequence still has to pass through every stage again at each token.

DP适合有多请求/多样本时并行处理；若单个模型装不下一卡，纯DP并不能解决。训练.en: DP suits parallel processing when there are several requests or samples; if a single model does not fit on one card, plain DP does not solve that. In training each replica has to synchronize gradients; in inference independent replicas can usually serve requests independently. ZeRO/FSDP shard the optimizer, the gradients and even the parameters, reducing duplication across training replicas, but they have to communicate to fetch the relevant part when the computation needs it.

Prefill/Decode分离在Prefill设备算完后把KV等必要状态送给D.en: With prefill/decode separation, the prefill device finishes computing and then sends the KV and other necessary state to the decode device. The resources can be optimized separately for throughput and for bandwidth, but the KV transfer can be large: the example in lesson 60 gives 4GiB for a single 32k sequence. If the network is slow, the context short or the request volume small, the gain from separation may be offset by the transfer and the queuing.

分布式的“切开”，要先指明切的是样本、矩阵还是状态.en: The "splitting" in distributed training: say first whether what is split is the samples, the matrices or the state

本例条件：</strong>独立两设备示意。网络含层L0—L3，一个矩阵W可按列.en: Conditions for this example: an independent two-device sketch. The network contains layers L0—L3, and one matrix W can be split by columns into W-left/W-right; everything in the figure is a logical responsibility, and no speed-up factor is given without hardware measurement.

数据并行：不同设备处理不同样本。.en: Data parallelism: different devices process different samples.

张量并行：同一次算子的矩阵分片。.en: Tensor parallelism: matrix sharding within a single operator.

流水并行：不同设备承担不同层。.en: Pipeline parallelism: different devices take different layers.

完整模型+样本A / 完整模型+样本B.en: Full model + sample A / full model + sample B

拼接或规约中间结果.en: Concatenate or reduce the intermediate results

传激活；可能出现等待空泡.en: Passes activations; waiting bubbles can appear

持有一部分参数/梯度/优化器状态.en: Holds part of the parameters / gradients / optimizer state

长输入处理 / 后续逐步生成.en: Handling the long input / generating step by step afterwards

传递KV状态并管理排队.en: Passes the KV state on and manages queuing

DP不一定让单条请求的同一步更快，它更自然地增加独立样本处理能力。TP才拆同一次.en: DP does not necessarily make the same step of a single request faster; what it adds more naturally is capacity for independent samples. It is TP that splits one operator, at the cost of extra communication.

PP让设备分别放不同层，可分担容量；单一微批仍要先过前层再过后层，多微批才有流水.en: PP puts different layers on different devices, which shares out the capacity; a single micro-batch still has to pass through the earlier layers before the later ones, and only with several micro-batches is there pipeline overlap.

同一系统可以组合这些策略，但每加一层划分都要追踪数据移动和同步。只有矩阵尺寸没有.en: One system can combine these strategies, but every further layer of partitioning means tracking data movement and synchronization. With the matrix sizes but no network bandwidth, the net gain is hard to judge.

不要混淆：</strong>“两张卡”不能直接推断“两倍速度”；如果新增通信超过.en: Do not conflate: "two cards" does not give "twice the speed"; if the added communication outweighs the computation saved, it can even be slower.

同样两张设备，DP、TP与PP各自切开什么.en: With the same two devices, what do DP, TP and PP each split

输入与条件。</strong>一个示意网络有4层，每层权重占100MB；不计算激.en: Input and conditions. A schematic network has 4 layers, each layer's weights taking 100MB; activations, gradients and the optimizer are not counted. Two inputs A and B, and two devices.

权重各400MB，一张处理A，一张处理B；训练时还需同步梯度。.en: 400MB of weights each; one handles A and the other B, and in training the gradients also have to be synchronized.

每层的矩阵计算分给两张设备.en: Each layer's matrix computation is divided between the two devices

理想均分时权重各200MB，但层内要交换或归约中间结果。.en: With an ideal even split that is 200MB of weights each, but intermediate results have to be exchanged or reduced inside the layer.

设备0放第1—2层，设备1放第3—4层.en: Device 0 holds layers 1—2, device 1 holds layers 3—4

权重各200MB，层间传激活，微批安排不佳会有空闲气泡。.en: 200MB of weights each, with activations passed between the stages; a poor micro-batch arrangement leaves idle bubbles.

切分优化器、梯度或参数的副本.en: Shard the copies of the optimizer, the gradients or the parameters

不等于简单把4层一分为二，不同阶段通信不同。.en: Not the same as simply cutting the 4 layers in two; the communication differs from stage to stage.

prefill和decode放在不同执行资源.en: Prefill and decode are placed on different execution resources

还必须转移或共享正确的KV状态，不能只移交一个请求编号。.en: The correct KV state also has to be transferred or shared; handing over a request number alone is not enough.

把过程连起来。</strong>并行名字背后是切数据、切矩阵、切层或切状态；画出.en: Join the steps up. Behind the names of the parallelisms lie splitting the data, splitting the matrix, splitting the layers or splitting the state; only by drawing what each device actually holds can the gain be estimated.

边界与反例。</strong>权重均分只作账本示例；实际模型有不可均分模块、通信.en: Limits and counterexamples. The even split of the weights is only a bookkeeping example; a real model has modules that cannot be split evenly, a communication topology, replication and extra caches.

追问：更多GPU为什么反而慢？.en: Follow-up: why can more GPUs be slower instead?

单卡计算变少，但同步、传输和调度增加；小模型或小batch可能通信占主导。跨节点.en: Each card computes less, but synchronization, transfer and scheduling all increase; with a small model or a small batch, communication may dominate. Interconnect bandwidth differs greatly between nodes and within one machine. Compare the speed-up on a real task and the cost per successful task, rather than using the number of GPUs as a measure of capability.

追问：TP度改变为什么可能影响复现？.en: Follow-up: why can a change in the TP degree affect reproducibility?

分片与归约改变浮点加法顺序，微小logit变化可能改变临界Token选择。还可能.en: Sharding and reduction change the order of floating-point additions, and a tiny change in a logit can change which token wins at the margin. Different kernels may also be used. A correctness test should keep the three levels of numeric tolerance, generation distribution and task result apart, rather than demanding that every parallel topology agree character for character.

追问：应用工程师需要实现这些内核吗？.en: Follow-up: do application engineers need to implement these kernels?

不一定，但需要知道配置影响哪个瓶颈。例如.en: Not necessarily, but they do need to know which bottleneck a setting affects. For example, when

延迟由远程工具占主导，研究TP不会解决；本地部署KV耗尽，就应看上下文、并发和状.en: latency is dominated by a remote tool, studying TP will not fix it; when a local deployment runs out of KV, look at the context, the concurrency and state management. The point of going deeper into the principles is to be able to locate the boundary correctly, not to rewrite every layer yourself.

本章分布式训练与并行部分的延伸依据：PyTorch张量并行说明与ZeRO原始论文.en: Further basis for the distributed-training and parallelism part of this chapter: the PyTorch tensor-parallel documentation and the original ZeRO paper.

先问错发生在哪一个边界.en: First ask which boundary the error happens at

“模型输出不对”不足以直接定位是学习率、Attention还是采样。先确认输入和.en: "The model's output is wrong" is not enough on its own to tell whether the learning rate, attention or sampling is at fault. Confirm the identity of the input and the weights first, then check the shared forward pass, and then decide whether it is a training-only step or a generation-only step. Changing ten places at once makes even a correct fix hard to attribute.

由可核验事实逐层缩小问题.en: Narrowing the problem down layer by layer from verifiable facts

编号与词表对应吗？标签shift一次吗？padding与position定义清楚.en: Do the IDs match the vocabulary? Are the labels shifted exactly once? Are padding and position defined clearly?

每层shape、mask、softmax轴与有限值正确吗？前缀是否因果不变？.en: Are each layer's shape, mask, softmax axis and finite values correct? Is the prefix causally unchanged?

loss分母是什么？解析/数值梯度能对上吗？backward后参数未变，step.en: What is the denominator of the loss? Do the analytic and the numeric gradient agree? The parameters do not change after backward — do they change after step?

重载参数指纹一致吗？配置与词表是否同版本？.en: Does the fingerprint of the reloaded parameters match? Are the configuration and the vocabulary the same version?

取的是最后有效位置吗？缓存和全量一致吗？选择/停止规则是否一致？.en: Is it the last valid position that is taken? Do the cached and the full computation agree? Are the selection and stopping rules the same?

这个顺序依赖可测对象，不依赖模型自己宣称“我已经检查过”。.en: This order relies on measurable objects, not on the model's own claim that "I have already checked".

先做哪一个小检查.en: Which small check to run first

loss不下降.en: The loss does not go down

标签/分母/梯度/step缺失.en: Labels / denominator / gradients / a missing step

固定一批数据，确认loss定义、梯度非空及step后权重改变.en: Fix one batch of data and confirm the loss definition, that the gradients are not empty, and that the weights change after step

loss异常很低但生成差.en: The loss is unusually low but generation is poor

偷看未来/目标泄漏.en: Peeking at the future / target leakage

改变未来Token，比较前缀logits；核对shift与mask.en: Change a future token and compare the prefix logits; check the shift and the mask

单条正确，组批错误.en: Correct one at a time, wrong in a batch

跨样本混合/PAD/最后位置.en: Mixing across samples / PAD / the last position

单条vs批次同样本logits对照.en: Compare the logits of the same sample one at a time and in a batch

缓存比全量差.en: The cache is worse than the full computation

位置重置/旧缓存/非方阵mask.en: Position reset / a stale cache / a non-square mask

逐轮记录输入位置、cache长度和最大logit差.en: Record the input position, the cache length and the largest logit difference round by round

前向对上但训练差.en: The forward pass matches but training is poor

梯度分支/共享参数累加.en: Gradient branches / accumulation over shared parameters

固定参数点做解析反向和有限差分.en: Do an analytic backward pass and a finite difference at a fixed parameter point

Dropout函数参数/采样/内核.en: The dropout function's arguments / sampling / the kernel

先固定贪心、禁dropout、记录同输入同权重.en: Fix greedy decoding first, disable dropout, and record the same input with the same weights

更新后重载不一致.en: Reloading after an update is inconsistent

对照参数指纹与完整配置，不只检查文件名.en: Compare the parameter fingerprint and the full configuration, not just the file name

长度结束被当完整回答.en: An end from length is taken for a complete answer

保存stop_reason，不从文本流畅推断任务完成.en: Save stop_reason; do not infer that a task is complete from fluent text

为什么“梯度不为0”远远不够.en: Why "the gradient is not 0" is nowhere near enough

错误分母、漏残差路径或错误mask，都可能产生非零梯度并让某些loss下降。测试.en: A wrong denominator, a missing residual path or a wrong mask can all produce non-zero gradients and make some losses go down. A test should check specific values, relations and an independent comparison, not merely whether there is a .grad.

本包的梯度比较在同一初值和批次上逐参数进行；手写反向使用数学规则，autogra.en: The gradient comparison in this package is done parameter by parameter at the same initial values and on the same batch; the hand-written backward pass uses the mathematical rules, autograd uses the framework's record, and the finite difference estimates from the difference between real forward passes. The three complement each other, but they can also agree if all of them use the same wrong training objective, so the input and the meaning of the objective still need human interpretation.

正确实现通过一个测试，可能只是断言过弱。故意关causal mask、用错误缓存.en: An implementation that passes one test may simply have assertions that are too weak. After deliberately turning the causal mask off, using the wrong cache position, applying softmax twice or mixing in stale KV, the test should observe a difference. That shows the test can at least identify these specific faults.

本书的坏实现仅用于临时本地对照，不会保存成默认模型或混进正式权重。报告里明确哪个.en: The bad implementations in this book are used only for temporary local comparison; they are not saved as the default model and are not mixed into the official weights. The report states clearly which path is the deliberately wrong one, so that readers do not take a wrong formula for a recommended method.

数值容差怎么选择.en: How to choose a numeric tolerance

float64 CPU有利于对照，但不是所有值都要逐位相同。softmax、归一.en: float64 on the CPU helps with comparison, but not every value has to agree to the last bit. A change in the order of softmax, normalization and matrix accumulation can cause small rounding differences; float16/bfloat16 or a fused kernel can differ more. Look at the absolute error, the relative error, the magnitude of the values and the task result together, and keep non-smooth places such as the ReLU kink in mind.

禁止把NaN都替换为0后宣布测试通过。先确认全遮蔽、溢出、除零、数据污染等原因。.en: Replacing every NaN with 0 and then declaring the test passed is forbidden. Confirm the cause first: a fully masked row, overflow, division by zero, contaminated data and so on. Asserting finiteness is where locating the problem starts, not a complete fix.

如何阅读随包结果.en: How to read the results shipped with this book

是一次实跑得到的全链路记录；.en: is the full-chain record of one actual run;

与日志记录本轮测试；.en: and the log record this round of tests;

来自标准库独立前向。页面中展示六位小数是阅读选择，程序继续使用完整精度。.en: comes from an independent forward pass in the standard library. Showing six decimal places on the page is a choice made for reading; the programs go on using the full precision.

追问：哪些变化可以声称保持相同计算目标？.en: Follow-up: which changes can claim to preserve the same computational objective?

在条件满足时，因果KV缓存、正确的分块精确注意力和存储分页可以保持相同目标，允许.en: When the conditions are met, a causal KV cache, correct blocked exact attention and storage paging can preserve the same objective, allowing the floating-point differences the implementation causes; quantization introduces an approximation; Top-k and temperature change the decoding distribution; replacing GQA or the FFN changes the architecture; LoRA training changes the parameters. Identify the type first, and only then is it clear whether consistency, task quality or system performance is what should be evaluated.

显存不够，使用no_grad与激活检查点是否是一回事？.en: When VRAM runs short, are using no_grad and using activation checkpointing the same thing?

不是。训练必须保留或重建求导链；no_grad关闭必要记录会破坏训练。激活检查点.en: No. Training has to keep or rebuild the chain for differentiation; no_grad turns off the recording that is needed and so breaks training. Activation checkpointing restores the necessary intermediate values by recomputing them before the backward pass, and the goal is still a correct gradient.

测试发现缓存与完整计算差异很小，可以直接忽略吗？.en: A test finds a very small difference between the cache and the full computation — can it simply be ignored?

先看误差量级、精度、内核和候选分数间距。若两候选几乎并列，小误差可能改变贪心结果.en: Start with the magnitude of the error, the precision, the kernel and the gap between the candidate scores. If two candidates are almost level, a small error can change the greedy result; if a position or a mask is misaligned, the source has to be explained however small the difference. A tolerance needs its conditions; it cannot all be waved away as "floating-point error".

验收1：用本书的具体词表，把“我爱学习！”变成训练输入和标签，说明哪里防止偷看未.en: Acceptance 1: using this book's specific vocabulary, turn "我爱学习！" into training input and labels, and say where peeking at the future is prevented.

完整[6,1,2,3,5,7]；输入[6,1,2,3,5]，目标[1,2,3,5.en: The complete sequence is [6,1,2,3,5,7]; the input is [6,1,2,3,5] and the target [1,2,3,5,7]. Attention in row t allows only s≤t, and the label does not enter that row's forward pass; the per-position norm and the FFN do not mix across the future.

验收2：从loss写出到Wq[0,0]的依赖，不允许只说“自动求导”。.en: Acceptance 2: write out the dependency from the loss down to Wq[0,0]; "autograd" on its own is not an acceptable answer.

L→Gz=(p−onehot)/10→U反传到最终F→RMSNorm到H→残差/.en: L→Gz=(p−onehot)/10→U back to the final F→RMSNorm to H→the residual/FFN merging into R→Wo to mix→G_A→softmax to G_S→the scaled dot product to G_Q→Σ_b,t N1[b,t,0]G_Q[b,t,0]. The K/V and residual paths for earlier inputs have to be merged in as well; at these initial values G_Wq[0,0] is about −0.002217527833.

验收3：第一次选中学习后，为什么缓存长度3而序列长度4？.en: Acceptance 3: after 学习 is selected for the first time, why is the cache length 3 while the sequence length is 4?

第一次只前向处理BOS、我、爱三个位置。学习只是从输出分布选出的编号，尚未作为输.en: The first forward pass handles only the three positions BOS, 我 and 爱. 学习 is no more than an ID selected from the output distribution; it has not yet gone through E/P and the layer computation as an input. Its K/V is appended only when the next round processes it.

验收4：本次400步loss约0.13948，为什么不应一看到非零就继续强迫它降.en: Acceptance 4: the loss after these 400 steps is about 0.13948 — why should it not be forced down to 0 the moment it is seen to be non-zero?

BOS相同前缀对应等频我/你，十题平均的不可消除歧义下界为ln2/5≈0.138.en: The same BOS prefix is followed with equal frequency by 我/你, so the irreducible ambiguity gives a lower bound of ln2/5≈0.138629 averaged over the ten questions. The data and the objective have to be understood; not every non-zero loss comes from an implementation error.

验收5：模型在GPU上速度提升30%，CPU小模型前向相同，能否证明部署无回归？.en: Acceptance 5: the model is 30% faster on the GPU and the small CPU model's forward pass is unchanged — does that prove the deployment has no regression?

不能。需要核对目标硬件的数值行为、实际批次和长度分布、缓存和模式、质量与尾延迟等.en: No. The numeric behavior on the target hardware, the actual batch and length distributions, the cache and the mode, quality and tail latency all have to be checked. Consistency in the CPU teaching setup verifies only the mechanism concerned; it is not a guarantee of production quality or speed.

09｜Agent一次任务的完整循环：谁在思考，谁在执行.en: 09｜One full agent task loop: who is thinking and who is executing

第03课｜Agent一次任务的完整循环：谁在思考，谁在执行 — AI系统工程.en: Lesson 03｜One full agent task loop: who is thinking and who is executing — AI Systems Engineering

沿着对象与状态理解本章</a><a href=\"#topic-2\">把一个A.en: Follow this chapter through its objects and statesBreak one agent task into the turns that actually happenQ001｜After the user types one sentence, how does the agent finish the task across several model calls?Q002｜What states does an agent have? Why can a conversation summary not replace the task database?Q003｜How do a stateless API and a stateful session each build the next turn's input? Is a session ID long-term memory?Q004｜When should an agent stop? Why does "continue until done" so easily turn into an infinite loop?One answer has finished — so why is the task still not done?Why does every model call need a consistent context snapshot?

Agent是外围程序驱动的一串模型调用。请求、响应、工具结果与任务状态各有自己的.en: An agent is a series of model calls driven by a surrounding program. The request, the response, the tool result and the task state each have their own life cycle; "the model says it is done" and "the environment really reached the goal" have to be verified separately.

第35课 · 先分清</a><a class=\"pill\" href=\"..en: Lesson 35 · Sort the objects out firstLesson 57 · From the last row of numbers to a token, and on to an answerLesson 01 · An agent is not another neural networkLesson 07 · APIs and streaming protocolsLesson 02 · State, events and checkpoints

进入深读前的小检查：</strong>画一次“请求读文件→校验调用→读取→返回文.en: A quick check before the deep reading: draw the loop "request a file read → validate the call → read → return the file → call the model again" once, and mark which arrow is executed by the program and which judgment comes out of the model.

以下使用“修复仓库里exclude不生效”的原创教学任务。它不代表对用户真实仓库.en: What follows uses an original teaching task, "fix exclude not taking effect in the repository". It does not stand for any change made to a user's real repository. While reading this chapter, always keep apart the model's proposal,

执行和环境真实状态。.en: 's execution and the real state of the environment.

把模型、宿主、工具画成不同泳道后，问“谁真正改变了文件”就有明确答案。跟踪每条返.en: Once the model, the harness and the tools are drawn as separate swim lanes, the question "who actually changed the file" has a definite answer. Follow every returned message, then decide whether the model has to be called again, a tool has to run, or it is over; do not take the model saying it is done as the environment being done.

相关动态过程：<a href=\"../visual/F22.html\">把一.en: Related step-by-step process: Break one agent task into the turns that actually happen. The rest of this section goes on to show the computation and the engineering limits in more detail.

继续看相关机制：<a href=\"../visual/F24.html\">第.en: Related mechanisms to continue with: Lesson 02 · Task state is not a one-line summary in the chatLesson 26 · A timeout tells you nothing arrived, not that nothing happened

Q001｜用户输入一句话后，Agent怎样经过多轮模型调用完成任务？.en: Q001｜After the user types one sentence, how does the agent finish the task across several model calls?

这题先认识什么</span>模型负责提出下一步，宿主真正调工具并回填结果。工作流.en: What to know first for this questionThe model is responsible for proposing the next step; the harness is what actually calls the tool and fills the result back in.
