A workflow fixes the route, while an agent loop allows the next step to change according to a new observation.

第01课 · Agent不是另一个神经网络</a><a class=\"pill.en: Lesson 01 · An agent is not another neural networkLesson 07 · APIs and streaming protocolsLesson 02 · State, events and checkpoints

把目标、规则、工具定义和当前证据组装成模型输入；模型返回普通文本或工具调用；Ha.en: assembles the goal, the rules, the tool definitions and the current evidence into the model's input; the model returns ordinary text or a tool call; the harness checks and executes the call and makes the result part of the new context; the model then goes on to decide the next step from the observation. The loop ends on a condition such as verifiable completion, a decision needed from the user, failure or an exhausted budget. ReAct describes the combination of reasoning–action–observation, and a product harness is what turns it into a real execution system.

走完六轮，而不是只画一个循环箭头.en: Walk all six turns, instead of just drawing one loop arrow

模型此刻看到了什么.en: What the model sees at this point

用户目标、仓库规则、搜索工具描述.en: The user goal, the repository rules, the search tool description

搜索exclude入口.en: Search for the exclude entry point

搜索返回路径和行号.en: The search returns paths and line numbers

前述内容＋搜索结果.en: The previous content + the search result

读取实现与测试.en: Read the implementation and the test

返回带版本的代码片段.en: Returns a code snippet with its version

条件分支、失败案例.en: The conditional branch and the failing case

进程退出1，输出断言失败.en: The process exits 1 and reports an assertion failure

实际失败与相关代码.en: The actual failure and the related code

校验旧内容后修改文件.en: Checks the old content, then edits the file

补丁结果与新版本.en: The patch result and the new version

记录命令、版本、退出码.en: Records the command, the version and the exit code

当前diff和测试证据.en: The current diff and the test evidence

每轮输入可以包含历史，也可以通过服务端状态引用衔接，但逻辑上必须让模型知道与当前.en: Each turn's input may contain the history, or may be joined up through a reference to server-side state, but logically the model has to be told the results that bear on the current decision. A tool call is not the model "imagining it has already read the file"; it must really be executed and a real output brought back. The model saying in turn 3 that "the test should fail" is no substitute for the run result.

模型可一次请求多个互不依赖工具，Harness也可能确定性地执行预设检查，因此真.en: The model can request several mutually independent tools at once, and the harness may also run preset checks deterministically, so a real flow need not have exactly one action per turn. What matters is that input–decision–execution–feedback correspond clearly. The versions behind reading a file, editing a file and the test result must join up, or old evidence ends up applied to a new state.

一次任务里的两轮模型调用，各自多知道了什么.en: Two model calls in one task, and what each of them knows in addition

本例条件：</strong>独立只读任务：问config.txt的timeout.en: Conditions for this example: an independent read-only task: ask for the timeout in config.txt. The content on disk is timeout=30, version r7. The file tool changes nothing, and a model request does not read the disk by itself.

组织请求、执行获准工具的程序。.en: The program that assembles the request and runs the tools that were granted.

把工具结果绑定到对应调用。.en: Bind the tool result to the call it belongs to.

真正执行得到的新证据。.en: The new evidence obtained by actually executing.

放大图解：一次任务里的两轮模型调用，各自多知道了什么.en: Enlarged figure: the two model calls within one task, and what each of them has come to know

任务已知，内容未知.en: The task is known, the content is not

问题 + read_file工具说明.en: The question + the read_file tool description

模型有可用能力描述.en: The model has a description of an available capability

只有提议，尚未取证.en: Only a proposal; no evidence gathered yet

下一轮新增了文件事实.en: The next turn adds the file fact

回答草稿：timeout为30，依据r7.en: Draft answer: the timeout is 30, based on r7

第二轮模型输出已结束.en: The second model output has ended

显示已核对的只读结果.en: Shows the read-only result that was checked

任务完成；没有发生文件修改.en: Task complete; no file was modified

沿着call c1追踪：模型产生调用项时磁盘没有因此改变，宿主必须再做执行动作。.en: Follow call c1: nothing on disk changes when the model produces the call item; the harness still has to take the executing action.

下一轮不是只发“30”这个孤立数字；要保留它回答哪次调用、来自哪个文件版本，避免.en: The next turn does not send the isolated number "30" on its own; it has to keep which call that number answers and which file version it came from, so that another tool's result is not spliced in.

这里实际需要两轮模型请求；如果宿主预先读取了文件，可能一轮就够。轮数取决于信息何.en: Two model requests are actually needed here; if the harness had read the file in advance, one might be enough. The number of turns depends on when the information arrives, not on some fixed constant of the agent.

不要混淆：</strong>结果回填丢失时，模型可能再次要求读取。应先查消息装配.en: Do not conflate: when the result is not filled back in, the model may ask to read it again. Check message assembly first, instead of putting every repeated call down to the model not being clever.

一个修复任务，为什么产生三次模型调用.en: Why one repair task produces three model calls

输入与条件。</strong>任务是把.en: Input and conditions.The task is to change

的超时从3改成5，工具有read、write、test。下面是确定的教学轨迹，.en: timeout from 3 to 5, with the tools read, write and test. What follows is a fixed teaching trace, not a real model running on its own.

用户任务＋可用工具说明.en: The user task + the descriptions of the available tools

模型提出read，尚未承诺文件已修改。.en: The model proposes read; it has not committed to the file having been changed.

结果连同调用ID进入历史。.en: The result enters the history together with the call ID.

任务＋read调用＋结果.en: The task + the read call + the result

模型提出在v7基础上写timeout=5。.en: The model proposes writing timeout=5 on top of v7.

宿主仍未证明功能测试通过。.en: The harness still has no proof that the functional test passed.

新版本和测试返回pass.en: The new version, and the test returning pass

模型归纳变更与验证；如果模型还需自行提出test，则还要增加一轮。.en: The model sums up the change and the verification; if it also has to propose the test itself, that adds another turn.

后端可能有多次模型请求和多次工具操作。.en: The back end may make several model requests and several tool operations.

把过程连起来。</strong>一轮模型调用的输出不是任务的全部生命周期；哪些工.en: Join the steps up. The output of one model call is not the whole life cycle of the task; which tools the model decides on and which the harness triggers automatically has to be stated clearly.

边界与反例。</strong>本例test由宿主固定触发，因此三次调用成立；不要.en: Limits and counterexamples. In this example the test is triggered by the harness on a fixed rule, which is why there are three calls; do not count it together with a configuration in which "every tool step needs another model proposal".

追问：为什么不一次把所有文件读完，再让模型直接给补丁？.en: Follow-up: why not read every file at once and have the model hand over the patch directly?

小仓库有时可以，但大仓库成本高且无关信息多。更重要的是下一步证据需求常由前一步发.en: For a small repository that sometimes works, but for a large one it is expensive and brings in much irrelevant information. More importantly, the evidence the next step needs is usually decided by what the previous step found. Only once the entry point is found do you know which call chain to look at; only once the test is run do you know the real failure. Reading on demand uses feedback from the environment to reduce guessing; it is not there to inflate the number of call turns.

追问：Agent是不是一定由LLM自由决定所有步骤？.en: Follow-up: must an agent always have the LLM decide every step freely?

由程序预先安排主要步骤和分支的流程。 例：不等于每一步都必须由模型临时决策。.en: A process whose main steps and branches are arranged in advance by the program. Example: this does not mean every step must be decided ad hoc by the model.

可以固定检索、验证、审批等关键步骤；LLM在不确定部分做判断。动态Agent允许.en: can fix key steps such as retrieval, verification and approval, while the LLM judges the uncertain parts. A dynamic agent lets the model choose the path, which is flexible but makes cost and behavior harder to predict. Real systems often mix the two: control should be allocated according to the uncertainty of the task, rather than turning deterministic programs into prompts as well.

追问：如何判断某次失败是模型问题还是Harness问题？.en: Follow-up: how do you tell whether a failure is a model problem or a harness problem?

先保存本轮可见输入、可调用工具与实际结果。若正确文件未返回，是检索/工具链问题；.en: First save this turn's visible input, the callable tools and the actual results. If the right file was not returned, it is a retrieval or tool-chain problem; if it was returned but then trimmed away, it is a context problem; if the model produced a valid call and the executor cannot find the tool, it is a registration or routing problem; only when all the necessary evidence was visible and the inference was still wrong does it come close to a model reasoning problem. The final error text by itself cannot locate the layer at fault.

一次回答结束，为什么任务仍未完成？.en: One answer has finished — so why is the task still not done?

先看一个会误报完成的任务.en: Start with a task that reports completion falsely

用户要求“修复目录排除规则，且不能修改生产配置”。模型输出了一段补丁，接着说“已.en: The user asks to "fix the directory exclusion rule without modifying the production configuration". The model emits a patch and then says "done". All that can be confirmed at this point is that the model produced text. Whether the file changed, whether the test ran, whether the test was aimed at the last change, and whether the original constraint is satisfied are four different facts. Do not compress the four facts into one

四种完成不互相替代。数值与状态属于本节明确设定的教学例；不是生产性能或商业模型实.en: Four kinds of completion do not substitute for one another. The numbers and states are a teaching example explicitly set out in this section; they are not production performance or a measurement of a commercial model.

在本节教学宿主里，记录四个字段：.en: In this section's teaching harness, four fields are recorded:

表示本次模型响应协议结束；.en: means this model response has ended at the protocol level;

表示本次工具调用有终态；.en: means this tool call has a terminal state;

表示外部状态经核验；.en: means the external state has been verified;

表示任务验收条件满足。第一项不能推出第四项。用户取消也可能让调用结束，但目标仍.en: means the task's acceptance conditions are satisfied. The first does not entail the fourth. A user cancellation can also end a call while the goal is still not reached.

沿固定源码读一次循环.en: Read one loop through the pinned source

并非简单地执行“模型返回文本就退出”。它先接收输入与钩子反馈，准备本轮上下文和.en: does not simply implement "the model returned text, so exit". It first takes in the input and the hook feedback, prepares this turn's context and tools, and then requests the model. Completed tool-call items go to the execution system; the result returns to the history, and only then does the next turn have new evidence. The sampled

还要结合待处理输入；看似结束时，Stop钩子也可能给出需要继续处理的反馈。这里.en: must also be combined with the pending input; when it looks finished, the Stop hook may still give feedback that needs further work. What is described here is the path in the pinned commit; one product's stopping policy is not taken as the definition for every agent.

“响应结束”“工具结果可用”“任务结束”应分别保留时间戳。假设响应在10:00:.en: "Response finished", "tool result available" and "task finished" should each keep their own timestamp. Suppose the response finished at 10:00:02 and the test process exited at 10:00:08: then 10:00:02 cannot declare the test passed. If another file edit happens at 10:00:09, the result from 10:00:08 only proves the old version and does not cover the new one.

一条可以逐项检查的教学轨迹.en: A teaching trace you can check item by item

收到任务、工具说明.en: Receives the task and the tool descriptions

只有目标，没有根因证据.en: Only the goal, no root-cause evidence

可依据r7分析.en: Analysis can be based on r7

代码已变，不等于正确.en: The code changed, which is not the same as correct

测试r8，返回失败.en: Tests r8 and returns a failure

应依据失败继续，而不是忽略.en: Should continue from the failure rather than ignore it

写入r9并重跑测试.en: Writes r9 and reruns the test

r8的通过或失败均不能替代r9验证.en: A pass or a failure on r8 is no substitute for verifying r9

核验约束、r9及测试结果.en: Verifies the constraints, r9 and the test result

才具备任务完成证据.en: Only now is there evidence that the task is complete

这不是强制所有任务都执行六轮。简单问题可能一轮完成；高风险动作可能要人工批准。应.en: This does not force every task through six turns. A simple question may finish in one; a high-risk action may need human approval. Expand according to the actual unknowns and the risk, rather than treating a fixed number of turns as a quality standard.

容易漏掉的停止条件.en: Stopping conditions that are easy to miss

反复调用同一搜索但没有新增证据，是停滞，不是持续进展。工具不可恢复失败应明确记录.en: Calling the same search over and over with no added evidence is stalling, not steady progress. An unrecoverable tool failure should be recorded explicitly and isolated; endless retries should not block the rest of the work. A completion condition needs externally checkable evidence; the stopping conditions should also cover an exhausted budget, a user cancellation, missing authorization and a decision needed from the user. <strong>Stopping is not the same as success, and continuing is not the same as being effective.

已核验的停止分支：不是一个done位.en: The verified stopping branches: not a single done bit

固定源码先看.en: In the pinned source, start with

和待处理输入。进入Stop检查后，有效的继续反馈会被写入历史并开启后续步骤；只.en: and the pending input. Once the Stop check is entered, valid continuation feedback is written into the history and opens the following steps; a bare "block the ending" with no feedback content raises a warning instead of looping out of nothing. The internal path for memory consolidation fails separately when it meets a Stop rejection, so the rejection is not fed again and again into an unattended loop.

把它用于自己的程序时，至少区分“没有新工作”“要补充验收”“被取消”“预算耗尽”.en: When you use this in your own program, distinguish at least "no new work", "acceptance still to be added", "canceled" and "budget exhausted". These are teaching state names, not a copy of Codex's enum. A verifiable counterexample: if the stop check finds one test missing, it should return the test as the goal; if it only ever returns "keep trying", the harness should exhaust a finite budget and report the task unfinished rather than recurse forever.

。源码限提交 86e17e98c7f9 和已读取路径；文章经验、公开文档与原创教.en: . The source is limited to commit 86e17e98c7f9 and the paths actually read; article experience, public documentation and original teaching experiments are labeled separately.<a href="../engineering/agent-evidence.html#acquisition">See how it was obtained, what was read, and the limits

Q002｜Agent有哪些状态？为什么对话摘要不能替代任务数据库？.en: Q002｜What states does an agent have? Why can a conversation summary not replace the task database?

这题先认识什么</span>任务目标、调用进度、外部事实和消息历史是不同状态；一.en: What to know first for this questionThe task goal, the call progress, the external facts and the message history are different states; one summary cannot automatically replace every state record.

第02课 · 状态、事件与检查点</a><a class=\"pill\" hr.en: Lesson 02 · State, events and checkpointsLesson 26 · Retries, idempotence and transactions

至少分三类：模型可见的认知上下文、Harness的控制状态、外部环境的实际状态。.en: At least three kinds: the cognitive context the model can see, the harness's control state, and the actual state of the external environment. They can be inconsistent for a while. A summary expresses "what is believed to have happened", the task record expresses "what the system tracked", and files, databases and remote services are where the side effects actually happen.

以一次提交为例拆状态.en: Take one commit as the example and separate the states

模型说“准备修改filter.py”，这是计划。Harness生成调用c17并记.en: The model says "I am about to modify filter.py": that is a plan. The harness creates call c17 and records it as pending: that is control state. The tool completes the write to disk and the file content changes: that is environment state. Then the process crashes before the success is written back to the task database: the environment succeeded, the control state is still pending, and the model has not yet seen the result.

恢复时若只读对话摘要“修改未完成”，会重复写；若只读pending就当失败，也可.en: If recovery reads only the conversation summary "the edit did not finish", it will write again; if it reads only pending and treats that as failure, it may also repeat the side effect. Check the action identity, the expected old version, the content after the write, or the remote idempotent result, and restore the state to succeeded or to still unknown. The model must not decide this by tone.

教学上可用以下对象分工：.en: For teaching purposes the work can be divided among the following objects:

Thread、Turn、Session：运行层次.en: Thread, turn, session: the levels of a run

这些通常是宿主对会话和工作轮次的划分，不是神经网络的层。Thread可指一条会话.en: These are usually the harness's divisions of a conversation and of units of work, not layers of a neural network. A thread can mean one conversation, and a turn can contain the several model and tool cycles needed to answer one user task; where the boundaries fall depends on the product.<span class="concept-micro">"This turn is done" cannot be equated with "every external tool has finished"; that takes looking at the actual events and results.

这不是要求所有项目新增六张表。简单本地Agent可以用日志和文件实现；核心是别把.en: This does not require every project to add six tables. A simple local agent can do it with logs and files; the point is not to blend these meanings into a single "done".

模型说“写好了”，任务记录和磁盘可能各是另一回事.en: The model says "it is written", while the task record and the disk may each say something else

本例条件：</strong>独立修改任务：目标把timeout从3改到10。模型.en: Conditions for this example: an independent editing task: the goal is to change the timeout from 3 to 10. The model has already emitted a patch, but the executor has not applied it yet; the initial file version is r7.

模型这次看到和说过的记录。.en: The record of what the model saw and said this time.

程序记载的阶段与动作结果。.en: The stage and action results that the program records.

真实文件和数据库当前内容。.en: The current content of the real files and database.

不能：可能只描述拟议修改.en: No: it may only describe a proposed change

不能：还没有提交记录.en: No: there is no commit record yet

明确没有达到目标.en: Clearly has not reached the goal

仍需要验证相应行为.en: The corresponding behavior still has to be verified

只证明这组测试对应r8.en: Only proves that this set of tests corresponds to r8

把三种状态分成三行后，矛盾一目了然。对话摘要只能概括文字，不能替代读取磁盘或查询.en: Once the three states are split into three rows, the contradiction is plain. A conversation summary can only sum up words; it cannot replace reading the disk or querying the action log.

提交与验证又是两步。文件真的变成10，不代表所有需求和回归都通过。.en: Committing and verifying are two further steps. The file really becoming 10 does not mean every requirement and regression passed.

完成报告应引用当前工件版本和验证记录，而不是把“已完成”一句话再存进记忆循环自证.en: A completion report should cite the current artifact version and the verification record, rather than storing the one line "done" back into a memory loop to prove itself.

不要混淆：</strong>任务状态写成succeeded后再改文件，会产生日志.en: Do not conflate: writing the task state as succeeded and then editing the file opens a window in which the log runs ahead of the real world; the commit order and the recovery strategy have to be stated.

对话说“写好了”，但磁盘与任务状态都不同意.en: The conversation says "it is written", but the disk and the task state both disagree

输入与条件。</strong>同一时刻有三份内容：assistant文本“已更新.en: Input and conditions.Three things exist at the same moment: the assistant text "updated"; the execution log

；磁盘版本仍为v7。.en: ; and the disk version is still v7.

自然语言、调用记录、外部文件.en: Natural language, the call record, the external file

它们不是同一份状态的三个可靠副本。.en: They are not three reliable copies of one and the same state.

读取磁盘仍timeout=3.en: Reading the disk still gives timeout=3

不能把assistant表述当作写入证据。.en: The assistant's wording must not be taken as evidence of a write.

工具请求可能尚未完成.en: The tool request may not have finished

先写unknown或pending，不能靠一句话强行改成succeeded。.en: Write unknown or pending first; one sentence is no ground for forcing it to succeeded.

目标、当前版本、调用ID、状态、下一步核查.en: The goal, the current version, the call ID, the state, the next check

恢复进程据此继续。.en: A recovering process continues from this.

只把“已更新”摘要交给后继Agent.en: Handing the successor agent only the summary "updated"

它可能跳过真正的写入和验证。.en: It may skip the actual write and verification.

把过程连起来。</strong>执行状态以系统证据为准；对话提供计划和解释，却不.en: Join the steps up. The execution state is settled by system evidence; the conversation supplies plans and explanations, but cannot replace an external result.

边界与反例。</strong>unknown的后续处理依工具能否查询、是否具有副.en: Limits and counterexamples. How an unknown is handled next depends on whether the tool can be queried and whether it has side effects. What is described here is only a diagnosable state model.

追问：LLM的KV缓存属于哪一类？.en: Follow-up: which kind does an LLM's KV cache belong to?

它是推理服务内部计算状态，支持模型连续生成，不是业务完成状态。KV丢失可能需要重.en: It is computation state inside the inference service, supporting the model's continuous generation; it is not business completion state. Losing the KV may require a fresh

，但文件修改仍然存在；数据库丢失也不会自动从KV恢复出可靠操作日志。这两种故障需.en: , but the file edit is still there; and losing the database does not automatically recover a reliable operation log out of the KV. These two failures need different means of recovery.

追问：Plan文件、Checkpoint和长期记忆分别保存什么？.en: Follow-up: what does a Plan file, a checkpoint and long-term memory each store?

Plan保存希望完成的步骤，Checkpoint保存可恢复的执行位置和状态，长期.en: A Plan stores the steps you hope to finish, a checkpoint stores a recoverable execution position and state, and long-term memory stores facts or experience that can be reused later. Planning a "test" does not prove a test ran; one pass recorded in a checkpoint does not mean it passes forever across versions; and the long-term lesson "this kind of interface has to be idempotent" is no substitute for the state of the current call.

追问：为什么每个状态都持久化可能过度工程化？.en: Follow-up: why can persisting every state be over-engineering?

不是所有中间推测都值得落库。可重做的只读搜索和临时推理可以轻量处理；不可逆操作、.en: Not every intermediate guess is worth putting in a database. A read-only search that can be redone, and temporary reasoning, can be handled lightly; irreversible operations, recovery points for long tasks and key evidence are worth more persistence. Let the consequence of losing something decide how strongly it is stored, rather than covering every

Q003｜无状态API与有状态会话各怎样构建下一轮输入？会话ID是不是长期记忆？.en: Q003｜How do a stateless API and a stateful session each build the next turn's input? Is a session ID long-term memory?

这题先认识什么</span>服务保存会话ID不等于每次免费得到无限历史。要核对实.en: What to know first for this questionA service keeping a session ID does not mean unlimited history for free on every call. Check what is actually retained, what is passed on, the budget, and how tool calls are paired up.

第07课 · API与流式协议</a><a class=\"pill\" hre.en: Lesson 07 · APIs and streaming protocolsLesson 02 · State, events and checkpointsLesson 11 · Assembling context

无状态调用通常由客户端传入需要的历史；有状态接口可以引用服务端已有会话或响应状态.en: A stateless call usually has the client pass in the history it needs; a stateful interface can reference a session or a response state the server already holds, which reduces what the client has to carry. Both have to obey the rules for the model's context and for product state. Having a session ID does not mean it is available forever, does not amount to knowledge governance across tasks, and does not guarantee a compute cache hit.

两条等价目标、不同实现的链.en: Two chains with the same goal and different implementations

在无状态风格中，第二轮输入可能是.en: In the stateless style the second turn's input might be

。第三轮再附加新调用及结果。若客户端漏掉工具调用只发工具结果，协议可能无法正确配.en: . The third turn then appends the new call and its result. If the client leaves out the tool call and sends only the tool result, the protocol may not pair them correctly; and if the tool result is merely pasted in as user text, the provenance and the trust boundary can be lost as well.

，服务端恢复必要上下文。它降低的是显式传输与状态管理负担，不意味着全部旧历史无限.en: , and the server restores the necessary context. What that lowers is the burden of explicit transmission and state management; it does not mean all the old history enters the model without limit. The service may still truncate, compact or require particular state items to be passed, depending on the interface.

跨会话记忆还需要选择保存内容、身份隔离、版本、更新与失效。一个能续接十分钟前响应.en: Memory across sessions also requires choosing what to keep, identity isolation, versions, updates and expiry. An ID that can pick up a response from ten minutes ago has done none of that governance for you. Conversely, even if every model call is stateless, good long-term capability can still be achieved with your own knowledge base and task checkpoints.

有状态与无状态接口，区别在于谁保存前一轮对象.en: Stateful and stateless interfaces differ in who keeps the objects from the previous turn

本例条件：</strong>独立两轮协议示意：第一轮输出工具调用c1，结果为“3.en: Conditions for this example: an independent two-turn protocol sketch: the first turn outputs tool call c1, whose result is "30". On the left the client replays everything in full; on the right it is linked through the server-side response ID. The exact fields vary with the API.

宿主显式保留并提交的消息序列。.en: The message sequence the harness explicitly keeps and submits.

由响应ID等引用的已存对象。.en: An already stored object referenced by a response ID or similar.

工具、规则等是否继承要查具体接口约定。.en: Whether tools, rules and the like are inherited has to be read off the specific interface agreement.

显式提交原任务+c1.en: Submit the original task plus c1 explicitly

不能只凭r1推定所有配置自动继承.en: r1 alone is no ground for assuming that every setting is inherited automatically

需单独保存/检索.en: Has to be saved and retrieved separately

会话关联本身不提供事实更新与遗忘.en: Session association by itself supplies neither fact updates nor forgetting

两条路线都要让模型知道结果对应c1。不同的是旧记录通过实际内容还是引用传递。.en: Both routes have to let the model know that the result belongs to c1. What differs is whether the old record is passed on as actual content or as a reference.

一个字符串session_id只是一把查状态的钥匙；服务是否存了什么、保留多久、.en: A session_id string is only a key for looking state up; whether the service stored anything, how long it keeps it and which settings apply this turn are for the contract to decide.

迁移到别的模型时，普通文本证据可能可重组，不透明压缩块则不能假定可跨提供方解释。.en: When moving to another model, ordinary text evidence can probably be reassembled, but an opaque compressed block cannot be assumed to be interpretable across providers.

不要混淆：</strong>链路连续不等于状态无限、完整或永不失效。故障时检查实.en: Do not conflate: an unbroken connection does not mean the state is unlimited, complete or never invalidated. When something fails, check the actual request and the state of the service rather than just confirming that the ID has not changed.

同一个session_id不代表相同的模型输入.en: The same session_id does not mean the same model input

输入与条件。</strong>第1轮用户说“变量a=7”，第2轮问“a是多少”。.en: Input and conditions.In turn 1 the user says "the variable a=7"; in turn 2 they ask "what is a". The two API styles are compared.

模型没有收到a=7，session_id只是业务字段时不会自动补历史。.en: The model never received a=7; when session_id is just an application field, it does not fill the history in by itself.

第2轮发送两条用户消息及必要中间回复.en: Turn 2 sends both user messages and the intermediate replies that are needed

此时a=7进入本次上下文。.en: Now a=7 enters this call's context.

用受支持的conversation或previous-response机制.en: Use a supported conversation or previous-response mechanism

服务端按接口约定恢复相关项目，但仍受上下文、权限和生命周期约束。.en: The server restores the relevant items as the interface agreement specifies, still subject to context, permission and life-cycle limits.

记录实际请求中的消息或服务端历史引用.en: Record the messages in the actual request, or the reference to server-side history

不能仅凭本地界面显示了旧消息就认定模型看见。.en: The local interface showing the old messages is no ground for deciding the model saw them.

服务端状态已删除，但本地沿用同一字符串.en: The server-side state has been deleted, but the same string is still used locally

会话键不再对应可恢复内容。.en: The session key no longer corresponds to anything recoverable.

把过程连起来。</strong>状态的所有者可能是应用、API服务或文件系统，必.en: Join the steps up. The owner of the state may be the application, the API service or the file system; who is responsible for keeping it and supplying it again has to be stated.

边界与反例。</strong>字段名只是概念举例，具体跨请求行为应按所用API文.en: Limits and counterexamples. The field names are only conceptual examples; the actual behavior across requests should be verified against the documentation of the API in use, and no uniform guarantee is made for every SDK.

追问：能否把某个厂商的压缩块复制给另一个模型？.en: Follow-up: can a compressed block from one vendor be copied over to another model?

不应假定可以。压缩块可能是该服务专用的opaque状态，格式与解释依赖模型/接口.en: Do not assume it can. A compressed block may be opaque state specific to that service, with a format and an interpretation that depend on the model or the interface. A handoff across models usually needs readable facts, constraints and evidence references, or a protocol both sides explicitly support. Encrypted state is not a general-purpose Markdown summary.

追问：重试一次相同模型请求是否会得到同一个工具调用ID？.en: Follow-up: does retrying the same model request give the same tool-call ID?

不能普遍假定。传输重连、请求重试与重新生成是不同操作。重新生成可能产生新的调用项.en: Not as a general assumption. Reconnecting the transport, retrying the request and regenerating are different operations. Regeneration may produce new call items, and application-level deduplication cannot rely on an ID the model happens to produce. The executor should maintain its own stable action identity, together with whatever idempotence or response-recovery mechanism the interface offers.

追问：为什么切换模型后长任务可能退化？.en: Follow-up: why can a long task degrade after the model is switched?

不同模型对工具格式、上下文、推理状态和指令的支持不同；能力、.en: Different models support tool formats, context, reasoning state and instructions differently; the capabilities, the

和压缩表示也可能变化。安全切换需要重新构建兼容上下文，保留关键事实和未完成副作用.en: and the compressed representation can change too. A safe switch requires rebuilding a compatible context and keeping the key facts and the unfinished side effects; you cannot just change the model name and go on pushing the original state through.

工程深挖 · E17 · 接续Q035.en: Engineering deep dive · E17 · continues Q035

有previous_response_id，为什么仍可能丢失规则或工具上下文？.en: With previous_response_id, why can the rules or the tool context still be lost?

第11课</a>。阅读顺序：先确认运行契约，再看反例与修复，最后检验边界。.en: Lesson 11. Reading order: confirm the run contract first, then look at the counterexamples and the fix, and finally test the limits.

会话关联与每轮控制字段是两个层次.en: Session association and the per-turn control fields are two different layers

在本次核对的OpenAI Responses迁移指南中，.en: In the OpenAI Responses migration guide checked here,

用于关联已有响应上下文，<strong>不继承上轮顶层instructions<.en: links an existing response context and does not inherit the previous turn's top-level instructions. Stable instructions that are needed should be resent every turn. This conclusion belongs to that interface's contract; not every service with "a session ID" behaves the same way.

错误实现往往首轮带“不得发布”，第二轮只发工具结果和previous_respo.en: A wrong implementation often carries "do not publish" in the first turn, sends only the tool result and previous_response_id in the second, and then assumes the prohibition is still in force in the same way. Diagnosis has to look at the actual second request, not at the first turn's log or the chat bubbles the user can see.

手动历史最危险的裁剪：只保留文本.en: The most dangerous trim in a manual history: keeping only the text

Responses的output包含有类型的项目，可能有message、func.en: The output of Responses contains typed items, which may include message, function_call, reasoning and others;

是便捷文本视图，不是完整可重放状态。函数结果必须与原调用的call_id配对。.en: is a convenient text view, not a complete replayable state. A function result must be paired with the call_id of the original call.

。只筛message得到空列表；文字摘要“已读文件”不包含相同协议关系。后续即使.en: . Filtering for message alone gives an empty list; the text summary "the file has been read" does not carry the same protocol relationship. Even if the model can later guess the progress of the work, that does not mean the tool protocol is still valid.

每轮装配时把三类信息明确分开：稳定规则与工具规格、历史协议项或服务端关联、当前新.en: When assembling each turn, keep three kinds of information clearly apart: the stable rules and tool specifications; the historical protocol items or the server-side association; and the input newly added this turn. Do not indiscriminately splice all the old output back in and reference previous_response_id at the same time, or you may end up with duplicated context. Whether to use a reference, a manual history or a persistent Conversation, pick one clear main path according to the service contract.

断言应检查“调用结果没有孤儿”“同一call_id不误绑定另一个参数”“规则版本.en: The assertions should check that "no call result is orphaned", that "the same call_id is not bound by mistake to different arguments", that "the rule version is included in this turn", and that "retrying the same request did not append the result twice". What is stored must meet privacy and retention requirements; unrelated sensitive data must not be kept for the sake of a complete replay.

追问：模型说‘我记得不得发布’，能当规则继承的证据吗？.en: Follow-up: if the model says 'I remember that publishing is not allowed', can that count as evidence the rule was inherited?

不能。它可能从普通历史文本推断，也可能只是生成了顺从表述。验证对象是最终发出的请.en: No. It may have inferred that from ordinary history text, or simply produced a compliant-sounding phrase. What you verify is the request finally sent and the interface state; the real permission to publish should also be restricted by the executor. Probabilistic compliance and deterministic authorization cannot stand in for each other.

追问：不透明reasoning或压缩项需要人工解码吗？.en: Follow-up: do opaque reasoning or compressed items need to be decoded by hand?

不需要，也不应编造内部结构。按官方要求把允许回传的项目保留、传递；应用只读取公开.en: No, and their internal structure should not be invented either. Keep and pass on the items that are allowed to be sent back, as the official documentation requires; the application reads only the public fields and the execution state. Replacing them with a summary of your own for the sake of being "readable" may break continuity. Whatever cannot be observed should be written down as unknown in the troubleshooting record.

E17：怎样读这份结果，而不是只看“通过”.en: E17: how to read this result instead of only looking at "pass"

会话引用保存了哪些项目，与本轮重新提供了哪些规则，是两个清单。应该核对实际请求边.en: Which items the session reference keeps, and which rules are supplied again this turn, are two separate lists. Check the actual request boundary; one session ID is no ground for inferring that every instruction is inherited forever.

自检：</strong>只保存SDK的output_text，是否足够恢复一段有.en: Self-check: is saving only the SDK's output_text enough to restore a session that contains tool calls?

不够。工具调用、调用结果、call_id及可能的非文本状态不是output_te.en: No. The tool calls, the call results, the call_id and possibly non-text state are not all part of output_text. Save the typed items as the interface agreement specifies, or use the server-side session association correctly, and resend the control fields that are needed.

为什么每次模型调用都需要一致的上下文快照？.en: Why does every model call need a consistent context snapshot?

模型调用需要的不只是用户一句话，还包括规则、历史、工具声明、环境信息和证据。把这.en: A model call needs more than one sentence from the user: it also needs the rules, the history, the tool declarations, information about the environment, and evidence. Call this list request snapshot S7: the model choice, rule version R3, tool catalog T8, environment E2, and the evidence

。快照不是把全部系统冻结，而是让本次决定所依据的对象能够对应起来。.en: . A snapshot does not freeze the whole system; it makes the objects this decision rests on line up with one another.

不能偷偷换成R4解释旧提议.en: No quietly switching to R4 to interpret the old proposal

检测是否已变r8.en: Detect whether it has already become r8

若撤销则拒绝执行.en: If it has been revoked, refuse to execute

同一请求绑定解释对象，执行时仍检查授权。数值与状态属于本节明确设定的教学例；不是.en: One request binds the objects it is interpreted against, and authorization is still checked at execution time. The numbers and states are a teaching example explicitly set out in this section; they are not production performance or a measurement of a commercial model.

假设模型在S7看到工具.en: Suppose that in S7 the model saw the tool

，但在它输出参数后，宿主已经换成S8，把同名工具解释为另一种接口。如果执行器仅按.en: , but after it had emitted the arguments the harness moved to S8, where a tool of the same name is interpreted as a different interface. If the executor only looks up "the latest tool" by name, an old decision can land on new semantics. This problem is called a change between check and use; do not memorize the acronym yet, just remember that "what was seen when the decision was made" and "what is used when it is actually executed" may not be the same thing.

保存请求级设置、环境快照、MCP绑定、工具路由器和已加载规则快照。采样请求公布.en: holds the per-request settings, the environment snapshot, the MCP bindings, the tool router and a snapshot of the loaded rules. The tools published by the sampling request and the dispatch of the calls that follow both use this context, which reduces mismatches inside one request.

在后续采样时可以重新捕获上下文，因此下一次调用能够看到变化，而不是会话开始后永.en: can capture the context again on a later sampling, so the next call can see the change instead of never refreshing once the session has begun.

这不等于授权永久冻结。该结构的环境访问还会结合当前授予信息。撤销权限、执行前批准.en: This does not mean authorization is frozen forever. The environment access in that structure also combines the information currently granted. Revoked permissions, approval before execution and a tool's own argument limits still have to be checked before a side effect actually happens. <strong>A consistent snapshot guarantees a consistent interpretation; it does not grant permission to act.

指令缓存也要有失效条件.en: An instruction cache needs expiry conditions too

对刷新进行串行化；发现规则需要读取提供者时，不把状态互斥锁跨越外部读取一直持有。.en: serializes refreshes; when discovering rules requires reading a provider, it does not hold the state mutex across that external read. When trust or permissions are tightened, the old cache must expire: a failed new read is no reason to go on using the more permissive old result. A sub-agent inherits certain already-applied snapshots; whether the providers are shared still depends on explicit configuration.

为什么日志里空工具列表不一定意味着没有工具.en: Why an empty tool list in the log does not necessarily mean there were no tools

在固定Codex代码的一种增量工具协议路径中，独立请求字段可能不重复发送工具与基.en: In one incremental tool-protocol path in the pinned Codex code, the standalone request fields may not resend the tools and the base instructions, because that information has already been passed on through the history or an incremental declaration. When reviewing, read the protocol in use and the final sequence; seeing one

就断言模型什么工具都没收到。.en: is no ground for asserting that the model received no tools at all.

教学调试表至少记录：请求ID、模型版本、规则哈希、工具声明版本、环境标识、证据版.en: A teaching debug table records at least: the request ID, the model version, the rule hash, the tool declaration version, the environment identifier, the evidence version and the authorization result at execution time. Do not record secrets, and do not keep all user content unconditionally. Attribution is reasonably safe only when a single thing changed; once the model, the prompt and the tools are all swapped at once, there is no way to know which caused the regression.

快照里哪些固定，哪些仍然实时？.en: What in the snapshot is fixed, and what is still live?

所读实现的处理.en: How the implementation that was read handles it

模型、工具路由、MCP绑定、已加载规则.en: The model, the tool routing, the MCP bindings, the loaded rules

由同一StepContext携带.en: Carried by one and the same StepContext

不是所有未来轮次永久不变.en: Not that every future turn stays unchanged forever

请求捕获时保持一致.en: Kept consistent at the moment the request is captured

不代表环境里的文件永远不变.en: Not that the files in the environment never change

访问器结合实时会话及本轮授权.en: The accessor combines the live session with this turn's authorization

不能写成“权限与模型一样完全冻结”.en: Must not be written as "permissions are frozen exactly like the model"

先完成准备再被选作执行上下文.en: Preparation finishes first, and only then is it chosen as the execution context

不能用半准备工具目录发出请求.en: A request must not be sent with a half-prepared tool catalog

例：t0声明read_file，t1用户新增了授权，t2执行读取。应查“t0选了.en: Example: at t0 read_file is declared, at t1 the user adds an authorization, and at t2 the read is executed. Check "which environment/handler t0 selected" and "how the accessor at t2 merged the authorizations", rather than inferring every execution permission from the configuration at t0. Conversely, a newly added authorization does not give the model a tool that was never exposed or bound. This example serves to explain the two kinds of state; it is not a log from a real product.

Q004｜Agent何时应该停？为什么“继续直到完成”容易变成死循环？.en: Q004｜When should an agent stop? Why does "continue until done" so easily turn into an infinite loop?

这题先认识什么</span>结束要对照可观察验收条件；没有更多工具调用、预算耗尽.en: What to know first for this questionEnding has to be checked against observable acceptance conditions; no more tool calls, an exhausted budget, or the model saying it is done — none of these alone proves the goal was reached.

第02课 · 状态、事件与检查点</a><a class=\"pill\" hr.en: Lesson 02 · State, events and checkpointsLesson 04 · Foundations of engineering qualityLesson 05 · The denominator of an evaluation metric

停止需要结合模型判断和可验证条件。模型可以提出已完成、受阻或需要澄清，Harne.en: Stopping needs the model's judgment together with verifiable conditions. The model can propose that it is done, blocked or in need of clarification, and the harness still has to check the result evidence, the outstanding actions and the budget. With no clear definition of completion, the loop may search again and again, rewrite the plan, or run the same failing operation.

用完成谓词代替情绪判断.en: Use a completion predicate instead of a gut feeling

教学任务可定义：目标测试通过；新增边界测试通过；当前diff只包含授权范围；验证.en: A teaching task can define: the target test passes; the new boundary test passes; the current diff contains only what was authorized; the verification matches the current code version; and there is no

无法确认外部动作是否已经完成的状态。 例：超时可能发生在成功执行之后。.en: A state in which it cannot be confirmed whether an external action has completed. Example: a timeout can happen after a successful execution.

写操作。满足这些并不证明软件绝对无缺陷，但清楚定义了本任务的交付依据。.en: write operation. Meeting these does not prove the software is absolutely free of defects, but it does define clearly what this task's delivery rests on.

循环还应区分“没有新证据”与“任务仍有进展”。连续三轮读取同一文件而没有新假设、.en: The loop should also distinguish "no new evidence" from "the task is still making progress". Reading the same file for three turns in a row with no new hypothesis, the same arguments failing again and again, a patch flipping back and forth between two ways of writing it — all of these are signs that progress has stalled. You can reduce the freedom of action and require the next operation to state what it expects to test, or to output the reason it is blocked.

预算至少包括墙钟时间、调用次数、Token、工具费用和风险。达到预算不应伪装完成.en: A budget covers at least wall-clock time, the number of calls, tokens, tool costs and risk. Reaching the budget should not be dressed up as completion; what is finished and what is not should be saved, with accurate evidence. In a long task, delivering what is partly finished and separating the remaining problems clearly is more dependable than an endless "let me review it once more".

结束判定要看证据增量，而不是循环次数本身.en: Deciding to stop should depend on added evidence, not on the number of loops in itself

本例条件：</strong>独立搜索任务：连续三次查询返回相同文件列表，没有新证.en: Conditions for this example: an independent search task: three queries in a row return the same file list, with no new evidence. The total budget is 5 turns; the budget is only illustrative, not a recommended uniform ceiling.

状态或证据真的发生了有用变化。.en: The state or the evidence really changed in a useful way.

连续重复同类结果的次数。.en: The number of consecutive repetitions of the same kind of result.

缺少当前工具无法获得的必要条件。.en: A necessary condition is missing that the current tools cannot obtain.

考虑改查询或读文件.en: Consider changing the query or reading the file

停止重复策略，记录原因.en: Stop the repeating strategy and record why

报告未完成与已知证据，不标成功.en: Report it unfinished with the evidence known, and do not mark it a success

计数器并不理解任务，因此不能只凭“跑了三轮”判断做得够了。关键是有没有缩小原因范.en: A counter does not understand the task, so "it ran three turns" alone cannot decide that enough was done. What matters is whether the range of causes was narrowed or a hypothesis was tested.

可设定重复证据指纹作为提示，但必须允许有目的的重复，例如验证外部状态是否改变。.en: A fingerprint for repeated evidence can be set as a hint, but purposeful repetition must be allowed — checking whether external state has changed, for instance.

停止不总是失败：需要用户授权、依赖不可访问或预算耗尽，都有不同的后续处理。.en: Stopping is not always failure: needing the user's authorization, an unreachable dependency and an exhausted budget each call for different handling afterwards.

不要混淆：</strong>只写“继续直到成功”会把未知错误变成无限工具调用；只.en: Do not conflate: writing only "continue until it succeeds" turns an unknown error into endless tool calls; a limit on the number of turns alone may cut off a task that was making progress.

同一搜索重做五次，何时应该停止.en: The same search redone five times: when should it stop?

输入与条件。</strong>任务需要找函数foo，工具连续返回not_foun.en: Input and conditions.The task is to find the function foo, and the tool returns not_found every time. For the first 5 queries the query string, the search directory and the repository version are exactly the same.

定义“新路径、新证据或新状态”才算新增信息.en: Define added information as "a new path, new evidence or a new state"

重复not_found不算进展。.en: A repeated not_found does not count as progress.

检查大小写、目录和符号可能更名.en: Check the case, the directory, and whether the symbol may have been renamed

允许有理由地改变一次搜索策略。.en: Changing the search strategy once, with a reason, is allowed.

识别查询指纹相同、无新证据.en: Recognize that the query fingerprint is the same and there is no new evidence

停止盲目重复，转到目录或调用者定位。.en: Stop repeating blindly and move to locating by directory or by caller.

预算用尽且关键证据仍缺.en: The budget is used up and key evidence is still missing

报告缺口，不把找不到变成“函数不存在”的无条件结论。.en: Report the gap; do not turn "not found" into the unconditional conclusion that "the function does not exist".

已修复、当前版本验证通过、原目标满足.en: Fixed, verified on the current version, and the original goal met

达到后不因还能继续反思就再开无意义循环。.en: Once that is reached, do not open another pointless loop just because more reflection is possible.

把过程连起来。</strong>停止规则同时需要预算、进展和验收条件；只有最大轮.en: Join the steps up. A stopping rule needs the budget, the progress and the acceptance conditions together; a maximum number of turns alone either stops too early or idles for a long time.

边界与反例。</strong>指纹可用简单元组，不要求为所有文本引入哈希体系；示.en: Limits and counterexamples. A simple tuple will do as a fingerprint; no hashing scheme has to be introduced for all text. The number of turns in the example is not a threshold recommended for a product.

追问：停止条件是否必须写成很多硬规则？.en: Follow-up: do stopping conditions have to be written as many hard rules?

不必。简单任务可由直接结果核验结束。高风险、长周期或曾反复失败的环节才值得增加明.en: No. A simple task can end on a direct check of its result. Only steps that are high-risk, long-running or have failed repeatedly are worth adding explicit conditions to. A rule is there to block a specific failure mode, not to replace every judgment the model makes.

追问：模型说缺信息时，应立即问用户吗？.en: Follow-up: when the model says information is missing, should the user be asked straight away?

先看可用工具是否能解决。文件路径、测试命令、现有配置可以从仓库读取，不应把本可自.en: First see whether the available tools can settle it. File paths, test commands and the existing configuration can be read from the repository, and a question you could look up yourself should not be handed to the user. Only where business intent, the choice of an irreversible operation or a permission boundary is really at stake is the user's decision irreplaceable.

追问：为什么不能用“所有测试都绿”作为唯一完成条件？.en: Follow-up: why can "all tests are green" not be the only completion condition?

测试可能没覆盖目标、没有实际运行、被跳过、对旧版本执行，甚至被Agent删掉。还.en: A test may not cover the goal, may never have run, may have been skipped, may have run against an old version, or may even have been deleted by the agent. The run list, the exit status, the version, the validity of the test and the scope of the change all have to be checked as well. The full verification chain is laid out in lesson 06.

工程深挖 · E18 · 接续Q036.en: Engineering deep dive · E18 · continues Q036

模型结束、工具结束、任务完成：三种“完成”不能用同一布尔值.en: The model finishing, the tool finishing and the task completing: three kinds of "done" cannot share one boolean

一次模型响应结束，只说明本次生成到达某种终止状态；一个工具返回成功，只证明其契约.en: One model response finishing only says that this generation reached some terminal state; a tool returning success only proves that an action or a check within its contract succeeded; completing the task further requires the user's goal and the acceptance conditions to be met. A tool call may be the request for the next step inside a model response, not the final delivery.

，会把“提出运行测试”误当成“测试通过”。把HTTP成功直接当业务成功也同样危险.en: mistakes "proposing to run the test" for "the test passed". Treating HTTP success as business success is just as dangerous: a service can report a business failure in a perfectly normal protocol response.

异步让旧结果污染新任务.en: Asynchrony lets an old result contaminate a new task

教学状态：用户原来让修复a.py，Agent已发起慢测试；用户随后改为b.py，.en: A teaching state: the user originally asked for a.py to be fixed and the agent had already started a slow test; the user then switched to b.py, and the task epoch went from 1 to 2. The old test arrives late and returns

。若宿主只根据“最近到达的测试成功”更新当前任务，就会把b.py标记完成。.en: . If the harness updates the current task on "the most recently arrived test succeeded" alone, it will mark b.py done.

epoch是本书设计的任务修订计数，不是某厂商强制字段。接收结果时核对task_.en: The epoch is a task revision count designed by this book, not a field required by any vendor. When a result arrives, check task_id, epoch, the target version, call_id and the expected operation; an old result can be kept as historical evidence, but it must not change the completion state of the new goal. This book's state experiment verifies that a mismatched epoch is refused for merging.

停止条件应表达原因.en: A stopping condition should state the reason

建议分别记录：目标已满足、预算耗尽、用户取消、等待外部结果、权限阻塞、模型响应不.en: Record them separately: the goal is met, the budget is exhausted, the user canceled, waiting for an external result, blocked on permission, the model response is incomplete, the tool failed, or the result is unknown. Each points the user to a different next step. The budget includes cumulative calls, tokens, time and the number of side effects; retrying endlessly after one tool error should not be taken for "persisting until the task is done".

未知不等于失败。</strong> 超时可能发生在外部动作已成功之后；重试前应核.en: Unknown is not the same as failure. A timeout can happen after the external action has already succeeded; before retrying, verify, or use idempotence downstream. An AWS engineering article discusses the problem of timeouts and retry intent specifically.

追问：用户取消后可立刻报告“没有改动”吗？.en: Follow-up: after the user cancels, can you report "nothing was changed" right away?

不可以。取消控制流不自动回滚外部副作用。先取消可取消的在途动作，查询已提交操作，.en: No. Canceling the control flow does not roll back external side effects by itself. First cancel the in-flight actions that can be canceled, query the operations already committed, and report to the user which parts are finished, which await verification and which never ran. If automatic compensation is riskier in itself, wait for authorization rather than treating "undo" as always safe.

追问：模型说没有更多工具调用，可以直接结束吗？.en: Follow-up: when the model says there are no more tool calls, can you end right there?

这只是一个候选结束信号。应检查验收谓词：例如最终工作树版本的测试记录是否齐全、是.en: That is only a candidate ending signal. Check the acceptance predicates: whether the test records for the final working-tree version are complete, whether any pending or unknown actions remain, whether the deliverable actually exists. Different tasks accept at different strengths; a simple question and answer should not be forced through a release transaction, but a write operation cannot rely on the model vouching for itself.

E18：怎样读这份结果，而不是只看“通过”.en: E18: how to read this result instead of only looking at "pass"

工具项、模型响应与业务任务分别有自己的完成条件。某个done=true只证明其所.en: A tool item, a model response and the business task each have their own completion conditions. Some done=true only proves that the object it belongs to has finished; it cannot be promoted across layers into task success.

自检：</strong>旧epoch的测试晚到并通过，是否可以让当前新epoch.en: Self-check: if a test from an old epoch arrives late and passes, can it make the task in the current new epoch complete?

不能。结果只证明其原任务、原目标版本上的测试。应保留历史但拒绝更新当前状态，除非.en: No. The result only proves the test on its original task and its original target version. Keep the history but refuse to update the current state, unless it is explicitly shown that the evidence still applies to the new goal.

10｜模型输出怎样变成真实工具调用：协议与执行边界.en: 10｜How model output becomes a real tool call: protocol and execution boundary

Why can a conversation summary not replace the task database?Q003｜How do a stateless API and a stateful session each build the next turn's input? Is a session ID long-term memory?Q004｜When should an agent stop? Why does "continue until done" so easily turn into an infinite loop?

第09课｜模型输出怎样变成真实工具调用：协议与执行边界 — AI系统工程.en: Lesson 09｜How model output becomes a real tool call: protocol and execution boundary — AI Systems Engineering
