D2若只对旧版本适用，不能覆盖当前问题；若用户无权访问，不能因为相关就把正文发给.en: If D2 applies only to an old version, it does not cover the current question; if the user has no access to it, being relevant is no reason to send its text to the model; and if D1 and D2 are duplicate chunks of the same original passage, they cannot count as two independent pieces of support. The source ID and the version are part of the evidence object.

Anthropic的Contextual Retrieval将块放回文档背景来改.en: Anthropic's Contextual Retrieval puts a chunk back into its document's context to improve retrieval, and combines methods such as lexical retrieval, vectors and reranking; its evaluation results belong to its own data and configuration, and should not be taken as a percentage that any repository is bound to gain.

索引阶段也会产生静默错配.en: The indexing stage produces silent mismatches too

向量维度都是768，不代表来自同一个嵌入空间。更换模型、池化、归一化或切块方式后.en: Both having 768 dimensions does not mean they come from the same embedding space. After a change of model, pooling, normalization or chunking, an old index and a new query can be interface-compatible yet semantically incompatible. An index version should be bound to the embedding model and the preprocessing version; rebuilding and switching over need a rollback condition.

权限过滤和候选数量.en: Permission filtering and the number of candidates

近似检索先拿20条再按权限过滤，可能只剩1条，不能把“取了20”当成“有20条可.en: If approximate retrieval takes 20 items first and then filters by permission, only 1 may be left, so "we took 20" must not be read as "there are 20 usable candidates". Where the system's capabilities allow it, bring the filter into the retrieval plan; otherwise increase the number of candidates and evaluate the recall loss. Never use a broadened query to get around permissions.

证据闭合的教学表.en: A teaching table for evidence closure

对每个最终结论列出：具体主张、支持段落、版本、适用条件、尚缺信息。回答“部署能否.en: For every final conclusion, list the specific claim, the supporting passage, the version, the conditions of use and the information still missing. Answering "can the deployment be rolled back" needs the target version, state compatibility and the way back as well; retrieving the word "supports rollback" is not enough. When the evidence is insufficient, keep retrieving, narrow the conclusion or say plainly that it is unknown, rather than covering the gap with more fluent text.

将原文机制与教学排名计算分开.en: Keep the mechanism in the original source apart from the teaching rank calculation

Contextual Retrieval讨论给文档块补上下文、组合关键词与向量检.en: Contextual Retrieval discusses adding context to document chunks, combining keyword and vector retrieval, and reranking. The RRF candidates D1/D2/D3 in the text are this book's independent algorithm example, not a record of one actual query on the system Anthropic published; the two must not be stitched together into a reproduction of the product.

在回答前还要做另一类判断：证据是否覆盖问题、权限是否允许、版本是否适用。相关度只.en: Another kind of judgment comes before answering: whether the evidence covers the question, whether permissions allow it, and whether the version applies. Relevance only indicates a match of some kind; it does not prove that the material itself is correct. We suggest storing the generated chunk context and the original citation separately, and going back to the position in the original text when checking; these are engineering suggestions derived from the mechanism, and they have to be evaluated on your own data set.

Q034｜Cross-encoder Reranker和ColBERT为什么比简.en: Q034｜Why are a cross-encoder reranker and ColBERT finer than a simple cosine?

这题先认识什么</span>证据充分要求所有关键条件被支持；多个相关片段并排也可.en: What to know first for this questionSufficient evidence requires every key condition to be supported; several relevant fragments side by side can still contradict each other or come from different versions.

第17课 · 从搜索结果到可信答案</a><a class=\"pill\" h.en: Lesson 17 · From search results to a trustworthy answerLesson 05 · The denominator of an evaluation metric

双编码器分别编码查询与文档，可以预存文档向量；交叉编码器共同处理一对查询与文档，.en: A bi-encoder encodes the query and the document separately, so document vectors can be stored in advance; a cross-encoder processes a query and a document together for a finer judgment, usually computing every pair. Reranking only orders candidates that have already been recalled.<span class="concept-micro">A correct document that was missed is not in the candidate set, and no reranker, however strong, can put it first; the recall has to be fixed first.

ColBERT类方法为查询和文档保留多个Token向量，再做后期交互。常见Max.en: ColBERT-style methods keep several token vectors for the query and for the document, then interact them late. The usual MaxSim takes, for each query token, the highest similarity with any document token, and then aggregates.<span class="concept-micro">It is not dual-encoder retrieval where "the whole document has only one vector", and it is not the self-attention output of each layer of a generative model.

和doc独立压成向量，便于全库搜索；cross-encoder把query与候选.en: and doc independently into vectors, which makes a whole-corpus search easy; a cross-encoder encodes the query and the candidate document jointly, which allows fine-grained interaction but has to be computed for every candidate. ColBERT keeps

级表示，通过late interaction在效率和精细匹配之间折中。.en: -level representations and trades efficiency off against fine matching through late interaction.

比较三种信息交互位置.en: Comparing three places where information interacts

，最后一个点积。文档预计算成本低，但许多细节已被压进单向量。Cross-enco.en: , and one dot product at the end. Documents are cheap to precompute, but much of the detail has already been squeezed into a single vector. Cross-encoder:

，query词能与文档不同位置交互，更容易检查“旧版本/禁止/例外”等，但不适合.en: , where query words can interact with different positions in the document, which makes it easier to check things like "old version / forbidden / exception", but it is not suited to running over a million documents one by one.

ColBERT的简化MaxSim评分是：对每个query Token向量q_i，.en: ColBERT's simplified MaxSim scoring is: for every query token vector q_i, find the largest similarity among the document token vectors d_j, then sum over the query tokens:

。这样保留多点匹配，文档Token向量可离线计算。代价是存储和索引比单向量更大，.en: . This keeps multi-point matching, and the document token vectors can be computed offline. The cost is that storage and indexing are larger than for a single vector, and MaxSim itself is still not a reasoner about facts.

工程管线常先廉价召回若干候选，再用reranker筛选较小集合，最后读取原文必要.en: An engineering pipeline usually recalls a number of candidates cheaply first, then uses a reranker to narrow them to a smaller set, and finally reads the necessary range of the original text. The reranker's input should be permission-filtered first as well: a sensitive candidate must not be sent to an external service that has no authorization for it.

Reranker更精细，是因为它有机会同时看查询与候选.en: A reranker is finer-grained because it gets to look at the query and the candidate together

本例条件：</strong>独立查询“生产环境能否关闭校验”。候选A写“测试环境.en: Conditions for this example: the independent query is "can validation be turned off in production". Candidate A says "it can be turned off in the test environment", and candidate B says "it must be on in production". No actual scores for any model are invented; the figure only explains how information is accessed.

先分别编码，再以向量相似度比较。.en: Encode each of them separately first, then compare by vector similarity.

查询与候选一起进入计算，直接打相关分。.en: The query and the candidate go into the computation together, scoring relevance directly.

保留多Token表示，后期做更细粒度匹配。.en: Keep multi-token representations and do the finer-grained matching later.

查询一向量、文档一向量.en: One vector for the query, one for the document

快，但细节已被压缩.en: Fast, but the detail has been compressed away

查询词与候选文本联合计算.en: The query words and the candidate text are computed together

更贵，适合较小候选集.en: More expensive; suited to a smaller candidate set

每个查询Token找文档Token高分匹配.en: Every query token finds its high-scoring match among the document tokens

存储与计算增加；仍需条件判断.en: More storage and computation; the conditions still have to be judged

两篇候选都有“环境、关闭、校验”，词面接近；是否回答生产问题取决于条件词与否定方.en: Both candidates contain "environment, turn off, validation" and look alike on the surface; whether they answer the production question depends on the conditional words and the direction of the negation.

重排通常放在召回之后，因为对全库逐篇联合计算成本太高。若正确文档根本没召回，重排.en: Reranking usually comes after recall, because computing jointly over the whole corpus document by document costs too much. If the correct document was never recalled, reranking has no chance to bring it back.

相关性评分也不是正确答案；最后仍要读出适用条件并绑定证据。.en: A relevance score is not the right answer either; the conditions of use still have to be read out and bound to the evidence at the end.

不要混淆：</strong>把重排得到的最高分当作“已确定允许关闭”会跳过事实抽.en: Do not conflate: taking the top score from reranking as "it is settled that it may be turned off" skips fact extraction, and negation is especially easy to miss that way.

ColBERT的“每个查询Token找最好匹配”怎样算.en: How ColBERT's "every query token finds its best match" is computed

输入与条件。</strong>两个查询向量q1=[1,0]、q2=[0,1]；文.en: Input and conditions.Two query vectors q1=[1,0] and q2=[0,1]; document A has d1=[0.8,0.6] and d2=[0,1], both of unit length.

两个查询位置的max相加.en: the maxima of the two query positions added together

得分约1.414214，A更高。.en: The score is about 1.414214, so A is higher.

把查询和文档联合送入模型.en: Feed the query and the document into the model together

不是固定做这个max规则，能建模更复杂的交互但通常更贵。.en: It does not apply this fixed max rule; it can model more complex interactions but usually costs more.

把过程连起来。</strong>单向量召回、多向量后交互和联合编码重排的计算路径.en: Join the steps up. Single-vector recall, multi-vector late interaction and joint-encoding reranking take different computation paths.

边界与反例。</strong>仅展示MaxSim数学核心，省略标记、投影、索引优.en: Limits and counterexamples. Only the mathematical core of MaxSim is shown; the markers, the projection and the index optimizations are left out. The dot-product conditions have been declared, and this cannot stand in for scoring by a real model.

追问：Reranker能找回召回阶段漏掉的文档吗？.en: Follow-up: can a reranker bring back a document that recall missed?

不能从不存在的候选中选中正确文档。它改善排序，不直接扩大全库召回。若正确证据根本.en: It cannot pick the correct document out of candidates that do not exist. It improves the ordering; it does not widen whole-corpus recall directly. If the correct evidence never entered the candidates, fix the chunking, the query, the index or the recall rather than switching to a stronger reranker.

追问：Reranker分数0.9就是90%相关吗？.en: Follow-up: does a reranker score of 0.9 mean 90% relevant?

通常不能这样解释。模型输出可能是logit或未校准分值；训练分布、候选来源和领域.en: Usually it cannot be read that way. The model's output may be a logit or an uncalibrated value; the training distribution, where the candidates came from, and a change of domain all affect the scale. If a threshold is needed, calibrate it on labeled data and re-check it after a change of model or index.

追问：为什么相邻片段要在重排后扩展？.en: Follow-up: why are neighboring fragments expanded after reranking?

重排小片段能更准确定位，但完整答案可能需要标题、前置条件和后一段例外。扩展后要重.en: Reranking small fragments locates things more accurately, but a complete answer may need the heading, the preconditions and the exception in the paragraph that follows. After expanding, deduplicate again and check the budget. If every candidate is expanded into a whole document, the benefit of retrieval's focus is lost again.

Q035｜检索到了相关资料，如何判断已经足够回答？引用怎样与结论绑定？.en: Q035｜Relevant material has been retrieved: how do you judge that it is already enough to answer? How is a citation bound to the conclusion?

这题先认识什么</span>查询改写扩展表达，假设文档帮助检索但不是事实，树与图.en: What to know first for this questionQuery rewriting broadens the wording, a hypothetical document helps retrieval but is not fact, and trees and graphs help organize relationships while introducing construction cost and error propagation.

把用户问题拆成需要支持的声明或行动条件，逐项检查证据是否直接、当前、完整且允许使.en: Break the user's question into the claims or action conditions that need support, and check item by item whether the evidence is direct, current, complete and permitted for use. The existence of a relevant fragment does not mean every part of the question has been answered; the existence of a citation link does not mean it supports the conclusion beside it.

一个“是否可自动重试”的证据表.en: An evidence table for "can this be retried automatically"

问题包含三个子条件：接口是否幂等、当前版本默认重试行为、生产环境是否允许自动重试.en: The question contains three sub-conditions: whether the interface is idempotent, the default retry behavior in the current version, and whether production allows automatic retries. Document A states only that the interface is idempotent, configuration B states that it retries three times, and permission policy C states that a write in production needs approval. Without C, "automatic retries for production writes are allowed" cannot be derived.

教学证据表可记录：claim、evidence_id、support_type、.en: A teaching evidence table can record: claim, evidence_id, support_type, version, missing_condition. support_type distinguishes direct support, indirect inference, contradiction and no evidence. Every factual sentence in the final answer should be bound to the source that supports it; an inference should be marked as such, with its grounds stated. What the original document does not say must not be written down as confirmed because it "sounds reasonable".

多文档冲突先查是否不同版本、不同环境、不同日期或不同定义，而不是立即投票。两个转.en: When documents conflict, first check whether they differ in version, environment, date or definition, rather than voting straight away. Two reprints are not two independent pieces of evidence; and a configuration value and a design intent do not necessarily contradict each other — the implementation may have drifted from the design. The answer should preserve these distinctions.

一个结论需要哪些证据，逐句列出来才知道够不够.en: Which evidence a conclusion needs: only listing it sentence by sentence shows whether it is enough

本例条件：</strong>独立问题：“产品v2在生产环境的超时是否为10秒？”.en: Conditions for this example: an independent question: "is the timeout for product v2 in production 10 seconds?" The recall returned D1, which says 10 seconds for the test environment, D2, which says 30 seconds for production but for version v1, and D3, which says 10 seconds for v2 in production but takes effect tomorrow. The question is about today.

这段证据是否真正推出该结论。.en: Whether this piece of evidence really entails that conclusion.

版本、环境、时间等适用边界。.en: Limits of applicability such as version, environment and time.

还缺哪项关键条件。.en: Which key condition is still missing.

D3：v2生产=10，明天生效.en: D3: v2 production = 10, takes effect tomorrow

可写结论.en: What can be written as a conclusion

目前证据不足以确认今天为10.en: The evidence so far is not enough to confirm it is 10 today

应补查今天有效的v2规则.en: The v2 rule in force today should be looked up as well

三个看似相关的结果加在一起，也不自动得到一份适用于今天的完整证据。条件必须同时成.en: Adding three seemingly related results together does not automatically give one complete piece of evidence that applies today. The conditions have to hold at the same time.

答案可区分“明天起生效”和“今天未证实”，比只写最高相似度来源中的数值更可信。.en: An answer that distinguishes "takes effect tomorrow" from "not confirmed for today" is more trustworthy than one that merely states the number from the most similar source.

引用应贴在它支持的具体结论附近；一篇长文被引用，不表示其中所有陈述都获支持。.en: A citation should sit next to the specific conclusion it supports; citing a long document does not mean that every statement in it is supported.

不要混淆：</strong>引用数量多不能弥补逻辑缺口；同源转载十次也不是十份独.en: Do not conflate: a large number of citations does not fill a gap in the logic; the same source reposted ten times is not ten independent supports either.

最高分证据回答不了“是否现在有效”，怎么办.en: The top-scoring evidence cannot answer "is it in effect now" — what then

输入与条件。</strong>用户问“现在生产环境超时是多少？”候选A相似度高，.en: Input and conditions. The user asks "what is the production timeout now?" Candidate A has a high similarity and says 3 seconds, but is labeled as the test environment; B says 5 seconds but was updated for an old production version; C is the current production configuration, 7 seconds.

需同时满足生产、当前、超时字段.en: Production, current and the timeout field all have to hold at once

三个条件都不能省。.en: None of the three conditions can be dropped.

主题相关但环境不符.en: Topically relevant but the wrong environment

不能作为目标答案。.en: It cannot serve as the answer sought.

环境对但版本旧.en: The right environment but an old version

读取当前版本和字段单位.en: Read the current version and the field's unit

得到7秒并可追溯。.en: This gives 7 seconds, and it can be traced.

候选集只有A/B.en: The candidate set has only A and B

回答证据不足，继续检索，而不是选最高分强答。.en: Answer that the evidence is insufficient and keep retrieving, instead of forcing an answer out of the top score.

把过程连起来。</strong>相关性排序只是候选优先级；证据充分性是对目标条件.en: Join the steps up. A relevance ranking is only a priority order over candidates; evidence sufficiency is an item-by-item verification against the target conditions.

边界与反例。</strong>数值与版本为教学构造；真实系统需要环境映射和权威来.en: Limits and counterexamples. The numbers and versions are a teaching construction; a real system needs environment mapping and rules about authoritative sources, not just a look at one date string.

追问：为什么“只根据提供资料回答”仍可能产生幻觉？.en: Follow-up: why can "answer only from the material provided" still produce hallucination?

模型可能用背景知识补空缺，误连因果、忽略否定或引用错误。Prompt是约束，不是.en: The model may fill a gap with background knowledge, join cause and effect wrongly, ignore a negation or cite the wrong thing. A prompt is a constraint, not a prover. What is needed is sufficient evidence, a permitted "missing" state, checks on the key assertions and appropriate deterministic verification; for code behavior a test can be run, and for numbers the calculation can be redone.

追问：资料不足时是继续搜索还是停止？.en: Follow-up: when the material is insufficient, keep searching or stop?

看缺口是否可通过已授权来源补齐，以及搜索的边际价值。能明确定位配置就继续读；没有.en: It depends on whether the gap can be filled from an authorized source, and on the marginal value of searching. If the configuration can be located precisely, go on reading; if there is no permission or the source does not exist, state the boundary. Searching without limit adds cost and may pick up low-quality support; one must not search until satisfied just to arrive at a yes.

追问：如何评估引用质量？.en: Follow-up: how is citation quality assessed?

至少检查引用存在、目标可访问、范围正确、内容支持声明、版本适用。可以用自动规则加.en: At a minimum, check that the citation exists, that the target is reachable, that the range is right, that the content supports the claim, and that the version applies. Automatic rules plus a model as an aid can judge this, but a high-risk claim needs a human or a deterministic check. Many citations are not the same as high quality; the minimum sufficient support is easier to review.

工程深挖 · E32 · 接续Q063.en: Engineering deep dive · E32 · continues Q063

相关、可引用、足以支持结论：证据要过三道不同的门.en: Relevant, citable, sufficient to support the conclusion: evidence must pass three different gates

第04课</a>。阅读顺序：先确认运行契约，再看反例与修复，最后检验边界。.en: Lesson 04. Reading order: confirm the run contract first, then look at the counterexamples and the fix, and finally test the limits.

不要把检索相似度当成逻辑蕴含.en: Do not take retrieval similarity for logical entailment

检索判断“这段与问题有关”；引用指向“这份材料来自哪里”；支持性判断“这段在这些.en: Retrieval judges "this passage has to do with the question"; a citation points at "where this material comes from"; a support judgment asks "can this passage, under these conditions, yield the current conclusion". None of the three can stand in for another. Rank fusion only combines relevance signals; it does not check the conditions of use for each proposition in the answer.

固定反例：资料说“Pro版本3允许上限100”，用户问“Free版本3是否允许1.en: A fixed counterexample: the material says "Pro version 3 allows a limit of 100", and the user asks "does Free version 3 allow 100". The title and the version are both highly relevant and the citation is genuine, but the tier condition does not match, so it cannot support "allowed". This book's local condition check returns false; this is not a judgment that relies on a language model's score.

把一个句子拆成带条件的命题.en: Break one sentence into propositions with conditions

例如“功能默认开启且不增加费用”含两个命题，可能分别需要配置文档与计费依据。证据.en: For example, "the feature is on by default and costs nothing extra" contains two propositions, which may need the configuration document and a billing basis respectively. An evidence table should record the proposition, the source range, the version, the time it took effect, who it applies to, the supporting or opposing relationship, and the unknowns. Keep as unknown whatever the source does not contain; do not use fluent language to fill it in as a conclusion.

时间尤其重要：同一功能旧文档与新文档不一致，可能是生效期变化，而非一份造假。长期.en: Time matters especially: an old document and a new one disagreeing about the same feature may mean the effective period changed, not that one of them is a fake. Research on long-term memory also treats temporal reasoning and knowledge updating as a separate capability.

应保留当时与现在的问题区别。.en: The difference between the question as it was then and as it is now should be preserved.

来源冲突时的处理顺序.en: The order in which conflicting sources are handled

先检查是否在讨论同一个对象、版本和条件；再看原始出处、发布时间与是否被后续正式撤.en: First check whether they are discussing the same object, version and conditions; then look at the original source, the publication time and whether it was formally withdrawn later. A conflict that cannot be resolved should be presented as it is, with a statement of which decision still needs verification. One cannot vote by "more sources support my current answer", especially as several web pages may have copied the same error.

追问：给每句都加引用就能避免幻觉吗？.en: Follow-up: does adding a citation to every sentence avoid hallucination?

不能。模型可以把真实来源挂到不被支持的句子后。自动检查至少需要定位引用范围与命题.en: No. A model can attach a genuine source to a sentence that the source does not support. An automatic check needs at least the citation's range and the proposition; a high-risk action needs a deterministic rule or a human check as well. The number of citations is not a measure of evidence sufficiency.

追问：怎样写这类测试而不过度依赖LLM裁判？.en: Follow-up: how are tests like this written without leaning too much on an LLM judge?

对明确结构条件使用可执行检查：版本、日期、tier、数量单位、授权状态。对开放表.en: For clearly structured conditions use executable checks: version, date, tier, units of quantity, authorization state. For open-ended statements use a small hand-labeled set of propositions and source fragments, then calibrate the judge. Keep counterexamples such as "relevant but unsupporting", "supports only half the sentence", "expired version" and "sources conflict", instead of testing only correct question-answer pairs.

E32：怎样读这份结果，而不是只看“通过”.en: E32: how to read this result, rather than only looking at "pass"

把结论的主体、版本、套餐或时间条件与证据逐格配对。相关段落只说明主题相似；条件不.en: Pair the conclusion's subject, version, plan or time condition with the evidence cell by cell. A relevant passage only shows that the topic is similar; when the conditions do not match, it cannot answer the current user directly.

自检：</strong>一篇材料高度相关且链接真实，为什么仍不能直接证明答案？.en: Self-check: a piece of material is highly relevant and its link is genuine, so why can it still not prove the answer?

它可能只适用于别的版本、用户层级或时间，或只支持答案的一部分。必须核对命题与来源.en: It may apply only to another version, user tier or time, or support only part of the answer. The proposition and the source's conditions and range have to be checked against each other, instead of letting relevance stand in for support.

Q036｜HyDE、RAPTOR、GraphRAG、Self-RAG分别解决哪个.en: Q036｜Which failure link does each of HyDE, RAPTOR, GraphRAG and Self-RAG address? When should they not be used?

这题先认识什么</span>召回漏了目标、重排压低正确项、生成曲解证据是三类故障.en: What to know first for this questionRecall missing the target, reranking pushing the correct item down, and generation distorting the evidence are three kinds of failure; they have to be measured separately before optimization can be aimed at one of them.

第17课 · 从搜索结果到可信答案</a><a class=\"pill\" h.en: Lesson 17 · From search results to a trustworthy answerLesson 05 · The denominator of an evaluation metricLesson 31 · Do not be fooled by a few percent

HyDE：假设文本只用于找材料.en: HyDE: the hypothetical text is only used to find material

用模型生成一份假设性的回答或文档，将其表示用于检索。这份生成文本是寻找证据的辅助.en: Have the model generate a hypothetical answer or document and use its representation for retrieval. That generated text is an aid to finding evidence, not a source of facts already found.<span class="concept-micro">The model guesses "it may be cache invalidation", which is reason enough to widen the search; before there is real evidence it must not be written up as "cache invalidation confirmed".

GraphRAG类方法利用实体关系及社区等组织信息；RAPTOR利用分层聚类与摘.en: GraphRAG-style methods use organizational information such as entity relationships and communities; RAPTOR uses hierarchical clustering and summaries to support retrieval. They introduce extra derived information, and with it problems of updating, provenance and error propagation.<span class="concept-micro">When the source document changes, an old summary or a relationship in the graph may be out of date. Changing the original text is no proof that every derived index has been updated with it.

借助生成的假设回答表示来帮助检索的方法。 例：假设内容不是可信事实，需要真实证据.en: A method that helps retrieval with the representation of a generated hypothetical answer. Example: the hypothetical content is not trustworthy fact, so real evidence is still needed.

改善查询表达与文档空间的匹配；.en: improves the match between the query's wording and the document space;

利用图关系或分层摘要组织检索的不同方法。 例：结构可帮助跨文档问题，也会产生构建.en: Different ways of organizing retrieval with graph relations or hierarchical summaries. Example: structure can help with questions that span documents, and it also brings a cost to build and maintain.

利用实体关系与社区摘要回答全局问题；Self-.en: uses entity relationships and community summaries to answer global questions; Self-

把检索与自我评价纳入模型行为；Corrective RAG关注检索质量评估和纠正.en: brings retrieval and self-evaluation into the model's behavior; Corrective RAG concerns itself with assessing and correcting retrieval quality. They are not a standard production pipeline that all has to be chained together.

用故障类型选择，而不是背名称.en: Choose by failure type, not by memorizing names

用户只有一句模糊问题、语料却是详细技术叙述，HyDE先生成假设文档再编码，可能缩.en: When the user has only one vague question while the corpus is detailed technical prose, HyDE generates a hypothetical document and encodes that, which may narrow the gap in wording. A hypothetical document is allowed to contain untrue detail, so it can serve only as a retrieval clue and cannot be cited as evidence. If the query already contains an exact error code, generating a passage of hypothetical content may dilute it instead.

需要理解长文档多个层次时，RAPTOR递归聚类和摘要形成树，查询可命中不同抽象层.en: When several levels of a long document have to be understood, RAPTOR clusters and summarizes recursively into a tree, and a query can hit different levels of abstraction. Summaries make an overview across passages easy, but updating the source document means updating the derived structure, and an error in a summary can propagate. When looking up one function parameter exactly, searching the source directly is usually simpler.

面向“整个资料集有哪些主要趋势”这种全局归纳，GraphRAG的实体关系与社区摘.en: For global induction such as "what are the main trends across the whole collection", GraphRAG's entity relationships and community summaries may suit better than a few local

片段更合适。代价是抽取、实体消歧、关系错误、建索引成本和更新复杂度。它不是把所有.en: fragments. The cost is extraction, entity disambiguation, wrong relationships, the cost of building the index and the complexity of updating. Turning all the text into a graph does not automatically yield causal knowledge.

Self-RAG原始研究包含训练与反思标记等机制，不等同于在任意模型后追加一句“.en: The original Self-RAG research includes mechanisms such as training and reflection tokens; it is not the same as appending "please check" after an arbitrary model. Corrective RAG also needs a quality-judging component; if that judgment is itself unreliable, it may trigger pointless web searches or discard good evidence by mistake.

先定位检索失败类型，再决定是否增加高级RAG组件.en: Locate the type of retrieval failure first, then decide whether to add advanced RAG components

本例条件：</strong>独立四种问题，各自隔离一个缺口。图不给统一胜者，也不.en: Conditions for this example: four independent questions, each isolating one gap. The figure names no overall winner and does not claim to reproduce the paper's scores.

查询表达缺口.en: A gap in how the query is expressed

用户问法与资料表述差距大。.en: The way the user asks is far from how the material words it.

答案分散在多个层级或文档。.en: The answer is spread across several levels or documents.

当前召回内容不够或不可信。.en: What has been recalled is not enough or not trustworthy.

查询太短，词汇不对齐.en: The query is too short and its vocabulary does not line up

HyDE生成假设描述辅助检索.en: HyDE generates a hypothetical description to help retrieval

假设文本不能当事实.en: A hypothetical text cannot be taken for a fact

长文需要局部与摘要切换.en: A long document needs switching between the local text and a summary

摘要丢细节或版本过期.en: The summary loses detail, or its version is out of date

跨实体/社区做全局归纳.en: Generalizing globally across entities or communities

建图维护与错误边传播.en: Graph maintenance and the propagation of wrong edges

需判断何时检索/纠正.en: When to retrieve or correct still has to be judged

Self-RAG、CRAG等研究.en: Research such as Self-RAG and CRAG

训练或流程成本与判断误差.en: The cost of training or of the pipeline, plus errors of judgment

同一关键词“RAG增强”背后可能改查询、改索引、改选择策略或改训练，不能当成一个.en: Behind the one keyword "enhanced RAG" there may be a change to the query, to the index, to the selection strategy or to the training; it cannot be treated as a single switch.

先用最小基线记录失败在哪一步，再挑对应方法。若问题是权限过滤错误，换更复杂的图索.en: Use the smallest baseline to record which step fails, then pick the matching method. If the problem is a permission-filter error, moving to a more elaborate graph index need not help at all.

评测时同时看正确率、证据可追溯、时效、成本和维护负担，而不只挑论文中的平均得分。.en: When evaluating, look at accuracy, traceability of evidence, timeliness, cost and maintenance burden together, rather than picking out the average score from a paper.

不要混淆：</strong>把论文机制简化成多写一句Prompt，不能声称已经实.en: Do not conflate: reducing a paper's mechanism to one extra line of prompt is no ground for claiming that the paper's system has been implemented.

四种RAG增强在同一个问题上分别做哪一步.en: Which step does each of the four RAG enhancements take on the same question

输入与条件。</strong>问题：“新发布规则为什么减少了构建失败？”资料有发.en: Input and conditions. The question is "why did the new release rule reduce build failures?" The material has release notes, failure logs and several module documents, with no ready-made summary.

先生成假设性说明用来检索.en: Generate a hypothetical account first and use it to retrieve

假设只当查询线索，不当发布事实。.en: The hypothesis counts only as a query clue, not as a release fact.

查分层摘要定位相关文档群.en: Search the layered summaries to locate the relevant group of documents

再回到叶子证据核查具体原因。.en: Then go back to the leaf evidence to check the actual cause.

利用模块、变更、错误之间的关系聚合.en: Aggregate using the relationships among modules, changes and errors

图中的边仍需来源支持。.en: The edges in the graph still need support from a source.

判断是否要取证、证据是否支持当前生成.en: Judge whether evidence should be fetched, and whether the evidence supports what is being generated

它涉及训练出的反思机制，不是随便加一句“自检”就完整复现。.en: It involves a reflection mechanism that was trained in; adding a "self-check" line is not a full reproduction of it.

证据只能说明相关变化而非因果.en: The evidence can only show a correlated change, not causation

结论保留“可能有关”，不补造实验。.en: Keep the conclusion at "possibly related" and do not invent an experiment.

把过程连起来。</strong>不同增强针对查询、索引层级、关系聚合或生成控制，.en: Join the steps up. Different enhancements act on the query, the index levels, relationship aggregation or generation control; a technique's name must not be treated as the same button.

边界与反例。</strong>流程是方法作用位置的对照，非四篇论文完整实现；不能.en: Limits and counterexamples. The flow is a comparison of where each method acts, not a complete implementation of the four papers; no performance gain can be derived from a teaching flow.

追问：如何验证一种高级RAG方案有实际收益？.en: Follow-up: how do you verify that an advanced RAG scheme really pays off?

先按问题类型建立测试集：精确事实、跨段、跨文档、全局归纳、时效冲突。与简单bas.en: Build a test set by question type first: exact facts, across passages, across documents, global induction, and conflicts over time. Compare against a simple baseline at the same budget, and look at recall, answer correctness, citation support, latency and the cost of building the store separately. The whole system cannot be judged with only the question type that suits the new method best.

追问：图里的关系可以直接当业务规则执行吗？.en: Follow-up: can the relationships in the graph be executed directly as business rules?

不能。LLM抽取的关系可能缺少条件、时间或否定；“A提到B”不是“A依赖B”，更.en: No. A relationship extracted by an LLM may lack a condition, a time or a negation; "A mentions B" is not "A depends on B", still less "A causes B". A rule that gets executed should have clear authoritative evidence and verification; using the graph for navigation and to associate candidates is sounder.

追问：为什么基础检索做不好时不宜立刻上复杂框架？.en: Follow-up: why is it unwise to adopt a complex framework the moment basic retrieval works badly?

解析丢信息、权限错、索引旧的问题会被复杂管线继承并放大。先保证原文、元数据、精确.en: Information lost in parsing, wrong permissions and a stale index are inherited and amplified by a complex pipeline. Make sure the original text, the metadata, exact retrieval and simple hybrid retrieval work first, then introduce new mechanisms for the specific failures that remain. A method's name cannot replace locating the failure.

17｜代码智能：从文本搜索到符号、版本与运行证据.en: 17｜Code intelligence: from text search to symbols, versions and run evidence

沿着对象与状态理解本章</a><a href=\"#topic-2\">从两个候.en: Follow this chapter through its objects and statesFrom two candidate lists to usable evidenceQ033｜How are BM25 and vector retrieval fused? Why does RRF not add the raw scores directly?Q034｜Why are a cross-encoder reranker and ColBERT finer than a simple cosine?Q035｜Relevant material has been retrieved: how do you judge that it is already enough to answer? How is a citation bound to the conclusion?Q036｜Which failure link does each of HyDE, RAPTOR, GraphRAG and Self-RAG address? When should they not be used?

第21课｜代码智能：从文本搜索到符号、版本与运行证据 — AI系统工程.en: Lesson 21｜Code intelligence: from text search to symbols, versions and run evidence — AI Systems Engineering

沿着对象与状态理解本章</a><a href=\"#topic-2\">代码检索.en: Follow this chapter through its objects and statesCode retrieval cannot rely on "semantically similar" aloneQ037｜What does each of grep, AST, LSP and the call graph know? Why can they not stand in for one another?Q038｜How does a code index handle Git versions, the work tree and unsaved files?Q039｜How should a bug be located step by step? Why is "read more source" not a sufficient method?Q040｜How do you get an agent to "understand the business" instead of only ever looking at local code?Why does code evidence need the work-tree version, and not just the commit?

源码有语言结构与版本关系。文本搜索找字符，AST找语法结构，LSP理解符号和类型.en: Source code has language structure and version relationships. A text search finds characters, an AST finds syntactic structure, and LSP understands symbols and types; compiling and testing provide run evidence. No single method can replace the other layers.

第02课 · 状态、事件与检查点</a><a class=\"pill\" hr.en: Lesson 02 · State, events and checkpointsLesson 16 · Retrieval, to begin withLesson 17 · From search results to a trustworthy answerLesson 18 · Code is not an ordinary documentLesson 04 · Foundations of engineering quality

进入深读前的小检查：</strong>对同名foo的两个模块，说明正则为何会混淆.en: A quick check before the deep reading: for two modules with a function named foo, say why a regular expression confuses them, what a definition-and-reference relationship adds, and why a language service can also be incomplete when the dependencies are not loaded.

代码库不是普通文章集合。标识符、类型、模块关系、构建配置、版本和执行环境提供了比.en: A code base is not an ordinary collection of articles. Identifiers, types, module relationships, build configuration, versions and the execution environment provide clues more precise than a semantic vector, but those clues have limits too.

代码里的同名字串、语法节点、符号引用、运行调用和测试证据是不同层。先看一段代码如.en: Identical strings in the code, syntax nodes, symbol references, calls at run time and test evidence are different layers. Look first at how one piece of code is located step by step by these layers, then judge whether a full-text search, an AST, LSP or an actual run is needed.

相关动态过程：<a href=\"../visual/F30.html\">代码.en: Related step-by-step process: Code retrieval cannot rely on "semantically similar" alone. The rest of this section goes on to show the computation and the engineering limits in more detail.

继续看相关机制：<a href=\"../visual/F34.html\">第.en: Related mechanisms to continue with: Lesson 04 · A test looks for counterexamples; it does not stamp code greenLesson 23 · Long-term memory is not a note that is always right

Q037｜grep、AST、LSP、调用图各知道什么？为什么不能互相替代？.en: Q037｜What does each of grep, AST, LSP and the call graph know? Why can they not stand in for one another?

这题先认识什么</span>正则找文本，AST找语法结构，LSP找语言语义关系。.en: What to know first for this questionA regular expression finds text, an AST finds syntactic structure, and LSP finds the language's semantic relationships. Dynamic loading, macros and generated code all affect how complete static analysis can be.

第18课 · 代码不是普通文档.en: Lesson 18 · Code is not an ordinary document

抽象语法树，表示程序的语法结构。 例：能区分函数定义与普通字符串，但不包含全部运.en: The abstract syntax tree, which represents the syntactic structure of a program. Example: it can tell a function definition from an ordinary string, but it does not contain every fact about the run.

编辑器与语言服务交互的协议，支持定义、引用和诊断等。 例：服务能力取决于语言实现.en: The protocol by which an editor and a language service interact, supporting definitions, references, diagnostics and the like. Example: what the service can do depends on the language implementation and the project configuration.

通过语言服务提供定义、引用、类型诊断等能力；调用图描述可能或已观察的调用关系。文.en: provides capabilities such as definitions, references and type diagnostics through a language service; a call graph describes possible or already observed call relationships. Text occurring is not a symbol reference, correct syntax is not correct types, and statically reachable is not actually happening at run time.

，可能命中函数定义、注释、字符串和测试数据。grep快且通用，但不知道哪些是同一.en: , and it can hit the function definition, comments, strings and test data. grep is fast and general, but it does not know which of them are the same symbol. An AST can recognize function declarations and call expressions and rule out some comment and string noise; but a syntax tree alone need not resolve import aliases, generics or dispatch at run time.

语言服务结合项目配置、依赖与类型信息，把某个使用位置解析到具体定义。两个不同模块.en: A language service combines the project configuration, the dependencies and type information to resolve one use site to its specific definition. Functions with the same name in two different modules should not be mixed together. If the build configuration is wrong, the dependencies are not installed, or the language server has not finished indexing, the result can also be missing or out of date.

静态调用图能帮助扩展影响范围，但反射、依赖注入、动态导入、函数指针和多态会使它不.en: A static call graph helps widen the scope of impact, but reflection, dependency injection, dynamic imports, function pointers and polymorphism make it incomplete or conservatively too broad. A run

只展示这一次输入经过的路径，也不能证明其他路径不存在。可靠定位通常组合文本、结构.en: only shows the path this one input took, and it cannot prove that other paths do not exist. Reliable location usually combines text, structure, type and run evidence.

grep、AST、LSP、运行日志分别回答不同层的问题.en: grep, AST, LSP and run logs each answer questions at a different layer

本例条件：</strong>独立代码例：两个模块都定义parse；某处调用obj.en: Conditions for this example: an independent code example: two modules both define parse; somewhere obj.parse() is called. Finding the string parse alone cannot settle which implementation is called at run time.

解析后的语法结构树。.en: The syntax tree obtained after parsing.

编辑器与语言服务沟通定义、引用等能力的协议。.en: The protocol by which an editor talks to a language service about definitions, references and similar capabilities.

实际接收者类型可能在运行时才确定。.en: The actual receiver type may only be fixed at run time.

哪些是注释，哪些是调用.en: Which are comments and which are calls

在当前项目配置下推断定义与引用.en: Infer definitions and references under the current project configuration

反射、运行时注入的所有路径.en: Every path through reflection and runtime injection

其他输入是否也走同一路径.en: Whether other inputs take the same path too

每一层都不是上一层的万能替代。grep适合快速缩小范围，AST排除文本噪声，语言.en: No layer is a universal replacement for the one before it. grep is good for narrowing the range quickly, an AST rules out textual noise, a language service adds static semantics, and run evidence checks the actual path.

运行一次确定了一条路径，不等于证明所有输入都只走这条路径。诊断报告应注明样例输入.en: One run establishes one path; that is not proof that every input takes only this path. A diagnostic report should state the sample input and the environment.

某层失败后要识别原因：解析失败可能是语法版本，跳转错误可能是项目配置，不必直接归.en: When a layer fails, identify why: a parse failure may be a grammar version and a wrong jump may be the project configuration, so neither has to be attributed to the model.

不要混淆：</strong>LSP返回的字符位置也有编码约定，UTF-16偏移不.en: Do not conflate: the character positions LSP returns follow an encoding convention of their own; a UTF-16 offset cannot be taken as a Python character index without conversion.

同名foo出现三次，grep和LSP给出的集合为何不同.en: The name foo appears three times, so why do grep and LSP give different sets

输入与条件。</strong>文件a定义foo，文件b导入a.foo并调用，文件.en: Input and conditions. File a defines foo, file b imports a.foo and calls it, and file c defines another local foo inside a function; a comment mentions foo as well.

得到定义、调用、局部同名与注释。.en: This gives the definition, the call, the local namesake and the comment.

可去掉注释，但同名调用仍可能属于不同绑定。.en: Comments can be dropped, but calls with the same name may still belong to different bindings.

LSP查a.foo的引用.en: LSP looks up the references to a.foo

应关联b的调用，不把c的局部foo混入。.en: It should associate b's call and should not mix in c's local foo.

若调用由字符串动态生成.en: If the call is generated dynamically from a string

静态引用可能漏，需检查注册与实际日志。.en: Static references may miss it; check the registration and the actual logs.

根据绑定和测试确定调用方.en: Determine the callers from the bindings and the tests

不能机械替换所有foo文本。.en: Not every occurrence of the text foo can be replaced mechanically.

把过程连起来。</strong>文本相等、语法角色相等和符号身份相等是逐步增强但.en: Join the steps up. Equal text, equal syntactic role and equal symbol identity are progressively stronger but different relationships.

边界与反例。</strong>LSP准确性依语言服务与工程配置；动态语言、反射、.en: Limits and counterexamples. LSP accuracy depends on the language service and the project configuration; for dynamic languages, reflection and generated code, static analysis is not guaranteed to be exhaustive.

追问：Tree-sitter解析成功就表示代码能编译吗？.en: Follow-up: does Tree-sitter parsing successfully mean the code compiles?

不。它关注语法结构并可容忍不完整编辑状态；类型错误、链接错误、依赖缺失和运行异常.en: No. It is concerned with syntactic structure and can tolerate an incomplete editing state; type errors, link errors, missing dependencies and run-time exceptions need other tools. Treating an AST as a complete semantic database misses the engineering configuration layer.

追问：为什么查references比全仓grep更有价值？.en: Follow-up: why is looking up references more valuable than grepping the whole repository?

当语言服务正确配置时，它按符号身份返回引用，减少同名误命中，并可跨别名和模块追踪.en: When the language service is configured correctly, it returns references by symbol identity, which cuts down false hits on the same name and can follow aliases and modules. But dynamic patterns it does not support may still be missed; choose according to the language and the project, and never take zero references as absolute proof that nothing uses it.

追问：什么时候直接grep最好？.en: Follow-up: when is a plain grep best?

已知错误码、配置键、日志文本、文件名或精确函数名时，低成本文本搜索往往是最有效入.en: When the error code, configuration key, log text, file name or exact function name is known, a low-cost text search is often the most effective way in. Narrow the scope with cheap tools first, then go deeper with semantic and type tools. A more advanced technique is not the one that should run first.

工程深挖 · E33 · 接续Q065.en: Engineering deep dive · E33 · continues Q065

代码位置的单位错一个，编辑就可能改错字符：UTF-8、UTF-16与版本号.en: Get the unit of a code position wrong by one and an edit can change the wrong characters: UTF-8, UTF-16 and version numbers

第18课</a>。阅读顺序：先确认运行契约，再看反例与修复，最后检验边界。.en: Lesson 18. Reading order: confirm the run contract first, then look at the counterexamples and the fix, and finally test the limits.

“character=3”先问单位是什么.en: "character=3": ask what the unit is first

LSP3.17的Position.character按初始化协商的Positio.en: Position.character in LSP 3.17 is interpreted according to the PositionEncodingKind negotiated at initialization; UTF-16 is the default and the encoding a server must support, and the counts mean different things in UTF-8 and UTF-32. This rule comes from position.md in the Microsoft specification; it was not guessed from the habits of JavaScript strings.

，b之前有2个Unicode码点、3个UTF-16 code unit、5个UT.en: , where before b there are 2 Unicode code points, 3 UTF-16 code units and 5 UTF-8 bytes. Python's plain string len, the string length commonly used in JavaScript, the Content-Length of the protocol transport and an LSP position can therefore give different numbers. Do not take tests passing for Chinese and English as proof that Unicode positions are handled correctly.

从一个位置到一次安全编辑.en: From one position to one safe edit

先用协商编码解释起止位置，再按对应的文档快照转换到内部索引；范围采用协议约定的边.en: Interpret the start and end positions with the negotiated encoding first, then convert them to internal indices against the matching document snapshot; take the range boundaries the protocol agrees on, and do not mistake the end position for including the last character. Then check the document version, and generate the edit last. The same line and character can point at entirely different content once the user has typed more.

本书实际计算上述三个长度，另将版本与内容指纹检查作为执行层约束。它没有启动真实语.en: This book actually computes the three lengths above, and additionally makes the version and content-fingerprint check a constraint at the execution layer. It did not start a real language server, so it claims no certification of compatibility with any IDE.

版本冲突不能靠“附近搜索同名文本”盲目修复.en: A version conflict cannot be fixed blindly by "searching nearby for the same text"

如果收到的编辑基于版本7，而当前buffer已经版本8，直接应用可能覆盖用户新内.en: If the edit received is based on version 7 while the buffer is already at version 8, applying it directly may overwrite the user's new content. Automatic relocation needs explicit context and a conflict policy; where no unique judgment is possible, fetch the range again or refuse. The line numbers the model gives are only a proposal, and they cannot bypass the harness's version protection.

追问：文件落盘内容与编辑器buffer谁更权威？.en: Follow-up: which is authoritative, the content on disk or the editor's buffer?

要看动作对象。LSP常处理内存文档；shell测试通常读取磁盘。两个视图没同步时.en: It depends on what the action acts on. LSP usually works with in-memory documents; a shell test usually reads the disk. When the two views are out of sync, the model may analyze the buffer while the test runs the old file. The evidence should say "the source is the in-memory version" or "the source is the work-tree file", and where necessary save explicitly or have the verification read the same snapshot.

追问：为什么不用所有地方统一成字节偏移？.en: Follow-up: why not unify everything on byte offsets?

内部可以统一，但边界仍需精确转换；协议、编辑器和模型报告未必使用字节。统一存储单.en: Internally they can be unified, but the boundaries still need exact conversion; the protocol, the editor and the model's reports need not use bytes. A unified unit of storage does not mean the input's unit can be ignored. Tests containing combining characters, emoji, CRLF and non-BMP characters expose hidden assumptions.

E33：怎样读这份结果，而不是只看“通过”.en: E33: how to read this result, rather than only looking at "pass"

同一字符串“a😀b”，b前的码点、UTF-16单元、UTF-8字节数不同。位置里.en: For the same string "a😀b", the number of code points, UTF-16 units and UTF-8 bytes before b differ. An integer in a position must carry its unit; and the version must match the actual text being edited.

自检：</strong>a😀b中b的起点，按UTF-16与UTF-8分别是多少？.en: Self-check: where does b start in a😀b, in UTF-16 and in UTF-8?

UTF-16是3个code unit：a占1，emoji占2；UTF-8是5字节.en: In UTF-16 it is 3 code units: a takes 1 and the emoji takes 2; in UTF-8 it is 5 bytes: a takes 1 and the emoji takes 4. The Unicode code point position is 2, and the three must not be used interchangeably.

代码证据为什么需要工作树版本，而不只是commit？.en: Why does code evidence need the work-tree version, and not just the commit?

commit相同，文件也可能不同.en: The commit can be the same and the file still different

用户有未提交修改，Agent也会在任务中连续写文件。两次测试都写着commit.en: The user has uncommitted changes, and the agent writes files one after another during the task too. Two test runs can both record commit abc while the things actually tested were the work trees r7 and r9. Record the content hash of the affected files, the command run, the environment and the set of tests, not just the branch name.

文件已被改成r8.en: The file has already been changed to r8

源码与证据版本链。数值与状态属于本节明确设定的教学例；不是生产性能或商业模型实测.en: The source and the version chain of evidence. The numbers and states are a teaching example explicitly set out in this section; they are not production performance or a measurement of a commercial model.

从文本搜索到可验证修改.en: From a text search to a verifiable change

先用路径、报错、精确符号缩小范围；需要时再借AST或LSP查定义与引用；最后用运.en: Narrow the scope first with the path, the error message and exact symbols; then, where needed, look up definitions and references with an AST or LSP; and verify the hypothesis with run evidence at the end. A syntax tree can express structure, but it does not automatically know about dynamic loading, run-time configuration or generated files. An LSP position also depends on the encoding unit negotiated in the protocol: a UTF-16 position cannot be taken unconditionally for a UTF-8 byte offset.

补丁的三个前置条件.en: The three preconditions for a patch

教学补丁P针对r7的第12行。真正应用前要核对目标仍是r7、预期旧文本仍存在、路.en: The teaching patch P targets line 12 of r7. Before it is really applied, check that the target is still r7, that the expected old text is still there, and that the path is still within the permitted range. If the file has become r8, an old line number cannot be relied on to overwrite blindly. A patch tool finding similar context automatically is no proof of semantic correctness either; after applying it, still look at the diff and the tests.

为什么测试通过之后再修改会失效.en: Why a passing test stops holding once something is changed afterwards

测试结果对象应绑定.en: A test-result object should be bound to

。通过后再格式化或生成代码，至少需要重新验证受影响部分。退出码0也要检查是否全部.en: . Formatting or generating code after it passes means at least re-verifying the affected part. An exit code of 0 also has to be checked for everything being skipped, no tests being collected, the command being wrapped wrongly, or an environment variable having changed the scope of the tests.

Anthropic的长任务工程强调可恢复进度与可验证功能，而非只写“完成”；大型.en: Anthropic's engineering for long-running tasks stresses recoverable progress and verifiable functionality rather than merely writing "done"; the large-scale parallel coding case likewise depends on tests and coordination. A case shows the value of one engineering approach; it does not mean every task should adopt large-scale parallelism.

交付应该回答四个问题.en: A delivery should answer four questions

改了什么、为什么改、哪些证据支持、哪些仍未验证。把“静态检查通过”和“实际运行验.en: What was changed, why it was changed, which evidence supports it, and what is still unverified. State "the static checks pass" and "verified by an actual run" separately; when a check cannot be run, record the reason and the risk, rather than writing "not run" down as "passed".

阅读、修改、测试必须指向同一对象.en: Reading, changing and testing must point at the same object

固定教学例：read看到r7，patch生成r8，测试运行r8；若格式化又产生r.en: A fixed teaching example: read sees r7, the patch produces r8, and the test runs r8; if formatting then produces r9, the delivery cannot go on marking the r8 test as r9 having passed. This principle does not require a whole-repository retest for every small change; it requires the coverage of the verification to match the last change made.

长任务工程文章强调可恢复产物和实际测试，但没有提供适用于所有语言的测试选择器。A.en: The article on engineering for long-running tasks stresses recoverable artifacts and real tests, but it does not provide a test selector that suits every language. How an AST, LSP or dependency graph helps narrow the scope still needs the language tools' own definitions and evidence from the current work tree; a general article about a harness is not used here as the source for a specific conclusion about the LSP protocol.

Q038｜代码索引怎样处理Git版本、工作树和未保存文件？.en: Q038｜How does a code index handle Git versions, the work tree and unsaved files?

这题先认识什么</span>仓库快照、工作区未提交文件与运行依赖共同决定实际程序.en: What to know first for this questionThe repository snapshot, the uncommitted files in the workspace and the run-time dependencies together decide the actual program; citing a commit alone is not enough to stand for the version being executed.

第02课 · 状态、事件与检查点</a><a class=\"pill\" hr.en: Lesson 02 · State, events and checkpointsLesson 18 · Code is not an ordinary documentLesson 04 · Foundations of engineering quality

一个仓库可能同时有提交快照、磁盘工作树、编辑器未保存缓冲和后台索引。.en: One repository can have a commit snapshot, a work tree on disk, unsaved buffers in the editor and a background index all at once.

必须知道当前证据来自哪一层，编辑与测试针对哪一层。路径相同不等于内容相同。.en: has to know which layer the current evidence comes from, and which layer the edits and the tests act on. The same path does not mean the same content.

四份“同一个文件”的冲突.en: Four conflicting copies of "the same file"

版本r10，用户本地已改为r11但未提交；编辑器又有未保存r12；索引仍是r10.en: is at version r10, the user has changed it locally to r11 without committing, the editor holds a further unsaved r12, and the index is still r10. The agent reads r10 from the index, generates a patch and writes it to disk over r11; the user then saves the editor's r12 over the agent's patch. Even though no single step reports an error, the final result is wrong.

安全的读取接口应尽可能返回内容来源与版本标识。编辑时核对预期旧内容或版本；测试实.en: A safe read interface should return the content's source and version identifier wherever it can. When editing, check the expected old content or the version; and which copy of the code a test actually runs, in the work tree or in the build environment, has to be stated as well. For an IDE integration, a workspace overlay can be designed so that unsaved content is read first, but one cannot assume that every tool shares that overlay automatically.

增量索引要处理文件修改、删除、重命名和生成文件变化。只按mtime可能漏掉特殊时.en: Incremental indexing has to handle file modifications, deletions, renames and changes to generated files. Going by mtime alone can miss unusual timestamps or caching problems; going by path alone will misidentify a rename. An implementation can combine version and content identifiers, but it need not build a complex whole-repository signature for every simple search.

HEAD、工作树、ETag与内容指纹.en: HEAD, working tree, ETag and content fingerprint

Git的HEAD标识当前检出的提交或分支位置；工作树还可能有未提交修改。ETag.en: Git's HEAD marks the commit or branch currently checked out; the working tree may still hold uncommitted changes. An ETag is a validator for an HTTP representation, and what it guarantees depends on the service. A content fingerprint is computed over the bytes; these kinds of version identity are not interchangeable. <span class="concept-micro">When the index comes from commit v7 but the file has been modified locally, the same file name does not mean the same content. Applying a patch or citing evidence should be checked against the version actually present.

同一路径，commit、工作树、编辑器可以有三份内容.en: For one path, the commit, the work tree and the editor can hold three different contents

本例条件：</strong>独立文件filter.py：仓库r7返回False，.en: Conditions for this example: an independent file filter.py: the repository at r7 returns False, the uncommitted file on disk has been changed to True, and the editor has added a further condition that is not saved. The index was built from r7.

版本库中的固定快照。.en: A fixed snapshot in the repository.

编辑器尚未保存的内容。.en: Content the editor has not saved yet.

解释已经过期.en: The explanation is out of date

测试对象与索引不同.en: The object under test is not the same as the index

还不是磁盘测试对象.en: not yet the object the on-disk test reads

读取当前内容并核对hash.en: Read the current content and check the hash

不把r7旧行号直接应用.en: Do not apply r7's old line numbers directly

这里不是时间越新越好这么简单，而是先确定“我们要修改和验证的工件到底是哪一个”。.en: It is not as simple as newer always being better; first settle "which artifact is the one we are going to change and verify".

每份证据携带版本；应用补丁前再次核对当前内容，避免基于旧索引覆盖用户的新修改。.en: Every piece of evidence carries a version; check the current content again before applying a patch, so that an old index does not overwrite the user's new change.

索引更新可以增量化，但删除、重命名和配置变化也会使关联失效，不能只监听新增文件。.en: Index updates can be incremental, but deletions, renames and configuration changes also make the links stale, so watching for new files alone is not enough.

不要混淆：</strong>只记录分支名main不足以定位工件，因为分支会移动；.en: Do not conflate: recording only the branch name main is not enough to identify an artifact, because a branch moves; a commit or content fingerprint is needed, together with the necessary working-tree diff.

索引对应v7，工作树已经改了，哪份代码才是证据.en: The index is at v7 and the work tree has changed: which code is the evidence

输入与条件。</strong>HEAD=v7，工作树有未提交变更w1；语义索引仍.en: Input and conditions. HEAD=v7, the work tree has the uncommitted change w1, and the semantic index is still built from v7. The model's search gives the old function signature foo(x).

知道它是哪个快照。.en: This tells you which snapshot it is.

工作树中签名为foo(x,y).en: In the work tree the signature is foo(x,y)

当前任务应以实际工作树为准。.en: The current task should go by the actual work tree.

旧索引用于定位文件，当前读取用于判断.en: The old index serves to locate the file; the current read serves to judge

不能把定位证据当最终内容。.en: Evidence used for locating must not be taken for the final content.

调用方可能只传一个参数.en: A caller may pass only one argument

检查实际代码和测试失败。.en: Check the actual code and the test failures.

记录提交或工作树指纹及测试对象.en: Record the commit or work-tree fingerprint and what was tested

确保最后交付不是又切回另一份版本。.en: This makes sure the final delivery has not switched back to another version.

把过程连起来。</strong>索引可以过期地帮助找路，但涉及修改与结论时必须回.en: Join the steps up. An index can help find the way even when it is stale, but once a change or a conclusion is involved, the target version has to be read back.

边界与反例。</strong>不要求每次都重建全量索引；差异增量与按需读取可以更.en: Limits and counterexamples. It does not require rebuilding the whole index every time; an incremental diff and reading on demand can be cheaper.

追问：全仓索引更新完再允许Agent工作是否最安全？.en: Follow-up: is it safest to let the agent work only once the whole-repository index has finished updating?

会降低延迟且可能阻塞不必要的任务。可采用候选索引定位后直接读取当前文件确认的策略.en: That costs latency and may block tasks that need no blocking. One can instead locate candidates with the index and then read the current file to confirm: the index is for finding things fast, the live read is for the facts. For a high-risk change, check the version of the key dependencies explicitly; there is no need to rebuild the whole repository every time.

追问：为什么只记录Git commit还不够？.en: Follow-up: why is recording the Git commit alone not enough?

未提交改动、生成代码、依赖锁文件、环境变量和测试配置都可能影响执行。验证证据至少.en: Uncommitted changes, generated code, dependency lock files, environment variables and test configuration can all affect execution. Verification evidence must at least correspond to the actual state of the work tree and the command's environment.

是重要标识，但不涵盖所有可变输入。.en: is an important identifier, but it does not cover every mutable input.

追问：源码更新后旧结论是不是全部作废？.en: Follow-up: once the source is updated, are all the old conclusions void?

不一定。只需重新验证受影响的事实与依赖。可以把知识绑定到具体模块/文件/符号，变.en: Not necessarily. Only the affected facts and dependencies have to be verified again. Knowledge can be bound to a specific module, file or symbol, so that a change triggers a local re-check. Forgetting everything wastes cost, and never expiring is dangerous; what matters is that the scope of the dependency is clear.

工程深挖 · E34 · 接续Q066.en: Engineering deep dive · E34 · continues Q066

HEAD没变为什么证据已经过期？工作树、未保存buffer与索引快照.en: HEAD has not moved, so why is the evidence already stale? The working tree, the unsaved buffer and the index snapshot

commit只标识提交，不标识当前全部事实.en: A commit identifies the commit, not every current fact

同一HEAD下文件可以有未提交修改；编辑器还可能有未保存buffer；构建产物与.en: Under the same HEAD a file can have uncommitted changes; the editor may also hold an unsaved buffer; and build artifacts and environment variables can change the result of a run too. Writing the retrieval cache key as repo+HEAD does not always guarantee that the current code is what gets read. Git's work-tree mechanism separates the working directory from the shared repository data, and it must not be understood as every fact being covered by the commit.

本书在临时目录把.en: In a temporary directory this book changes

，固定“HEAD标签”不变，文件内容哈希改变。这个实验没有伪造Git提交，只用实.en: , keeping the "HEAD label" fixed while the file's content hash changes. This experiment did not fake a Git commit; it uses an actual file change alone to prove the logic: commit identity is not enough to cover the state of the work tree.

证据应描述它观察的那个世界.en: Evidence should describe the world it observed

一份代码证据可记录路径、内容指纹、范围、仓库提交、工作树/文档版本以及读取时间；.en: One piece of code evidence can record the path, the content fingerprint, the range, the repository commit, the work-tree or document version, and the time it was read; run evidence also includes the command, the dependencies, the configuration and the input fixture. There is no need to build a complex database for every small task, but it should at least be able to answer "which file exactly does this test correspond to".

检索索引可能异步更新。用户刚改代码，语义索引还在旧快照时，应该对命中的关键文件重.en: A retrieval index may update asynchronously. When the user has just changed the code while the semantic index is still on the old snapshot, the key files that were hit should be read again, or the index version stated. For a modifying operation, taking the line numbers from an old snippet and writing the current file is not allowed.

补丁的前置条件要和写入放在同一个受控过程.en: A patch's preconditions have to sit in the same controlled process as the write

先读hash=r7，生成补丁期间别人改成r8；提交前检查还是r7，再原子替换。如.en: First read hash=r7; while the patch is being generated someone changes it to r8; check before committing that it is still r7, then replace atomically. If another writer can still slip in between the check and the replacement, there is a TOCTOU (a change between the time of check and the time of use) window. A collaborative system needs everyone to honor the same lock, or to use storage that supports a conditional update on version.

追问：给每个Agent一个worktree就不会冲突吗？.en: Follow-up: does giving each agent its own worktree avoid conflicts?

它隔离各自文件修改，便于汇总，但最后合并可能有语义冲突；共享端口、数据库、包缓存.en: It isolates each one's file changes and makes them easier to collect, but the final merge can still have semantic conflicts; shared ports, databases, package caches and parts of the Git state have no natural isolation either. Tests that depend on the same external state still need their own fixtures.

追问：怎样避免把旧测试结果错贴到新补丁上？.en: Follow-up: how do you avoid pasting an old test result onto a new patch?

记录测试启动和结束时验证的版本/指纹。所有预期修改完成后运行验收；若测试期间文件.en: Record the version or fingerprint verified when the test started and when it ended. Run the acceptance tests once all the intended changes are complete; if a file changed during the test, the result should be marked as based on the old version or as uncertain. Showing "the last test was green" without showing what was verified manufactures a false sense of safety.

E34：怎样读这份结果，而不是只看“通过”.en: E34: how to read this result, rather than only looking at "pass"

HEAD相同只证明提交指针未移动。工作树或IDE缓冲区可以已经不同，验证结果需要.en: The same HEAD only proves that the commit pointer has not moved. The work tree or the IDE's buffer can already differ, so a verification result has to be bound to the file's content and not only to the commit string.

自检：</strong>同一commit下函数文件已改但未提交，按commit缓.en: Self-check: under the same commit, a function's file has been changed but not committed. Is a symbol index cached by commit necessarily still valid?

不一定。HEAD不包含未提交工作树或未保存buffer。关键操作需核对当前内容/.en: Not necessarily. HEAD does not include an uncommitted work tree or an unsaved buffer. A critical operation has to check the current content or document version; a hit in the index cannot replace reading before execution.

Q039｜一个Bug应怎样逐步定位？为什么“多读源码”不是充分方法？.en: Q039｜How should a bug be located step by step? Why is "read more source" not a sufficient method?

这题先认识什么</span>Bug定位从可复现现象到候选代码，再排除反例。找到看.en: What to know first for this questionLocating a bug goes from a reproducible symptom to candidate code, and then rules candidates out with counterexamples. Finding a function that looks suspicious is not the same as finding the root cause.

第17课 · 从搜索结果到可信答案</a><a class=\"pill\" h.en: Lesson 17 · From search results to a trustworthy answerLesson 18 · Code is not an ordinary documentLesson 04 · Foundations of engineering quality

先形成可观察失败，再提出可证伪假设，选择能区分假设的最小证据。代码阅读、测试和日.en: Form an observable failure first, then propose a falsifiable hypothesis, and choose the smallest evidence that can tell the hypotheses apart. Reading code, tests and logs should serve to narrow the set of causes, not to pile up context aimlessly.

以exclude不生效为例.en: Take exclude having no effect as an example

用户现象：配置了.en: What the user sees: they configured

但仍打包build目录。候选原因可包括配置没加载、规则解析错误、路径规范化不一致.en: but the build directory still gets packaged. Candidate causes include the configuration not being loaded, a rule being parsed wrongly, inconsistent path normalization, and the match result being overwritten later. First confirm that the rule is present in the running configuration, which rules the first one out; then print or test the paths the matching entry point receives, and find that they are absolute while the rule targets relative paths; build a minimal test and reproduce it. At that point the focus turns to normalization and the meaning of the root directory, rather than to reading more of the unrelated packaging module.

就直接换库，可能把根因掩盖，还引入新匹配语义。修复前先确认需求：规则按仓库根还是.en: and swaps the library straight away, the root cause may be buried and new matching semantics introduced. Before fixing it, settle the requirement: are rules relative to the repository root or to the current directory? How are path separators handled? Does a directory rule include the files below it? Are symbolic links followed? These boundaries decide the test and the patch.

最小补丁后，先跑原失败案例，再跑针对相邻语义的回归。若测试仍失败，应依据新错误更.en: After the minimal patch, run the original failing case first, then the regressions aimed at the neighboring semantics. If a test still fails, update the hypothesis from the new error instead of repeating the same change. Every step should ideally answer "what do I expect to see, and what does a different result mean".

定位Bug：用能区分假设的输入，而不是盲目多读文件.en: Locating a bug: use input that can tell the hypotheses apart, rather than blindly reading more files

本例条件：</strong>独立目录排除Bug：规则vendor/应排除vend.en: Conditions for this example: an independent directory-exclusion bug: the rule vendor/ should exclude vendor/a.py and should not exclude myvendor/a.py. The original implementation treated string containment as a directory prefix.

用来击穿错误实现的小输入。.en: A small input that breaks a wrong implementation.

对错误原因的可验证解释。.en: A verifiable explanation of the cause of the error.

两种实现输出不同的位置。.en: The place where the two implementations output something different.

需先定义是根目录规则还是任意层目录.en: Whether the rule covers the root directory or a directory at any level has to be defined first

第一行通过不能证明算法正确，因为正确实现和错误实现都能过。第二行才区分了它们。.en: Passing the first row does not prove the algorithm correct, because a correct implementation and a wrong one both pass it. Only the second row tells them apart.

第三行提醒：有时不是代码错而是需求没定义。先固定规则语义，再写测试，否则Agen.en: The third row is a reminder: sometimes the code is not wrong, the requirement was never defined. Fix the meaning of the rule first, then write the test; otherwise the agent can only guess.

确认根因后做最小修改并回归相邻边界，比继续读更多无关文件更有效。.en: Once the root cause is confirmed, making the smallest change and running a regression on the adjacent boundaries is more effective than reading yet more unrelated files.

不要混淆：</strong>修改后若仅新增第一行测试，依然无法防止原来的错误实现.en: Do not conflate: if the change only adds the first line of test, it still does nothing to stop the original wrong implementation coming back.

exclude误删ab目录：从失败输入一步步到根因.en: exclude wrongly drops the ab directory: from the failing input step by step to the root cause

输入与条件。</strong>要求排除目录a及其子目录，但保留ab。旧判断是pa.en: Input and conditions. Directory a and everything below it are to be excluded, but ab is to be kept. The old test was path.startswith("a"); the inputs are a, a/x and ab/y.

三个字符串都以a开头.en: All three strings begin with a

规范化后path==a或path以a/开头.en: After normalization, path==a or path begins with a/

边界是目录分隔符，不是任意字符前缀。.en: The boundary is the directory separator, not any character prefix.

用ab/y即可触发错误.en: ab/y alone is enough to trigger the error

不需要先重构整个路径系统。.en: There is no need to restructure the whole path system first.

再加绝对/相对路径、分隔符规范化的实际需求。.en: Then add the real requirements for absolute and relative paths and for separator normalization.

目录是否涉及软链或大小写.en: Whether the directories involve symlinks or case

仅在部署平台与需求真实涉及时补对应规则。.en: Add the matching rules only where the deployment platform and the requirement really involve them.

把过程连起来。</strong>先把目标语义写成区分正确与错误实现的例子，再做最.en: Join the steps up. Write the target semantics as an example that tells a correct implementation from a wrong one first, then make the smallest necessary change.

边界与反例。</strong>字符串条件只对已规范化的教学POSIX路径成立；不.en: Limits and counterexamples. The string condition holds only for the normalized POSIX paths of this teaching example; it cannot be taken as a cross-platform safe path check.

追问：反证式分析是否意味着设计很多检查表？.en: Follow-up: does analysis by refutation mean designing a lot of checklists?

不必。可以只保留两三个可区分假设和最便宜验证。反证的核心是允许事实推翻自己的解释.en: No. Two or three distinguishable hypotheses and the cheapest verification are enough. The heart of refutation is letting the facts overturn your own explanation, not promoting a simple bug into a long-term research project.

追问：什么时候需要扩大阅读范围？.en: Follow-up: when does the reading have to be widened?

局部行为正确但系统结果错误、涉及调用方契约、状态传播或并发时，应沿数据/控制依赖.en: When local behavior is correct but the system's result is wrong, or when a caller's contract, state propagation or concurrency is involved, extend along the data and control dependencies. Make clear what evidence is missing first, then read the relevant boundaries. Broad reading should be driven by the problem, not be the default step.

追问：模型提出合理根因，为什么仍要复现？.en: Follow-up: the model proposes a plausible root cause, so why reproduce it anyway?

合理解释可能有多个，只有观察与可重复反例能区分。复现也为补丁提供验证：原版本失败.en: There can be several plausible explanations; only observation and a repeatable counterexample can tell them apart. Reproducing also gives the patch its verification: the old version fails, the new one passes. Without a reproduction a well-grounded fix is still possible, but the shortfall in verification should be stated clearly, and a guess must not be dressed up as a confirmed root cause.

Q040｜怎样让Agent“懂业务”，而不是每次只看局部代码？.en: Q040｜How do you get an agent to "understand the business" instead of only ever looking at local code?

这题先认识什么</span>业务规则既来自代码也来自约定与数据；先记录适用条件和.en: What to know first for this questionBusiness rules come from the code as well as from conventions and data; record the conditions of use and the acceptance examples first, then decide which knowledge is worth becoming long-term guidance.

把业务目标、不变量、关键流程、领域术语和实现入口连接起来，并保持可查询、可验证、.en: Connect the business goals, the invariants, the key flows, the domain terms and the implementation entry points, and keep them queryable, verifiable and updatable. Understanding the business is not stuffing every document into the prompt, and it is not an architecture diagram either.

建立从需求到实现的最短路径.en: Build the shortest path from requirement to implementation

例如“订单取消后不能重复退款”是业务不变量；它对应状态机、支付接口幂等键、数据库.en: For example, "there must be no second refund once an order is canceled" is a business invariant; it corresponds to a state machine, an idempotency key on the payment interface, a database constraint and tests. When an agent works on a refund bug, it needs to know this invariant, and then to find the execution path and the way to verify it. A document that says only "the system uses a microservice architecture" can hardly guide a correct change.

可用轻量入口文件说明核心对象、边界、常见任务与代码路径；具体模块文档记录为什么这.en: A lightweight entry file can describe the core objects, the boundaries, the common tasks and the code paths; the documents for a particular module record why it was designed this way, which alternatives were rejected, and the exceptions that hold at present. A decision record should be short and carry its conditions of use; not every variable name needs an ADR.

代码、测试、运行指标和文档彼此核对。文档说“最多重试三次”，代码常量是五次，不能.en: Code, tests, run-time metrics and documents check one another. When a document says "at most three retries" while the constant in the code is five, neither the document nor the code can be taken as true automatically; judge the current environment and the target specification, then decide whether the document is out of date or the implementation is defective.

业务规则要有可执行的例外，而不只是一句口号.en: A business rule needs an exception that can be executed, not just a slogan

本例条件：</strong>独立业务：退款通常不能超过已付款，但已退款金额也必须.en: Conditions for this example: an independent business case: a refund normally cannot exceed what has been paid, and the amount already refunded must also be deducted. The order was paid 100, 40 has been refunded, and 70 is requested this time. Amounts are in teaching points.

所有允许操作都应满足的约束。.en: A constraint every permitted operation should satisfy.

规则在这一笔操作前的真实数据。.en: The real data the rule sees before this particular operation.

具体输入与预期结果。.en: The concrete input and the expected result.

退款不超过付款.en: A refund does not exceed the payment

另一退款也可能改变已退.en: Another refund may change the amount already refunded as well

提交时需按当前状态原子校验.en: On submission it has to be validated atomically against the current state

懂业务不是把文档读得多，而是能把“约束、例外、状态、验证”连成明确判断。.en: Understanding the business is not reading a great many documents; it is being able to join "constraint, exception, state, verification" into an explicit judgment.

业务知识应放在可维护规则与测试中；Agent检索到规则后仍要读取当前订单状态。.en: Business knowledge belongs in maintainable rules and tests; after an agent retrieves a rule, it still has to read the current order state.

为了展示并发风险可以先用两次请求的时间线，不能把这条规则仅写成模型提示而没有执行.en: A timeline of two requests can serve to show the concurrency risk; this rule must not be written only as a hint to the model, with no protection at the execution end.

不要混淆：</strong>付款100不变不代表可退额不变；忽略已退和在途操作会.en: Do not conflate: a payment of 100 staying the same does not mean the refundable amount stays the same; ignoring refunds already made and operations in flight mistakes static knowledge for a live fact.

业务规则在测试里，为什么只读函数体不够.en: The business rule lives in the tests, so why is reading the function body not enough

输入与条件。</strong>函数返回折扣，注释写“会员优惠”；测试明确：普通会.en: Input and conditions. The function returns a discount and the comment says "member discount"; the tests are explicit: 5% for an ordinary member, 10% for a premium member, and no stacking during a campaign.

还不知道不叠加是否重要约束。.en: It is still unknown whether no stacking is an important constraint.

找到活动优惠与会员优惠冲突用例.en: A case where the campaign discount and the member discount conflict is found

得到优先级的可执行证据。.en: This gives executable evidence of the precedence.

核对测试是否仍对应当前业务.en: Check whether the tests still match the current business

旧测试不是永远正确的权威。.en: An old test is not an authority that is right forever.

新方案在活动+高级会员组合上运行.en: Run the new version on the campaign plus premium member combination

防止把两个单独正确分支相加成错误结果。.en: This prevents two separately correct branches being added into a wrong result.

说明采用哪条规则、证据版本与验证结果.en: State which rule was adopted, the version of the evidence and the verification result

把过程连起来。</strong>实现、测试、需求与运行行为相互校验；只选其中一类.en: Join the steps up. The implementation, the tests, the requirements and the run-time behavior check one another; picking only one of them easily misses a business constraint.

边界与反例。</strong>折扣政策为虚构数据，不暗示任何真实企业规则。.en: Limits and counterexamples. The discount policy is invented data and implies no real company's rules.

追问：业务知识适合长期记忆还是仓库文档？.en: Follow-up: does business knowledge belong in long-term memory or in the repository's documents?

团队共享且应随版本变化的知识通常适合仓库或权威知识库；个人偏好和跨项目经验可放个.en: Knowledge that the team shares and that should change with the version usually belongs in the repository or an authoritative knowledge base; personal preferences and experience that crosses projects can go in personal memory; what is transient to the current task goes in the checkpoint. Storing the same fact in many places increases conflict, so keep one authoritative source and have memory point at it.

追问：新人导读怎样兼顾易读与内部深度？.en: Follow-up: how can an onboarding guide be both easy to read and deep enough internally?

先给业务流程和核心对象，再链接具体模块、状态转移、数据结构和失败案例。不能只列目.en: Give the business flow and the core objects first, then link to the specific modules, state transitions, data structures and failure cases. It cannot be only a table of contents, and it cannot ask the reader to read thousands of lines of source at the start. Progressive does not mean deleting the detail; it means giving the detail a clear entry point and prerequisites.

追问：如何知道这些文档真的提高了Agent质量？.en: Follow-up: how do you know these documents really improved the agent's quality?

选真实业务任务，对比没有入口文档、完整大文档、按需结构化入口三组，测必要证据读取.en: Choose real business tasks and compare three groups — no entry document, one complete large document, and a structured entry point loaded on demand — measuring the reading of the necessary evidence, wrong business assumptions, task success and cost. Growth in the number of documents is not growth in capability.

18｜长期记忆：写入、检索、冲突、失效与遗忘.en: 18｜Long-term memory: writing, retrieval, conflict, expiry and forgetting

Why can they not stand in for one another?Q038｜How does a code index handle Git versions, the work tree and unsaved files?Q039｜How should a bug be located step by step? Why is "read more source" not a sufficient method?Q040｜How do you get an agent to "understand the business" instead of only ever looking at local code?
