Why do Valid time and Recorded time have to be kept apart?Q048｜How does memory retrieval avoid picking up the wrong project or an expired rule? And when should something be forgotten?Why is writing memory a pipeline with leases and acceptance?

记忆要保存的是有来源、条件和时间的信息，而不是“模型曾经说过的话”。工作状态、项.en: What memory has to keep is information that carries a source, conditions and a time, not "something the model once said". Working state, project facts and rules learned from experience are each updated differently.

第02课 · 状态、事件与检查点</a><a class=\"pill\" hr.en: Lesson 02 · State, events and checkpointsLesson 22 · Compaction is not magicLesson 16 · Retrieval, to begin withLesson 17 · From search results to a trustworthy answerLesson 23 · Foundations of long-term memoryLesson 05 · The denominator of an evaluation metric

进入深读前的小检查：</strong>区分“政策从10月1日生效”和“系统10月.en: A quick check before the deep reading: tell "the policy takes effect from 1 October" apart from "the system only learned of it on 5 October", then say why a query about 3 October gives one answer for the policy that really applied and another for the policy the system knew at the time.

本章把记忆当作带来源和生命周期的数据系统。框架与论文提供不同实现思路，但“能存入.en: This chapter treats memory as a data system with provenance and a life cycle. Frameworks and papers offer different implementation ideas, but "it can be put into a vector store" completes only a very small part of the work.

记忆必须回答两个时间问题：事实什么时候生效，系统什么时候知道。下图用超时配置30.en: Memory has to answer two questions about time: when the fact took effect, and when the system knew it. The figure below follows the source, the valid time and the expiry of a timeout setting that goes from 30 seconds to 20, so that old knowledge is not simply repeated in a familiar tone.

相关动态过程：<a href=\"../visual/F31.html\">长期.en: Related step-by-step process: Long-term memory is not a note that is always right. The rest of this section goes on to show the computation and the engineering limits in more detail.

Q045｜工作记忆、情景记忆、语义记忆、程序性记忆有什么区别？.en: Q045｜What is the difference between working memory, episodic memory, semantic memory and procedural memory?

这题先认识什么</span>工作状态、事件经历、稳定事实与执行经验需要不同保存策.en: What to know first for this questionWorking state, events experienced, stable facts and execution experience need different storage strategies; they cannot all be stuffed into one ever-growing summary.

第02课 · 状态、事件与检查点</a><a class=\"pill\" hr.en: Lesson 02 · State, events and checkpointsLesson 22 · Compaction is not magicLesson 23 · Foundations of long-term memory

工作记忆支持当前任务；情景记忆记录具体经历；语义记忆保存相对稳定事实；程序性记忆.en: Working memory supports the current task; episodic memory records specific experiences; semantic memory keeps relatively stable facts; procedural memory keeps reusable ways of doing things. The classification helps decide when to write, how to query and when to expire; it does not force you to build four kinds of database.

同一Bug产生四种不同信息.en: One and the same bug produces four different kinds of information

当前工作记忆：“已定位filter.py，下一步补测试”。情景记忆：“在2026.en: Current working memory: "filter.py has been located; next, add tests". Episodic memory: "in a task in 2026, absolute paths did not match the relative rule, which made exclude fail; the patch and the test are in PR X". Semantic memory: "in this project, exclusion rules are interpreted relative to the repository root". Procedural memory: "when checking a file-filtering problem, first check the path baseline, the separator and the semantics of the rule".

这四条不能直接互换。工作记忆任务结束后价值下降；情景记忆保留具体证据；语义事实随.en: These four are not interchangeable. Working memory loses value once the task ends; episodic memory keeps the concrete evidence; a semantic fact can expire as the project changes; procedural experience transfers, but it must carry its conditions and must not turn into "every filtering bug is a path problem".

参数记忆是训练形成的模型能力，与应用外部记忆不同。外部存储可更新和审查，却需要可.en: Parametric memory is model capability formed by training, and is not the same as an application's external memory. External storage can be updated and audited, but it needs reliable retrieval. Putting the whole history into the context is the simplest extension of working memory, yet it runs into limits of length, cost and interference between pieces of information.

四类记忆放在不同地方，才不会把临时假设当永久规则.en: Keep the four kinds of memory in different places and a temporary hypothesis will not be taken for a permanent rule

本例条件：</strong>独立仓库任务：正在定位Bug，曾经修过一次相似错误，.en: Conditions for this example: an independent repository task: a bug is being located, a similar error was fixed once before, the project forbids changing the API, and a set of reproduction steps exists.

当前任务暂时持有的状态。.en: State held temporarily by the current task.

某一次具体经历及其条件。.en: One specific episode and its conditions.

有来源和范围的事实或规则。.en: A fact or rule that has a source and a scope.

可复用的做事方法。.en: A reusable way of doing something.

当前怀疑是路径标准化.en: The present suspicion is path normalization

未验证，不升为项目事实.en: Not verified; not promoted to a project fact

上周r5修过大小写问题.en: r5 fixed a case-sensitivity problem last week

要核对是否同条件.en: Check whether the conditions were the same

公共API签名不改.en: The public API signature does not change

来源与有效版本可追溯.en: The source and the valid version are traceable

按任务风险适当简化.en: Simplified as far as the task's risk allows

“我记得上次这样修好了”只是一次经历，不能直接推出所有相似报错都有同一根因。.en: "I remember this fixed it last time" is one episode; it does not follow that every similar error message has the same root cause.

工作状态随任务完成失效，项目规则可能长期适用，保存期限与检索方式因此不同。.en: Working state goes stale once the task is done, while project rules may apply for a long time; their retention periods and retrieval methods therefore differ.

记忆系统不要求先建复杂图数据库；先把类型、来源、适用范围和撤销办法定义好。.en: A memory system does not require building a complex graph database first; define the type, the source, the scope of use and the way to withdraw an entry first.

不要混淆：</strong>把模型自我反思中的猜测写入永久语义库，会让后续任务反.en: Do not conflate: writing a guess from the model's own reflection into the permanent semantic store makes later tasks fetch the same error again and again.

同一事故里，四种记忆分别保存什么.en: What each of the four kinds of memory keeps from one and the same incident

输入与条件。</strong>事故：v7中路径前缀判断误排除ab目录；v8已修复.en: Input and conditions. The incident: in v7 the path-prefix test wrongly excluded the ab directory; v8 has fixed it and the tests pass.

当前任务v8待合并.en: The current task: v8 awaiting merge

下次恢复这一个任务需要。.en: Needed when this one task is resumed next time.

事故输入、错误版本、补丁与结果.en: The incident's input, the faulty version, the patch and the outcome

帮助未来相似问题追溯经历。.en: Helps a similar problem in future trace back the experience.

当前exclude按目录边界判断.en: At present exclude is judged on directory boundaries

必须带版本和来源，防止长期过期。.en: Must carry a version and a source, so that it does not quietly go out of date.

遇到前缀匹配改动先测同前缀兄弟目录.en: When a prefix-matching change comes up, test sibling directories with the same prefix first

是一条带适用条件的方法。.en: It is a method that comes with conditions of use.

完整失败日志放外部证据.en: The full failure log goes into external evidence

不要四种记忆各复制同一长日志。.en: Do not copy the same long log into all four kinds of memory.

把过程连起来。</strong>记忆分类的用途是决定保存与读取粒度，不是为了建立.en: Join the steps up. Classifying memory serves to decide the granularity of what is stored and what is read; it is not there to build more databases that duplicate one another.

边界与反例。</strong>记忆类型在研究与产品中命名不完全一致；本例强调职责.en: Limits and counterexamples. The naming of memory types is not entirely consistent across research and products; this example stresses responsibilities and does not prescribe four tables.

追问：记忆与RAG是不是一回事？.en: Follow-up: are memory and RAG the same thing?

是从外部知识检索后辅助生成的一类机制，记忆系统还包括从交互中写入、更新、冲突处理.en: is a class of mechanism that retrieves external knowledge and then uses it to help generate, whereas a memory system also covers writing from interactions, updating, conflict handling and forgetting. Memory retrieval can use RAG, but being able to read documents does not by itself build up experience.

追问：模型自动总结的“经验”为什么容易过拟合？.en: Follow-up: why is "experience" summarized by the model so prone to overfitting?

一次成功可能由特定环境、偶然路径或测试不足造成。总结若去掉条件，就会把局部做法升.en: One success may be due to a particular environment, an accidental path or insufficient testing. If the summary drops the conditions, it promotes a local practice into a general rule. A piece of experience needs at least the setting, the action, the outcome, the evidence and the known limits on record; only after it has been reused several times does its effect decide whether it should be raised to a default procedure.

追问：长期记忆是不是越多越好？.en: Follow-up: is more long-term memory always better?

不是。重复、冲突和过期记忆会增加检索噪声与上下文负担。核心指标是减少重复错误、提.en: No. Duplicate, conflicting and expired memories add retrieval noise and context load. The core metrics are fewer repeated mistakes, better task quality and a lower cost of rebuilding context, not the number of memory entries.

Q046｜一条信息从对话进入长期记忆，应该经过哪些判断？.en: Q046｜Which judgments should a piece of information pass through on its way from a conversation into long-term memory?

这题先认识什么</span>写入记忆先验证来源、作用域和重复冲突。模型自述的成功.en: What to know first for this questionBefore writing to memory, verify the source, the scope and any duplication or conflict. A success the model reports of itself is not a verified fact.

第17课 · 从搜索结果到可信答案</a><a class=\"pill\" h.en: Lesson 17 · From search results to a trustworthy answerLesson 23 · Foundations of long-term memoryLesson 05 · The denominator of an evaluation metric

先识别候选事实或经验，核验来源与适用范围，查重和冲突，再选择新增、更新、保留为待.en: First identify the candidate fact or experience, verify the source and the range it applies to, check for duplication and conflict, then choose to add it, update it, hold it as pending confirmation, or not store it. Everything the model produces in an answer cannot be stored automatically as fact.

一条候选的写入链.en: The write chain for one candidate

用户明确说“项目日志保留7天”，这是来自用户的项目约束；工具配置显示生产环境保留.en: The user states explicitly that "project logs are kept for 7 days", which is a project constraint coming from the user; the tool configuration shows that production keeps them for 30 days, which is a fact about the implementation. When the two conflict, you cannot simply let the newer text overwrite the older: you have to judge whether the user is setting a new target or describing the current situation. Memory can keep "the target requirement is 7 days" and "the current production configuration is 30 days" separately, marked as needing adjustment.

TTL、有效时间与记录时间.en: TTL, valid time and record time

TTL是存储或缓存的到期设置；有效时间指事实何时适用；记录时间指系统何时知道。到.en: A TTL is an expiry setting on storage or a cache; valid time is when a fact applies; record time is when the system came to know it. An expiry policy cannot stand in for verifying the fact and its source.<span class="concept-micro">A rule that takes effect on October 1 is only read on October 10: the business valid time counts from the 1st, while the time the system knew about it counts from the 10th.

写入时可使用轻量结构：subject、predicate、.en: A lightweight structure can be used when writing: subject, predicate,

、valid_time、source、status。对经验再加condition.en: , valid_time, source, status. For a piece of experience, add conditions and outcome as well. The fields should answer real needs; there is no need to apply a complex knowledge graph mechanically.

查重先找同一主题/范围候选，再比较语义。相同结论来自两个独立证据可以合并证据引用.en: To check for duplicates, first find the candidates on the same subject or in the same range, then compare the meaning. The same conclusion from two independent pieces of evidence can have its evidence references merged; similar wording in a different environment should not be merged; a negation relationship should be treated as a conflict. The model can help with extraction and comparison, but an important authoritative fact is best given a definite identity and confirmed by a person or a tool.

信息写入长期记忆前，要把观察、假设、规则分开.en: Before information is written to long-term memory, keep the observation, the hypothesis and the rule apart

本例条件：</strong>独立对话：用户说“这个项目暂时用Python 3.1.en: Conditions for this example: an independent conversation: the user says "this project uses Python 3.11 for now"; the model guesses "all projects use 3.11". What is written must correspond to the original fact that was authorized.

这条信息适用哪个项目/用户。.en: Which project/user this piece of information applies to.

谁明确说过或哪份文件证明。.en: Who explicitly said it, or which document proves it.

候选、确认、撤销等生命周期。.en: A lifecycle of candidate, confirmation, revocation and so on.

有用户来源，但有项目与时间范围.en: It comes from the user, but is scoped to a project and a time range

模型推广，无原始支持.en: The model generalized it; there is no support in the original

不写入确认事实.en: nothing is written in as a confirmed fact

后来用户改为3.12.en: The user later changed it to 3.12

更新生效区间并保留来源.en: Update the interval of validity and keep the provenance

提取器会生成看起来整齐的字段，但字段整齐不证明事实成立。范围不能比原话更宽。.en: An extractor will produce fields that look tidy, but tidy fields are no proof that the fact holds. The scope must not be wider than the original wording.

暂时性信息要有复核触发或过期策略，永久保存可能把临时试验变成长期约束。.en: Temporary information needs a re-check trigger or an expiry policy; keeping it for good can turn a short-lived experiment into a long-term constraint.

写入前检查是否重复、是否冲突、有无隐私限制；写入后还要能按证据撤回。.en: Before writing, check for duplication, for conflict and for privacy restrictions; after writing, it must still be possible to withdraw it on the evidence.

不要混淆：</strong>“模型总结过”不是独立来源。如果总结漏掉“本项目”和.en: Do not conflate: "the model summarized it" is not an independent source. If the summary drops "in this project" and "for now", later retrieval will widen the error.

一句模型猜测经过哪些检查才能进入长期记忆.en: Which checks a guess by the model has to pass before it can enter long-term memory

输入与条件。</strong>候选记忆：“所有路径错误都用startswith修.en: Input and conditions. The candidate memory: "fix every path error with startswith." It comes from a suggestion that has not yet passed its tests.

没有成功验证，且措辞“所有”过宽.en: No successful verification, and the wording "every" is too broad

不能升级为通用经验。.en: It cannot be promoted to general experience.

改为“本次排除目录需要边界判断”.en: Change it to "the exclusion of directories in this case needs a boundary test"

范围限定到具体问题。.en: The range is limited to the specific problem.

记录修复版本和a/a-x/ab反例测试.en: Record the version that fixed it and the a / a-x / ab counterexample tests

区分提议与已确认结果。.en: Tell a proposal apart from a confirmed result.

与已有条目不冲突、未来可复用且成本合理.en: No conflict with existing entries, reusable in future, and reasonable in cost

满足才保存。.en: Store it only if these hold.

路径平台或实现改变.en: The path, the platform or the implementation changes

重新验证适用性，不永久强制所有任务执行。.en: Verify that it still applies; do not force it on every task for good.

把过程连起来。</strong>长期记忆不是把模型最后一句话自动粘贴到系统提示里.en: Join the steps up. Long-term memory is not pasting the model's last sentence automatically into the system prompt.

边界与反例。</strong>此处写入门槛是可选工程策略；简单偏好可更轻量，不必.en: Limits and counterexamples. The write threshold here is one optional engineering strategy; a simple preference can be handled more lightly, and there is no need to design a complex approval for every record.

追问：什么时候可以不保存？.en: Follow-up: when is it all right not to store something?

临时状态、容易重新查到且变化快的数据、无证据猜测、对未来无用的闲聊，以及保存风险.en: Temporary state, data that is easy to look up again and changes fast, guesses with no evidence, small talk of no future use, and sensitive information whose storage risk outweighs its benefit may all not be worth long-term memory. Leaving out a worthless write is more effective than cleaning up afterwards.

追问：自动记忆是否意味着模型自行修改规则？.en: Follow-up: does automatic memory mean the model changes the rules by itself?

保存候选经验与激活执行规则应分开。可以允许自动积累证据，但让已验证规则、待确认假.en: Storing a candidate experience and activating an execution rule should be kept apart. Evidence may be allowed to accumulate automatically, but verified rules, hypotheses awaiting confirmation and explicit user instructions should have different statuses. Otherwise one bad summary can affect every later task at once.

追问：异步写记忆会发生什么问题？.en: Follow-up: what can go wrong when memory is written asynchronously?

写入延迟会让刚纠正的事实尚未生效，旧记忆仍被检索；并发写入可能覆盖新内容。需要定.en: A write delay means a fact that has just been corrected is not in force yet and the old memory is still retrieved; concurrent writes can overwrite new content. Visibility, versions and a conflict policy have to be defined. Not every application needs strong consistency, but you have to know when what you read is a stale state.

记忆写入为什么是一条带租约与验收的流水线？.en: Why is writing memory a pipeline with leases and acceptance?

聊天结论不能直接升级为长期事实.en: A conclusion from a chat cannot be promoted straight into a long-term fact

例如“这次pytest通过”只对某文件版本和测试集合成立，不应存成“该模块没有问.en: "pytest passed this time", for instance, holds only for one file version and one set of tests, and should not be stored as "there is nothing wrong with this module". A usable memory should include the content, the source, the scope, the time it happened or took effect, the time it became known, its trust status and the conditions under which it expires. A checkpoint for the current task answers "how far did we get"; long-term memory answers "when, later on, may this be consulted".

记忆流水线的发布条件。数值与状态属于本节明确设定的教学例；不是生产性能或商业模型.en: The publishing conditions of the memory pipeline. The numbers and states are a teaching example explicitly set out in this section; they are not production performance or a measurement of a commercial model.

固定Codex源码中的两阶段.en: The two stages in the pinned Codex source

启动逻辑受会话是否临时、功能开关、主线程身份、数据库及目录条件限制。.en: The startup logic is constrained by whether the session is temporary, by feature switches, by the identity of the main thread, and by database and directory conditions.

第一阶段筛选符合条件的历史源并发抽取，结果可能是有效输出，也可能是成功但无值得.en: The first stage screens the eligible history sources and extracts from them concurrently; the result may be a valid output, or it may be a success with nothing worth keeping. The latter should not be treated as an error and retried without end.

第二阶段有全局任务租约，准备工作区、同步候选、计算差异，再决定是否需要整合工作者.en: The second stage has a global task lease: it prepares the workspace, synchronizes the candidates, computes the differences, and then decides whether a consolidation worker is needed. When there is no new difference and the existing artifact is valid, one model call can be skipped. Once the worker has finished, you still have to shut it down, verify the artifact, check that the lease is still held and advance the watermark before publication counts as a success.

为什么租约不是一个布尔锁.en: Why a lease is not a boolean lock

租约包含所有者与到期时间。旧工作者卡住后，新工作者可能获得新租约；旧工作者恢复时.en: A lease carries an owner and an expiry time. Once an old worker is stuck, a new worker may take out a new lease; when the old worker comes back, it must not go on to publish its old result. The final write has to carry the ownership condition. A heartbeat only extends the validity period; it does not prove the work itself is correct. The watermark states the range of sources already taken in; it does not mean the model "remembers all of it".

隔离也要读具体分支.en: Isolation, too, has to be read branch by branch

固定整合工作者关闭了一些工具、记忆和协作能力，以减少递归反馈；但沙箱分支仍受父环.en: The pinned consolidation worker switches off some tools, memory and collaboration abilities in order to reduce recursive feedback; but the sandbox branch is still affected by the type of the parent environment. Seeing one restricted branch is no reason to write "every memory worker always forces the same sandbox".

使用时重新验证.en: Verify again at the point of use

记忆说测试命令是.en: The memory says the test command is

，仓库版本变化后目录已删除，应使条目失效或重新确认，而不是修饰解释让旧记忆继续成.en: , but the directory was deleted after a change of repository version; the entry should be expired or confirmed again, rather than explained away so that the old memory still holds. When a user withdraws a fact, deleting the original record is not enough: the summaries, vectors and experience rules generated from it also have to be traced through their source dependencies and expired.

本地实验用租约代际和源版本构造两个竞争工作者，确认旧所有者不能提交。它没有运行生.en: The local experiment builds two competing workers out of lease generations and source versions, and confirms that the old owner cannot commit. It does not run a production memory service or model extraction; what it verifies is the boundary of the control state.

逐步读代码，不要盲信注释中的顺序.en: Read the code step by step; do not trust the order given in a comment

阶段一的实际run先构建请求上下文，再领取候选，尽管概要注释把顺序写得不同。阶段.en: The actual run of stage one builds the request context first and takes the candidates afterwards, even though the summary comment puts the order differently. Stage two is not "the model has written the file, so it has succeeded": first the worker is ended, then the artifact and the lease are checked, and last the Git baseline and the database record are updated. If the shutdown fails, the code as read keeps the lease and waits for it to expire, so that the old process and the new worker do not modify things in parallel.

Git基线更新与数据库成功标记是两次操作，不应在教材中画成一个保证原子的事务。教.en: Updating the Git baseline and marking success in the database are two operations, and should not be drawn in a textbook as one transaction guaranteed to be atomic. A teaching counterexample: the baseline succeeds and the database registration fails, and recovery should check both rather than unconditionally run consolidation again or unconditionally declare the publication done. The watermark only states the range of sources taken in; it does not prove that a remembered fact is true.

隔离配置也有分支：托管沙箱可以限制为本地记忆根、无网络；父配置明确Disable.en: The isolation configuration has branches too: a managed sandbox can be restricted to the local memory root with no network; where the parent configuration says Disabled or External explicitly, the relevant branch keeps that choice. Picking out the strictest passage is no reason to claim that "all background memory is always without a network".

Q047｜新旧记忆冲突怎样处理？Valid time和Recorded time.en: Q047｜How are conflicts between old and new memory handled? Why do Valid time and Recorded time have to be kept apart?

这题先认识什么</span>生效时间表示事实何时适用，记录时间表示系统何时知道。.en: What to know first for this questionValid time says when a fact applies; recorded time says when the system knew it. Different retrospective questions can give different query results.

第02课 · 状态、事件与检查点</a><a class=\"pill\" hr.en: Lesson 02 · State, events and checkpointsLesson 23 · Foundations of long-term memory

事实适用的时间与系统记录或获知它的时间。 例：政策1日生效、5日才录入，两个时间.en: When a fact applies, and when the system recorded or learned it. Example: a policy takes effect on the 1st but is only entered on the 5th; the two times are not interchangeable.

表示事实在现实中适用的时间，.en: is the time over which a fact applies in reality, and

表示系统何时知道/记录它。二者分开才能回答“当时事实是什么”和“当时系统知道什么.en: is when the system knew or recorded it. Only by keeping the two apart can you answer both "what was the fact at the time" and "what did the system know at the time". A newer record does not necessarily stand for a more up-to-date fact about reality.

用迟到消息看双时间.en: Seeing both times through a late message

10月10日系统记录“超时30秒”。10月17日收到通知：“10月12日起已改为.en: On 10 October the system records "a timeout of 30 seconds". On 17 October a notice arrives: "it was changed to 60 seconds with effect from 12 October". The new fact's valid time is the 12th and its recorded time is the 17th. A query for the actual configuration on 14 October should answer 60 seconds; a review of "why did the system suggest 30 seconds on 14 October" has to take in that it had not yet received the new message.

如果只是用updated_at覆盖原记录，旧知识状态会消失，无法解释历史决策。轻.en: If the original record is simply overwritten using updated_at, the old state of knowledge disappears and historical decisions can no longer be explained. A light implementation can keep version records and a supersedes relation, without necessarily needing a full temporal database. For high-risk tasks you should also tell the target policy, the actual deployment and the observed value apart, because they may hold different values at the same time.

冲突处理顺序可以是：同一对象吗？同一环境/版本吗？同一生效时间吗？来源是否有权修.en: One order for handling conflicts is: the same object? the same environment or version? the same valid time? is the source entitled to change this fact? is the new record a correction, an exception or additional evidence? Only after answering these do you decide to overwrite, to keep both, or to mark the matter unresolved.

有效时间与记录时间，是两个独立的问题.en: Valid time and record time are two separate questions

本例条件：</strong>独立教学日期：10月3日获知一项规则自10月1日起生.en: Conditions for this example: independent teaching dates: on 3 October it becomes known that a rule takes effect from 1 October; on 8 October it becomes known that it was in fact revoked from 5 October. These are not real user records.

规则在现实中从何时到何时适用。.en: From when to when the rule applies in the real world.

系统何时收到这条消息。.en: When the system received this message.

问当时实际状态，或问当时系统知道什么。.en: Ask what the actual state was then, or ask what the system knew then.

放大图解：有效时间与记录时间，是两个独立的问题.en: Enlarged figure: valid time and record time are two independent questions

有效时间与记录时间：系统何时知道，不等于事实何时生效.en: Valid time and recorded time: when the system knows is not when the fact takes effect

事实有效区间.en: The interval over which a fact is valid

系统知悉时间.en: The time the system learned of it

问10月6日实际是否有效.en: Ask whether it was actually in force on 6 October

按修正后应为无效.en: Invalid once the correction is applied

不等于6日系统已知道撤销.en: does not mean the system already knew about the revocation on the 6th

问6日系统当时会怎样答.en: Ask how the system would have answered on the 6th

当时只知道起始规则.en: At the time only the initial rule was known

可重建当时知识状态.en: The state of knowledge at the time can be rebuilt

横向看真实生效区间，纵向看系统何时知道。把两者合成一个updated_at会让“.en: Read across for the real interval of effect, and down for when the system knew. Collapsing the two into a single updated_at makes "looking back at a fact" and "replaying a decision" confuse each other.

迟到的修正不能粗暴把过去的系统日志改写成“当时就知道”，否则事故复盘会失真。.en: A late correction must not crudely rewrite past system logs into "we knew at the time"; otherwise the incident review comes out distorted.

未必所有项目都需要完整双时间数据库，但只要业务会出现追溯生效或迟到修正，就必须理.en: Not every project needs a full bi-temporal database, but as soon as the business has retroactive effect or late corrections, these two kinds of time have to be understood.

不要混淆：</strong>“最新记录”可能描述过去的事实；按录入时间直接决定今.en: Do not conflate: the "most recent record" may describe a past fact; deciding today's applicable value straight from the time of entry is not reliable.

“什么时候生效”与“什么时候知道”不是同一时间.en: "When it takes effect" and "when it became known" are not the same time

输入与条件。</strong>10月1日记录：生产超时5秒，生效区间[10月1日.en: Input and conditions. Recorded on 1 October: the production timeout is 5 seconds, valid over [1 October, ∞). Only on 10 October does it become known that it should have been 7 seconds from 5 October, and the correction is recorded.

按10月3日业务时间查询.en: Query by a business time of 3 October

当时有效值.en: The value valid at the time

按10月7日业务时间、截至10月8日的已知记录查询.en: Query by a business time of 7 October, against the records known as of 8 October

系统那时尚不知道修正.en: The system did not yet know of the correction

仍会返回当时知道的5秒。.en: It still returns the 5 seconds known at the time.

按10月7日业务时间、截至10月11日查询.en: Query by a business time of 7 October, as of 11 October

可以用10月10日记录的回溯修正.en: The retroactive correction recorded on 10 October may be used

只存当前值7会丢掉“当时为何答5”.en: Storing only the current value 7 loses "why 5 was the answer at the time"

保留记录时间支持审计。.en: Keeping the recorded time supports auditing.

测试环境也有7秒.en: The test environment has 7 seconds too

不能与生产混用。.en: It must not be mixed with production.

把过程连起来。</strong>有效时间回答现实规则何时成立，记录时间回答系统何.en: Join the steps up. Valid time answers when a rule held in reality; recorded time answers when the system came by that information.

边界与反例。</strong>时间区间按左闭右开定义；这是简化双时间示例，回溯修.en: Limits and counterexamples. Time intervals are defined as closed on the left and open on the right; this is a simplified bi-temporal example, and a retroactive correction must have authoritative evidence behind it, history cannot be rewritten at will.

追问：用户的最新指令一定覆盖旧经验吗？.en: Follow-up: does a user's latest instruction always override older experience?

在该用户有权决定且范围明确的任务约束中，新指令通常应改变旧偏好；但不能让低可信网.en: Within a task constraint that this user is entitled to decide and whose scope is clear, a new instruction should usually change an old preference; but a low-trust web page must not be allowed to pass itself off as a user instruction, and a new requirement for project A must not override project B. Authority and scope come before mere chronological order.

追问：删除错误记忆后，派生总结怎么办？.en: Follow-up: once a wrong memory is deleted, what about the summaries derived from it?

需要让依赖它的摘要、规则和缓存失效或重新生成。只删除原条目但保留“根据旧条目总结.en: The summaries, rules and caches that depend on it have to be expired or regenerated. Deleting only the original entry while keeping "the experience summarized from the old entry" lets the error go on spreading. Recording source dependencies is not just for tidy citation; it is also what makes a revocation propagate.

追问：发生冲突时全部交给LLM自由判断可行吗？.en: Follow-up: when a conflict arises, can it all be left to the LLM's free judgment?

低风险文本可让模型给候选解释；关键身份、时间、版本和授权最好由结构化信息约束。L.en: For low-risk text the model may offer candidate explanations; critical identity, time, version and authorization are best constrained by structured information. An LLM is good at comparing meaning, but it should not override a highly authoritative fact on the strength of linguistic confidence. When no decision can be reached, keeping the conflict is more reliable than manufacturing a false unified conclusion.

工程深挖 · E35 · 接续Q071.en: Engineering deep dive · E35 · continues Q071

“什么时候是真的”与“什么时候知道的”：记忆时间必须拆开.en: "When it was true" and "when it became known": the two times in memory have to be kept apart

第23课</a>。阅读顺序：先确认运行契约，再看反例与修复，最后检验边界。.en: Lesson 23. Reading order: confirm the run contract first, then the counterexamples and the fix, and test the limits last.

只有updated_at会丢掉两个不同问题.en: updated_at alone loses two different questions

事实生效时间回答“现实中从哪天开始有效”；记录时间回答“系统从哪天知道这件事”。.en: A fact's valid time answers "from which day was it true in reality"; the recorded time answers "from which day did the system know this". The two are different. LongMemEval lists temporal reasoning, knowledge updating and abstention as separate abilities, a reminder that recall cannot go by content similarity alone.

本节双时间结构是本书给出的工程设计，不宣称论文指定了此数据库schema。.en: The bi-temporal structure in this section is an engineering design given by this book; it is not a claim that the paper specifies this database schema.

固定同一例子回答两种查询.en: One fixed example answering two kinds of query

第1天知道额度为10；第8天才收到通知：第5天起额度其实已改为20。问“按第6天.en: On day 1 the quota is known to be 10; only on day 8 does a notice arrive: from day 5 the quota had in fact been changed to 20. Asked "what was the quota as known on day 6", the answer should be 10; asked "looking back now, what value actually applied on day 6", it should be 20. If the update simply overwrites 10 with 20, the system can never answer the first question correctly again.

本地测试分别按.en: The local test filters events by

筛选事件，得到10和20。此处的“天数”只是教学顺序，不是实际用户资料。.en: respectively, giving 10 and 20. The "day numbers" here are only a teaching order, not real user data.

数据结构需要表达更正，不只是新值.en: The data structure has to express a correction, not just a new value

建议保留来源、适用对象、有效区间、记录区间、证据版本、状态与替代关系。区间尽量采.en: Keep the source, the object it applies to, the valid interval, the recorded interval, the evidence version, the status and the supersedes relation. Intervals should as far as possible use the explicit half-open convention

，这样边界时刻不同时属于新旧两条。纠错、正常变更与撤销应不同：纠错可能说明过去记.en: , so that a boundary moment does not belong to the old and the new entry at once. A correction, an ordinary change and a revocation should be distinct: a correction may state that the past record was simply wrong, whereas an ordinary change does not deny that the old value once held.

数据库能原子写入并不自动理解这些语义；事务只保护被正确设计的字段更新。.en: A database being able to write atomically does not mean it understands any of this meaning; a transaction only protects field updates that were designed correctly.

冲突处理要根据来源权威、时间与适用范围，不按“最后写入胜出”解决所有知识冲突。.en: Conflict handling has to go by the authority of the source, the time and the range of application; it does not settle every knowledge conflict by "last write wins".

追问：新信息总覆盖旧信息更简单，为什么不够？.en: Follow-up: always overwriting old information with new is simpler, so why is it not enough?

因为“我现在住东京”与“去年住北京”不冲突；“预算从下月改为20”也不该立刻影响.en: Because "I live in Tokyo now" does not conflict with "I lived in Beijing last year"; and "the budget changes to 20 from next month" should not affect this month straight away. Crude overwriting flattens the time conditions, and tends to make answers look as if they remember a great deal while using the wrong period every time.

追问：来源互相矛盾但没有权威排序怎么办？.en: Follow-up: what do you do when sources contradict each other and there is no ranking of authority?

保留冲突状态和各自证据，必要时向用户核实，不能通过模型自信分数制造事实。没有足够.en: Keep the conflict status and the evidence on each side, check with the user where necessary, and do not manufacture a fact out of the model's confidence score. Without sufficient grounds, the answer should be "not yet determined", which is not the same problem as a failure to retrieve the memory. An evaluation should include cases where abstaining is the correct answer.

E35：怎样读这份结果，而不是只看“通过”.en: E35: how to read this result, instead of only looking at "passed"

两次查询问的都是第6天，但允许使用的知识截止时间不同。不要把事后得知的规则偷偷带.en: Both queries ask about day 6, but the cut-off for the knowledge they are allowed to use differs. Do not smuggle a rule learned afterwards back into the decision made at the time, unless you are explicitly making a retrospective correction.

自检：</strong>第8天得知第5天起额度变20，回问“第6天当时系统知道多.en: Self-check: on day 8 it becomes known that the quota changed to 20 from day 5. Asked back "how much did the system know on day 6", what should the answer be?

应答旧知识10；若问现在回看第6天实际生效额度，则答20。需要同时保留有效时间与.en: It should answer with the old knowledge, 10; if the question is what quota actually applied on day 6, looking back now, then 20. Both valid time and recorded time have to be kept; storing only the last value will not do.

Q048｜记忆检索怎样避免拿错项目、拿到过期规则？什么时候应该遗忘？.en: Q048｜How does memory retrieval avoid picking up the wrong project or an expired rule? And when should something be forgotten?

这题先认识什么</span>记忆取回后仍要确认有效性；更新、失效和删除是常规功能.en: What to know first for this questionOnce a memory has been fetched, its validity still has to be confirmed; updating, expiring and deleting are ordinary functions, not optional trimmings added after retrieval is done.

第16课 · 检索入门</a><a class=\"pill\" href=\".en: Lesson 16 · Retrieval, to begin withLesson 17 · From search results to a trustworthy answerLesson 23 · Foundations of long-term memoryLesson 05 · The denominator of an evaluation metric

先按身份、项目、任务类型、时间和有效状态过滤，再做相关性检索与必要重排，使用前核.en: Filter first by identity, project, task type, time and valid status, then run the relevance retrieval and any reranking needed, and check the key sources before use. Forgetting serves to reduce expired and low-value information; it should not damage what auditing requires or evidence that is still cited.

从查询到使用的完整链.en: The full chain from query to use

任务是“修复项目A的退款重复执行”。先限制用户/项目A，排除失效规则，检索与幂等.en: The task is "fix the duplicated refund execution in project A". Restrict to the user and project A first, exclude expired rules, and retrieve experience to do with idempotence and refunds. The candidates may include a payment incident in project B; close as that may be in meaning, it cannot be treated directly as a rule for A. It can serve as a general point to watch, but its limits of application have to be kept.

选择记忆后，把它转成当前可用上下文：一条简洁经验、适用条件、证据入口、与当前版本.en: Once a memory has been chosen, turn it into context usable now: one concise piece of experience, its conditions of use, an entry point to the evidence, and its relationship to the current version. If the experience depends on the behavior of an old interface, read the current code before deciding whether it applies. "It worked last time" is no reason to skip checking the boundaries of what has changed.

遗忘可按生命周期处理：临时任务状态过期；稳定事实被新版本替代；重复条目合并；长期.en: Forgetting can be handled by life cycle: temporary task state expires; a stable fact is superseded by a new version; duplicate entries are merged; low-value experience long unused is archived; an entry shown to be false is marked revoked. Deleting sensitive information also has to run through backups, indexes and derived data, and the specific retention requirements should be decided by the application's policy.

记忆检索先过适用门，再比语义相似度.en: Memory retrieval passes the applicability gate first, and compares semantic similarity second

本例条件：</strong>独立问题：项目P1当前超时。候选M1为P2超时10，.en: Conditions for this example: an independent question: project P1 currently times out. Candidate M1 is a timeout of 10 for P2, M2 is 30 from an old version of P1, and M3 is 20 from the current version of P1. The numbers are a teaching construction.

排除不属于当前范围的记录。.en: Exclude records outside the current scope.

在允许候选中找更相关者。.en: Find the more relevant ones among the permitted candidates.

删除、失效或降低检索资格，不一定抹掉审计记录。.en: Deleting a record, letting it expire or lowering its eligibility for retrieval does not necessarily erase the audit record.

能否作为当前答案.en: Whether it can serve as the current answer

版本已过期.en: The version is out of date

仍需核对来源可靠性.en: The reliability of the source still has to be checked

语义分数最高的M1可能只是措辞最相近，却属于另一个项目。范围约束不能被相关性分数.en: M1, with the highest semantic score, may simply be the closest in wording while belonging to another project. A scope constraint cannot be canceled out by a relevance score.

过期内容可以保留在审计库，但默认检索当前事实时要排除或显著标明历史身份。.en: Expired content may stay in the audit store, but when retrieval asks for the current fact by default it has to be excluded or clearly marked as a historical identity.

撤销一条源事实还应处理它产生的摘要、向量块和缓存，否则用户仍可能从派生层读到旧结.en: Revoking a source fact also means dealing with the summaries, vector chunks and caches it produced; otherwise a user can still read the old conclusion out of the derived layer.

不要混淆：</strong>删除原文件后不重建或失效化派生索引，不等于已经忘记它.en: Do not conflate: deleting the original file without rebuilding or invalidating the derived index is not the same as having forgotten it.

删除一条记忆后，为什么向量索引仍可能泄露它.en: Once a memory has been deleted, why can the vector index still leak it

输入与条件。</strong>记忆m7有正文、向量、摘要引用与缓存答案四个派生存.en: Input and conditions. Memory m7 has four derived storage locations: the body text, the vector, a summary reference and a cached answer. The user withdraws permission to use it.

先让检索和答案层不再返回m7.en: First stop the retrieval and answer layers returning m7

不能等待所有后台物理清理完成才生效。.en: It must not wait for all the background physical cleanup to finish before taking effect.

根据来源ID找向量、摘要和缓存.en: Find the vectors, summaries and caches by the source ID

正文删除不等于派生内容全部删除。.en: Deleting the body text is not deleting everything derived from it.

授权过滤在候选选择和最终输出都核查.en: The authorization filter is checked both at candidate selection and at the final output

避免摘要绕过正文权限。.en: This keeps a summary from getting around the body text's permissions.

按存储策略删除或使派生项失效.en: Delete, or expire the derived items, according to the storage policy

记录已处理范围与未完成项。.en: Record the range already handled and the items left undone.

原查询再次执行.en: The original query is run again

确认已撤回信息不再出现在返回内容里。.en: Confirm that the withdrawn information no longer appears in what is returned.

把过程连起来。</strong>记忆生命周期必须覆盖派生索引和缓存，而不只是数据.en: Join the steps up. A memory's life cycle has to cover derived indexes and caches, not only the main database table.

边界与反例。</strong>删除技术方案依存储与合规要求；这里不作法律上的彻底.en: Limits and counterexamples. The technical approach to deletion depends on the storage and the compliance requirements; no promise of legally thorough deletion is made here.

追问：最近使用频率高的记忆一定重要吗？.en: Follow-up: is a memory used often recently necessarily important?

不一定。检索偏好可能让一条错误记忆越用越多，形成自我强化。价值应看实际帮助与证据.en: Not necessarily. A retrieval preference can make one wrong memory used more and more, which becomes self-reinforcing. Value should be judged by actual help and evidence, not by the number of accesses alone. A rare but critical safety boundary may also go uncalled for a long time, and should not be deleted for being infrequent.

追问：怎么测记忆系统是否真正有效？.en: Follow-up: how do you test whether a memory system really works?

使用跨会话任务、迟到更正、多项目隔离、冲突和遗忘测试。比较无记忆、原始历史、精选.en: Use cross-session tasks, late corrections, multi-project isolation, and conflict and forgetting tests. Compare task completion and error rates with no memory, with the raw history and with curated memory; benchmarks such as LongMemEval offer ways of thinking about how to evaluate memory ability, but your own project still needs a comparison on real tasks.

追问：何时应该停止继续增加记忆机制？.en: Follow-up: when should you stop adding more memory machinery?

当新增机制没有减少重复错误或重建成本，却增加维护、检索噪声和延迟时，应简化。一个.en: When new machinery does not reduce repeated mistakes or the cost of rebuilding, yet adds maintenance, retrieval noise and latency, it is time to simplify. One versioned document plus a lean index may suit a small team better than a complex Memory Service. Complexity should be driven by problems that have actually appeared.

工程深挖 · E36 · 接续Q072.en: Engineering deep dive · E36 · continues Q072

删掉原文不等于遗忘：摘要、缓存与经验条目也有依赖.en: Deleting the original text is not forgetting: summaries, caches and experience entries depend on it too

忘记是一条传播链，而不是删一行.en: Forgetting is a chain of propagation, not the deletion of one row

一份文档可以派生出chunk、摘要、检索向量、回答缓存和长期经验。原文撤回或用户.en: One document can give rise to chunks, summaries, retrieval vectors, answer caches and long-term experience. Once the original is withdrawn or the user's permission is revoked, deleting only the document row still leaves the other derivatives able to feed the original content back into the model. This risk comes from data dependency; tool boundaries such as MCP also require identity and resource access to be handled continuously, not checked only on the first read.

本节使用独立教学依赖图：doc→chunk→summary→answer_cac.en: This section uses an independent teaching dependency graph: doc→chunk→summary→answer_cache and memory. Once doc is revoked, all five classes of object are marked invalid along the dependency closure. The local program's verification result contains five nodes. It is not connected to real user data, and this graph is not treated as legal compliance certification.

吊销可用性与物理删除不是同一步.en: Revoking availability and deleting physically are not one step

物理删除可能异步完成；在此之前至少要阻止已吊销资料继续参与检索、缓存命中与记忆构.en: Physical deletion may complete asynchronously; until it does, revoked material must at least be kept from taking any further part in retrieval, cache hits and memory construction. If you rely only on a TTL cleanup once a day, there is still a window between the revocation and the cleanup. The read path should check the validity of the source or the permission version, rather than trusting that the derived record was authorized when it was created.

反过来，删除所有相似记忆也可能误伤独立合法来源。需要保留来源集合：当一条事实由两.en: Conversely, deleting every similar memory can also catch independent legitimate sources by mistake. The set of sources has to be kept: when a fact is supported by two independently permitted sources, whether it remains usable after one source is withdrawn is decided by the policy and the relation between the facts. Do not treat all similar text as coming from the same place.

更新与遗忘也要被评测.en: Updating and forgetting have to be evaluated too

LongMemEval明确包含知识更新与弃答能力。.en: LongMemEval explicitly covers knowledge updating and the ability to abstain.

对工程系统应进一步加入“先记住、再撤回、再询问”的时序测试；只测首次召回率会奖.en: For an engineering system you should go further and add timing tests of "remember, then withdraw, then ask"; testing only first-time recall rewards unlimited memory. Record the retrieval hits, what was actually fed into the prompt and the final answer, to confirm that the model did not merely happen not to say it.

追问：删除外部记忆能删除模型参数中的知识吗？.en: Follow-up: can deleting external memory delete knowledge in the model's parameters?

不能这么推断。外部存储的可用性控制、训练数据删除和参数层遗忘是不同问题。本教材此.en: That does not follow. Controlling the availability of external storage, deleting training data and unlearning at the parameter level are different problems. What this book guarantees here reaches only as far as the controllable chain of external derivatives; it makes no claim to have changed what the base model has already learned in its parameters.

追问：经验条目没有保存原文，还需要来源吗？.en: Follow-up: if an experience entry does not store the original text, does it still need a source?

需要。经验可能来自一次错误根因分析；没有来源与适用条件，就无法在代码升级或结论撤.en: It does. A piece of experience may come from one root-cause analysis of an error; without a source and conditions of use, it cannot be expired once the code is upgraded or the conclusion withdrawn. Storing a lean conclusion does not exempt you from evidence governance; it makes a traceable compression relation all the more necessary.

E36：怎样读这份结果，而不是只看“通过”.en: E36: how to read this result, instead of only looking at "passed"

从原始文档沿来源依赖向外看：分块、摘要、记忆、回答缓存都可能继承错误。删除文档文.en: Look outward from the original document along the source dependencies: chunks, summaries, memories and answer caches can all inherit the error. Deleting the document file itself is no guarantee that the derived conclusions disappear.

自检：</strong>删除源文档后回答缓存仍能命中，为什么不能认为系统已经遗忘.en: Self-check: after the source document is deleted the answer cache still hits. Why can the system not be considered to have forgotten?

派生缓存、摘要和记忆可能继续提供内容。应沿来源依赖传播失效，并在读取时检查撤销/.en: Derived caches, summaries and memories may go on supplying the content. Invalidation should propagate along the source dependencies, and the revocation or permission version should be checked at read time; physical deletion and ceasing to use have to be verified separately.

19｜Skills与路由：怎样加载刚好需要的专业能力.en: 19｜Skills and routing: loading exactly the expertise needed

Why do Valid time and Recorded time have to be kept apart?Q048｜How does memory retrieval avoid picking up the wrong project or an expired rule? And when should something be forgotten?

第14课｜Skills与路由：怎样加载刚好需要的专业能力 — AI系统工程.en: Lesson 14｜Skills and routing: loading exactly the expertise needed — AI Systems Engineering

And why can a model not be chosen on prompt length alone?How does a progressively loaded skill go from "a file" to actual capability?

Skill是可复用任务指导，路由决定是否提供，工具负责真实操作。说明文字可以帮助.en: A skill is reusable task guidance, routing decides whether it is offered, and the tool does the real work. Explanatory text can help the model judge, but it cannot stand in for permissions and verification; expertise is not reading every skill every time.

第01课 · Agent不是另一个神经网络</a><a class=\"pill.en: Lesson 01 · An agent is not another neural networkLesson 08 · Tools and MCPLesson 11 · Assembling contextLesson 18 · Code is not an ordinary documentLesson 23 · Foundations of long-term memoryLesson 13 · Skills, routing and multi-agentLesson 05 · The denominator of an evaluation metric

进入深读前的小检查：</strong>构造一个明显该加载、明显不该加载和边界模糊.en: A quick check before the deep reading: construct one task that clearly should load it, one that clearly should not, and one on a blurred boundary, and write out for each the real cost of loading wrongly and of missing it.

技能不是模型参数，也不是自动执行的程序。它通过可发现的元数据、任务说明和资源，为.en: A skill is not model parameters, and it is not a program that runs by itself. Through discoverable metadata, task instructions and resources, it supplies the model with an expert method. Routing has to avoid both missing a load and loading too much.

技能路由不是文件有无的二选一。名称可发现、描述匹配、正文读取、资源可访问、执行正.en: Skill routing is not a choice between a file being there and not being there. A discoverable name, a matching description, reading the body, reachable resources, correct execution: each of these can fail on its own. Working through this chain of evidence finds the specific cause better than adding one more line saying "the skill must be used".

相关动态过程：<a href=\"../visual/F32.html\">Sk.en: Related step-by-step process: A skill exists — so why can it still be of no use at all?. The rest of this section goes on to show the computation and the engineering limits in more detail.

继续看相关机制：<a href=\"../visual/F25.html\">第.en: Related mechanisms to continue with: Lesson 08 · MCP connects interfaces; it does not hand over permissions on its ownLesson 11 · Each turn's context is like a working file with a boundaryO12 · Model routing: cheaper per call is not cheaper per successful task

Q021｜一个Skill从存在于磁盘到真正影响输出，经历哪些阶段？.en: Q021｜Which stages does a skill pass through, from existing on disk to really affecting the output?

这题先认识什么</span>发现Skill靠元数据，加载正文供模型使用，运行资源.en: What to know first for this questionDiscovering a skill relies on metadata, loading the body makes it usable by the model, and running its resources is another layer of action again. A directory existing is no proof that it was loaded this turn.

至少有发现、候选选择、正文加载、资源获取、实际执行与验证。文件存在不代表被发现，.en: There are at least discovery, candidate selection, body loading, resource acquisition, actual execution and verification. A file existing does not mean it was discovered; a description matching does not mean the body was read; the body being read does not mean the key step was executed. Use this chain to explain "the skill had no effect", instead of guessing from the result alone.

每个阶段都有独立失败.en: Every stage can fail on its own

发现阶段扫描支持目录、解析元数据。路径不支持或格式错误会让技能完全不可见。选择阶.en: The discovery stage scans the supported directories and parses the metadata. An unsupported path or a malformed format makes the skill completely invisible. At the selection stage the model sees the name and the description and decides whether it is relevant to the current task; too broad a description can be selected wrongly, too narrow a one can be missed. The loading stage reads the body; if the file is too long, a reference is broken or the context is trimmed, the content actually in effect may be incomplete.

执行阶段需要工具、权限和当前证据。一个数据库性能.en: The execution stage needs tools, permissions and current evidence. A database-performance

要求查询执行计划，但子.en: asks for a query execution plan, but when the sub-

没有数据库工具，就不能完成关键步骤。验证阶段检查最终代码或分析是否体现相关约束，.en: has no database tool, the key step cannot be completed. The verification stage checks whether the final code or analysis reflects the relevant constraints, rather than requiring the skill's name to appear in the answer.

因此路由日志可记录“发现了哪些候选、选了哪个、读了什么、执行了什么、为何停”。这.en: A routing log can therefore record "which candidates were found, which one was chosen, what was read, what was executed, and why it stopped". This need not expose the full internal chain of thought; recording the observable actions and the grounds for them is enough.

Skill有效应用是一条证据链，不是一个“loaded”日志.en: A skill applied effectively is a chain of evidence, not one "loaded" log line

本例条件：</strong>独立技能目录包含“目录规则审查”Skill，目标检查.en: Conditions for this example: an independent skill directory contains a "directory rule review" skill whose goal is to check the exclude boundary. Follow the metadata first, then the body and the actual tests.

宿主找到了名称与描述。.en: The harness found the name and the description.

相关说明实际进入上下文。.en: The relevant instructions actually enter the context.

执行中出现该方法要求的操作或验证。.en: An operation or verification required by that method appears during execution.

宿主已经发现.en: The harness has already discovered it

正文已经读取.en: The body has already been read

请求中含边界规则.en: The request contains the boundary rule

模型已经遵循.en: The model has already followed it

当前版本执行记录.en: An execution record for the current version

未覆盖的场景也正确.en: Scenarios that were not covered are correct too

逐层定位可以避免“技能文件写得很专业，却完全没有进入模型”的无效优化。.en: Locating it layer by layer avoids the empty optimization of "the skill file is expertly written but never reached the model".

反过来，加载了长篇说明但没有任何对应动作，也不算有效应用；要看任务行为与结果。.en: Conversely, loading a long set of instructions with no corresponding action is not effective application either; look at the task behavior and the result.

Skill的专业性应通过具体失败案例验证，而不是以篇幅或术语数量衡量。.en: A skill's expertise should be verified against concrete failure cases, not measured by its length or its number of technical terms.

不要混淆：</strong>模型回复“已使用某技能”只能当声明，不能替代加载轨迹.en: Do not conflate: the model replying "I used such-and-such skill" counts only as a claim; it is no substitute for a loading trace and evidence of execution.

一个Skill怎样从磁盘文件进入当前动作.en: How a skill gets from a file on disk into the current action

输入与条件。</strong>目录里有Python测试技能，名称/描述声明“适用.en: Input and conditions. The directory holds a Python testing skill whose name and description declare it "suited to diagnosing Python test failures", and whose body cites pytest commands and a classification of failures.

只知道技能存在。.en: All that is known is that the skill exists.

任务是pytest断言失败.en: The task is a pytest assertion failure

候选具有关联；若任务是改文档错字则不应强行加载。.en: The candidate is relevant; if the task were fixing a typo in the documentation, it should not be forced in.

读取执行步骤和所需资料.en: Read the execution steps and the material they need

从“知道名字”进入“知道方法”。.en: This moves from "knowing the name" to "knowing the method".

环境无pytest或只读.en: The environment has no pytest, or is read-only

调整验证方案并说明缺口，而非声称已运行。.en: Adjust the verification plan and state the gap, rather than claiming it has been run.

测试运行对应当前修改版本.en: The test run matches the version as currently modified

Skill被读过不是任务完成证明。.en: A skill having been read is no proof the task is done.

把过程连起来。</strong>技能生命周期最终落在真实动作与证据上，而不是一个.en: Join the steps up. A skill's life cycle comes down in the end to real actions and evidence, not to an "already loaded" label.

边界与反例。</strong>具体发现/自动匹配由产品实现；本例依开放Skill.en: Limits and counterexamples. How discovery and automatic matching actually work is up to the product; this example follows the open skill organization concept and does not guarantee that every tool runs the same process automatically.

追问：为什么让模型在回答中声明“我使用了X技能”不是好评测？.en: Follow-up: why is having the model declare "I used skill X" in its answer not a good evaluation?

它可能声明但没执行，也可能执行了却没提名字。应看实际读取、工具调用和产物行为。关.en: It may declare it without executing it, and it may execute it without mentioning the name. Look at what was actually read, which tools were called and how the artifact behaves. A keyword test only suits checking an explicit formatting requirement; it does not suit proving that expertise was applied.

追问：渐进式加载有什么隐藏成本？.en: Follow-up: what hidden costs does progressive loading have?

额外发现和读取轮次、错误选择、上下文切换与引用失效。对短小且几乎每次都要用的规则.en: Extra rounds of discovery and reading, wrong selections, context switching and broken references. For a short rule needed almost every time, loading it by default may be cheaper. Progressive loading suits a large long tail; it is not an unconditional reason to split every single rule into its own file.

追问：Skill脚本运行成功就意味着Skill完成了吗？.en: Follow-up: once a skill's script has run successfully, does that mean the skill is done?

不。脚本可能只生成候选或中间文件，任务还需解释结果、验证适用性、处理错误和交付。.en: No. The script may only produce candidates or intermediate files; the task still needs the result explained, its applicability verified, errors handled and the work delivered. Mechanical execution succeeding has to be told apart from the user's goal being met.

工程深挖 · E37 · 接续Q073.en: Engineering deep dive · E37 · continues Q073

Skill未生效时，为什么反复改description常常改错层？.en: When a skill has no effect, why does editing the description over and over so often change the wrong layer?

把“生效”拆成可观察的五个关卡.en: Breaking "in effect" into five observable gates

文件存在→宿主发现→本轮选择→正文/资源加载→实际执行关键流程。每一关都可能失败.en: File exists → harness discovers it → selected this turn → body and resources loaded → the key process actually executed. Every gate can fail. The skill description affects discovery and selection, but it cannot fix a path that is not scanned, an invalid file format, a sub-agent that was not preloaded, or insufficient tool permissions. Claude Code's documentation on skills and sub-agents reflects these different life cycles.

教学状态中exists和discovered为True，selected/bod.en: In the teaching state exists and discovered are True, while selected, body_loaded and used are False. Recording only "the skill was discovered" mistakes the first half of the process for success. At that point routing is worth studying; if discovered is itself False, work through the files and the configuration first, and do not rewrite the trigger wording.

JIT节省Token的前提是补充信息真的来得及.en: JIT saves tokens only if the supplementary information really arrives in time

渐进加载意味着先给元数据，需要时再读正文和资源。description太宽会误触.en: Progressive loading means giving the metadata first and reading the body and resources when they are needed. Too broad a description triggers wrongly, too narrow a one fails to trigger; and too long a body may be trimmed or may swamp the task. The most useful record is not how many tokens were loaded, but whether the steps a key task needs really entered the context and were executed.

工具也有类似分层：Codex固定源码中的注册、暴露、可达与分派并非一个对象。.en: Tools have a similar layering: registration, exposure, reachability and dispatch in the pinned Codex source are not one object.

Skill要求使用某工具，但子Agent没有该能力时，继续丰富技能内容不会创造.en: When a skill requires a tool but the sub-agent does not have that ability, enriching the skill's content further will not create the ability to execute.

该怎样构造路由回归集.en: How to construct a routing regression set

收集应该触发的真实任务、近似但不应触发的任务、显式点名任务和组合任务。为每项注明.en: Collect real tasks that should trigger it, tasks that are close but should not, tasks that name it explicitly, and combined tasks. For each one, note "what specifically goes wrong if it is not loaded" and "what it costs if it is". Do not use loading everything for every task as a high-recall approach, or the test will only reward redundancy.

同时测试隐藏依赖：主Agent选中了Skill，子Agent执行时是否得到必要正.en: Test the hidden dependencies at the same time: if the main agent selected the skill, does the sub-agent get the body it needs when it executes; do the resources' relative paths resolve against the right directory; does a change of description affect other skills of the same kind. What is being judged is the final task's quality and cost, not the accuracy of a static classification.

追问：把必须步骤写进Skill就能强制执行吗？.en: Follow-up: does writing a required step into a skill make it enforced?

不能。Skill是提供给模型的指导和资源，不等于运行时约束。如果某步骤涉及安全边.en: No. A skill is guidance and resources supplied to the model; it is not a runtime constraint. If a step touches a security boundary or a deterministic acceptance condition, it should be realized by a program check or wrapped in a tool; not every recommendation has to be raised to a mandatory gate.

追问：模型已经更强，旧Skill还要保留吗？.en: Follow-up: now that the model is stronger, should an old skill be kept?

用真实任务消融测试。若删除后成功率不降、耗时减少，可能是过时补丁；若特定边界明显.en: Run an ablation test on real tasks. If the success rate does not drop and the time goes down once it is removed, it may be an outdated patch; if a particular boundary clearly regresses, keep the part that covers it. A skill does not grow more expert by piling up; it should maintain a gain that can be demonstrated.

E37：怎样读这份结果，而不是只看“通过”.en: E37: how to read this result, instead of only looking at "passed"

逐项读exists、discovered、selected、body_loade.en: Read exists, discovered, selected and body_loaded one by one. The first boundary where true turns to false is usually worth fixing before rewriting the skill body again and again.

自检：</strong>技能文件存在且被扫描到，但子任务没有执行其中测试步骤，第.en: Self-check: the skill file exists and was scanned, but the subtask did not carry out the test steps in it. What should the first reaction be?

先检查选择、正文加载、子Agent上下文和工具权限，确定断在哪一关；不能直接归因.en: Check the selection, the body loading, the sub-agent's context and the tool permissions first, to establish which gate it broke at; you cannot put it down to a weak description straight away, and you cannot take "it was discovered" for "it was executed".

渐进加载的Skill怎样从“文件”变成实际能力？.en: How does a progressively loaded skill go from "a file" to actual capability?

，不代表审查任务已经使用它。需要被目录发现；描述与任务匹配；完整说明被读取；脚本.en: , and that does not mean the review task has used it. It has to be discovered by the directory; the description has to match the task; the full instructions have to be read; the scripts or reference material have to be fetched as needed; and in the end the action has to follow them and get the right result. The first four steps are only conditions; it is the fifth that comes close to effective application.

渐进披露的目的，是让默认上下文只承担必要的发现信息，而不是无条件加载全部规则。A.en: The point of progressive disclosure is to let the default context carry only the discovery information that is needed, rather than load every rule unconditionally. Anthropic's Skills design layers metadata, body and on-demand resources; it does not guarantee that routing never errs, and it does not turn documentation into permission.

固定Codex的加载位置.en: The pinned loading site in Codex

处理显式提及、技能目录快照、依赖、警告和要注入的片段；还会去重已经注入的路径。特.en: handles explicit mentions, the snapshot of the skills directory, dependencies, warnings and the fragments to be injected; it also de-duplicates paths already injected. The particular isolated-review path does not treat an embedded parent conversation as a new explicit mention, so that untrusted content is not mistaken for the current user's choice.

描述边界怎样测试.en: How to test the boundaries of a description

教学样本三类：修改一个变量名，不应加载大型架构审查；跨模块协议迁移，应加载相关专.en: Three classes of teaching sample: renaming one variable, which should not load a large architecture review; migrating a protocol across modules, which should load the relevant expert checks; and a user naming a particular skill, which should be handled by the product's semantics while still bounded by permissions. When comparing an old description with a new one, keep the tasks, the model, the tools and the other rules the same.

记录必要技能召回、不必要加载、额外Token、任务成功与返工。仅证明“少加载了2.en: Record the recall of the skills that were needed, the unnecessary loads, the extra tokens, task success and rework. Proving only that "20% fewer skills were loaded" does not establish an optimization, because essential knowledge may have been missed as well. Conversely, loading every skill for every task has high recall but may add conflict and interference.

稳定且可复用的流程、工具用法、核验标准可以进入；本次文件版本、一次偶然成功、已过.en: A stable, reusable procedure, how to use a tool, and acceptance criteria can go in; this file version, one lucky success and a deployment address that has expired belong in the task's evidence or in memory with a life cycle. A skill itself should have limits of application and failure examples, rather than accumulating more and more "must", "always" and "under all circumstances".

专业能力仍依赖模型理解、资料质量和执行反馈。Skill不是独立模型训练，不要把“.en: Expertise still depends on the model's understanding, the quality of the material and execution feedback. A skill is not independent model training; do not describe "the documentation was loaded" as the parameters having learned a new ability.

技能正文的寿命与工具许可的寿命不同.en: A skill body's lifetime is not the same as a tool permission's lifetime

Claude Code所读文档区分正文保留和allowed-tools临时许可：.en: The documentation read for Claude Code distinguishes keeping the body from allowed-tools being a temporary permission: the body having entered the context does not mean the tool permission continues indefinitely. Whether it appears in the menu, whether the model can trigger it itself, and whether a sub-agent preloads it are governed by different fields too, and cannot be replaced by a single "enabled" boolean.

Codex的显式技能路径会读取快照、处理MCP依赖、得到正文片段及警告、按已注入.en: Codex's explicit skill path reads the snapshot, handles MCP dependencies, obtains body fragments and warnings, and de-duplicates against paths already injected; the parent conversation in an isolated review is evidence, and should not be reinterpreted as this turn's user asking for a skill to be installed or invoked. This is the specific path of the function that was read; it does not cover every implicit skill-selection strategy.

教学检查用两个时刻：t0读取技能并取得本轮许可；t1新用户消息开始。正文仍可被引.en: The teaching check uses two moments: at t0 the skill is read and this turn's permission obtained; at t1 a new user message begins. The body can still be cited, while the temporary permission may already have ended; before executing again you have to judge afresh by the current policy, and "I learned it earlier" does not entail "I am permitted to execute now".

Q022｜怎样写路由Description，既不漏边界任务又不过度触发？.en: Q022｜How do you write a routing description that neither misses a borderline task nor triggers too often?

这题先认识什么</span>描述要表达适用任务及边界；太宽产生误加载，太窄漏专业.en: What to know first for this questionA description has to state the tasks it suits and its boundaries; too broad and it loads wrongly, too narrow and the expertise is missed. Test it with positive, negative and borderline examples.

第17课 · 从搜索结果到可信答案</a><a class=\"pill\" h.en: Lesson 17 · From search results to a trustworthy answerLesson 13 · Skills, routing and multi-agentLesson 05 · The denominator of an evaluation metric

描述应表达明确任务意图、适用对象和关键边界，避免只堆专业名词或无限扩大适用范围。.en: A description should state a clear task intent, what it applies to and the key boundaries, and avoid merely piling up technical nouns or extending its range without limit. Routing quality comes from validating positive, negative and borderline examples against a real task distribution, not from copy that looks comprehensive.

看一个容易误路由的例子.en: Look at an example that is easy to route wrongly

“用于所有存储、数据库、缓存、文件、性能、安全与架构任务”覆盖太广，几乎任何后端.en: "For all storage, database, cache, file, performance, security and architecture tasks" covers far too much: almost any backend change would trigger it. Conversely, "use only when the user explicitly says to optimize an SQL index" may miss the natural phrasing "the endpoint query is too slow, help me track it down".

更有用的描述可围绕意图：“在任务需要分析数据库查询计划、索引选择、事务隔离或持久.en: A more useful description can be built around intent: "use when the task needs analysis of database query plans, index choice, transaction isolation or persistence consistency; ordinary file reads and writes, and renaming a field with no database semantics, usually do not need it." This is still an example, not generally optimal wording. Let the boundary of expertise be corrected by actual evidence: a task looks simple at first, reading the code reveals that transactions are involved, and the expert skill is then escalated.

评测集包括明显正例、明显负例和模糊边界。除了选择是否正确，还看漏选会造成什么具体.en: An evaluation set includes clear positive examples, clear negative examples and blurred boundaries. Beyond whether the selection is right, look at what specific error a missed selection causes and at how much a wrong selection adds in extra

和流程。一个误加载但不影响输出的场景，与漏掉事务一致性导致重复扣款，风险不同。.en: and process steps. A case where something loads by mistake but does not affect the output differs in risk from one where transaction consistency is missed and a charge is taken twice.

路由描述的好坏，要看正例与近邻反例是否分得开.en: Whether a routing description is good depends on whether positive examples and near-miss negatives can be told apart

本例条件：</strong>独立两个任务：A修改SQL迁移脚本；B只给READM.en: Conditions for this example: two independent tasks: A changes an SQL migration script; B only fixes a typo in the README. The candidate skill is "database migration review"; not every task whose text mentions "database" needs it.

必须启用该技能的任务。.en: A task for which that skill must be enabled.

措辞相似但不该启用的任务。.en: A task worded similarly that should not enable it.

漏掉必需技能与加载无关技能的两种错误。.en: The two errors: missing a required skill, and loading an irrelevant one.

涉及迁移与兼容风险.en: It involves migration and compatibility risk

B：README提到数据库的错字.en: B: the typo in the README's mention of the database

C：修改ORM字段映射.en: C: change the ORM field mapping

可能影响schema，先小范围取证.en: May affect the schema; gather evidence on a small scope first

把description写成“所有数据库相关任务都用”会提高表面覆盖，却让B也走.en: Writing the description as "use for every database-related task" raises apparent coverage but sends B through the heavy process as well.

C是边界任务，合理做法不是凭一句描述强判，而是读取少量关键证据后决定是否扩展。.en: C is a borderline task; the sensible move is not to force a judgment from one line of description, but to read a little key evidence and then decide whether to widen the scope.

评测要同时包含正例、反例和边界例；只用正例测试会鼓励越来越宽泛的描述。.en: An evaluation must include positive cases, counterexamples and boundary cases together; testing with positive cases alone encourages ever vaguer descriptions.

不要混淆：</strong>误加载率下降但漏掉高风险任务，不是成功优化；要看各类.en: Do not conflate: a lower rate of wrong loading that misses the high-risk tasks is not a successful optimization; look at the cost of each kind of error and at the final code quality.

“所有开发任务都适用”的描述会怎样误加载.en: How a description saying "applies to all development tasks" leads to wrong loading

输入与条件。</strong>候选A描述“提升工程质量，适用所有代码任务”；B描.en: Input and conditions. Candidate A is described as "improves engineering quality, suits all code tasks"; B as "analyzes concurrent shared state, races and lock ordering".

改README拼写.en: Fix a spelling mistake in the README

A容易宽泛匹配，B不相关。.en: A matches it loosely all too easily; B is irrelevant.

余额并发扣减出现负数.en: Concurrent balance deductions produce a negative number

新增普通纯函数测试.en: Add a test for an ordinary pure function

质量相关不等于必须加载并发分析。.en: Being quality-related is not the same as having to load concurrency analysis.

收紧A的具体触发与不适用例.en: Tighten A's specific triggers and its non-applicable examples

不是把描述压成难懂缩写。.en: This is not compressing the description into an opaque abbreviation.

用必要召回和不必要加载双指标.en: Use the two metrics of necessary recall and unnecessary loading

只减少加载量可能把B该触发的任务也漏掉。.en: Reducing the amount loaded alone may also miss the tasks B should trigger on.

把过程连起来。</strong>路由描述的边界需要正例和相邻反例，而不是一堆“专.en: Join the steps up. The boundary of a routing description needs positive examples and adjacent negative ones, not a heap of adjectives like "expert", "comprehensive" and "best".

边界与反例。</strong>教学例不能证明真实LLM选择概率；需用目标模型与固.en: Limits and counterexamples. A teaching example cannot establish a real LLM's selection probabilities; those need measuring with the target model and a fixed task set.

追问：是否需要很多硬性分类等级？.en: Follow-up: are a lot of hard classification levels needed?

不一定。可以保留“简单直接做，证据显示复杂再深化”的原则，让模型在证据支持下判断.en: Not necessarily. You can keep the principle of "do the simple thing directly, and go deeper when the evidence shows it is complex", letting the model judge on the strength of evidence. Hard classification is worth adding only when a predictable error keeps recurring and there really is a gain; otherwise it may force open-ended tasks into boxes that do not fit.

追问：多个Skill重叠时该全部加载吗？.en: Follow-up: when several skills overlap, should they all be loaded?

先确定主问题和必要专业边界。重叠可能需要组合，也可能只是描述重复。加载后要检查指.en: Establish the main problem and the expert boundaries actually needed first. An overlap may call for a combination, or it may just be a repeated description. After loading, check for conflicting instructions and duplicated work. If both skills demand a full independent analysis and review, stacking them directly may double the task's cost without producing new evidence.

追问：修改Description怎样证明没有降低专业召回？.en: Follow-up: how do you prove that changing a description has not lowered expert recall?

在固定任务集比较旧/新版本，重点看原来应命中的任务是否丢失，同时增加真实误触发负.en: Compare the old and the new version on a fixed task set, looking above all at whether tasks that used to hit are now lost, and add real false-trigger negatives at the same time. Do not only verify that "the earlier wrong load has gone", or you may gain a false improvement in precision by writing the description extremely narrowly.

Q023｜Skill、Instruction、Hook、Tool和Agent分别.en: Q023｜What should a skill, an instruction, a hook, a tool and an agent each be responsible for?

这题先认识什么</span>指令指导行为，Skill复用流程，工具执行动作，Ho.en: What to know first for this questionAn instruction guides behavior, a Skill makes a procedure reusable, a tool performs the action, and a Hook runs a program at a given point. State the actual shortcoming before choosing a mechanism.

第01课 · Agent不是另一个神经网络</a><a class=\"pill.en: Lesson 01 · An agent is not another neural networkLesson 08 · Tools and MCPLesson 13 · Skills, routing and multi-agentLesson 04 · Foundations of engineering quality

Instruction表达持续约束；Skill提供按需专业方法；Tool执行具体.en: Instruction expresses a standing constraint; Skill supplies an expert method on demand; Tool performs a concrete action;

在确定节点运行程序化逻辑；Agent承载独立任务执行与上下文。用职责选择机制，避.en: runs programmatic logic at a fixed point; Agent carries an independent task's execution and its own context. Choose the mechanism by responsibility, and avoid writing the same logic out five times.

“所有代码遵循项目格式”可在项目指令中说明；“遇到数据库迁移时核对回滚与兼容”可.en: "All code follows the project format" can be stated in the project instructions; "when there is a database migration, check rollback and compatibility" can be a skill; "run the migration checker" is a tool; "run the deterministic format check automatically before a commit" can be carried out by a suitable hook/

执行；“独立审查迁移方案”在风险足够时可委派Agent。.en: ; "review the migration plan independently" can be delegated to an agent when the risk warrants it.

自然语言适合开放判断，确定性程序适合可机械验证的条件。例如文件是否存在、.en: Natural language suits open-ended judgment, and a deterministic program suits conditions that can be checked mechanically. Whether a file exists, whether a

是否合法、命令退出码是否为零，不需要模型猜。模型适合判断哪些测试相关、证据是否支.en: is valid, whether a command's exit code is zero: none of these need the model to guess. The model is good at judging which tests are relevant and whether the evidence supports a root cause, but the conclusion should still be bound by the facts the tools give.

技能引用资源需保证相对路径、版本和权限可用。工具权限不能因为Skill正文写“允.en: A skill citing a resource has to be sure the relative path, the version and the permissions are available. A tool permission cannot be extended because a skill's body says "access allowed". Nor is a hook safe by nature: the script it runs may hold the process's permissions, and needs the same review.

把需要确定执行的动作放在程序里，不只写进说明.en: Put the actions that must certainly be carried out in the program, not only in the instructions

本例条件：</strong>独立需求：提交前必须运行格式检查，复杂安全修改再请R.en: Conditions for this example: an independent requirement: a format check must be run before committing, and a complex security change also needs a reviewer. The responsibilities of an instruction, a skill, a hook, a tool and an agent are compared.

持续或当前任务的指导。.en: Guidance that is ongoing, or that belongs to the current task.

在明确事件触发的程序逻辑。.en: Program logic triggered by an explicit event.

模型可请求的动作。.en: The actions the model can request.

有自己上下文与执行循环的任务承担者。.en: A task-taker with its own context and execution loop.

更合适的承载方式.en: A more suitable place to carry it

特定迁移任务的检查方法.en: A checking method for a specific migration task

提交前确定跑格式检查.en: Make sure the format check runs before submitting

不依赖模型记得请求.en: does not rely on the model remembering the request

有独立任务与证据需求.en: Has an independent task and its own evidence needs

如果某操作是机械必做且容易确定触发，程序钩子通常比让模型每次记住它更可靠。.en: If an operation is mechanical, mandatory and easy to trigger reliably, a program hook is usually more dependable than having the model remember it every time.

Skill不是钩子的替代：它告诉“怎样做”，不自动保证事件发生时执行。.en: A skill is not a substitute for a hook: it says "how to do it", and does not guarantee by itself that anything runs when the event occurs.

多Agent也不是更高级的Tool，每个独立上下文会产生初始化、交接和合并成本。.en: Multi-agent is not a more advanced kind of Tool either; every separate context brings costs of initialization, handoff and merging.

不要混淆：</strong>所有任务固定经过多个Agent和重复Review，可.en: Do not conflate: routing every task through several agents and repeated review can add cost without addressing any new failure mode.

想强制格式检查，写进Prompt还是用Hook.en: To enforce a format check, write it into the prompt or use a hook?

输入与条件。</strong>规则是提交前必须运行格式检查；任务另需Python.en: Input and conditions. The rule is that a format check has to run before a commit; the task also needs expert Python advice and a file-reading tool.

向模型说明约束与目标.en: State the constraint and the goal to the model

模型能够理解但并非确定性执行保证。.en: The model can understand it, but that is no guarantee of deterministic execution.

提供Python问题的专业处理流程.en: Supplies an expert procedure for handling Python problems

提供format_check()实际执行能力.en: Supplies the actual ability to execute format_check()

调用后产生退出码与日志。.en: Calling it produces an exit code and a log.

Hook或固定流程.en: A hook or a fixed procedure

在提交事件前确定性触发检查.en: Trigger the check deterministically before the commit event

对必须发生的机械步骤更合适。.en: Better suited to a mechanical step that has to happen.

在失败时决定检查文件、修改与重试.en: Decide, on failure, which files to check, what to change and whether to retry

负责动态行动，不代替格式工具自身。.en: It handles the dynamic action; it does not replace the format tool itself.

把过程连起来。</strong>选择机制看它承担的是解释、方法、动作、强制时机还.en: Join the steps up. Choose a mechanism by what it carries: explanation, method, action, enforced timing or dynamic decision.

边界与反例。</strong>Hook可用事件与阻断行为依产品；不能假设某任意C.en: Limits and counterexamples. Which events a hook can use, and whether it can block, depend on the product; do not assume that any given CLI offers the same abilities.

追问：为什么不把所有检查都放Hook强制执行？.en: Follow-up: why not put every check into a hook and enforce it?

频繁且昂贵的全量检查可能拖慢简单任务，部分检查需要业务判断而非固定脚本。Hook.en: A frequent, expensive full check can slow a simple task down, and some checks need business judgment rather than a fixed script. A hook suits a cheap, deterministic, critical mechanical boundary. A risk-driven deep review should not be replaced by a fixed trigger frequency.

追问：Skill可否独立于某个框架复用？.en: Follow-up: can a skill be reused independently of a particular framework?

可以把领域原理、操作步骤与资源尽量写成平台无关内容，再为具体工具提供轻量适配。但.en: You can write the domain principles, the operating steps and the resources as platform-independent content as far as possible, and then provide a light adapter for a specific tool. But tool names, permissions, paths and calling protocols usually need adapting. Being portable is not the same as copying it unchanged into every CLI and having it run.

追问：什么时候需要拆成独立Agent？.en: Follow-up: when does it need splitting into a separate agent?

任务有独立上下文、可并行目标或确有独立审查价值时；仅仅说明较长不一定需要子Age.en: When the task has its own context, goals that can run in parallel, or genuine value in independent review; merely being long to explain does not necessarily need a sub-agent. A sub-agent adds handoff, cost and state management, and should not be treated as the default substitute for a file-loading mechanism.

Q024｜多模型路由怎样优化成本而不牺牲质量？为什么不能只按Prompt长度选模.en: Q024｜How does multi-model routing optimize cost without sacrificing quality? And why can a model not be chosen on prompt length alone?

这题先认识什么</span>模型路由看任务难度、风险与实测成功成本，不凭一个标签.en: What to know first for this questionModel routing goes by task difficulty, risk and the measured cost per success; it does not fix strong and weak by a label for good. Escalating and downgrading both need evidence.

第62课 · 算得快与装得下</a><a class=\"pill\" href.en: Lesson 62 · Computing fast and fitting in memoryLesson 13 · Skills, routing and multi-agentLesson 05 · The denominator of an evaluation metricLesson 31 · Do not be fooled by a few percent

路由应考虑任务难度、风险、需要的工具/上下文能力和真实成功率。Prompt长度只.en: Routing should take in task difficulty, risk, the tool and context abilities needed, and the real success rate.
