频繁低价值审批会增加疲劳，也未必阻止真正风险。只读、可恢复、明确受限动作可自动执.en: Frequent low-value approvals add fatigue and do not necessarily stop the real risk. Read-only, recoverable, clearly restricted actions can run automatically; high-risk or irreversible ones take a precise confirmation. What matters is that the permission boundary and the approved object are clear, not that the number of dialogs is as high as possible.

固定同一请求，分别改变目标、正文、用户、版本与过期时间，检查哪些变化必须重新批准.en: Hold one request fixed and vary the target, the body, the user, the version and the expiry in turn, checking which changes force a fresh approval; also test that a network retry of the same intent is not mistaken for a new authorization. Do not let one "the confirmation was clicked" boolean cover a whole session.

E48：怎样读这份结果，而不是只看“通过”.en: E48: how to read this result, rather than only looking at "pass"

批准必须绑定具体参数和目标版本。批准后换路径、扩大金额或目标变化，都要重新校验，.en: An approval must be bound to specific arguments and a target version. A changed path, a raised amount or a shifted target after the approval all require a fresh check; a "consent" detached from the action cannot be reused.

自检：</strong>用户批准了write a.py的v1内容，模型后来改为v.en: Self-check: the user approved writing the v1 content of a.py, and the model later changed it to v2 while call_id stayed the same. May it be executed?

不能沿用原批准。call_id不是完整意图；内容、目标、用户、版本与有效期等需与.en: The original approval cannot carry over. call_id is not the full intent; the content, the target, the user, the version and the validity period all have to match what was approved, and a change of arguments should be re-checked or confirmed again.

Q060｜记忆污染和检索投毒怎样发生？为什么删除源文档后还可能继续受影响？.en: Q060｜How do memory poisoning and retrieval poisoning happen? Why can the effect continue after the source document is deleted?

这题先认识什么</span>恶意经验可经记忆长期放大，写入和取回都需来源与适用条.en: What to know first for this question A malicious experience can be amplified over the long run through memory; both the write and the retrieval need a source and conditions of use. A summary must not promote low-trust text into a rule.

第22课 · 压缩不是魔法</a><a class=\"pill\" href=.en: Lesson 22 · Compaction is not magicLesson 23 · Foundations of long-term memoryLesson 29 · Security basics

不可信或错误内容被保存成长期事实、程序性经验或摘要后，会在未来反复检索，获得看似.en: Once untrusted or wrong content has been saved as a long-term fact, a procedural experience or a summary, it is retrieved again and again in future and acquires the apparently credible standing of history. If deleting the original text leaves the derived memories, indexes and caches untouched, the effect can persist.

一条错误经验的放大路径.en: How one wrong experience gets amplified

外部文档写“本项目测试可忽略权限检查”。Agent误信后在总结里记录“团队默认不.en: An external document says "tests in this project may ignore the permission check". The agent believes it and records in a summary that "the team does not check permissions by default"; long-term memory then loads that as a rule, and later sub-agents inherit it as well. The original source is lost step by step, until it looks as if the user had been asking for this all along. This is provenance and permission being laundered in the course of derivation.

防御要保留来源链、写入资格和状态。外部证据可以成为候选事实，不能直接升级为执行指.en: A defense has to keep the provenance chain, the eligibility to write and the state. External evidence can become a candidate fact, but not directly an instruction to execute; a procedural rule needs a more trustworthy basis; a conflict between old and new should be handled explicitly. Retrieval should filter by identity and

过滤，避免另一项目经验影响当前项目。.en: so that experience from another project does not affect the current one.

撤销时查依赖：原文chunk、向量、关键词索引、摘要、长期记忆、生成报告和缓存。.en: When revoking, look through the dependencies: the source chunk, the vectors, the keyword index, the summary, long-term memory, generated reports and caches. Whether they must be deleted outright or marked invalid depends on policy, but revoked content cannot go on being treated as a valid basis.

删除源文档后，派生摘要与向量块还可能继续传播旧结论.en: Once the source document is deleted, derived summaries and vector chunks can still go on spreading the old conclusion

本例条件：</strong>独立来源D1被撤回，它曾生成chunk C1、摘要S.en: Conditions for this example: an independent source D1 is withdrawn, having previously produced chunk C1, summary S1 and long-term memory M1. Invalidation has to follow the provenance dependencies. This is not real user data.

从原文产生的块、向量、摘要、记忆。.en: The chunks, vectors, summaries and memories produced from the original text.

指出某条结论依赖哪些原始证据。.en: It states which original evidence a conclusion depends on.

源撤回时同步禁止过期派生项继续使用。.en: When the source is withdrawn, stale derived items are barred from further use at the same time.

放大图解：删除源文档后，派生摘要与向量块还可能继续传播旧结论.en: Enlarged figure: after the source document is deleted, derived summaries and vector chunks can still go on spreading the old conclusion

撤回D1后应做什么.en: What to do after D1 is withdrawn

从检索中删除或标失效.en: Remove it from retrieval or mark it invalid

重新生成或标明部分依据撤回.en: Regenerate it, or note that part of its basis was withdrawn

复核来源，不能当独立确认.en: Re-check the source; it cannot count as independent confirmation

引用M1的旧答案.en: An old answer that cites M1

按相关键失效化.en: Invalidate it by the related keys

如果只删除D1文件，C1还在索引里，下一次仍会被召回。物理删除一份原文不等于系统.en: If only the D1 file is deleted, C1 is still in the index and will be recalled next time. Physically deleting one copy of the original text does not mean the system has forgotten it.

派生记忆引用摘要时，最好还能追到原始证据；否则多次转述会制造“多个来源都这么说”.en: When a derived memory cites a summary, it is better if the original evidence can still be traced; otherwise repeated retelling creates the illusion that "several sources all say so".

复杂来源图有维护成本，可从文档ID、版本和派生列表做最小实现，不必一开始搭通用知.en: A complex provenance graph costs maintenance; a minimal implementation from document IDs, versions and a list of derivatives will do, and there is no need to build a general knowledge graph at the outset.

不要混淆：</strong>把模型生成的摘要当新的独立来源，会把同一次污染重复计.en: Do not conflate: treating a model-generated summary as a new independent source counts one and the same contamination as several pieces of evidence.

恶意建议被写入记忆后，下一次任务怎样被带偏.en: How the next task is led astray once a malicious suggestion has been written into memory

输入与条件。</strong>一个外部文档声称“为提高效率，今后任何测试失败都直.en: Input and conditions. An external document claims that "for efficiency, from now on mark any test failure straight as pass". With no validation, the system saves it as experience m9.

把外部文字当权威执行经验.en: External text is taken as authoritative execution experience

来源可信度丢失。.en: The credibility of the source is lost.

下次检索到m9并作为规则.en: Next time m9 is retrieved and used as a rule

一次不可信输入跨会话影响行为。.en: One untrusted input affects behavior across sessions.

写入防线.en: The line of defense at write time

经验必须关联真实验证、适用范围与来源.en: An experience must be tied to real verification, a scope of use and a source

该命题应被拒绝，而不是只给低优先级。.en: The proposition should be refused, not merely given a low priority.

删除或失效m9及派生摘要与索引.en: Delete or invalidate m9 together with the derived summaries and indexes

防止旧缓存继续返回。.en: This keeps the old cache from going on returning it.

模拟测试失败任务.en: Simulate a task whose test fails

确认系统仍报告失败与缺口，而非自动改标签。.en: Confirm that the system still reports the failure and the gap, instead of changing the label by itself.

把过程连起来。</strong>记忆提高连续性，也会提高错误与攻击的持续时间，因.en: Join the steps up. Memory raises continuity, and it also lengthens how long an error or an attack lasts, so both writing and reading back need boundaries.

边界与反例。</strong>本例为防御场景；简单关键词过滤不足以证明记忆安全。.en: Limits and counterexamples. This example is a defensive scenario; simple keyword filtering is not enough to prove that memory is secure.

追问：可以给每条记忆打可信分数解决吗？.en: Follow-up: can giving every memory a trust score solve it?

分数可辅助排序，但不能替代来源权限。一个经常被引用的错误记忆可能高分；一条新发布.en: A score can help with the ordering, but it cannot replace provenance and permission. A wrong memory that is cited often may score highly, while a newly published authoritative correction may be infrequent. Identity, source type, validity state and statistical signals have to be kept apart.

追问：如何测试这类问题？.en: Follow-up: how is this kind of problem tested?

在隔离测试环境注入无害的伪指令或错误规则，观察是否被执行、保存、跨会话传播和撤销.en: In an isolated test environment, inject a harmless fake instruction or wrong rule and watch whether it is executed, saved, propagated across sessions and revoked. The verification should cover retrieval, summarization, memory writes and tool authorization, not just one refusal in a chat.

追问：为什么安全不是一个独立末尾模块？.en: Follow-up: why is security not a separate module at the end?

权限过滤影响检索，来源保真影响压缩，动作身份影响重试，状态绑定影响批准。安全跨越.en: Permission filtering affects retrieval, fidelity of provenance affects compaction, the identity of an action affects retries, and binding to state affects approval. Security runs across every layer of the system. Leaving it to the end and adding a "security agent" cannot recover data that has already leaked or a side effect that has already run.

25｜生产运行：Trace、成本、队列、灰度与回滚.en: 25｜Production operation: traces, cost, queues, canary releases and rollback

沿着对象与状态理解本章</a><a href=\"#topic-2\">资料能影.en: Follow this chapter through its objects and statesMaterial can influence a model without thereby gaining permissionQ057｜How does Prompt Injection differ from an ordinary malicious user input? Why can external material not become an instruction?Q058｜What does a sandbox actually isolate? Why must file permissions, network permissions and MCP permissions be looked at separately?Q059｜What should a human approval approve? Why can "allow this task" not cover every action that follows?Q060｜How do memory poisoning and retrieval poisoning happen? Why can the effect continue after the source document is deleted?

第34课｜生产运行：Trace、成本、队列、灰度与回滚 — AI系统工程.en: Lesson 34｜Production operation: traces, cost, queues, canary releases and rollback — AI Systems Engineering

沿着对象与状态理解本章</a><a href=\"#topic-2\">Trac.en: Follow this chapter through its objects and statesA trace should tell you causation, not just timestampsQ065｜How should one agent task record its trace, so that "slow, expensive, wrong" can be located?Q066｜Why is "cheap per token" not the same as "cheap to get the work done"? How should cost be computed?Q067｜Does more concurrency always mean more throughput? How is agent latency understood through queueing?Q068｜What exactly has to be versioned when an agent system goes live? Why is a rollback not just switching the model back?Work out the waiting, the usage and the cost of failure from one trace

把运行分成可观察的跨度，才能找出慢在排队、模型、工具还是返工。成本要按成功完成任.en: Only by dividing a run into observable spans can you find whether the slowness is in the queue, the model, the tools or rework. Cost should be computed per successfully completed task, and read together with quality and tail latency.

第62课 · 算得快与装得下</a><a class=\"pill\" href.en: Lesson 62 · Computing fast and fitting in memoryLesson 02 · State, events and checkpointsLesson 26 · Retries, idempotence and transactionsLesson 05 · The denominator of an evaluation metricLesson 31 · Do not be fooled by a few percentLesson 29 · Security basicsLesson 33 · Reading a production run

进入深读前的小检查：</strong>读一份Trace时先重建依赖关系，独立并行.en: A quick check before the deep reading: when reading a trace, rebuild the dependencies first — independent parallel spans are not simply added up — and count the actual consumption of a failed task just the same.

本章不把“加日志、做监控”当作答案。我们要能从一条慢任务的轨迹中分离等待、模型、.en: This chapter does not treat "add logs, set up monitoring" as the answer. We want to be able to separate waiting, the model, the tools, recovery and verification in the trace of one slow task, and to explain at which stage the system comes close to its capacity limit. All the numbers are teaching assumptions, not a vendor quotation or a production measurement.

性能图先用实际起止时间画，而不是将所有工具耗时直接相加。下图中缩短非关键路径的A.en: A performance chart is drawn from the actual start and end times, not by adding up every tool's duration. In the figure below, shortening A, which is off the critical path, does not shorten the total time; likewise, a lower price per token does not necessarily lower the cost of a successful task.

相关动态过程：<a href=\"../visual/F38.html\">Tr.en: Related step-by-step process: A trace should tell you causation, not just timestamps. The rest of this section goes on to show the computation and the engineering limits in more detail.

继续看相关机制：<a href=\"../visual/F24.html\">第.en: Related mechanisms to continue with: Lesson 02 · Task state is not a one-line summary in the chatO06 · Continuous batching: when a seat frees up, take the next oneO12 · Model routing: cheaper per call is not cheaper per successful task

Q065｜一个Agent任务应该怎样记录Trace，才能定位“慢、贵、错”？.en: Q065｜How should one agent task record its trace, so that "slow, expensive, wrong" can be located?

这题先认识什么</span>Trace包含跨度、时间和依赖，可定位一次任务在哪环.en: What to know first for this question A trace holds spans, times and dependencies, which locate where one task spent its time. Sensitive information in a log should be kept to a minimum.

第02课 · 状态、事件与检查点</a><a class=\"pill\" hr.en: Lesson 02 · State, events and checkpointsLesson 33 · Reading a production run

把一次用户任务作为逻辑根，把检索、模型调用、工具执行、压缩和验证作为子操作；记录.en: Take one user task as the logical root, with retrieval, model calls, tool execution, compaction and verification as sub-operations; record the causal relations, the input versions, the output status and the resource consumption.

回答“这次发生了什么”，指标回答“总体怎样”，日志和证据对象回答“具体细节是什么.en: answers "what happened this time", metrics answer "how things are overall", and logs and evidence objects answer "what the details actually were". None of the three can replace another.

一条轨迹里的对象与关联键.en: The objects in one trace, and the keys that link them

可能由另一个工作进程执行。关联应依赖稳定ID，而不是“看时间差不多”猜它们是一组.en: may be executed by another worker process. Correlation should rest on stable IDs, rather than guessing from "the times look about right" that they belong together.

每次模型调用至少区分请求模型、返回模型标识、输入量、可观测的缓存量、输出量、响应.en: For every model call, distinguish at least the model requested, the model identifier returned, the input volume, the observable cached volume, the output volume, the response status and the elapsed time. Whether reasoning usage is itemized separately, and how it is billed, depends on the interface; it should not be guessed from the length of the final text. For every tool call, record a summary of the arguments or a controlled reference to them, the permission outcome, the execution status and the external operation ID. Full sensitive arguments should not enter a public log by default.

若两个工具并行，各自耗时8秒和10秒，不能把18秒直接算成这段用户等待；关键路径.en: If two tools run in parallel and take 8 seconds and 10 seconds, 18 seconds cannot be taken as the user's wait over that stretch; the critical path is more like 10 seconds plus the scheduling cost. If there is queue waiting between the spans but only the execution function is instrumented, monitoring will show "the tools are fast" while the user still waits a long time. Record the enqueue, the start and the finish separately.

Trace里的并行段不能直接相加成用户等待时间.en: Parallel spans in a trace cannot simply be added up into the user's waiting time

本例条件：</strong>独立任务：模型计划0—2秒，之后工具A运行2—7秒、.en: Conditions for this example: an independent task: the model plans from 0—2 s, then tool A runs from 2—7 s and tool B from 2—5 s, and finally the model consolidates from 7—10 s.

一段有开始、结束及父子关系的操作。.en: An operation with a start, an end and a parent–child relationship.

各Span耗时之和，可含并行重叠。.en: The sum of the time each span takes, which may include parallel overlap.

决定最终完成时刻的依赖链。.en: The chain of dependencies that decides the final completion time.

放大图解：Trace里的并行段不能直接相加成用户等待时间.en: Enlarged figure: parallel segments in a Trace cannot simply be added up into the user's waiting time

优化B到1 s，墙钟仍10 s.en: Optimize B to 1 s and the wall clock is still 10 s

横轴使用真实示意时间，A和B有重叠。用户等的是最晚依赖完成，不是两条工具时间的总.en: The horizontal axis uses real illustrative times, and A and B overlap. What the user waits for is the last dependency to finish, not the sum of the two tool times.

若Trace只记录工具内部耗时，可能漏掉排队、连接与响应传输，端到端仍对不上。.en: If the trace records only the time spent inside the tool, it may miss queuing, connection and response transfer, and the end-to-end figure will still not add up.

每个Span应关联任务、尝试、工具ID与工件身份，才能把慢和错连接到具体操作。.en: Every span should be linked to the task, the attempt, the tool ID and the artifact identity, so that slowness and errors can be tied to a specific operation.

不要混淆：</strong>父Span已经包含子Span时间时，把父子再次相加会.en: Do not conflate: when the parent span already includes the child span's time, adding parent and child together counts that time twice.

Trace里三个span加起来10秒，任务为什么只用了7秒.en: Three spans in the trace add up to 10 seconds — why did the task take only 7

输入与条件。</strong>检索span A=[0,3]秒、B=[0,5]秒，.en: Input and conditions. Retrieval spans A=[0,3] seconds and B=[0,5] seconds, consolidation C=[5,7] seconds, parent task=[0,7] seconds.

10秒，表示各操作累计时长。.en: 10 seconds, the accumulated duration of the individual operations.

5+2=7，A不是当前关键路径。.en: 5+2=7, and A is not the current critical path.

若B仍5秒，总任务仍7秒。.en: With B still at 5 seconds, the whole task is still 7 seconds.

此时等待A3秒，任务变5秒，不是4秒。.en: Now the wait on A is 3 seconds and the task becomes 5 seconds, not 4.

把过程连起来。</strong>优化应看关键路径和依赖，不是优先压缩所有span.en: Join the steps up. Optimization should follow the critical path and the dependencies, rather than starting with whichever span is easiest to shorten.

边界与反例。</strong>忽略资源竞争的确定性时间线；异步Trace的父子关.en: Limits and counterexamples. This is a deterministic timeline that ignores resource contention; in an asynchronous trace, the parent-child relation still has to be told apart from the actual waiting dependency.

追问：不存完整Prompt，还能调试上下文遗漏吗？.en: Follow-up: without storing the full prompt, can missing context still be debugged?

可以存上下文清单：片段ID、来源版本、角色、加载原因、.en: You can store a context manifest: fragment IDs, source versions, roles, the reason each was loaded, the

估计、裁剪状态和最终排序。它不能重建全部文本，但可发现“本该加载的文件没有进入请.en: estimate, the trimming state and the final ordering. It cannot reconstruct all of the text, but it can reveal that "a file that should have been loaded never entered the request". When the content itself has to be replayed, use an evidence store with permissions and limited retention. Keeping the manifest apart from the body is a compromise between diagnostic power and privacy.

追问：为什么不要把用户ID、完整Prompt放进指标标签？.en: Follow-up: why should user IDs and full prompts not go into metric labels?

这些值数量极大，会产生高基数时间序列，增加存储和查询成本；还可能泄露信息。指标适.en: There are enormous numbers of such values, so they produce high-cardinality time series that raise storage and query costs; they can also leak information. Metrics suit a limited set, such as the tool category, the result type or the version group. Put a single task's high-cardinality fields in a controlled trace or log, and jump there from a metric anomaly to look.

追问：Trace里的“成功”应该由谁决定？.en: Follow-up: who should decide what counts as "success" in a trace?

成功只说明调用完成；工具成功只说明工具返回成功；任务成功应由验收结果决定。根跨度.en: success only means the call completed; a tool success only means the tool returned success; task success should be decided by the acceptance result. The root span is best at keeping both the termination reason and the business acceptance result. Otherwise "an answer was generated" covers up zero tests, partial completion or a failed external write.

用一条Trace算清等待、用量和失败成本.en: Work out the waiting, the usage and the cost of failure from one trace

一条请求至少有三种时间.en: One request has at least three kinds of time

用户等待是墙钟；模型计算是推理跨度；工具操作总量是各动作耗时相加。并发时总量可以.en: The user's wait is wall clock; the model's computation is the inference span; the total tool work is the durations of the individual actions added up. With concurrency the total can be greater than the wall clock. Ordered collection, queues, locks and retries can add waiting too, and none of that shows up in the execution time of a single tool handler.

优化关键路径才改变墙钟。数值与状态属于本节明确设定的教学例；不是生产性能或商业模.en: Only optimizing the critical path changes the wall clock. The numbers and states are a teaching example explicitly set out in this section; they are not production performance or a measurement of a commercial model.

教学Trace：模型2秒，工具A5秒与B3秒并行，汇总1秒，墙钟约8秒，工具总量.en: A teaching trace: the model 2 seconds, tools A at 5 seconds and B at 3 seconds in parallel, aggregation 1 second, a wall clock of about 8 seconds and 8 seconds of total tool work. Optimizing A to 4 seconds makes the wall clock 7; shrinking only B to 1 second leaves it at 8. Look at the critical path first, then decide which part to optimize.

两组请求样本大小不同，两个p95的平均不是整体p95。整体应从原始延迟分布或可合.en: When two groups of requests have different sample sizes, the average of their two p95s is not the overall p95. The overall figure should be computed from the raw latency distribution or from a mergeable statistical structure. Recording only the mean hides the long tail; reporting only p95 is no substitute for the sample size, the error rate and the timeout policy.

成功任务成本必须计入失败.en: The cost per successful task must include the failures

教学10次请求共花20元，7次达标，则每个成功结果的这批总成本为20/7，不是只.en: In a teaching case, 10 requests cost 20 yuan in all and 7 meet the bar, so this batch's total cost per successful result is 20/7, not the average fee of the 7 successful calls alone. A discarded compaction candidate, a model request that completed after a cancellation and a tool retry can all still consume resources. The pinned asynchronous compaction path deals specifically with the wind-down and the usage, which shows that "the result was not used" is not "there was no cost".

Trace既要能串起来，也要避免泄密.en: A trace has to join things up and also avoid leaking secrets

相关ID连接用户任务、模型调用、工具调用和下游操作；版本字段连接规则、模型、工具.en: A correlation ID links the user task, the model call, the tool call and the downstream operation; version fields link the rules, the model, the tools, the evidence and the index. By default record only the necessary summary and hashes, redact sensitive content and set a retention policy. Full observability is not keeping prompts forever.

同时更新模型、Prompt、工具和索引，出问题很难归因。每个版本形成可回退配置；.en: Update the model, the prompt, the tools and the index at once and a problem is hard to attribute. Each version should form a configuration that can be rolled back; a rollback is not only replacing code — the memory, the checkpoints, the index format and the new state all have to be checked for compatibility. Data written by the new version need not be readable correctly by the old one.

会话窗口的大小与已经花掉的钱分开记.en: Record the size of the session window separately from the money already spent

固定实现对未完成响应报告的用量提供SpendingOnly路径；后台摘要即使未采.en: The pinned implementation provides a SpendingOnly path for usage reported on a response that did not complete; even when a background summary goes unused, the calls that did complete still have to be settled. "The current window got smaller" must not be written down as "the total spend went down too", and the length of a recoverable session log must not be taken directly as the model's current context length.

教学账本固定三次尝试成本2、3、5，其中只一项任务最终成功，则总花费是10，不是.en: A teaching ledger fixes the cost of three attempts at 2, 3 and 5, of which only one task finally succeeds, so the total spend is 10, not the 5 of the last attempt. Cost per success, queueing delay and the critical path each have their own denominator. Real billing also has to be worked out from the usage the service returns and the pricing version; this book gives no fixed commercial unit price.

Q066｜为什么“每Token便宜”不等于“完成工作便宜”？成本应怎样算？.en: Q066｜Why is "cheap per token" not the same as "cheap to get the work done"? How should cost be computed?

这题先认识什么</span>总成本包括失败、重试和工具，成功任务成本用总消耗除成.en: What to know first for this question The total cost includes failures, retries and tools, and the cost per successful task is the total consumption divided by the number of successes. Cheap tokens on one call do not make the whole thing cheap.

第62课 · 算得快与装得下</a><a class=\"pill\" href.en: Lesson 62 · Computing fast and fitting in memoryLesson 05 · The denominator of an evaluation metricLesson 33 · Reading a production run

成本单位应是满足质量要求的一次任务，而不是一次模型请求。总成本包含成功和失败尝试.en: The unit of cost should be one task that meets the quality requirement, not one model request. The total cost covers successful and failed attempts, retrieval, tools, verification, human rework and the resources to run it all; caching, model routing and parallelism only mean something when quality and total cost are compared together.

从单请求账单走到任务成本.en: From a single request's bill to the cost of a task

设第i次调用的未缓存输入、缓存输入、输出分别为.en: Let the uncached input, the cached input and the output of call i be

，则模型成本是各调用的.en: ; the model cost is then the sum over all calls of

之和。若产品另收缓存写入、工具或其他费用，需要按其口径加项，不能把未知费用默认为.en: . If the product charges separately for cache writes, tools or anything else, those items have to be added according to that product's own accounting basis; an unknown fee cannot be taken as zero by default.

两个教学方案：A每次尝试成本1单位，成功率0.8；B每次成本0.6，成功率0.4.en: Two teaching options: A costs 1 unit per attempt with a success rate of 0.8; B costs 0.6 per attempt with a success rate of 0.4. Assuming independent, identically distributed retries after a failure, no limit on retries and the same quality on success, the expected number of attempts before a success is

，所以成本分别1.25与1.5。B单次便宜，成功一次反而更贵。现实中独立假设常不.en: , so the costs are 1.25 and 1.5 respectively. B is cheaper per attempt and yet dearer per success. In reality the independence assumption often fails: repeated runs that lack the same evidence may go on failing, so this formula must not be used blindly to predict a production bill.

实践应在同一任务集比较：总花费、成功数、失败类型、总延迟分位数、人工介入量。还要.en: In practice, compare on the same task set: total spend, number of successes, failure types, the quantiles of total latency, and how much human intervention was needed. Look at simple and complex tasks in separate strata as well; an overall mean can hide a cheap model's clear degradation on one class of high-risk task.

成功任务成本的分子，必须包含失败和返工.en: The numerator of cost per successful task must include failures and rework

本例条件：</strong>独立100任务实验：方案A每次花1单位、成功80次；.en: Conditions for this example: an independent 100-task experiment: option A costs 1 unit per run and succeeds 80 times; option B costs 0.7 units per run and succeeds 50 times, with no retry after a failure. For now count only the call charges and ignore human cost.

所有尝试总费用除成功任务数。.en: The total cost of all attempts divided by the number of successful tasks.

还包括重试、工具和人工返工。.en: It also includes retries, tools and human rework.

放大图解：成功任务成本的分子，必须包含失败和返工.en: Enlarged figure: the numerator of the cost per successful task must include failures and rework

完成工作却更贵.en: Finishes the work, yet costs more

“便宜30%”只描述调用单价，不描述结果。失败也已经花钱，所以不能只把成功那50.en: "30% cheaper" describes the unit price of a call, not the result. Failures have cost money too, so the 35 units from the 50 successful runs cannot be the only numerator.

真实比较还要把重试、验证、工具费用和必要人工处理计入；同时报告延迟和不可接受错误.en: A real comparison must also count retries, verification, tool charges and the human handling required, and report latency and unacceptable errors alongside.

相同预算下多试几次可能提高成功率，但有副作用任务不能无条件反复执行。.en: Within the same budget, a few more attempts may raise the success rate, but a task with side effects cannot be repeated unconditionally.

不要混淆：</strong>只比较输入Token数会漏掉输出、内部推理、工具与失.en: Do not conflate: comparing input token counts alone misses the output, the internal reasoning, the tools and the cost of failures.

一个方案少花Token，却增加两次工具往返.en: One option spends fewer tokens but adds two tool round trips

输入与条件。</strong>方案A：模型输入费用4单位、输出2、工具等待1秒一.en: Input and conditions. Option A: model input costs 4 units, output 2, with one tool wait of 1 second; option B: input 2, output 2, but two more serial tool reads of 1 second each.

仅模型部分A6，B4.en: For the model part alone, A is 6 and B is 4

B多2秒串行等待.en: B has 2 more seconds of serial waiting

若模型本来只省0.2秒，总延迟仍增加1.8秒。.en: If the model only saved 0.2 seconds to begin with, the total latency still rises by 1.8 seconds.

B是否因分段读取漏了跨文件关系.en: Did B miss a cross-file relationship by reading in pieces

不能只看费用。.en: The fee cannot be the only thing looked at.

A稳定前缀可能可复用.en: A's stable prefix may be reusable

实际计费与逻辑输入量分开记录。.en: Record the actual billing separately from the logical input volume.

按场景延迟约束和成功率选方案.en: Choose the option by the latency constraint of the setting and by the success rate

不是任何“少Token”修改都值得上线。.en: Not every "fewer tokens" change is worth shipping.

把过程连起来。</strong>上下文、工具调用、缓存与返工共同决定成本，优化指.en: Join the steps up. Context, tool calls, caching and rework together determine the cost, and the metric being optimized has to correspond to the user's goal.

边界与反例。</strong>单位和等待时间均是教学假设，不是实时价格；没有给成.en: Limits and counterexamples. The units and the waiting times are teaching assumptions, not live prices; with no success rate given, neither option can be claimed to be better overall.

追问：缓存命中率越高越好吗？.en: Follow-up: is a higher cache hit rate always better?

不一定。不断携带大量无关历史可能提高缓存命中，但增加逻辑上下文、解码注意力读量或.en: Not necessarily. Carrying a large irrelevant history along can raise the cache hit rate, while adding logical context, attention reads during decoding, or distraction. A cache hit is an intermediate metric; in the end it is still quality, the bill and the elapsed time that count. Deleting a useless prefix may give up one hit and yet lower the long-run cost afterwards.

追问：什么时候选更强模型反而更省？.en: Follow-up: when does choosing a stronger model actually cost less?

当更强模型显著减少错误工具调用、无效搜索、返工或人工审查时。需要在控制任务和工具.en: When the stronger model markedly reduces wrong tool calls, useless searches, rework or human review. This has to be confirmed in a controlled experiment that holds the task and the tool conditions fixed. It cannot be settled from the model's name or from one impressive case; nor should a simple deterministic task default to the largest reasoning budget.

追问：预算耗尽时应该丢掉验证步骤吗？.en: Follow-up: when the budget runs out, should the verification step be dropped?

通常先缩小承诺或停止新增修改，而不是把未验证结果包装为完成。可预留验证与收尾预算.en: Usually you narrow what is promised, or stop making further changes, rather than dressing an unverified result up as finished. Budget for verification and winding down can be set aside; if it is already short, report what is done, what is unverified, the risks and where to resume from. An unverified result that "looks finished" may pass the cost on to whoever maintains it next.

工程深挖 · E49 · 接续Q098.en: Engineering deep dive · E49 · continues Q098

墙钟、Span总时长、p95、成功成本：指标名字相似，算错就会选错优化.en: Wall clock, total span duration, p95, cost per success: the metric names look alike, and computing the wrong one means choosing the wrong optimization

并行耗时不能简单相加.en: Parallel durations cannot simply be added up

两个检索分支同时开始，分别耗3秒和5秒，之后汇总2秒。端到端关键路径是.en: Two retrieval branches start at the same time and take 3 seconds and 5 seconds, after which the aggregation takes 2. The end-to-end critical path is

，所有子Span持续时间相加却是10秒。Trace中的父子与并行关系用于解释时间.en: , whereas adding up the durations of all the child spans gives 10 seconds. Parent-child and parallel relations in a trace are there to explain the time, not to have every segment added up indiscriminately.

把3秒分支缩短为1秒，端到端仍是7秒；若缩短5秒分支才可能改变关键路径。优化前要.en: Shortening the 3-second branch to 1 second still leaves the end-to-end time at 7 seconds; only shortening the 5-second branch can change the critical path. Draw the dependency graph before optimizing, or a great deal of work will go in while the user's wait stays the same.

p95的平均不是总体p95.en: The average of p95s is not the overall p95

本书定义nearest-rank分位数，避免不同插值口径混淆。100次快请求都耗.en: This book defines the quantile by nearest rank, to avoid confusion between different interpolation conventions. 100 fast requests each take 1 and 10 slow ones each take 100; the two groups' p95s are 1 and 100, averaging 50.5, but the p95 of all 110 together is 100. Averaging p95 straight across machines or tenants produces an overall experience that nobody had.

应汇总可合并的分布数据或直方图，并说明分桶与采样误差。不能仅凭每个实例的一个p9.en: Aggregate mergeable distribution data or histograms, and state the bucketing and the sampling error. A global quantile cannot be reconstructed from one p95 scalar per instance.

失败成本也要算进成功任务成本.en: The cost of failures also belongs in the cost per successful task

四次任务成本[1,1,5,5]，只有前两次成功。全体花费12、成功2次，成功任务.en: Four tasks cost [1,1,5,5] and only the first two succeed. The whole thing spends 12 for 2 successes, so the unit cost per successful task is 6; counting only the successful calls reports 1. The latter hides the waste of the failures and may reward an unreliable option that is cheap per attempt. An evaluation should include both the final outcome and the attempts actually made.

追问：更多日志是否就能定位一切？.en: Follow-up: does more logging locate everything?

不。缺少关联ID、版本、起止时间和错误分类的长日志反而难用。敏感Prompt与工.en: No. A long log without correlation IDs, versions, start and end times and an error classification is harder to use, not easier. Sensitive prompts and tool arguments also need redaction and access control. Logs, spans and metrics each have their use, and not every user ID can go into a high-cardinality monitoring label.

追问：队列时间要不要从模型延迟中扣掉？.en: Follow-up: should the queue time be subtracted from the model's latency?

可以为诊断分开，但面向用户的端到端延迟必须包含队列。否则系统在过载时“模型推理仍.en: They can be separated for diagnosis, but the user-facing end-to-end latency has to include the queue. Otherwise, under overload, "model inference is still fast" while the user keeps waiting. Designing for overload in SRE has to attend to queueing and deadlines, not only to how fast the device executes.

E49：怎样读这份结果，而不是只看“通过”.en: E49: how to read this result, rather than only looking at "pass"

同一个表里有成本与耗时，但它们的分母和合并规则不同。并行Span相加不是墙钟；p.en: Cost and elapsed time sit in the same table, but their denominators and their rules for combining differ. Adding up parallel spans is not the wall clock; p95s cannot simply be averaged; and the fees of failures cannot be dropped from the cost per successful task either.

自检：</strong>并行3秒、5秒后汇总2秒，为什么把3秒分支优化到1秒并不.en: Self-check: with 3 seconds and 5 seconds in parallel and then 2 seconds of aggregation, why does optimizing the 3-second branch to 1 second not reduce the user's wait?

关键路径仍是5秒分支+2秒汇总，共7秒。Span工作总量减少，但端到端由最长依赖.en: The critical path is still the 5-second branch plus the 2-second aggregation, 7 seconds in all. The total work in the spans goes down, but the end-to-end time is set by the longest dependency path.

Q067｜并发越大吞吐越高吗？怎样从排队理解Agent延迟？.en: Q067｜Does more concurrency always mean more throughput? How is agent latency understood through queueing?

这题先认识什么</span>队列承载等待任务，限流控制输入速率，背压防止过载继续.en: What to know first for this question A queue holds the waiting tasks, rate limiting controls the input rate, and backpressure keeps an overload from piling up further; retries amplify the request volume.

第62课 · 算得快与装得下</a><a class=\"pill\" href.en: Lesson 62 · Computing fast and fitting in memoryLesson 26 · Retries, idempotence and transactionsLesson 33 · Reading a production run

SLI、SLO与错误预算.en: SLI, SLO and the error budget

SLI是实际测量的服务水平指标；SLO是该指标的目标；错误预算是相应目标允许的失.en: An SLI is a service level indicator that is actually measured; an SLO is the target for that indicator; the error budget is the room for failure that target allows. They are objects of service operation, not model parameters.<span class="concept-micro">"The API returned 200" may not be success for the user; some businesses should define the indicator as the proportion of tasks completed correctly within a bounded time.

Little定律：L=λW的局部记号.en: Little's law: L=λW as local notation

队列记账中，L表示平均在系统中的任务数，λ是平均到达率，W是平均停留时间；在稳定.en: In queue accounting, L is the average number of tasks in the system, λ is the average arrival rate and W is the average time spent in it; under applicable conditions such as stability, L=λW. Here W is not a projection matrix, and L is not the number of model layers. <span class="concept-micro">Independent example: with 2 items arriving per second on average and an average stay of 3 seconds, about 6 items are in the system on average; an instantaneous spike cannot simply stand in for the long-run average.

并发只在资源尚有余量时帮助提高利用率；超过模型、工具、数据库或配额的容量，新增任.en: Concurrency helps raise utilization only while there is resource headroom; beyond the capacity of the model, the tools, the database or the quota, new tasks mostly go into the queue. In a stable system, Little's law

连接平均在途任务数、平均到达率和平均停留时间，但它不是无条件的容量规划保证。.en: ties together the average number of tasks in flight, the average arrival rate and the average time in the system, but it is not an unconditional guarantee for capacity planning.

从请求进入到离开.en: From a request's arrival to its departure

任务到达后先入队，等待可用执行槽；取得槽位后仍可能等待模型配额或外部工具。若一个.en: A task is queued when it arrives and waits for a free execution slot; once it has one, it may still wait for a model quota or an external tool. A task that holds an expensive worker process while waiting a long time on a remote network lowers resource utilization. Recoverable task state can be decoupled from short-lived execution resources, but that brings in persistence and scheduling complexity, and everything should not be split apart at the outset for the sake of a tidy architecture.

教学例：平均每秒进入2个任务，平均停留30秒，在稳定观测范围内平均在途约60个。.en: A teaching example: 2 tasks arrive per second on average and stay 30 seconds on average, so within a stable observation window about 60 are in flight. With only 20 synchronous worker slots, whether the system is stable depends on how long each task actually occupies a slot, and it cannot be worked out from the latency of the final answer alone. If each slot is fully occupied for 30 seconds, the theoretical ceiling on the service rate is about 20/30, below the arrival rate of 2, and the backlog will go on growing.

尾延迟来自长任务、服务时间方差、队头阻塞、重试风暴和资源争用。对交互式短任务和批.en: Tail latency comes from long tasks, variance in service time, head-of-line blocking, retry storms and resource contention. Separate queues or quotas for short interactive tasks and long batch tasks reduce the interference between them; but priority must not starve low-priority tasks indefinitely. There should be a maximum wait, propagation of cancellation, backpressure and an explicit refusal, rather than accepting work without limit.

平均处理能力够，不代表高峰请求不用排队.en: Enough average throughput does not mean peak requests avoid the queue

本例条件：</strong>独立简化单服务槽：每请求处理1秒，三条请求都在t=0.en: Conditions for this example: an independent, simplified single service slot: each request takes 1 s, all three requests arrive at t=0, and service is first-come, first-served; the network is not included.

实际占用执行资源的时间。.en: The time that actually occupies execution resources.

进入队列到开始执行之间。.en: Between entering the queue and starting to execute.

放大图解：平均处理能力够，不代表高峰请求不用排队.en: Enlarged figure: enough average capacity does not mean peak requests avoid the queue

每个请求内部都只算1秒，最后一位用户却等3秒。只看模型耗时会漏掉排队体验。.en: Each request takes only 1 s of computation, yet the last user waits 3 s. Looking only at model time misses the queueing experience.

增加并发可以减少等待，但若每个请求因争用显存、带宽而变慢，吞吐未必继续线性增长。.en: Raising concurrency can reduce waiting, but if every request slows down through contention for VRAM and bandwidth, throughput need not keep growing linearly.

Little定律在稳定系统下联系平均在途数、到达率和平均时间；不应拿失稳队列或短.en: Little's law ties the average number in flight, the arrival rate and the average time together in a stable system; it should not be applied mechanically to a queue that has lost stability or to a brief peak.

不要混淆：</strong>无限放大并发不是限流替代，过载时拒绝、排队与降级的语.en: Do not conflate: turning concurrency up without limit is no substitute for rate limiting; the semantics of rejecting, queueing and degrading under overload should be stated.

并发10个请求，队列为什么仍不断增长.en: Ten requests run concurrently — why does the queue still keep growing

输入与条件。</strong>稳定处理一项平均需要2秒，10个并发槽位，粗略最大.en: Input and conditions. Steady processing of one item takes 2 seconds on average, there are 10 concurrent slots, so the rough maximum completion rate is 5 items/s; the arrival rate is 6 items/s.

超过容量，平均每秒积压约1项。.en: That exceeds capacity, and about 1 item per second builds up on average.

新增积压约100项，等待不断变长。.en: The backlog grows by about 100 items, and the wait keeps getting longer.

稳态条件.en: The condition for a steady state

先使有效到达率小于可服务能力.en: First bring the effective arrival rate below the serving capacity

限流、扩容或减少服务时长。.en: Rate limiting, more capacity, or a shorter service time.

例如λ=4、平均在系统停留W=3秒，平均系统内12项，包括等待与服务。.en: For example, with λ=4 and an average time in the system of W=3 seconds, there are 12 items in the system on average, waiting and service together.

把过程连起来。</strong>增加并发只有在资源还能支持时才可能增加吞吐；超载.en: Join the steps up. Raising concurrency can only raise throughput while the resources can still support it; in an overloaded system a steady-state formula must not be used blindly to predict a fixed wait.

边界与反例。</strong>10/2是粗略均值容量示例，不考虑长尾、共享瓶颈、.en: Limits and counterexamples. 10/2 is a rough average-capacity example; it does not account for the long tail, a shared bottleneck, retry storms or requests of different sizes.

追问：为什么增加超时可能让故障更严重？.en: Follow-up: why can a longer timeout make a failure worse?

它延长了资源占用与在途请求寿命。下游变慢时，上游继续接收并延长超时，内存、连接和.en: It lengthens how long resources are held and how long an in-flight request lives. When something downstream slows down, the upstream goes on accepting work and waiting longer, until memory, connections and worker slots are all full. A timeout should match the semantics of the task and the end-to-end deadline, retries should have an overall budget, and each layer must not multiply the retry count independently.

追问：CPU利用率不高，为什么仍然排队？.en: Follow-up: CPU utilization is low, so why is there still a queue?

显存、KV容量、每分钟Token配额、外部API并发、数据库锁或人工批准。监控应.en: VRAM, KV capacity, the per-minute token quota, concurrency on an external API, a database lock or a human approval. Monitoring should cover the queues and the scarce resources, not just the

。大量等待型任务甚至会出现CPU很低、用户体验很差的组合。.en: . With a lot of waiting-type tasks you can even get the combination of very low CPU and a very poor user experience.

追问：SLO应该只规定P95响应时间吗？.en: Follow-up: should an SLO specify only the P95 response time?

还应包含任务正确性、可用性或人工介入等目标，并定义哪些任务纳入分母。否则系统可以.en: It should also include goals for task correctness, availability or human intervention, and define which tasks go into the denominator. Otherwise a system can "optimize latency" by refusing quickly or returning an empty answer. For a long asynchronous task, the acceptance latency, the real progress and the final completion can be kept apart; an ordinary web-response metric does not fit it.

Q068｜Agent系统上线时究竟要版本化什么？回滚为什么不只是换回模型？.en: Q068｜What exactly has to be versioned when an agent system goes live? Why is a rollback not just switching the model back?

这题先认识什么</span>上线应绑定模型、提示、工具和索引等版本，灰度比较后可.en: What to know first for this question A release should bind the versions of the model, the prompt, the tools, the index and so on; after a canary comparison the whole combination can be rolled back, rather than one line of prompt undone.

第18课 · 代码不是普通文档</a><a class=\"pill\" hre.en: Lesson 18 · Code is not an ordinary documentLesson 05 · The denominator of an evaluation metricLesson 31 · Do not be fooled by a few percentLesson 33 · Reading a production run

最终行为由模型、提示、工具.en: The final behavior is determined by the model, the prompt, the tool

、技能、检索索引、记忆策略、权限、运行器和评测规则共同决定。上线要保存可追溯组合.en: , the skills, the retrieval index, the memory policy, the permissions, the runner and the evaluation rules, all together. A release has to save a traceable combination and watch the results in a canary; a rollback must deal with the state already written and with external side effects, not merely switch the model name.

一个能解释回归的版本清单.en: A version list that can explain a regression

假设同一天更换模型、压缩摘要格式和代码索引，成功率下降。没有版本清单就很难区分原.en: Suppose the model, the compaction summary format and the code index are all replaced on the same day and the success rate drops. Without a version list the causes are hard to tell apart; changing only a few attributable variables at a time, running the offline regression first and then watching a small amount of real traffic, makes the judgment easier. A canary is not handing a dangerous operation out to a few users at random; a high-risk capability still needs permissions and acceptance in place first.

回滚前检查新版本写入的记忆和checkpoint是否能被旧版读取。若摘要sche.en: Before rolling back, check whether the memory and the checkpoints written by the new version can be read by the old one. If the summary schema changed, the old runner misreading "

”为“failed”可能重复写入。外部订单、邮件、部署不会因程序回滚自动撤销；需.en: " as "failed" may lead to a duplicate write. An external order, an email or a deployment is not undone just because the program was rolled back; they have to be checked and compensated according to the business semantics. A safer rollback may be to stop new write operations and keep read-only checking with a person taking over, rather than going on running incompatible old code.

回滚要成组恢复兼容对象，不只换回模型名.en: A rollback has to restore a compatible group of objects, not just put the model name back

本例条件：</strong>独立上线包v2包含Prompt p2、工具schem.en: Conditions for this example: an independent release package v2 contains prompt p2, tool schema t2, index embedding e2 and memory format m2. The model goes back to v1, but the other components stay at v2.

共同定义一次运行语义的配置集合。.en: The set of configuration that together defines the semantics of one run.

旧组件是否能读取新数据和协议。.en: Whether an old component can read the new data and protocol.

如何恢复旧组合或迁移已有状态。.en: How to restore the old combination, or migrate the state that exists.

只回模型后的风险.en: The risk of rolling back the model only

依赖新模型或新字段.en: Depends on the new model or on new fields

模板与行为回归.en: The template, and a behavior regression

旧适配器不识别字段.en: The old adapter does not recognize the fields

参数与返回兼容.en: Compatibility of arguments and return values

旧查询编码器空间不一致.en: The old query encoder's space does not match

编码器与索引成对切换.en: Switch the encoder and the index as a pair

旧读取器误解释状态.en: The old reader misinterprets the state

迁移/双读/降级设计.en: A migration, dual-read or degradation design

前后配置混用.en: The old and new configuration get mixed

固定到任务版本或显式迁移.en: Pin to the task's version, or migrate explicitly

回滚不是时间倒流，v2运行产生的外部副作用和新状态仍可能存在。.en: A rollback is not time running backwards: the external side effects and the new state produced by the v2 run may still be there.

发布清单应覆盖模型、Prompt、工具、索引、权限、评测和依赖版本；哪些必须成组.en: A release list should cover the model, the prompt, the tools, the index, the permissions, the evaluation and the dependency versions; which of them must be switched as a group follows from the actual compatibility relations.

可先灰度小部分流量观察再扩大，保留可执行回退路径而不是仅有一份文档承诺。.en: A small amount of traffic can be watched in a canary before widening it, keeping a fallback path that can actually be run rather than only a promise in a document.

不要混淆：</strong>回滚模型后未失效化错误答案缓存，会让用户继续得到新版.en: Do not conflate: rolling the model back without invalidating the cache of wrong answers leaves users getting the old results from the new version's period.

只回滚Prompt，为什么故障还在.en: Only the prompt was rolled back — why is the failure still there

输入与条件。</strong>版本包V1={贯通模型1,提示P1,工具T1,索引.en: Input and conditions. Version package V1={worked model 1, prompt P1, tool T1, index I1}; V2 upgrades all of them to M2/P2/T2/I2, and a failure appears.

不能立即认定只是Prompt问题。.en: It cannot immediately be put down to the prompt alone.

这既不是V1也不是原V2，兼容性未知。.en: This is neither V1 nor the original V2, and its compatibility is unknown.

恢复已验证的兼容版本包.en: Restore a verified, compatible version package

确认环境和索引能共同工作。.en: Confirm that the environment and the index work together.

在受控任务中逐项或成组改变必要组件.en: Change the necessary components one at a time or in groups, on a controlled task

避免同时引入新变量。.en: This avoids introducing new variables at the same time.

保存输入、版本、评测和回滚条件.en: Save the inputs, the versions, the evaluation and the rollback conditions

让下一次对比可复现。.en: It makes the next comparison reproducible.

把过程连起来。</strong>Agent行为由模型、上下文、工具、数据和执行环.en: Join the steps up. An agent's behavior is determined by the model, the context, the tools, the data and the execution environment together, so version governance should cover the combination too.

边界与反例。</strong>并非每次修改都必须冻结全部数据；动态数据需要明确版.en: Limits and counterexamples. Not every change has to freeze all the data; dynamic data needs an explicit version or time range so that differences can be explained.

追问：为什么不能只用最新Benchmark分数选模型上线？.en: Follow-up: why can the latest benchmark score not be the only basis for putting a model live?

Benchmark任务、工具、资源和成功标准未必与你一致。应把候选模型放进自己的.en: A benchmark's tasks, tools, resources and success criteria need not match yours. Put the candidate model into your own

和历史失败集测试，尤其检查结构化输出、工具遵循、长上下文和成本。公开成绩提供候选.en: and your own historical failure set and test it there, checking structured output, tool compliance, long context and cost in particular. A public score offers a signal for shortlisting; it does not replace local acceptance.

追问：提示只改了一个词，需要版本吗？.en: Follow-up: one word changed in a prompt — does that need a version?

若该提示影响生产行为，就应能追溯具体内容；但不需要为每个文字变化建立复杂审批层。.en: If that prompt affects production behavior, the exact content should be traceable; but there is no need for a complex approval layer around every wording change. Versioning is for attribution and rollback, and how deep the approval goes depends on the risk. Do not read "traceable" as "a multi-level review every time".

追问：如何知道优化已经可以停止？.en: Follow-up: how do you know the optimization can stop?

当主要失败模式已被解决，新增机制在代表性任务上没有可辨认收益，或收益小于成本与维.en: Once the main failure modes have been dealt with, and a further mechanism brings no discernible gain on representative tasks, or a gain smaller than its cost and maintenance risk, piling on more rules should stop. Keep the monitoring and the flow of real failures coming back, and wait for new evidence to trigger a change. That fits the engineering goal better than chasing a perfect process forever.

工程深挖 · E50 · 接续Q100.en: Engineering deep dive · E50 · continues Q100

只回滚模型名为什么可能越滚越乱？系统版本是一组向量.en: Why can rolling back the model name alone leave things in a worse tangle? A system version is a set of vectors

同一个模型名，不代表同一个系统.en: The same model name does not mean the same system

行为由模型权重/服务版本、tokenizer、消息模板、工具Schema、Ski.en: Behavior is determined together by the model weights or service version, the tokenizer, the message template, the tool schema, the skill, the index generation, the memory rules, the application code and the grader. Recording only model=m1 cannot explain a regression brought by the template going t1→t2 or the index going i1→i2. The model interface, cache identity and work-tree evidence all show this dependence on many components.

本书用版本向量.en: This book uses the version vector

与只改index的i2比较，模型名相同但联合指纹不同。这个指纹不是质量证明，却是.en: to compare against an i2 in which only the index changed: the model name is the same but the joint fingerprint differs. The fingerprint is no proof of quality, but it is the least identification needed for replay and attribution.

回滚要考虑在途任务.en: A rollback has to account for tasks in flight

新版本已发出工具调用、写入新格式记忆或生成新Schema状态，旧代码可能读不懂。.en: The new version has already issued tool calls, written memory in the new format or produced state in the new schema, and the old code may not be able to read it. Switching straight back to the old model does not undo those actions. Keep apart the rollback of routing for new tasks, the policy for continuing or canceling tasks in flight, data format compatibility, and the reconciliation of side effects. Where necessary, use forward-compatible reading or pause the writes, rather than forcing the old logic to take everything over.

灰度的分组要能解释.en: The grouping in a canary has to be explainable

按用户、任务类型或稳定哈希分流，避免同一长任务中途在不同Prompt/工具版本间.en: Split traffic by user, task type or a stable hash, so that one long task does not switch between prompt or tool versions unplanned partway through. Record which samples belong to which version combination, and compare the success rate, the tail latency and the risk events under the same task distribution. If the index or the cache is shared, say whether that can contaminate the two arms of the comparison.

追问：为什么同一Prompt重放仍不能保证完全复现？.en: Follow-up: why does replaying the same prompt still not guarantee an exact reproduction?

服务端模型、随机状态、工具外部数据和基础设施可能变化；部分状态不可见。应区分可重.en: The server-side model, the random state, the external data behind the tools and the infrastructure can all change, and some state is invisible. Keep apart a replayable request, a replayable environment and bit-for-bit reproduction. Keeping enough evidence improves the ability to troubleshoot, but it must not be claimed that hidden internal state has been saved in full.

追问：哪些版本信息不该放进指标标签？.en: Follow-up: which version information should not go into metric labels?

细粒度请求ID、长哈希、任意文件路径可能导致高基数。指标保留有限版本发布号与分类.en: Fine-grained request IDs, long hashes and arbitrary file paths can lead to high cardinality. Metrics should keep a limited set of release numbers and categories, while the detailed joint fingerprint goes into a trace or a controlled log. Observability design has to balance cost, privacy and searchability, rather than printing without limit.

在发布前用旧/新两版各读取一份对方生成的状态fixture；模拟新版本动作在回滚.en: Before the release, have the old and the new version each read a state fixture produced by the other; simulate an action of the new version that completes only after the rollback; and check whether the idempotency key, the target version and the approval still match. Testing that the home page opens is not enough to show that an agent task recovers safely.

E50：怎样读这份结果，而不是只看“通过”.en: E50: how to read this result, rather than only looking at "pass"

版本是一组模型、Prompt、工具、索引、记忆Schema与代码的组合。只替换模.en: A version is a combination of a model, a prompt, tools, an index, a memory schema and code. Replacing only the model name while still reading state in the new schema can make the rollback produce fresh compatibility errors.

自检：</strong>模型从m2回滚到m1后，索引和工具Schema仍是新版，.en: Self-check: after the model is rolled back from m2 to m1 while the index and the tool schema stay at the new version, has the old system been restored?

没有。回滚对象是版本组合和在途状态，不只是模型名。需核对模板、工具、索引、代码与.en: No. What is rolled back is the version combination and the state in flight, not just the model name. Check the template, the tools, the index, the code and the data format for compatibility, and deal with the side effects already issued.

How should cost be computed?Q067｜Does more concurrency always mean more throughput? 第67课｜深度应用：把组件组合成能解释的工作系统 — AI系统工程.en: Lesson 67｜Deep applications: composing components into a working system you can explain — AI Systems Engineering

应用蓝图不是技术名词拼盘，而是“允许哪些输入、寻找什么证据、做哪些动作、怎样证明.en: An application blueprint is not a platter of technical terms but "which input is allowed, what evidence to look for, which actions to take, and how the result is proved". The same basic framework carries different risks in Q&A, in coding and in a GUI.

进入深读前的小检查：</strong>给企业问答与自动修改生产数据分别列出最小验.en: A quick check before the deep reading: list the minimum verification for enterprise Q&A and for automatically changing production data separately, and explain why the citation check of the first cannot replace the permission and execution confirmation of the second.

这里不是列举“企业知识库、研发.en: This is not a list of the three nouns "enterprise knowledge base, development

、研究助手”三个名词，而是解释请求在这些应用内部怎样逐步变换。蓝图是本书提出的工.en: , research assistant". It explains instead how a request is transformed step by step inside these applications. The blueprint is an engineering design put forward by this book; it does not claim that any commercial product implements it in full.

从失败发生的位置选择组件：信息没取到先改检索，已有证据却读错再看上下文与模型，执.en: Choose the component by where the failure happens: if the information was never retrieved, change retrieval first; if the evidence was there but read wrongly, look at the context and the model; if the outcome of an execution is unknown, check the state first. Do not add Memory, multi-agent and Review all at once and then guess which one helped.

Q105｜企业知识问答怎样做到不仅能回答，还能证明回答适用且不过期？.en: Q105｜How can enterprise knowledge Q&A not only answer, but also prove that the answer applies and is not out of date?

这题先认识什么</span>企业问答先确认身份与证据，再回答并引用；知识过期和无.en: What to know first for this questionEnterprise Q&A confirms identity and evidence first, then answers with citations; expired knowledge and insufficient evidence each need a defined behavior rather than forced generation.

第22课 · 压缩不是魔法</a><a class=\"pill\" href=.en: Lesson 22 · Compaction is not magicLesson 17 · From search results to a trustworthy answerLesson 23 · Foundations of long-term memoryLesson 05 · The denominator of an evaluation metricLesson 29 · Security basics

把问答拆为身份与时间范围确定、证据检索、适用性检查、主张生成、引用验证和答复。检.en: Break the Q&A into settling the identity and time range, retrieving evidence, checking applicability, generating claims, verifying citations, and replying. Retrieval similarity is only responsible for finding candidates; the version, the permissions and the conditions decide whether a candidate can serve as grounds. Where necessary, admit that the evidence is not enough rather than inventing a policy.

一次“我能否报销这笔费用”的运行过程.en: One run of "can I claim this expense?"

接收问题时先确定用户所属组织与费用日期，避免拿当前政策回答历史报销。检索入口用身.en: When the question arrives, settle the user's organization and the date of the expense first, so that a historical claim is not answered with the current policy. The retrieval entry point filters the readable documents by identity, then narrows or widens the candidates by the date the policy took effect. Parsing should keep the main clause, the exceptions, the amount thresholds and the relationship to attachments; it must not return only the sentence "claimable".

假设候选包含普通差旅政策、海外差旅例外和一个过期版本。系统应把它们表示成带来源和.en: Suppose the candidates include the ordinary travel policy, the exception for overseas travel, and one expired version. The system should represent them as evidence carrying a source and a validity interval, rather than stitching them into unordered paragraphs. Before generating, list the claims that have to be answered: whether the expense type is covered, the amount limit, and whether approval is needed. Every claim must have applicable evidence; if the region of the expense is missing, say that this condition is not yet settled rather than assuming the ordinary rule applies.

最后检查引用真的指向支持该主张的文本。引用存在不等于支持：一条关于交通费的段落不.en: Finally, check that the citation really points at text that supports the claim. A citation existing is not the same as support: a paragraph about transport costs cannot prove a lodging cap. In the reply, keep "the explicit wording of the policy", "what follows from the conditions given" and "material still to be confirmed" apart. Where a real reimbursement decision is involved, the organization's authorization still has to be followed; an answering tool should not acquire financial approval authority on its own.

企业问答的正确答案，要同时过范围、时间和证据三关.en: A correct answer in enterprise Q&A has to pass three gates at once: scope, time and evidence

本例条件：</strong>独立员工问答：问“我今年能报销多少”。公司有地区、岗.en: Conditions for this example: an independent employee question: "how much can I claim this year". The company has different rules by region, role and year; the current user is in region A, role P, year 2026.

哪些资料可访问、哪些规则适用。.en: Which material may be accessed, and which rules apply.

规则对何时生效。.en: Which times the rule is in effect for.

引用中有足够条件与数值。.en: The citation contains enough of the conditions and the numbers.

地区岗位对，年度旧.en: Region and role match, year is old

仅供历史，不直接作答.en: For the history only; not used to answer directly

继续核对例外与审批限制.en: Go on to check the exceptions and the approval limits

在对应条件下上限150.en: The limit is 150 under the matching conditions

附具体来源与适用范围.en: With the specific source and scope of use attached

这个系统不是“文档越多越会答”。没有身份和适用范围，最相关的数字也可能对当前用户.en: This system is not a case of "the more documents, the better the answer". Without an identity and a scope of use, even the most relevant number can be wrong for the current user.

允许访问某规则不等于该规则一定适用当前人；授权过滤与业务范围判断是两道检查。.en: Being allowed to read a rule does not mean the rule applies to the person at hand; authorization filtering and judging the business scope are two separate checks.

不能验证必要条件时应说明缺口或询问，而不是拼接多份候选中的数值。.en: When a necessary condition cannot be verified, state the gap or ask, instead of stitching numbers together out of several candidates.

不要混淆：</strong>图中额度纯属教学数字；事实、政策和权限都必须来自真实.en: Do not conflate: the amounts in the figure are purely teaching numbers; facts, policy and permissions must all come from the real system rather than being filled in by the model.

企业问答怎样把答案每个分句接回证据.en: How enterprise Q&A connects every clause of the answer back to evidence

输入与条件。</strong>问题：“试用用户周六申请第6天的退款，可以吗？”虚.en: Input and conditions. The question: "a trial user applies on a Saturday for a refund on day 6 — is that allowed?" The fictional policy says "within 7 days and accepted on working days only".

确定要匹配的条件。.en: The conditions to be matched are settled.

取得当前试用政策完整条款.en: obtain the full clauses of the current trial policy

6≤7满足期限；周六不满足工作日.en: 6≤7 meets the time limit; Saturday does not meet "working day"

两个条件是且，不是或。.en: The two conditions are an and, not an or.

“期限内，但周六不满足受理日条件”.en: "within the time limit, but Saturday does not meet the acceptance-day condition"

分别关联同一条款中的不同条件。.en: Each is tied to a different condition of the same clause.

政策未说顺延到周一是否仍可.en: the policy does not say whether deferring to Monday is still allowed

不自动补一个顺延承诺。.en: No promise of a deferral is added on its own.

把过程连起来。</strong>可信问答需要条件组合和证据边界，不只是相关文档加.en: Join the steps up. A trustworthy answer needs a combination of conditions and a boundary on the evidence, not just a relevant document plus a fluent retelling.

边界与反例。</strong>政策完全虚构，用于说明逻辑，不对应真实退款或法律权.en: Limits and counterexamples. The policy is entirely fictional, used to explain the logic; it corresponds to no real refund or legal right.

追问：为什么不把整本制度放进大上下文？.en: Follow-up: why not put the whole set of rules into a large context?

小型单一制度可以直接完整读取，未必需要.en: A small, single set of rules can simply be read in full, and does not necessarily need

。但文档多、权限不同、频繁更新时，全量上下文增加成本与冲突处理负担。选择应基于规.en: . But when the documents are many, the permissions differ and updates are frequent, putting everything in the context adds cost and the burden of resolving conflicts. The choice should rest on the scale, the update rate and task performance, not on a default vector store or a default very long context.

追问：用户要求“给一个确定答案”怎么办？.en: Follow-up: what if the user demands "just give me a definite answer"?

确定性来自条件和证据，不来自强硬语气。可明确回答在已知条件下能确认什么，并指出哪.en: Certainty comes from conditions and evidence, not from a firm tone. You can state plainly what can be confirmed under the known conditions, and point out which missing condition would change the conclusion. A user's preference for definite phrasing is no reason to ignore a contradiction in the evidence or to fill an unknown field with a favorable value.

追问：问答缓存的键为什么不能只有问题文本？.en: Follow-up: why can the key of a Q&A cache not be the question text alone?

同一句问题可能来自不同权限用户、不同组织和不同日期；知识版本也会变化。缓存必须绑.en: The same question may come from users with different permissions, from different organizations and on different dates; the knowledge version changes too. The cache has to be bound to the identity scope, the evidence version and the applicable conditions it needs, or else use a safe shared scope. Otherwise the cache bypasses the permission control in the retrieval stage.

工程深挖 · E51 · 接续Q101.en: Engineering deep dive · E51 · continues Q101

“根据材料可退款”与“现在可以执行退款”中间还缺什么？.en: What is still missing between "the material says a refund is possible" and "the refund can be carried out now"?

建议层与动作层必须有不同证据要求.en: The advisory layer and the action layer must have different evidence requirements

知识库问答可以根据一份已注明版本的政策解释条件；执行写操作还要核对当前用户、当前.en: Knowledge-base Q&A can explain the conditions from one policy whose version is recorded; performing a write also has to check the current user, the current order, the current policy, the remaining allowance and whether it is a duplicate. This section uses refunds as the teaching business; it connects to no real payment system and provides no actual financial operation.

MCP安全设计要求资源与权限匹配，幂等API实践要求重复调用意图明确，Agent.en: MCP security design requires resources and permissions to match, idempotent API practice requires the intent of a repeated call to be explicit, and agent evaluation requires looking at the result in a real environment rather than a statement in text.

把三者合起来的工程推论是：检索结论不能直接越过业务事务边界。.en: The engineering inference from putting the three together is: a retrieval conclusion cannot cross a business transaction boundary directly.

计划时正确，执行时可能已失效.en: Right at planning time, possibly already void at execution time

教学场景：规划时政策版本7允许操作，执行前政策变8且该订单不再满足条件。若直接用.en: A teaching scenario: at planning time policy version 7 allows the operation; before execution the policy becomes 8 and that order no longer meets the conditions. Using the "allowed" the model remembered produces a stale write. The local test rejects the submission on the version mismatch. The point of the rejection is not that the model answered wrongly, but that the premise of the action has changed.

动作工具可以接受结构化业务意图，由服务端重新查当前状态并条件提交；不要让模型提供.en: An action tool can accept a structured business intent, with the server re-reading the current state and submitting conditionally; do not let a "conditions met = true" supplied by the model stand in for the check. If the executor finds the state has changed, it should return an explainable conflict so the agent verifies again, rather than quietly altering the arguments to get around it.

审计链要把解释和操作连起来.en: The audit chain has to connect the explanation to the operation

记录用户请求、采用的政策证据、执行时实际版本、审批对象、操作意图键、下游结果和最.en: Record the user's request, the policy evidence used, the actual version at execution time, the object that was approved, the intent key of the operation, the downstream result and the final reconciliation. Keep stored sensitive fields to a minimum. The success message the user sees must come from the real submission result, not from the earlier eligibility analysis text.

追问：每次操作都重新查资料是否浪费？.en: Follow-up: is re-reading the material before every operation wasteful?

可复用静态说明与已验证的缓存，但动态资格、授权和目标版本必须有有效性保证。用版本.en: Static descriptions and a verified cache can be reused, but dynamic eligibility, authorization and the target version must come with a guarantee of validity. Cutting down repeated queries with a version condition, a TTL or a server-side transaction is an optimization; leaving out the verification changes the security semantics. The two are not the same.

追问：业务工具返回失败，Agent能否尝试别的工具完成相同动作？.en: Follow-up: when a business tool returns a failure, may the agent try another tool to carry out the same action?

先判断失败类型。权限/政策拒绝不应被视为“换条路试试”的技术错误；网络未知应走核.en: Judge the kind of failure first. A permission or policy refusal should not be treated as a technical error inviting "try another route"; an unknown network outcome should go down the verify-or-idempotent path; insufficient input can be supplemented with more material. Tool orchestration has to respect the boundary of the business intent; the number of actions completed is not the goal.

E51：怎样读这份结果，而不是只看“通过”.en: E51: how to read this result, rather than only looking at "pass"

计划版本7与执行时版本8不同，意味着计划依据可能过期。重新读取状态并检验额度/权.en: The planned version 7 differs from version 8 at execution time, which means the grounds for the plan may be out of date. Re-reading the state and checking the allowance and permissions matters more than simply executing the old plan.

自检：</strong>规划时政策版本7允许，提交时版本8不允许，模型原判断是否.en: Self-check: policy version 7 allows it at planning time and version 8 forbids it at submission time — is the model's original judgment enough to authorize execution?

不够。建议依据与执行时资格不同。执行器应核对当前政策、资源状态、权限和版本，冲突.en: No, it is not. The grounds for the advice and the eligibility at execution time are different things. The executor should check the current policy, the state of the resource, the permissions and the version, and on a conflict either refuse or verify again.

Q106｜一个仓库修复Agent从接单到交付，最少需要哪些内部对象？.en: Q106｜What is the minimum set of internal objects a repository repair agent needs, from taking the ticket to delivery?

这题先认识什么</span>编码Agent需要当前工作区、可靠定位、受限修改和真.en: What to know first for this questionA coding agent needs the current workspace, reliable location of the fault, bounded changes and real tests; retelling the repository's documentation is not the same as finishing the development.

第18课 · 代码不是普通文档</a><a class=\"pill\" hre.en: Lesson 18 · Code is not an ordinary documentLesson 26 · Retries, idempotence and transactionsLesson 04 · Foundations of engineering qualityLesson 05 · The denominator of an evaluation metric

至少要能表达任务目标与约束、当前代码快照、候选解释与证据、修改集、执行结果和验收.en: At a minimum it has to be able to express the task's goal and constraints, a snapshot of the current code, the candidate explanations and their evidence, the change set, the execution results and the acceptance status. Files plus a few structured records are enough to start with; no complex platform has to be built right away. What matters is that these objects are clearly related to one another, instead of all being mixed into the chat history.

以exclude路径错误为例.en: Take the exclude path bug as the example

接单时记录“项目根目录相对路径匹配；不改变现有包含规则；修复后保留未排除文件”。.en: When the ticket is taken, record "match on paths relative to the project root; do not change the existing include rules; keep unexcluded files after the fix". Once repository version r42 has been fetched, run the smallest failing test first and save the command, the environment, the return code and the failing assertion. Then follow the call chain to check whether the path is already normalized before it enters the matching function from the caller.

找到候选根因后，Agent应该能回答“哪条证据排除了其他解释”。例如匹配库本身在.en: Once a candidate root cause is found, the agent should be able to answer "which piece of evidence ruled out the other explanations". For instance, only the fact that the matching library itself works correctly on relative paths while the caller passes an absolute path supports fixing the normalization at the entry point. The change becomes a standalone

把图片分片或用视觉编码器转为数值表示的过程。 例：224×224、16×16切片.en: The process of cutting an image into patches, or using a vision encoder, to turn it into a numeric representation. Example: a 224×224 image in 16×16 patches gives 196 patches, but that is no guarantee of exactly 196 tokens in the end.

，应用时核对旧内容或版本；若用户同时修改了文件，重新读取并协调，不能覆盖。.en: , and when it is applied the old content or version is checked; if the user has changed the file in the meantime, read it again and reconcile rather than overwrite.

验证先运行根因相关测试，再根据影响面增加回归。最终交付绑定当前工作区版本：修改了.en: Verification runs the tests tied to the root cause first, then adds regression tests according to the blast radius. The final delivery is bound to the current workspace version: what was changed, why it is right, what the tests actually ran, and what was left unverified. The model may explain this evidence, but an explanation cannot stand in for a run result. Whether to commit, push or deploy is decided by the scope of authorization, not widened automatically by the words "task complete".

最小仓库修复器，也应留下能复核的四份对象.en: Even the smallest repository fixer should leave behind four objects that can be re-checked

本例条件：</strong>独立exclude修复任务，工作树从r7变到r8。只.en: Conditions for this example: an independent exclude repair task, with the working tree going from r7 to r8. Only the necessary objects are tracked; no fixed multi-agent approval chain is introduced.

实际源码与失败记录。.en: The actual source and the failure record.

还需应用与验证的修改。.en: A change that still has to be applied and verified.

最终版本和对应测试结果。.en: The final version and the matching test results.

下一对象怎样依赖它.en: How the next object depends on it

r7实现 + 最小失败例.en: the r7 implementation + the smallest failing example

r8上的正例、反例、回归.en: the positive, negative and regression cases on r8

改动范围+命令+结果+限制.en: Scope of change + command + result + limits

读者可复核，不只一句成功.en: The reader can re-check it, not just read a one-line success

如果把中间分析文件删掉，至少还应保留能重建关键判断的证据引用和最终diff。.en: If the intermediate analysis files are deleted, what must at least remain is the evidence references and the final diff needed to rebuild the key judgments.

小任务可以单Agent直接做，但“少流程”不等于省略当前版本验证。.en: A small task can be done directly by a single agent, but "less process" does not mean skipping verification against the current version.

长任务增加检查点时，保存的是这四份对象的状态与位置，不是无限延长聊天历史。.en: When a long task adds checkpoints, what is saved is the state and position of these four objects, not an endlessly lengthening chat history.

不要混淆：</strong>报告写得很细但缺最终文件版本，仍无法证明测试结果属于.en: Do not conflate: a very detailed report that lacks the final file version still cannot show that the test result belongs to what was actually delivered.

从Bug描述到补丁交付，哪些对象必须一致.en: From the bug description to the delivered patch, which objects must agree

输入与条件。</strong>任务B17要求保留ab目录；补丁P应用于基线v7，.en: Input and conditions. Task B17 requires the ab directory to be kept; patch P applies to baseline v7 and yields v8; test R runs against v8.

B17包含a、a/x、ab/y的预期.en: B17 holds the expectations for a, a/x and ab/y

后续验收有稳定目标。.en: Later acceptance has a stable target.

源码定位到v7的startswith.en: the source is located at v7's startswith

根因依据可核对。.en: The grounds for the root cause can be checked.

P声明基线v7与改动范围.en: P declares baseline v7 and the scope of the change

应用失败时不把部分结果当完整补丁。.en: When applying fails, a partial result is not taken for a complete patch.

R记录v8、命令、退出码与边界断言.en: R records v8, the command, the exit code and the boundary assertions

与交付版本一致。.en: It agrees with the delivered version.

不能改出v9后仍沿用v8的测试记录。.en: After changing on to v9, the v8 test record must not still be used.

把过程连起来。</strong>任务、证据、补丁、版本与验证之间的关联，是工程A.en: Join the steps up. The relationships between task, evidence, patch, version and verification are the skeleton of what an engineering agent can deliver.

边界与反例。</strong>可用简单文件和现有Git实现，不要求额外建设复杂合.en: Limits and counterexamples. Plain files and the Git already in place are enough to implement this; no extra complex contract, signature or database platform is required.

追问：AGENTS.md是否越完整越好？.en: Follow-up: is a more complete AGENTS.md always better?

更适合作为稳定、短小的导航和约束入口，把可按需读取的专业内容放到对应位置。把全部.en: It works better as a stable, short entry point for navigation and constraints, with specialist content that can be read on demand kept where it belongs. Loading the whole architecture, history, test rules and long case studies permanently raises the fixed cost of every task. The layering of the content should be adjusted from real omissions and real wrong loading.

追问：Agent需要完整理解整个仓库才能修Bug吗？.en: Follow-up: does an agent have to understand the whole repository before it can fix a bug?

不需要。它需要对修改涉及的不变量、调用方与验证范围形成充分理解。局部错误可以局部.en: No. It needs a sufficient understanding of the invariants, the callers and the verification scope that the change touches. A local bug can be fixed locally; if the evidence shows coupling across modules, widen the scope then. "Global understanding" is no reason to read source without limit, and neither should a single line be changed while the interface boundary is still unclear.

追问：怎样避免Agent为了让测试通过而改坏需求？.en: Follow-up: how do you stop an agent from breaking the requirement in order to make the tests pass?

保留原始需求、失败断言与独立验收约束，并审查是否删除测试、放宽断言或绕过功能。测.en: Keep the original requirement, the failing assertion and an independent acceptance constraint, and review whether tests were deleted, assertions loosened or the feature bypassed. The test itself may be wrong, but changing a test calls for independent evidence. If the interpretation of the requirement, the implementation and the grading can all be rewritten at will by the same model path, the result is a closed loop that proves itself.

Q107｜研究型Agent怎样处理“多个来源说法冲突”，而不是写一篇流畅拼贴？.en: Q107｜How does a research agent handle "several sources that contradict one another", rather than writing a fluent collage?

这题先认识什么</span>长研究任务需要持久证据、假设与到期事项；阶段摘要用于.en: What to know first for this questionA long research task needs persistent evidence, hypotheses and items that expire; a stage summary is for handover and does not replace the original source.

第02课 · 状态、事件与检查点</a><a class=\"pill\" hr.en: Lesson 02 · State, events and checkpointsLesson 22 · Compaction is not magicLesson 17 · From search results to a trustworthy answerLesson 23 · Foundations of long-term memoryLesson 05 · The denominator of an evaluation metric

以可核验的主张为单位组织研究，记录来源时间、适用范围和支持关系。冲突可能来自日期.en: Organize the research around verifiable claims as its unit, recording the date of each source, the scope it applies to and what supports what. A conflict may come from dates, definitions, samples, method or a factual error; which premise the conflict sits in has to be located, rather than settled by a simple majority vote or an average.

从问题到结论的中间状态.en: The intermediate states from question to conclusion

先把问题拆成需要证据的子问题，例如“机制是什么”“在哪些条件下有效”“代价和反例.en: Break the question into sub-questions that need evidence first, such as "what is the mechanism", "under which conditions does it work" and "what are the costs and counterexamples". A search result only enters the candidate set; an evidence record is formed only after the text itself has been read. If source A says context compaction reduces cost while B says compaction reduces reliability, that is not necessarily a real contradiction: the first measures the bill and the second measures information loss, and both may hold at once.

对同一指标的真实分歧，比较实验任务、模型版本、预算和成功定义。将无法消除的分歧留.en: For a real disagreement about the same metric, compare the experimental tasks, the model versions, the budget and the definition of success. Leave a disagreement that cannot be removed in the conclusion, and say how it bears on the decision. A provisional guess made during the research should not be promoted to a long-term rule on its own; only with explicit evidence, scope and version does something enter reusable knowledge.

输出前做“主张—证据”反查：每个重要数字、能力和因果结论来自哪里？原文是否只说明.en: Before output, run a "claim—evidence" check back the other way: where does each important number, capability and causal conclusion come from? Does the original text state only a correlation rather than causation? Has a result the author reported been written up as an independent replication? Has the behavior of an old version been written up as a guarantee of the current product? These checks matter more than simply having the model "polish it to sound more professional".

两个来源矛盾，先对齐时间和口径再谈谁对.en: When two sources contradict each other, line up the times and the definitions before arguing about which is right

本例条件：</strong>独立研究：来源A说日活100，B说日活150。A统计.en: Conditions for this example: an independent study: source A gives 100 daily actives, B gives 150. A counts a calendar day in the local time zone and includes only logged-in users; B counts a rolling 24 hours in UTC and includes guests. The numbers are a teaching setting.

指标怎样定义和计数。.en: How the metric is defined and counted.

事实发生或统计覆盖的时间。.en: The time at which the fact happened or that the count covers.

材料发布时刻，与事件时间不同。.en: The moment the material was published, which is not the event time.

本地自然日；登录用户.en: a local calendar day; logged-in users

UTC滚动24小时；含游客.en: a rolling 24 hours in UTC; guests included
