The last of these does not include all the extra position parts of a real MLA.

多Query使用同一KV组。.en: Several Queries use the same KV group.

保存较低维的压缩表示，按架构变换恢复需要的计算。.en: Keep a lower-dimensional compressed representation, and recover the computation needed through the architecture's transform.

位置处理可能需要单独保留，不能省略记账。.en: Position handling may have to be kept separately; the bookkeeping cannot be left out.

本例潜变量3个数.en: 3 numbers in the latent in this example

潜变量+必要的额外分量.en: The latent plus the extra components that are needed

必须按报告架构核对，不止3个数.en: Must be checked against the reported architecture; more than 3 numbers

GQA主要改变头间共享关系，低秩缓存主要改变表示方式。它们都可能减缓存，却不是同.en: GQA mainly changes what the heads share; a low-rank cache mainly changes how things are represented. Both can shrink the cache, but they are not one algorithm under two names.

“能低秩压缩”通常来自架构与训练安排，不能对任意现成模型随意截短KV并声称无损。.en: "It can be compressed to low rank" usually comes out of the architecture and the training arrangement; one cannot truncate the KV of any off-the-shelf model at will and claim no loss.

需要比较完整缓存、投影计算、位置处理与硬件核，不只挑潜变量尺寸展示漂亮倍率。.en: The full cache, the projection computation, the position handling and the hardware kernels all have to be compared; you cannot just pick the latent size and show off a flattering ratio.

不要混淆：</strong>图中的8→3是教学维度，不是DeepSeek报告实测.en: Do not conflate: the 8→3 in the figure is a teaching dimension, not a measured compression ratio from the DeepSeek report, and it cannot be used to estimate the VRAM of a real service.

低秩缓存能少存数字，为什么不等于随便压缩K/V.en: A low-rank cache can store fewer numbers, so why is that not the same as compressing K/V however you like

输入与条件。</strong>教学矩阵W为4×4，但恰好可以写成A(4×1)乘B.en: Input and conditions. The teaching matrix W is 4×4, but it happens to be writable as A(4×1) times B(1×4). The input x is 1×4; first compute the latent variable c=xA, then compute cB.

只需1个潜数，再通过B恢复本例目标向量。.en: Only 1 latent number is needed, and B then recovers this example's target vector.

则xW=(xA)B；一般矩阵用秩1近似会有误差。.en: Then xW=(xA)B; for a general matrix a rank-1 approximation carries error.

缓存较短潜表示可能省容量.en: Caching a shorter latent representation may save capacity

但使用时仍需正确恢复或调整后续计算。.en: but using it still requires recovering it correctly or adjusting the later computation.

真实MLA还涉及联合KV低秩表示、位置相关设计与矩阵吸收.en: Real MLA also involves a joint low-rank K/V representation, a position-dependent design and matrix absorption

不能把这个小分解称作完整MLA。.en: This small factorization cannot be called full MLA.

把过程连起来。</strong>低秩方法的有效性来自模型结构和代数关系，不能对任.en: Join the steps up. A low-rank method works because of the model structure and the algebraic relationships; dimensions cannot be dropped at will from any trained K/V.

边界与反例。</strong>这是低秩原理例，不是DeepSeek模型复现；与G.en: Limits and counterexamples. This is an example of the low-rank principle, not a reproduction of a DeepSeek model; the mechanism differs from GQA's shared heads.

追问：为什么RoPE不能随便吸收到一个固定投影里？.en: Follow-up: why can RoPE not simply be absorbed into one fixed projection?

依赖位置。若把位置旋转与内容上投影混在一起，变换通常随位置变化，无法简单用一个固.en: depends on position. Mixing the positional rotation together with the content up-projection usually makes the transformation vary with position, so one fixed matrix cannot simply be reused at every past position. Decoupling the positional branch keeps position modeling while retaining the convenience of a low-rank cache.

追问：MLA就是KV量化吗？.en: Follow-up: is MLA just KV quantization?

不是。量化减少每个数的表示位数；MLA改变需要缓存的表示维度与结构。两者理论上可.en: No. Quantization reduces the number of bits used to represent each number; MLA changes the dimension and the structure of the representation that has to be cached. The two can be combined in principle, but the error, the operator support and the effect have to be verified separately: the gain from one technique cannot simply be multiplied by the advertised factor of another.

追问：MoE、MLA、FlashAttention各改哪一层？.en: Follow-up: which layer does each of MoE, MLA and FlashAttention change?

MoE改变前馈计算的稀疏选择；MLA改变注意力表示；.en: MoE changes the sparse selection in the feed-forward computation; MLA changes the attention representation;

优化注意力计算的IO与中间存储。它们解决不同瓶颈，可以出现在同一系统，也不互相等.en: optimizes the IO and the intermediate storage of the attention computation. They address different bottlenecks, can appear in the same system, and are not equivalent to one another.

Q111｜In-Context Learning到底是不是“学习”？为什么换几个.en: Q111｜Is In-Context Learning really "learning"? Why does changing a few examples change the behavior?

这题先认识什么</span>上下文学习是在当前输入条件下表现出模式，不等于每次都.en: What to know first for this question In-context learning is a pattern shown under the current input conditions; it does not mean the parameters are updated each time. Complex capability comes from training and inference acting together.

第37课 · 文字为什么要先变成Token编号</a><a class=\"pi.en: Lesson 37 · Why text has to become token IDs firstLesson 45 · The smallest neural network modelLesson 53 · One training run end to endLesson 11 · Assembling context

通常的推理过程中模型参数不更新，但输入示例改变了隐藏状态和条件分布，因此表现出任.en: In ordinary inference the model parameters are not updated, but the examples in the input change the hidden state and the conditional distribution, so task adaptation shows up. This is called in-context learning; it differs from training, which updates parameters by gradients, and from writing experience into an external long-term memory.

以标签映射为例追踪变化.en: Tracking the change through a label-mapping example

假设输入给出“正面评论→标签A，负面评论→标签B”的示例。模型接收这些示例后，后.en: Suppose the input gives the examples "positive review → label A, negative review → label B". Once the model has taken these examples in, the later positions use the correspondence in them through attention; the

由包含这些信息的隐藏状态产生。示例删除或会话重置后，这个局部映射可能不再被提供，.en: of the final classification token are produced from a hidden state that contains this information. Once the examples are deleted or the session is reset, this local mapping may no longer be supplied, because the weights were not permanently changed by that request.

示例选择影响模型推断出的任务：标签是否平衡、格式是否一致、例子是否覆盖边界、顺序.en: The choice of examples affects the task the model infers: whether the labels are balanced, whether the format is consistent, whether the examples cover the boundaries, and whether their order creates a bias. If every example uses the same label, the model may learn the output format as one fixed answer. Wrong examples can contaminate the current behavior as well. Good few-shot work is not piling examples up; it is supplying information that conveys the task rules, the boundaries and the output contract.

“模型记住我的项目”需要继续问：是当前上下文仍携带信息，客户端重新加载了文件，检.en: "The model remembers my project" calls for a further question: is the current context still carrying the information, has the client reloaded the files, has the retrieval system fetched the memory back, or has the model really been fine-tuned? Only by telling these mechanisms apart can recovery, deletion and privacy controls be designed correctly.

In-Context Learning改变本次条件，不等于改了权重文件.en: In-context learning changes the conditions of this run; it does not change the weight file

本例条件：</strong>独立分类提示：给两个例子“好→正向”“坏→负向”，然.en: Conditions for this example: an independent classification prompt: two examples are given, "good → positive" and "bad → negative", and then "excellent" is asked about. The model's parameters are unchanged, but a task rule has been added to the input.

根据当前示例推断任务模式。.en: Infers the task pattern from the current examples.

外部系统把信息再次提供给后续会话。.en: An external system supplies the information again to a later session.

例子+问题，条件已变.en: Examples + question; the conditions have changed

新会话不带例子.en: A new session without the examples

先前条件可能不再可见.en: The earlier conditions may no longer be visible

训练数据进入参数更新过程.en: The training data enters the parameter-update process

把同一个函数放在不同输入条件下，输出改变，并不要求函数本身变了。这样能解释“刚教.en: Putting the same function under different input conditions changes the output, and that does not require the function itself to have changed. This explains "it used the format as soon as I taught it".

这不是否认模型在内部执行复杂适应，而是明确可观察机制：正常推理没有因此执行权重优.en: This does not deny that the model performs complex adaptation internally; it states the observable mechanism: ordinary inference does not thereby run weight optimization.

示例顺序、标签质量与任务分布可能影响结果；几个示例不能保证跨任务永久学会。.en: The order of the examples, the quality of the labels and the task distribution can all affect the result; a few examples are no guarantee of having learned something permanently, across tasks.

不要混淆：</strong>把聊天里的纠正称为永久训练，容易让用户误以为新会话自.en: Do not conflate: calling a correction made in chat permanent training easily leads users to believe that a new session keeps every rule automatically.

模型照着两条示例回答，权重就改变了吗.en: The model answers by following the two examples, so have the weights changed

输入与条件。</strong>当前上下文给“红→R，蓝→B”，随后问“蓝的代号”.en: Input and conditions. The current context gives "red → R, blue → B", and then asks for "the code for blue". Suppose the model answers B as the examples indicate.

它们作为Token进入当前前向。.en: They enter the current forward pass as tokens.

推理没有反向传播或优化器更新.en: Inference has no backward pass and no optimizer update

参数不因此改变。.en: The parameters do not change as a result.

隐藏状态和KV会随上下文变化.en: The hidden state and KV change with the context

这是计算状态，不是模型重新训练。.en: This is computation state, not the model being retrained.

新请求不再提供映射，也无外部记忆检索.en: A new request no longer supplies the mapping, and there is no external memory retrieval

不能保证仍知道这套临时代号。.en: There is no guarantee that it still knows this temporary code.

对样本计算损失并更新参数.en: Computes the loss on samples and updates the parameters

把过程连起来。</strong>上下文内适应能改变当前行为，但不能因此推断形成跨.en: Join the steps up. Adaptation within the context can change the current behavior, but no parameterized memory across sessions can be inferred from that.

边界与反例。</strong>回答B是假定教学行为，不声称每个模型都必然准确遵循.en: Limits and counterexamples. Answering B is an assumed teaching behavior; there is no claim that every model will follow arbitrary examples accurately.

追问：每次对话都会更新厂商模型参数吗？.en: Follow-up: does every conversation update the vendor's model parameters?

不能这样推断。单次推理、产品记忆和厂商离线训练是不同流程；数据使用政策取决于具体.en: That cannot be inferred. A single inference, a product's memory and a vendor's offline training are different processes; the data-use policy depends on the particular product and configuration, and a model "remembering a sentence" is no basis for inferring that it has updated weights online. This book does not speculate about undisclosed data-handling implementations.

追问：上下文越长，Few-shot越多就越好吗？.en: Follow-up: the longer the context and the more few-shot examples, the better?

更多例子可能帮助覆盖，也可能引入冗余、冲突和位置效应。需要在固定任务集上比较示例.en: More examples can help with coverage, and can also bring in redundancy, conflict and position effects. The number of examples, the selection strategy and the cost have to be compared on a fixed task set. If the error comes from a missing fact about the code, adding format examples is not necessarily useful; what needs filling in is the evidence.

追问：Skill与Few-shot有什么关系？.en: Follow-up: how are a skill and few-shot related?

可以包含说明、示例、资源和脚本；被加载后，这些内容成为上下文或工具支持的一部分。.en: can contain instructions, examples, resources and scripts; once loaded, these become part of the context or of the tool support. It does not change the parameters by itself, and it does not guarantee that the model follows it strictly. The value of a skill has to be verified through task behavior, not confirmed by the file existing.

Q112｜面对一个新框架、新论文或Agent失败，如何判断应该改哪一层？.en: Q112｜Faced with a new framework, a new paper or an agent failure, how do you judge which layer to change?

这题先认识什么</span>用输入、模型、工具、状态、证据和验证逐层诊断，选择最.en: What to know first for this question Diagnose layer by layer through input, model, tools, state, evidence and verification, and choose the smallest effective fix; do not add retrieval and review without limit just because you are uncertain.

第02课 · 状态、事件与检查点</a><a class=\"pill\" hr.en: Lesson 02 · State, events and checkpointsLesson 17 · From search results to a trustworthy answerLesson 26 · Retries, idempotence and transactionsLesson 04 · Foundations of engineering qualityLesson 05 · The denominator of an evaluation metricLesson 33 · Reading a production runLesson 66 · From core concepts to system analysis

先定位失败发生在信息、模型、协议、执行、状态还是验收，再选择最小能改变原因的措施.en: First locate whether the failure happens in the information, the model, the protocol, the execution, the state or the acceptance, and only then choose the smallest measure that can change the cause. Papers and frameworks offer candidate mechanisms; they do not replace causal diagnosis. An engineering change has to keep a baseline and a counterexample, to prove that complexity has not been used to cover the problem up.

从一个错误答案逆向回查.en: Working backwards from one wrong answer

第一步确认任务定义：用户要求的到底是什么，成功如何判断？第二步看证据是否存在、是.en: Step one: confirm the task definition — what exactly did the user ask for, and how is success judged? Step two: see whether the evidence exists, whether there is permission for it, and whether the version is right. Step three: see whether the evidence was retrieved and reached the final model request; "a tool read it" is not "the current model still sees it". Step four: check whether the model output expresses the action correctly, and whether the protocol and the arguments are complete.

第五步核验外部执行与持久状态是否一致，尤其超时和中断。第六步检查验证是否针对最终.en: Step five: verify that the external execution and the persistent state agree, especially around timeouts and interruptions. Step six: check that the verification targets the final version and that it really ran. Only when these conditions are broadly right and the failure still occurs reliably is there better reason to attribute the bottleneck to model capability and to try a stronger model, a task split or post-training.

阅读新论文时，把“作者解决的问题—关键假设—改动的对象—实验条件—局限”连起来。.en: When reading a new paper, join up "the problem the authors solve — the key assumptions — the object changed — the experimental conditions — the limitations". If a study is about question answering over static documents yet is used to show that dynamic code modification is reliable, the scope has been stretched much too far. If a new framework only wraps existing mechanisms in layers of classes without producing a gain in task quality or efficiency, it is not necessarily worth moving to.

先找到最早错误边界，再决定换模型还是改系统.en: Find the earliest error boundary first, then decide whether to change the model or change the system

本例条件：</strong>独立Agent失败：最终回答“生产timeout=1.en: Conditions for this example: an independent agent failure: the final answer is "production timeout=10", while the real rule is 30. Possible causes are a retrieval that missed a condition, compaction that dropped "test", a misuse in generation, or stale tool state.

流水线中第一次从正确输入得到不适用内容的位置。.en: The first place in the pipeline where correct input yields content that does not apply.

只移除或更换一个机制，观察变化。.en: Remove or replace one mechanism only, and watch what changes.

针对已证实原因改动，避免无关复杂化。.en: Change what a proved cause points to, and avoid unrelated complication.

原文与索引块.en: The original text and the index chunk

表头“仅测试”在切块时丢了.en: The "test only" header was lost when the text was chunked

改解析/切块.en: Fix the parsing or the chunking

条件完整，压缩摘要丢了.en: The condition was complete; the compaction summary lost it

生产30明确存在，输出仍10.en: Production 30 is plainly there, yet the output is still 10

改提示/模型并评测.en: Change the prompt or the model and evaluate

读的是旧版本配置.en: It read an old version of the configuration

改时效与状态核验.en: Fix the freshness and state checks

不要先选喜欢的技术，再把所有问题解释成需要它。四种原因可能产生同一个错误答案，但.en: Do not pick a favourite technique first and then explain every problem as needing it. Four different causes can produce the same wrong answer, but the place to fix them differs.

每次固定输入、版本与验收，只改变一处，再看真实结果和回归。.en: Each time, fix the input, the version and the acceptance, change one thing only, and then look at the real result and the regression.

“系统能力更强”应落到任务成功、代价和可恢复性，而不是流程变长、图变复杂。.en: "The system is more capable" has to come down to task success, cost and recoverability, not to a longer pipeline and a more complicated diagram.

不要混淆：</strong>新框架演示成功不证明能解决你的失败；先要求一个能区分.en: Do not conflate: a successful demo of a new framework does not prove it fixes your failure; ask first for a concrete counterexample that tells the new approach apart from the old.

引入新框架前，先做一个能推翻自己的对照.en: Before bringing in a new framework, run a comparison that could refute you

输入与条件。</strong>系统修复任务成功率低。候选方案是新增向量数据库和三.en: Input and conditions. The success rate of system repair tasks is low. The proposed approach is to add a vector database and three review agents; the logs, however, show that the key file never entered the readable directory at all.

权限配置让关键源码不可见.en: The permission configuration makes the key source invisible

这是已观察的缺口。.en: This is the gap that was observed.

修正正当读取范围，其他不变.en: Correct the legitimate read scope and change nothing else

测试是否直接恢复任务。.en: Test whether that restores the task directly.

只加向量库但不改可读范围.en: Add only the vector store without changing the readable scope

无法凭空索引受阻内容。.en: Content that is blocked cannot be indexed out of nothing.

三个审查仍无关键文件.en: The three reviews still have no key file

可能重复同一猜测而非增加证据。.en: They may repeat the same guess rather than add evidence.

只有代表性任务证明额外机制还有净收益.en: Only once representative tasks show that the extra mechanism still has a net gain

才把新增复杂度引入主流程。.en: is the added complexity brought into the main pipeline.

把过程连起来。</strong>高级工程能力包括证明一种复杂方案目前没有必要，而.en: Join the steps up. Advanced engineering ability includes proving that a complex approach is not needed for now, not just being able to deploy more components.

边界与反例。</strong>本例不是否定向量库或多Agent，而是说明工具选择.en: Limits and counterexamples. This example does not reject vector stores or multi-agent setups; it shows that the choice of tool should be driven by the specific failure and by the evidence.

追问：怎样避免把简单任务复杂化？.en: Follow-up: how do you avoid making a simple task complicated?

每加一个检索器、Agent、Review或记忆层，先指出没有它会发生的具体失败，.en: For every retriever, agent, review or memory layer added, first state the specific failure that happens without it and the improvement that can be observed. If neither can be stated, keep the simple implementation for now. The principle is that complexity is driven by real evidence and risk, not by the completeness of a catalog.

追问：怎样避免把复杂任务过度简化？.en: Follow-up: how do you avoid over-simplifying a complex task?

检查跨模块不变量、未知副作用、权限边界和不可逆操作。若这些尚不明确，直接改一行可.en: Check the cross-module invariants, the unknown side effects, the permission boundaries and the irreversible operations. While these are still unclear, changing one line directly may only hide the risk. Simple does not mean fewer steps; it means no useless steps. The analysis and verification that are needed should be kept.

追问：怎样判断自己真正学会了？.en: Follow-up: how do you tell whether you have really learned it?

给一个未见过的任务，能逐步说明对象、数据流、关键状态、失败窗口和验证方式，并能指.en: Given a task you have not seen before, you can explain step by step the objects, the data flow, the key state, the failure window and the way it is verified, and you can point out which conclusions have no evidence yet. Being able to describe the run clearly, locate an error to a layer and verify the gain from a fix comes far closer to real ability than reciting terms.

工程深挖 · E56 · 接续Q112.en: Engineering deep dive · E56 · continues Q112

深度排障的终点不是“换更强模型”，而是找出失效的不变量.en: Deep troubleshooting does not end at "switch to a stronger model" but at finding the invariant that failed

第66课</a>。阅读顺序：先确认运行契约，再看反例与修复，最后检验边界。.en: Lesson 66. Reading order: confirm the run contract first, then the counterexamples and the fix, and test the limits last.

把系统拆成可干预的因果链.en: Breaking the system into a causal chain you can intervene in

对于一次失败，先写明用户验收结果，再沿输入证据、检索、上下文组装、模型输出、工具.en: For one failure, write down the user's acceptance result first, then locate it along the chain of input evidence, retrieval, context assembly, model output, tool execution, state write-back and verification. At every layer ask: which invariant should it preserve, and where is that actually broken? "The model is not clever enough" is too broad to guide a smallest fix.

可用受控oracle替换诊断：把真实正确证据直接提供给模型，测试检索是否是瓶颈；.en: A controlled oracle substitution can be used to diagnose: give the model the genuinely correct evidence directly, to test whether retrieval is the bottleneck; hand the executor tool arguments that are known to be correct, to check the execution boundary; hand the verifier the final artifact directly, to check whether the grader misjudges it. These substitutions are for locating a problem; a success rate under oracle conditions must not be taken as a deployment score. The principles of real outcomes and of infrastructure control in agent evaluation support this layered comparison.

单因素没收益，也可能存在交互.en: No gain from a single factor may still hide an interaction

本书教学表：旧检索+旧Prompt成功率0.6，新检索+旧Prompt0.6，旧.en: This book's teaching table: old retrieval + old prompt gives a success rate of 0.6, new retrieval + old prompt 0.6, old retrieval + new prompt 0.6, and only both new together gives 0.9. The interaction term is

。这不是实测产品数据，而是说明：新证据只有被新组装逻辑正确利用时才有效；单看某个.en: . This is not measured product data; it illustrates that new evidence only works once the new assembly logic uses it correctly, and that looking at an independent A/B of one module alone can miss a combined dependency.

反过来，同时改五处后提高也无法知道哪一处有用。根据怀疑的依赖做有限组合实验，避免.en: Conversely, an improvement after changing five things at once tells you nothing about which one helped. Run a limited set of combinations based on the dependency you suspect, and avoid the pointless expense of a full permutation. Start from real failure samples and the smallest falsifiable hypothesis.

改动量与风险也属于结论.en: How much is changed, and the risk, are part of the conclusion too

若一个掩码取反就能修复所有相关反例，不需要重写整套Agent；若底层权限模型错误.en: If inverting one mask fixes every related counterexample, there is no need to rewrite the whole agent; if the underlying permission model is wrong, one more sentence of prompt is not enough. Judging which layer to fix has to follow the evidence, not a preference for a more complex architecture. Acceptance covers the intended fix, neighboring regressions, the cost and any new failure modes.

追问：怎样把排障经验写进记忆而不过拟合？.en: Follow-up: how do you write troubleshooting experience into memory without overfitting?

记录触发条件、失效机制、原始证据、最小修复、有效版本、反例和失效条件。不要只写“.en: Record the trigger condition, the failure mechanism, the original evidence, the smallest fix, the versions it holds for, the counterexample and the conditions under which it stops working. Do not write only broad instructions such as "from now on, add more context whenever there is a problem". When the environment differs next time, check the premises first, and do not promote one success into an eternal rule.

追问：一个“资深八股文答案”最少应包含什么？.en: Follow-up: what is the minimum a "senior-level canned answer" should contain?

先准确定义对象与边界；再走一遍关键状态或计算；给能区分正确与错误实现的反例；说明.en: First define the objects and the boundaries accurately; then walk through the key state or computation; give a counterexample that separates a correct implementation from a wrong one; explain why the fix works, what it costs and under which conditions it stops working; and finally be able to point to the basis and the verification path. Reciting terms, flow charts or a list of "best practices" is not enough to answer a series of follow-ups.

给你一份失败trace，能否指出下一步最便宜、最有辨别力的检查？如果答案总是“重.en: Given a failure trace, can you name the cheapest and most discriminating check to do next? If the answer is always "rerun it, change the model, add more material, add one more review agent", then the mechanisms learned have not yet been turned into engineering judgment.

E56：怎样读这份结果，而不是只看“通过”.en: E56: how to read this result, rather than only looking at "pass"

错误变体分别破坏一个不变量，再看验证能否准确指出它。单次成功不是证据链完整；能稳.en: Each error variant breaks one invariant, and then we see whether the verification points to it accurately. One success is not a complete chain of evidence; only catching counterexamples of this kind reliably shows that the fix targets a known failure boundary.

自检：</strong>把正确检索证据直接给模型后任务成功，能否宣布线上检索优化.en: Self-check: the task succeeds once the correct retrieved evidence is handed to the model directly — can the production retrieval optimization be declared a success?

不能。oracle替换只帮助定位检索/证据不足这个瓶颈。线上系统仍需真实检索、权.en: No. An oracle substitution only helps to locate the bottleneck of insufficient retrieval or evidence. The production system still needs real retrieval, permissions, versions and cost to be verified; a condition in which the correct answer was injected by hand cannot be taken as a deployment score.

怎样把知识图谱变成工程判断，而不是概念大全？.en: How is a knowledge graph turned into engineering judgment rather than a compendium of concepts?

图谱的最小可用单位是可检查的关系.en: The smallest usable unit of the graph is a relationship you can check

“Agent—工具—记忆”三个词连在一起几乎没有信息。更有用的边是：.en: Stringing the three words "agent—tool—memory" together carries almost no information. More useful edges are:

。每条边注明来源、适用版本和反例。.en: . Each edge notes its source, the versions it applies to, and a counterexample.

把问题放回图中定位.en: Putting the problem back into the graph to locate it

Agent重复改同一文件，可能是结果没回填、任务状态没持久化、摘要把完成改成未完.en: An agent that keeps modifying the same file may be a result that was not filled back in, a task state that was not persisted, a summary that turned "done" into "not done", an unstable retry key, or a subtask dispatched twice. Start from the visible symptom and follow the dependency edges to find the break. Simply adding a prompt that says "do not repeat yourself" only hides the mechanism problem.

事实：源码某函数在handler返回之后处理后置钩子。推论：后置拒绝不能阻止此前.en: Fact: in the source, a certain function handles the post-execution hook after the handler returns. Inference: a refusal at that point cannot stop an external action that has already happened. Recommendation: a sensitive operation should be checked before execution, and an unknown result should be given a verification or idempotent path. The three have to be kept apart; a recommendation must not be written up as a guarantee the product already provides.

变更时怎样使用图谱.en: How to use the graph when making a change

修改工具Schema，要回归参数组装、钩子改写、授权绑定、执行和结果回填。修改压.en: Change a tool schema, and argument assembly, hook rewriting, authorization binding, execution and filling the result back in all need regression. Change compaction, and the key constraints, the historical versions, the calls in flight and recovery need regression. Change memory, and extraction, leases, artifact verification, source withdrawal and expiry at the point of use need regression. The graph helps to settle the scope of the impact; it does not require every small change to rerun every test in the system.

不值得做的设计也要能删掉.en: A design that is not worth doing has to be removable too

一项机制没有对应失败模式，没有评测收益，却增加调用、状态和维护成本，就不应因为看.en: A mechanism with no matching failure mode and no gain on the evaluation, yet with added calls, state and maintenance cost, should not be kept because it looks complete. Advanced engineering judgment is knowing when a complex mechanism is needed, and equally when simple direct execution is better.

知识图谱的每条边也有证据等级.en: Every edge of a knowledge graph has a level of evidence too

“ToolRouter包含可见规格”是代码关系；“后置钩子不能回滚已有副作用”是.en: "ToolRouter contains the visible specification" is a code relationship; "a post-execution hook cannot roll back a side effect that has already happened" is a conclusion about execution order; "add one more check for high-risk operations" is an engineering recommendation. The three kinds of relationship need different verification methods, and they must not all be drawn as the same "official requirement".

本轮图谱给边附上固定源码范围、官方文档章节或原创推导标签，并把未取得原文的旧记录.en: This round's graph attaches to each edge a pinned source range, an official documentation section or an original-derivation label, and leaves older records whose original text was not obtained as history rather than continuing to cite them. When reading the graph, look at an edge's predicate and conditions first and at its source afterwards. A passing test supports only the teaching cases that were run; it does not replace reading the source, a Rust integration test, or verification against a commercial service.

Why can one token/parameter ratio not simply be memorized?Q110｜What is the essential difference between MLA and GQA? Why can a low-rank KV reduce the cache?Q111｜Is In-Context Learning really "learning"? Why does changing a few examples change the behavior?Q112｜Faced with a new framework, a new paper or an agent failure, how do you judge which layer to change?

代码、数值与验证边界 — AI系统工程.en: Code, numbers and the limits of verification — AI Systems Engineering

如何运行</a><a href=\"#code-foundation\">基础手.en: How to run itThe complete hand-calculation programThe complete program for the 39 testsActual numeric resultsActual test logAdvanced numeric programRun-chain programAdvanced experimentsRecomputable checks of parameters, representations and symbols

基础实验程序只依赖Python标准库。它核对数表、矩阵、softmax、注意力、.en: The foundation experiment program depends only on the Python standard library. It checks the number tables, matrices, softmax, attention, masks, rotation, gradients, a simple preference and the evaluation formulas. Every input, vocabulary and weight is explicitly stated teaching data.

测试结果与适用范围.en: Test results and scope of use

39项unittest测试通过，0失败、0错误、0跳过。</strong>完整结.en: 39 unittest tests passed, with 0 failures, 0 errors and 0 skipped. The complete results are below. They are deterministic program checks, not the model's general capability, the quality of compaction, or a production-safety pass rate.

无需网络、GPU或API密钥。Python 3.10及以上，在资料包目录执行：.en: No network, GPU or API key is needed. With Python 3.10 or above, run this in the material package's directory:

不运行代码也可阅读全部推导。JSON保存精确输出，课文使用适当小数位。.en: All the derivations can be read without running the code. The JSON keeps the exact output; the text uses a suitable number of decimal places.

39项测试完整程序.en: The complete program for the 39 tests

基础计算实验位于labs目录；数值与运行链路实验位于checks目录；训练、检索.en: The foundation computation experiments are in the labs directory; the numeric and run-chain experiments are in the checks directory; the training, retrieval and failure-recovery topics are in the studies/labs directory. Each group of experiments states its dependencies, its input data and the scope of its results separately; a passing test does not mean that a commercial model's capability or production safety has been verified.

阅读辅助：</strong> <a href=\"worked-examples.en: Reading aids: Index of worked runs

两句话穿过模型的完整数表.en: The full number tables for two sentences passing through the model

数值与状态核验.en: Verification of the numbers and state

参数、表示与符号的可复算检查.en: Recomputable checks of parameters, representations and symbols

F11使用完整指定的X、Wq、Wk、Wv，先做投影，再计算缩放点积和因果读取份额.en: F11 uses a fully specified X, Wq, Wk and Wv: it projects first, then computes the scaled dot product and the causal read shares. Every displayed value comes from a continuous computation over unrounded values. The code and results below can be re-checked in an offline environment.

标准库程序有30项确定性检查；另用已安装的PyTorch 2.10.0+cpu、.en: The standard-library program has 30 deterministic checks; separately, the installed PyTorch 2.10.0+cpu was used on CPU with float64 to compare 3 Linear projections, the low-level SDPA and the high-level MultiheadAttention, and all 5 comparison groups passed. The high-level MHA received the same X while the low-level SDPA received the already projected Q/K/V; this verifies the difference between interface levels, and is not an evaluation of model quality or GPU performance.

同一算例的完整中间结果.en: The complete intermediate results of the same worked example

配套程序检查记录.en: Check records for the accompanying programs

术语使用位置清单.en: List of where each term is used

术语清单包含120项定义，按指定模式扫描143个阅读页，针对首次语义使用安排51.en: The term list holds 120 definitions, scans 143 reading pages according to a specified pattern, and places 514 in-place explanations at the first semantic use of a term; F11 is additionally written along the full dependency chain. The scan excludes the contents text and the exercise answers, and it cannot prove that every term, or every possible ambiguity in reading, has been exhausted. The numeric and state tests verify the objects listed; they do not mean that a real commercial agent was run.

公式与术语：先认识对象，再理解运算 — AI系统工程.en: Formulas and terms: know the objects before the operations — AI Systems Engineering

阅读数学式之前，先分清五类对象</a><a href=\"#reading-ob.en: Before reading a formula, sort out the five kinds of objectRead XW through in one plain sentence first, then look at the matrix sizesHow to read capitals, subscripts and superscriptsA letter that recurs cannot be pinned to one meaning for goodA function name is not another mysterious data tableData, requests and state in a program need identities tooThe dependency path from the basics to the systemConcept index: objects, sources, uses and independent micro-examplesThe basis and limits of the definitions

阅读数学式之前，先分清五类对象.en: Before reading a formula, sort out the five kinds of object

公式不是缩写词竞赛。一个符号可能是<strong>本次输入、模型参数、计算出的中.en: A formula is not an acronym contest. One symbol may be this input, a model parameter, a computed intermediate value, a size or a subscript, an execution rule or a function. Classify the objects first, then read how they relate. The examples below only explain notation; they are independent micro-examples about symbols, and they do not replace the main worked example of any lesson.

用户数据、分词器或训练样本.en: User data, the tokenizer or training samples

输入编号、X、正确下一Token.en: Input IDs, X, the correct next token

初始化程序、训练、已保存的权重文件.en: The initialization routine, training, a saved weight file

普通推理中通常不更新.en: Usually not updated in ordinary inference

Embedding表、Wq/Wk/Wv、偏置、归一化参数.en: The embedding table, Wq/Wk/Wv, biases, normalization parameters

Q/K/V、分数S、份额A、隐藏状态、logits.en: Q/K/V, the scores S, the shares A, hidden states, logits

模型设计及当前请求长度.en: The model design and the length of the current request

有些固定，有些随请求改变.en: Some are fixed, some change with the request

层数、头数、每头宽度、当前有效长度.en: The number of layers, the number of heads, the width per head, the current effective length

程序、协议及任务规则.en: The program, the protocol and the task rules

依具体条件构造.en: Constructed according to the specific conditions

Norm函数、softmax、mask、执行状态.en: The Norm function, softmax, a mask, execution state

“权重”有两种常见含义。</strong> 参数矩阵W中的权重是模型保存的系数；.en: "Weight" has two common senses. The weights in the parameter matrix W are coefficients the model has saved; the weights in the attention table A are shares of information computed from the current input. Both take part in multiplication, but their origin and life cycle differ. The word "parameter" has two levels too: model parameters are numbers that were learned, whereas the parameters of a tool call are fields of one request, and the two must not be conflated.

先用一句中文读完XW，再看矩阵尺寸.en: Read XW through in one plain sentence first, then look at the matrix sizes

读作：“把X的每一行，按W每一列提供的系数组合，产生Y的各列。”例如X有两行、每.en: is read as: "take each row of X and combine it by the coefficients that each column of W supplies, producing each column of Y." For example, X has two rows of three numbers each and W has three rows of two numbers each:

这里i选X的哪一行，j选输出哪一列。不是把i和j传给另外一个模型。若X表示两个T.en: Here i selects which row of X, and j which column of the output. i and j are not being passed to another model. If X stands for the positions of two tokens, the origin of one output cell can still be traced back to the three features at that same input position. Mixing across tokens takes a further operation along the position axis, such as multiplying the table of attention shares by the Value table.

都可能用来命名查询投影参数。它们是记号写法，不是三种独立算法。反过来，长得相同的.en: can all be used to name the query projection parameters. They are ways of writing the notation, not three separate algorithms. Conversely, a letter that looks the same may carry a different role in another chapter, so this book does not let the look of a letter stand in for a local definition.

大小写、下标、上标怎样读.en: How to read capitals, subscripts and superscripts

大写表包含多行，小写取一行.en: A capital letter is a table of several rows; a lowercase one takes a single row

X=[两行]；x₁是第1号位置那一排数.en: X=[two rows]; x₁ is the row of numbers at position 1

先选第i行，再选第j个特征.en: Pick row i first, then feature j

Q是这张W的用途标签.en: Q is a label for what this W is used for

用来生成Query，不是W乘Q.en: It is used to produce the query; it is not W times Q

ℓ标第几层的参数.en: ℓ marks which layer the parameters belong to

第0层和第1层通常各自有W_Q.en: Layer 0 and layer 1 usually each have their own W_Q

把K指定的行列轴交换.en: Swap the designated row and column axes of K

不是K的T次方.en: Not K to the power of T

是一张m行n列的实数表.en: Is a table of real numbers with m rows and n columns

可以包含小数和负数.en: It may contain decimals and negative numbers

对j列出的全部项相加.en: Add up all the terms listed for j

不代表把其他未列的轴也求和.en: It does not mean summing over the other axes that are not listed

对应格子逐元素相乘.en: Multiply the matching cells element by element

矩阵乘法，乘后沿内侧维度相加.en: Matrix multiplication: multiply, then add along the inner dimension

损失相对参数的变化率.en: The rate of change of the loss with respect to the parameters

算出梯度，不等于已经更新参数.en: Computing the gradient is not the same as having updated the parameters

将右侧结果存回左侧.en: Store the result on the right back into the left

从0开始的下标是一种编程约定。若另一个算例明确从1开始，就按它的声明读；不要把“.en: Subscripts that start from 0 are a programming convention. If another worked example states that it starts from 1, read it as declared; do not treat "position 1" and "the first item" as the same object without saying so.

不能把重复出现的字母永久固定成一个意思.en: A letter that recurs cannot be pinned to one meaning for good

序列长度；另有转置上标ᵀ.en: Sequence length; also the transpose superscript ᵀ

看它是尺寸还是操作；温度优先写τ.en: See whether it is a size or an operation; for temperature, prefer writing τ

Value表；一些论文用V表示词表大小.en: The Value table; some papers use V for the vocabulary size

看形状；本书词表规模尽量写Vocab或n_vocab.en: Look at the shape; this book writes the vocabulary size as Vocab or n_vocab wherever it can

头数；隐藏向量；图像高度.en: The number of heads; a hidden vector; image height

每个公式先注明对象，不能只凭字母判断.en: State the object for each formula first; the letter alone is not enough to decide

层数；损失；排队系统平均任务数.en: The number of layers; the loss; the average number of tasks in a queueing system

看是不是一个计数、目标函数或运行统计量.en: See whether it is a count, an objective function or a runtime statistic

模型权重矩阵；Little定律中的平均停留时间.en: A model weight matrix; the average time spent in the system in Little's law

两种场景单位和对象类型都不同.en: The two settings differ in both unit and kind of object

LayerNorm偏移；Adam平滑系数；DPO设置系数.en: The LayerNorm offset; the Adam smoothing coefficient; the DPO setting coefficient

各章必须重新按当前公式解释.en: Each chapter has to explain it again from the formula at hand

规范化稳定常数；有限差分步幅.en: The stabilizing constant in normalization; the step size of a finite difference

都是小正数，但用途、取值和影响不同.en: Both are small positive numbers, but they differ in purpose, value and effect

注意力份额表；LoRA的一个因子；比较方案A.en: The table of attention shares; one factor in LoRA; approach A in a comparison

不能跨公式自动沿用形状或语义.en: Neither shape nor meaning carries over automatically from one formula to another

圆周率；概率策略符号π_θ.en: The circle constant; the probability-policy symbol π_θ

旋转角与策略概率分属不同计算.en: A rotation angle and a policy probability belong to different computations

注意力的一行；检索问题；Top-k保留数量.en: One row of attention; a retrieval query; the number of items Top-k keeps

字母相同不等于数据相同.en: The same letter does not mean the same data

如果一个章节从“两个Token的向量”转向“十篇文档的检索排名”，应当明确建立新.en: If a chapter moves from "the vectors of two tokens" to "the retrieval ranking of ten documents", it should establish the new input explicitly. Both sets of numbers can be summed mathematically, which does not mean they come from the same run.

函数名不是另一个神秘数据表.en: A function name is not another mysterious data table

表示按指定轴把分数转为份额。函数可能内部使用可学习参数，但函数名本身不是一排权重.en: means turning scores into shares along the axis designated. A function may use learnable parameters inside it, but the function name itself is not a row of weights.

为例，应按顺序读：先对X规范化，Attention处理该结果，把注意力输出与原X.en: as an example: it should be read in order — first normalize X, let Attention process that result, add the attention output to the original X, and finally call the whole result U. U is only a name for a temporary result. Another formula using U as well does not mean the numbers are shared automatically. Where a continuous worked example carries U over, it points explicitly at the line above.

高级接口还可能把投影前的数据命名为.en: A high-level interface may also give the data before projection the names

；底层接口的同名参数则可能是投影后的数据。查看“接口内部是否已经做了W变换”比只.en: ; the parameter of the same name in a low-level interface may instead be the data after projection. Checking "whether the interface has already done the W transformation inside" matters more than reading the parameter name alone. A formula and a program may also take different layouts, one right-multiplying the parameter table and the other storing the weights transposed; align the layouts first, then compare the numbers.

程序里的数据、请求与状态也需要身份.en: Data, requests and state in a program need identities too

表达目标，不是文件内容.en: It states a goal, not the content of a file

path必须是字符串.en: path has to be a string

结构约束，不证明文件存在.en: A structural constraint; no proof that the file exists

模型提出、宿主校验.en: Proposed by the model, checked by the harness

要调用的对象，不是执行结果.en: The object to be called, not the result of executing it

用来配对，不自动等于业务幂等键.en: Used for pairing; not automatically a business idempotency key

本次运行证据，需注明版本与范围.en: Evidence from this run; the version and the scope have to be stated

目前确认到了哪一步.en: Which step has been confirmed so far

便于恢复，但不能替代原始证据.en: Convenient for recovery, but no substitute for the original evidence

“模型记住了”也至少分三层：推理缓存里的一组K/V、当前会话中的事实与摘要、跨会.en: "The model remembered" also has at least three levels: a set of K/V in the inference cache, facts and summaries within the current session, and long-term memory retrieved across sessions. Ask which kind of object it saved, when that was written and when it expires, instead of treating all three levels as an update to the model parameters.

从基础到系统的依赖路径.en: The dependency path from the basics to the system

模型计算路径：</strong> 数字容器与形状 → Token编号与Embed.en: The model computation path: numeric containers and shapes → token IDs and embeddings → row-by-column multiplication → parameters and intermediate results → Query/Key/Value → scores and read shares → masks and position → multiple heads, the output projection, residuals and the feed-forward network → output tokens and the cache.

训练路径：</strong> 前向结果 → 正确标签与损失 → 导数和链式法则.en: The training path: the forward result → the correct labels and the loss → derivatives and the chain rule → the gradient for each parameter → optimizer state and updates → post-training objectives. Without derivatives you can still start by understanding how W takes part in the forward pass; "the weights come from training" must not be mistaken for "every reinforcement learning algorithm has to be understood first".

Agent路径：</strong> 请求与结构化数据 → 模型输出项 → 工具调.en: The agent path: requests and structured data → model output items → tool call identifiers → permissions and execution → events and state → reassembling the context → recovery after compaction → multi-agent collaboration.

知识和质量路径：</strong> 原始证据 → 分块及索引 → 召回与重排 →.en: The knowledge and quality path: original evidence → chunking and indexing → recall and reranking → versions and permissions → generation and citation → the memory life cycle → task results you can check → statistical comparison and running cost.

进入一个新机制时，能回答“输入是哪个对象、参数从哪里来、实际算什么、结果供哪一步.en: When you come to a new mechanism, be able to answer "which object is the input, where do the parameters come from, what is actually computed, and which step uses the result" before going into the formula. For the terms this book finds easiest to confuse, the concept index below gives a definition you can read on the spot, an independent micro-example and the matching full lesson.

以下微例只解释术语，不接续其他章节的输入。点击课程入口可阅读完整计算链。.en: The micro-examples below only explain the terms; they do not continue the input of any other chapter. Click a lesson entry to read the full chain of computation.
