C03 · 工具可见性、调用转换与路由.en: C03 · Tool visibility, call conversion and routing

工具注册、直接暴露、延迟发现与Code Mode是不同表面。exposes_to.en: Tool registration, direct exposure, deferred discovery and Code Mode are different surfaces. exposes_tool covers several paths; build_tool_call separates local from hosted search, and the dispatch carries the call_id and the original StepContext. A registration metric is no proof of being visible or executable.

C04 · 并行准入、执行、取消与结果.en: C04 · Parallel admission, execution, cancellation and results

阅读ToolCallRuntime的创建、准入、执行与取消；调用可以立即启动，消.en: Read the creation, admission, execution and cancellation in ToolCallRuntime; a call may start immediately, and the future that consumes the result does not stand for the actual start time. The parallel-allowed flag only decides how work is scheduled; it is no proof that the read and write targets are independent of one another.

该文件按列出的范围取得并阅读，包内保留原始定位与中文笔记，没有伪造或拼凑全文副本.en: The file was obtained and read within the scope listed; the package keeps the original locations and the Chinese notes, with no fabricated or stitched-together copy of the full text.

C05 · 输出项记录、分派与回填.en: C05 · Recording output items, dispatch and filling results back in

完整输出项到达后先记录调用，再选择即时或延期分派。已记入历史但还未执行就取消的调.en: Once the complete output item has arrived, the call is recorded first and then dispatched either immediately or later. A call already written into the history but canceled before it ran still needs a matching abort result, so that no orphaned call is left after recovery. A tool item finishing is not the whole response, nor the business task, finishing.

C06 · 异步压缩生命周期与候选验证.en: C06 · The asynchronous compaction life cycle and candidate validation

后台压缩受功能标记、TokenBudget禁用和远端V2支持共同约束。启动身份包.en: Background compaction is constrained jointly by the feature flag, by TokenBudget being disabled and by remote V2 support. The identity it starts from includes the history-rewrite generation, the model and compaction version, and the authorization generation. Canceling this turn only stops new work, while work already under way is managed by the session; discarding the result does not erase its cost.

C07 · 压缩候选安装及回退.en: C07 · Installing a compaction candidate, and falling back

安装先核对模型与压缩哈希，经共同路径转换候选，再交给历史替换原语。候选安装后实时.en: Installation first checks the model and the compaction hash, converts the candidate through the shared path, and then hands it to the history-replacement primitive. After a candidate is installed the live suffix may still leave the window over budget, and one foreground fallback is allowed; this is not unlimited retrying.

C08 · 历史版本、重写与基线.en: C08 · History versions, rewrites and baselines

history_version记录重写；reset_version用于破坏性重置.en: history_version records rewrites; reset_version is for a destructive reset; user_message_revision is independent of both. The model history, the retained facts and the review context also exist separately. Neither the number of messages nor a single version number can be taken for the identity of the whole state.

C09 · 注册冲突、准入、钩子及结果.en: C09 · Registration conflicts, admission, hooks and results

前置钩子可阻止handler或重建入参；handler执行后才有后置检查。固定源.en: A pre-execution hook can block the handler or rebuild its arguments; the post-execution check comes only after the handler has run. The pinned source makes it explicit that a post-execution block rejects the result without undoing the execution, and that on_tool_result_accepted is called after post-execution acceptance.

C10 · 规则刷新、缓存与子线程共享.en: C10 · Rule refresh, caching and sharing with child threads

规则刷新串行化但外部provider调用不占状态锁。环境或信任变化先失效旧缓存，.en: Rule refresh is serialized, but the call out to an external provider does not hold the state lock. A change of environment or of trust invalidates the old cache first, so that a failed refresh does not go on exposing the old rules. A sub-agent inherits the text already applied, and a dynamic thread provider has to allow sharing explicitly.

C11 · 子Agent输入与消息提交.en: C11 · Sub-agent input and message submission

提交或邮箱排队只返回接受标识。未装载接收者且trigger_turn=false.en: Submitting, or queuing in the mailbox, returns only an acceptance identifier. With no receiver loaded and trigger_turn=false it can merely queue, which does not mean it started, still less that the sub-task finished. The session identity and the tree runtime are separate.

C12 · 子线程创建及历史过滤.en: C12 · Creating a child thread, and filtering its history

所读fork过滤函数对不同消息类型有不同保留规则，并移除父线程累计用量。某一路径.en: The fork filter function that was read keeps different message types by different rules, and it removes the parent thread's accumulated usage. One path being able to copy the history does not mean that every kind of sub-agent copies the parent's context, tools, permissions and cache in full.

C13 · 记忆流水线启动条件.en: C13 · The conditions for starting the memory pipeline

启动记忆有根线程、非临时会话、功能标记、数据库和目录等条件；清理与阶段任务顺序可.en: Starting memory has conditions: a root thread, a session that is not temporary, the feature flag, the database and the directory; the order of the cleanup and the staged tasks can be traced. It must not be written up as every conversation learning permanently.

C14 · 记忆抽取与候选状态.en: C14 · Memory extraction and candidate state

实际run先创建stage-one请求上下文再领取候选，不能盲从注释步骤。候选受.en: The actual run creates the stage-one request context before claiming candidates, so the steps in the comments cannot be followed blindly. Candidates are constrained by source, age, idle time, an upper limit and a lease; concurrent extraction includes a "succeeded with no output" result, which should not be treated as an error to retry.

C15 · 记忆整合、租约与产物核验.en: C15 · Memory consolidation, leases and artifact verification

阶段二先取全局租约并准备Git基线，必要时才启动整合Agent；完成后先关停，检.en: Stage two first takes the global lease and prepares the Git baseline, and starts the consolidation agent only where that is needed; once it has finished, it shuts the agent down, checks the artifact, confirms the lease again, and only then resets the baseline and registers the success. The file baseline and the database completion record are not one atomic transaction; a failed shutdown leaves the lease in place to wait for expiry.

C16 · 会话历史替换与持久化入口.en: C16 · Session-history replacement and the persistence entry point

捕获模型/环境时有锁顺序，耗时准备移到锁外。前缀安装在状态锁内核验代际、长度、授.en: There is a lock order when the model and the environment are captured, and the slow preparation is moved outside the lock. The prefix install checks the generation, the length and the authorization inside the state lock and keeps the live suffix; only then does it persist. Returning true means that path accepted the in-memory replacement, which on its own cannot be taken as evidence of a successful recovery after power loss.

C17 · 远程压缩参数、钩子与回退.en: C17 · Remote compaction parameters, hooks and fallback

区分前台、后台候选、是否前台回退与前置钩子。常量2是此快照中压缩传输重试上限，不.en: It separates the foreground, the background candidate, whether there is a foreground fallback, and the pre-execution hook. The constant 2 is the retry limit for the compaction transport in this snapshot, not a general agent retry standard.

C18 · 取消与复用的固定测试案例.en: C18 · The pinned test cases for cancellation and reuse

已读取参数化Rust测试，检查取消前不发请求、已启动请求在轮次取消后仍可复用，并.en: The parameterized Rust tests have been read: they check that no request is sent before cancellation, that a request already started can still be reused after the turn is canceled, and they assert that only one request was received. These Rust tests were not executed in this environment.

实际范围：</strong>完整正文的架构、工具设计与何时使用Agent部分。.en: Actual scope: the architecture, tool design and when-to-use-an-agent parts of the full text.

流程预定与动态行动需要分开。先用满足目标的简单方案，出现真实的不确定步骤后再增加.en: A predetermined flow and dynamic action need to be kept apart. Use the simple approach that meets the goal first, and add dynamic orchestration once a genuinely uncertain step appears; what the article lists are composable patterns, not an approval chain every task has to go through.

边界：</strong>不要推成“复杂任务必用多Agent”或固定角色数量。.en: Limits: do not stretch it into "a complex task must use multiple agents" or into a fixed number of roles.

实际范围：</strong>上下文管理、按需取证、压缩和长任务部分。.en: Actual scope: the context-management, evidence-on-demand, compaction and long-task parts.

信息选择既可提前组织，也可按需检索。压缩优先保留后续判断要用的事实和约束，再减少.en: Information can be selected by organizing it in advance or by retrieving it on demand. Compaction keeps the facts and constraints that later judgment will need first, and only then reduces redundancy; the original evidence should remain re-readable.

边界：</strong>压缩保真是需要测量的能力，不是摘要长度达标就成立。.en: Limits: compaction fidelity is a capability that has to be measured; it does not hold simply because the summary is short enough.

实际范围：</strong>工具原型、评测、命名、响应格式与有效描述部分。.en: Actual scope: the tool-prototype, evaluation, naming, response-format and effective-description parts.

工具接口应减少猜测与无用返回，按任务选择简明或详细结果，同时保留后续调用必需的标.en: A tool interface should reduce guesswork and useless returns, choose a terse or a detailed result according to the task, and at the same time keep the identifiers a later call needs. Tool improvements have to be verified on representative tasks.

边界：</strong>简短响应不等于可以删除来源、版本或机器所需ID。.en: Limits: a short response does not mean the source, the version or the IDs a machine needs may be deleted.

实际范围：</strong>多Agent架构、委派、工具、评测和生产经验部分。.en: Actual scope: the multi-agent architecture, delegation, tools, evaluation and production-experience parts.

并行研究需要明确子任务范围、资源预算和产物要求，用可追溯产物减少层层转述。协调和.en: Parallel research needs explicit sub-task scope, a resource budget and artifact requirements, and it uses traceable artifacts to cut down on retelling through layer after layer. Coordination and consolidation have a cost of their own, so whether the approach applies depends on whether the problem can be divided.

边界：</strong>研究系统的测量结果不直接证明代码修改任务同样获益。.en: Limits: measurements from a research system are no direct proof that code-modification tasks gain in the same way.

日期／版本：</strong>2025-10-16；原文注明2025-12-18.en: Date / version: 2025-10-16; the original notes an update on 2025-12-18. Actual scope: the skill structure, progressive discovery, resources and security parts.

技能先暴露概述，再按需读取正文及附属资源；可复用程序能降低重复生成的不稳定性。执.en: A skill exposes its overview first, and its body and attached resources are read on demand; a reusable procedure reduces the instability of generating the same thing again and again. The source and the permissions still have to be verified before a third-party script is run.

边界：</strong>技能描述不等于已经读取正文；技能文件不自动取得外部权限。.en: Limits: a skill description is not the body having been read, and a skill file does not acquire external permissions by itself.

实际范围：</strong>初始化、增量工作、交接、测试和剩余挑战部分。.en: Actual scope: the initialization, incremental work, handoff, testing and remaining-challenges parts.

长任务需要可恢复的功能状态、工作记录和实际验收；每轮开始重建当前情况，结束留下可.en: A long task needs a recoverable functional state, a work record and real acceptance; each turn begins by rebuilding the current situation and ends by leaving an artifact that can be inspected. A claim of progress should not stand in for a test.

边界：</strong>初始化/编码角色是该案例设计，不是强制每个简单修改都分两.en: Limits: the initialization and coding roles are that case's own design, not a requirement that every simple change be split between two agents.

实际范围：</strong>全文正文：任务/试验/判分定义、判分器、实施步骤与边.en: Actual scope: the whole text: the definitions of task, trial and grading, the grader, the implementation steps and the limits.

评测对象包括模型和Harness，最终环境结果与输出文本要区分。任务可有多个判分.en: What is evaluated includes the model and the harness, and the final environment result has to be kept apart from the output text. A task can have several grading dimensions, the sample should include counterexamples where no action should be taken, and the judge should be checked by hand.

边界：</strong>不能把调用轨迹必须一模一样当成通用成功标准；关键安全顺序.en: Limits: an identical call trace cannot be made a general criterion of success; a critical safety ordering can be checked on its own.

实际范围：</strong>上下文增强、检索组合、重排和实验限制部分。.en: Actual scope: the context-enrichment, retrieval-combination, reranking and experimental-limit parts.

为块补充上下文再建立关键词及向量索引，可缓解块失去背景的问题；混合检索与重排各解.en: Adding context to a chunk before building the keyword and vector indexes eases the problem of a chunk losing its background; hybrid retrieval and reranking each solve a different stage. The generated context should still be kept separate from the original text.

边界：</strong>原文检索实验不是任意知识库的保证收益，也不是最终回答事实.en: Limits: the retrieval experiment in the article is no guaranteed gain for an arbitrary knowledge base, and it is not the factual accuracy of the final answer.

实际范围：</strong>工具发现、代码执行、数据处理与基础设施部分。.en: Actual scope: the tool-discovery, code-execution, data-processing and infrastructure parts.

由代码组合工具并在执行环境过滤中间数据，可以少让模型阅读大批结果。工具网络请求不.en: Having code compose the tools and filter the intermediate data inside the execution environment lets the model read fewer bulk results. The tools' network requests do not necessarily go down; the execution environment still needs isolation, permissions and resource limits.

边界：</strong>减少模型可见内容不自动保证日志、工具服务器或外部服务不接.en: Limits: reducing what the model can see is no automatic guarantee that the logs, the tool server or an external service never touch sensitive data.

实际范围：</strong>工具搜索、程序化调用、调用示例、取舍与上手部分。.en: Actual scope: the tool-search, programmatic-call, call-example, trade-off and getting-started parts.

工具搜索应对大量定义，程序化调用应对数据中转，示例应对复杂参数约定。应根据实际瓶.en: Tool search answers a large number of definitions, programmatic calls answer the relaying of data, and examples answer complex argument conventions. Each should be assessed against the actual bottleneck, rather than bundling the three features into a default flow.

边界：</strong>旧文章中的Beta参数和模型支持不能直接复制为当前可运行.en: Limits: the beta parameters and model support in an older article cannot be copied straight across as an interface that runs today.

实际范围：</strong>文件系统/网络隔离、许可交互及实现说明部分。.en: Actual scope: the file-system and network isolation, the permission interaction and the implementation-notes parts.

文件系统与网络限制约束工具执行的破坏范围；批准对话和运行时隔离承担不同职责。模型.en: File-system and network restrictions bound how much damage tool execution can do; the approval dialog and run-time isolation carry different responsibilities. An instruction to the model cannot replace a system boundary.

边界：</strong>有沙箱不等于所有远端工具和授权内的数据都安全，不能宣称彻.en: Limits: having a sandbox does not mean every remote tool and all the data inside the granted scope are safe, and it is no ground for claiming that injection has been eliminated.

实际范围：</strong>资源上限、评测噪声及实验建议部分。.en: Actual scope: the resource-limit, evaluation-noise and experiment-advice parts.

执行资源上限改变会改变任务可完成性。比较模型/Harness前，应固定或记录资源.en: Changing the execution resource limits changes which tasks can be completed at all. Before comparing models or harnesses, the resources, timeouts and environment should be fixed or recorded; the classification of failures has to stay inside the statistical basis.

边界：</strong>文章中的特定资源倍数不是所有任务的最优配置。.en: Limits: the particular resource multiples in the article are not the best configuration for every task.

实际范围：</strong>规划/生成/评价、模型升级后简化、实验及附录正文。.en: Actual scope: the planning, generation and evaluation parts, the simplification after the model upgrade, and the experiment and appendix text.

独立评价可减少自评偏宽，但仍需要标准与校准。文章也展示随着模型变化移除重置和阶段.en: An independent evaluation can reduce the leniency of self-assessment, but it still needs a standard and calibration. The article also shows the reset and the stage orchestration being removed as the model changed; the flow therefore has to be re-verified as the task and the model change.

边界：</strong>角色分离不是统计独立保证，也不证明更多Agent总是更优.en: Limits: separating the roles is no guarantee of statistical independence, and it is no proof that more agents are always better.

实际范围：</strong>模型、Harness、会话和执行环境分离部分。.en: Actual scope: the part on separating the model, the harness, the session and the execution environment.

将可持久会话记录、推理控制和执行环境分开，可以分别处理故障和资源调度。日志仍需转.en: Separating the persistable session record, the inference control and the execution environment makes it possible to handle faults and resource scheduling apart from each other. The logs still have to be turned into model context that is of use.

边界：</strong>产品案例的首Token延迟改善不是本教材实测，也不是普遍.en: Limits: the improvement in time to first token in the product case was not measured by this book, and it is not a general performance conclusion.

实际范围：</strong>并行编译器案例的任务划分、验证、瓶颈与局限部分。.en: Actual scope: the task division, verification, bottlenecks and limitations of the parallel-compiler case.

多个工作者需要共享可检查任务、稳定测试和合并纪律。当全部工作者被同一问题阻塞时，.en: Several workers need a shared task that can be inspected, stable tests and merge discipline. When every worker is blocked by the same problem, adjusting the tests and the division of tasks is worth more than adding still more concurrency.

边界：</strong>实验产物的能力和缺点均需保留，不能写成生产级编译器已经被.en: Limits: both the capability and the shortcomings of an experimental artifact have to be kept; it must not be written up as production-grade compilers having been widely replaced.

实际范围：</strong>质量事件说明、三个原因、修复时间与后续措施。.en: Actual scope: the account of the quality incident, the three causes, the time to fix and the follow-up measures.

这份复盘将具体质量变化关联到推理设置、上下文管理和产品提示变更。教材据此要求记录.en: This retrospective ties the specific changes in quality to the inference settings, context management and changes to the product prompt. On that basis the book requires the product configuration and version to be recorded, so that the model is not blamed on the strength of an impression.

边界：</strong>这是已披露的历史事件，不表示现在相同缺陷仍存在，也不适用.en: Limits: this is a disclosed historical incident; it does not mean the same defect is present now, and it does not apply to every API user.

历史上独立think工具用于复杂工具任务的中间整理。作者后来说明多数场景优先使用.en: Historically a separate think tool was used for intermediate organizing in complex tool tasks. The author later explained that the improved extended thinking is preferred in most situations, so the book keeps the historical method without listing it as a required step.

边界：</strong>不把隐藏推理全文当交付证据；更长思考或更多调用本身不是正.en: Limits: the full hidden reasoning is not treated as delivery evidence; thinking for longer or calling more often is not in itself a guarantee of correctness.

会话历史、自动整理、工具和文件检查点是不同机制。检查点可恢复哪些文件应查具体产品.en: Session history, automatic tidying, tool checkpoints and file checkpoints are different mechanisms. 日期／版本：</strong>2026-10-22检索快照。<strong>实际.en: Date / version: retrieval snapshot of 2026-10-22. Actual scope: the subsections on PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure and output and logging.

前置改写与后置结果处理是不同时间点；Claude后置block追加原因并保留原结.en: Rewriting beforehand and handling the result afterwards happen at different moments; a Claude post-execution block appends a reason and keeps the original result, while replacement uses a separate field. 边界：</strong>文档有3271行，本轮核验上述相关小节，不声称逐项审查全.en: Limits: the document runs to 3271 lines; this round verified the subsections above and makes no claim to have reviewed every hook event item by item.

日期／版本：</strong>2026-10-22检索快照。<strong>实际.en: Date / version: retrieval snapshot of 2026-10-22. Actual scope: the subsections on rule order and on matching tools against run-time permissions.

读取的文档给出deny/ask/allow等规则评估顺序；工具是否出现在模型上下.en: The documentation that was read gives the order in which rules such as deny, ask and allow are evaluated; whether a tool appears in the model's context must not be conflated with the argument-level check at execution time. 边界：</strong>具体模式和配置属于检索时版本，不当成不可变标准。.en: Limits: the particular patterns and configuration belong to the version at the time of retrieval and are not treated as an immutable standard.

菜单可见、允许模型调用、正文已加载和工具使用许可是不同状态；文档还区分正文保留与.en: Visible in the menu, allowed for the model to call, body already loaded, and permitted to use a tool are different states; the documentation also distinguishes the lifetime of a retained body from that of a temporary tool permission.

先给可检查的完成标准，再根据问题是否不明、是否跨模块选择规划和验证深度。简单明确.en: State a completion criterion that can be checked first, then choose the depth of planning and verification according to whether the problem is unclear and whether it crosses modules. 具体模型是否绑定输入输出权重及如何初始化新行，须查相应实现。.en: Whether a particular model ties its input and output weights, and how it initializes the new rows, has to be looked up in that implementation.

2.10；与本书本次CPU实验版本一致.en: 2.10; the same version as this book's CPU experiment this time

布尔True表示可参与；函数按dropout_p应用dropout；非方阵is_.en: A boolean True means the position may take part; the function applies dropout according to dropout_p; for a non-square matrix is_causal aligns to the top left; and the fused kernel and the mathematical implementation differ in floating point.

这里描述2.10接口，不把所有Attention库都视为同一契约；CPU实验不能.en: What is described here is the 2.10 interface; not every attention library is treated as the same contract, and a CPU experiment is no proof of GPU speed.

查询日stable动态文档；本地实验另记录2.10.en: The stable live documentation on the day of the query; the local experiment records 2.10 separately

MHA的布尔掩码True表示禁止对应位置，与SDPA语义相反。.en: In MHA a boolean mask True means the position is forbidden, the opposite of its meaning in SDPA.

高层MHA包含投影；不能把高层接口参数名当成已投影张量的证明。.en: The high-level MHA includes the projections; a parameter name in a high-level interface is no proof that the tensor has already been projected.

增量注意力读取历史和当前K/V；mask覆盖过去与当前长度；文档的cache_p.en: Incremental attention reads both the past and the current K/V; the mask covers the past length together with the current one; the cache_position in the documentation is unaffected by the meaning of the padding content.

缓存实现可能是动态、静态、滑窗；槽位、绝对位置与真实有效Token数不能混为一谈.en: A cache implementation may be dynamic, static or a sliding window; the slot, the absolute position and the real number of valid tokens must not be run together.

常见decoder-only generate需要左补齐；只给attention.en: The common decoder-only generate needs left padding; supplying attention_mask alone is no substitute for selecting the logits at the last valid position correctly.

这是该生成调用路径的约定，不是右补齐在所有自定义前向中都不合法。.en: This is the convention of that generation call path, not a statement that right padding is illegitimate in every custom forward pass.

公开修复案例指出，累计不同有效Token数的小批次时，应按总token损失与总有.en: The public fix case points out that when mini-batches with different numbers of valid tokens are accumulated, the normalization should be the total token loss over the total number of valid tokens, not a plain average of each batch's average loss.

历史事故不表示当前版本仍有该bug；分布式缩放需另看DDP/Trainer实现。.en: A historical incident does not mean the current version still has that bug; for distributed scaling, the DDP and Trainer implementations have to be read separately.

裁剪应在unscale之后；一轮累计更新的缩放与unscale时机必须一致。.en: Clipping should come after the unscale; across one round of accumulated updates, the scaling and the timing of the unscale have to match.

本次用CPU数值反例验证缩放代数，不声称执行了CUDA GradScaler训练.en: This time the scaling algebra was verified with a CPU numeric counterexample; no claim is made that CUDA GradScaler training was run.

激活检查点会在反向时重算；随机状态与重算函数一致性影响正确性；重算不是纯省内存开.en: Activation checkpointing recomputes on the backward pass; the random state and the consistency of the recomputed function affect correctness; recomputation is not a switch that merely saves memory.

重入/非重入行为不同；不要依赖函数只执行一次。.en: The reentrant and non-reentrant behaviors differ; do not rely on the function running only once.

默认参考初始化使用A的Kaiming-uniform与零B，使增量初始为零。.en: The default reference initialization uses Kaiming-uniform for A and zeros for B, so that the increment starts at zero.

文档中的“identity”指不改变基座路径，不表示基座W本身是单位矩阵；其他初.en: The "identity" in the documentation means the base path is left unchanged; it does not mean the base W is itself the identity matrix, and other initializations do not necessarily have B=0.

偏好目标比较策略与参考策略对成对回答的相对对数概率。.en: The preference objective compares the relative log probabilities that the policy and the reference policy give to a pair of answers.

本书给出的掩码/缓存/长度反例为独立工程推导，不是复现论文训练成绩。.en: The mask, cache and length counterexamples this book gives are independent engineering derivations, not a reproduction of the paper's training results.

正确的推测采样通过接受/拒绝校正保持目标分布。.en: Correct speculative sampling preserves the target distribution through the accept and reject correction.

本书枚举有限分布验证正确性，不复现论文硬件加速比。.en: This book verifies correctness by enumerating a finite distribution; it does not reproduce the paper's hardware speed-up.

块身份依赖前缀链和附加信息；请求盐支持限制跨信任域复用；共享块需要生命周期管理。.en: A block's identity depends on the prefix chain and the additional information; a request salt makes it possible to limit reuse across trust domains; a shared block needs life-cycle management.

盐不是用户身份认证；本书只模拟身份和别名，不声称运行vLLM服务。.en: A salt is not user authentication; this book only simulates the identity and the aliasing, and makes no claim to have run a vLLM service.

KV空间不足可导致抢占和重算；调度和分块prefill影响吞吐、TTFT与tok.en: Too little KV space can lead to preemption and recomputation; scheduling and chunked prefill shift the trade-off between throughput, TTFT and inter-token latency.

默认值随版本变化；本书不提供未经压测的万能配置或加速百分比。.en: The defaults change from version to version; this book offers no universal configuration and no speed-up percentage that has not been load-tested.

previous_response_id不携带上轮顶层instructions；.en: previous_response_id does not carry the previous turn's top-level instructions; managing context by hand means handling typed output items, not keeping output_text alone.

没有调用付费API，也没有访问闭源隐藏提示。.en: No paid API was called, and no closed-source hidden prompt was accessed.

调用与结果通过call_id关联；流式参数分片需按项组装；模型提出调用不等于应用.en: A call and its result are linked by call_id; streamed argument fragments have to be assembled per item; the model proposing a call is not the application having executed it.

不同协议终止事件不同；本书协议实验是本地适配器，不伪装真实API回包。.en: Termination events differ from protocol to protocol; this book's protocol experiment is a local adapter and does not pass itself off as a real API response.

Schema约束不等于事实与权限正确；拒绝和不完整响应需要分支处理。.en: A schema constraint is not the facts and the permissions being right; a refusal and an incomplete response each need a branch of their own.

不能据此声称任意schema、任意模型都支持同一严格输出能力。.en: It cannot be used to claim that any schema and any model support the same strict-output capability.

压缩响应中的完整规范输出窗口应一起传递；其中可能同时有保留内容与不透明压缩项，不.en: The complete canonical output window in a compacted response should be passed on together; it may hold retained content and an opaque compaction item at once, so one of them cannot simply be kept on its own.

不解读或编造不透明压缩状态的内部内容；接口支持范围需以实际模型为准。.en: The internal content of an opaque compaction state is neither interpreted nor invented here; what the interface supports depends on the actual model.

缓存依赖可复用前缀与服务规则；缓存不是删除输入上下文。.en: Caching depends on a reusable prefix and on the service's rules; caching is not deleting the input context.

计费、阈值、保留时间和支持模型是易变参数，教材不写成永久常量。.en: Billing, the thresholds, the retention time and the supported models are volatile parameters, and the book does not write them up as permanent constants.

明确固定2025-11-25，不声称最新版本.en: Explicitly pinned to 2025-11-25, with no claim to be the newest version

工具列表可分页；能力变更需按协商处理；协议错误与工具执行返回isError分属不.en: The tool list can be paginated; a change of capability has to be handled through negotiation; a protocol error and a tool execution that returns isError belong to different layers.

发现能力不等于授权执行；工具注解来自服务，不天然可信。.en: Discovering a capability is not authorization to execute it; a tool annotation comes from the service and is not trustworthy by nature.

初始化需要协商协议版本和能力；开始业务调用前应完成生命周期约定。.en: Initialization requires negotiating the protocol version and the capabilities; the life-cycle agreement should be complete before the business calls begin.

超时与取消不自动撤销已完成的外部副作用。.en: A timeout or a cancellation does not automatically undo an external side effect that has already completed.

必须处理令牌受众、权限范围和代理信任边界，不能用会话标识代替身份验证或透传不合受.en: The token audience, the permission scope and the proxy trust boundary all have to be handled; a session identifier cannot stand in for authentication, and a token with the wrong audience cannot be passed through.

本书不执行真实OAuth服务或安全渗透测试。.en: This book runs no real OAuth service and no security penetration test.

长期记忆评测需要覆盖时序推理、知识更新和拒答，不能只检查内容能否被召回。.en: Evaluating long-term memory has to cover temporal reasoning, knowledge updates and abstention; checking only whether the content can be recalled is not enough.

1．文字如何转换为编号.en: 1. How text is turned into IDs

我们用两条文字：“我爱学习”和“你爱”。<strong>分词器</strong>.en: We use two pieces of text: 我爱学习 ("I love study") and 你爱 ("you love"). A tokenizer is a set of rules that matches pieces of text to integer IDs. On this page we lay down by hand that it splits the first sentence into 我/爱/学习 and the second into 你/爱. That is only so the arithmetic comes out clearly; it is not the real tokenization of any commercial model.

但两条编号列表一条长3、一条长2。为了先用普通规则表格计算，我们给短的那条末尾放.en: But one of the two ID lists is 3 long and the other 2. So that an ordinary regular table can be used for the computation first, we put a placeholder ID 0 at the end of the shorter one:

The two-row, three-column ID table is a tensor with two axes: the first axis selects which sentence, the second selects which position within that sentence.

这不是把“你爱”编码成三个真实词：</strong>第三行只是为了补齐到长度3。.en: This is not "你爱" encoded as three real words: the third row is only there to pad it out to length 3. What the lookup gives is still the initial numeric representation of each token, not one act of understanding the whole sentence's meaning. Note that 爱, in both sentences, gets the same row of numbers from the first lookup. That does not mean it never looks at context; the network that follows will combine the current position with the other positions it is allowed to read, producing a new representation. The lookup is the starting point, not the whole of understanding.

设备</strong>在这里指执行计算的处理器，例如CPU或GPU。CPU是通用.en: A device here means the processor that carries out the computation, such as a CPU or a GPU. A CPU is a general-purpose processor; a GPU is good at running large amounts of suitable numeric work in parallel. For the computation to run at all, the program has to get the input data and the model parameters onto compatible devices and into compatible storage formats.

存到内存，再复制到GPU显存中；它们仍然是相同编号，并没有因为移动就变得更“智能.en: in memory and then copy it into GPU VRAM; they are still the same IDs, and moving them has not made them any more "intelligent". VRAM is a kind of storage the GPU can use directly. Moving data can take time, and the space can run short, so this is a real engineering step.

9．还要带哪几份“辅助信息”.en: 9. Which pieces of "auxiliary information" also have to come along

第一份是<strong>填充掩码</strong>：告诉后续计算哪些位置是真的。.en: The first is the padding mask: it tells later computation which positions are real.

这里的0/1不是Token编号，而是“能不能算作有效内容”的标记。即使PAD的E.en: The 0/1 here are not token IDs but markers for "can this count as valid content". Even if PAD's embedding happens to be all zeros, that does not mean later computation will naturally ignore it, so these positions still have to be handled properly.

注意力</strong>先理解为“为当前这个位置挑出可以参考的位置，再按不同份额.en: Attention is, to begin with, "picking out the positions the current position may refer to, then combining their numbers in differing shares". The mask decides "who may be referred to", not "how much". The latter is worked out with a weighted average in F09–12.

生成下一Token时，训练与运算通常要遵守不能偷看未来的规则。对三位置例子，可以.en: When the next token is generated, both training and computation usually have to obey the rule against peeking at the future. For the three-position example, the positions that may be read are:

这是<strong>因果掩码</strong>。第二句话还必须把作为填充项的位置.en: This is the causal mask. For the second sentence, position 2 has to be excluded as well, because it is a padding item. Different interfaces inside a model do not necessarily use the same mask shape or the same meaning for true and false; the table on this page only explains the visibility relation and does not pose as the input argument of any particular API.

第三份是<strong>位置编号（position IDs）</strong>。.en: The third is the position IDs. The three real positions, for instance, are recorded as 0, 1 and 2. A token ID answers "which fragment"; a position ID answers "where it occurs". They are not the same column. With left padding, or with a cache, the logical position and the table's column number can differ; F13 gives an example of each.

最后可能有<strong>KV缓存（KV Cache）</strong>。缓存就.en: Last, there may be a KV cache. A cache simply keeps results already computed that can be reused later. The first time something is processed from scratch there is usually no history cache; when generation continues, some of the numbers each layer computed earlier can be brought back, which avoids recomputing from the start. This is not long-term memory, and it is not new knowledge entering the model parameters. What K and V mean, why they can be reused, and which changes invalidate them, are covered by explaining attention in F11 first and then deriving it in full in F19; this page does not ask you to memorize the two letters first.

10．完整过程小结.en: 10. A summary of the whole process

把两条独立输入一起计算，并把较短的编号列表补到本批安排的长度。由此得到一张两行、.en: Two independent inputs are computed together, and the shorter ID list is padded to the length laid out for this batch. That gives one table of two rows with 128 IDs each. From each ID the model fetches a row of 4096 numbers out of its own embedding parameter table, so the result is two tables of 128 rows and 4096 columns. At the same time the program prepares the valid positions, which positions may refer to which, and the position IDs of the real fragments; if this is continued generation, it also brings in reusable results from earlier computation. The attention and the other numeric transformations of each layer then begin. The embedding lookup is itself already a computation step in the model's numeric representation, not something that meets the neural network only once the lookup is done.

你现在不需要先理解Attention的完整公式，便能解释这一步的每个对象。下一段.en: You do not need to understand the full attention formula first in order to explain every object in this step. If Q, K, V or softmax turn up directly in what follows, go through F07 → lesson 44 → lesson 46 first; do not read on by guessing at abbreviations.

自检：请先口头回答，再看答案.en: Self-check: answer out loud first, then look

问题一：词表1000项、三条输入、每条10个位置、每项用8个数表示，Embedd.en: Question one: with a vocabulary of 1000 items, three inputs, 10 positions each and 8 numbers per item, how big are the embedding table and the lookup result?

。1000决定可以查多少种条目，3和10决定这一批查了多少个位置。.en: . 1000 decides how many kinds of entry can be looked up; 3 and 10 decide how many positions this batch looked up.

问题二：为何同样写0，有时表示PAD编号，有时表示掩码里的不能看？.en: Question two: why does the same 0 sometimes stand for the PAD ID and sometimes for "cannot be seen" in a mask?

它们属于不同数据对象。.en: They belong to different data objects.

的0用于找词表行；有效性或可见性表里的0是一条运算标记。不能只看数字相同就混为一.en: has a 0 that is used to find a vocabulary row; a 0 in a validity or visibility table is a computation marker. They must not be run together just because the digit is the same.

问题三：Embedding的第2个数是不是永远表示情绪？.en: Question three: does the 2nd number of an embedding always stand for emotion?

没有这种一般保证。它是训练得到的分布式表示的一部分。教材里的数字只演示读取和计算.en: There is no such general guarantee. It is part of a distributed representation arrived at by training. The numbers in this book only demonstrate the reading and the computation; they do not force a semantic label onto every column.

问题四：组批时第二个用户会读取第一个用户的内容吗？.en: Question four: when batching, will the second user read the first user's content?

普通独立样本batch不应如此。批轴安排一起运算，不是把样本拼成一条上下文。真实.en: An ordinary batch of independent samples should not allow that. The batch axis arranges for things to be computed together; it does not splice the samples into one context. A real system still has to put tenant and cache isolation in place.

从具体对象与小例子开始，理解计算过程与适用条件。.en: Start from concrete objects and small examples, to understand the computation and the conditions under which it applies.

共同的计算，先训练，再推理.en: The shared computation first, then training, then inference

共通前向之后，训练与推理走向不同的状态变化.en: After the shared forward pass, training and inference lead to different changes of state

放大图解：共通前向之后，训练与推理走向不同的状态变化.en: Enlarged figure: after the shared forward pass, training and inference lead to different changes of state

训练与推理共用前向，但只有训练更新参数.en: Training and inference share the forward pass, but only training updates the parameters

模型最初只是参数和运算规则。基础课程先解释这些数字如何前向计算，再解释用标签计算.en: At the start a model is nothing but parameters and computation rules. The Foundation lessons first explain how those numbers are computed forward, then how a loss is computed against labels, backpropagated and used to update the parameters, and last how the training result is loaded to generate one item at a time. Inference still runs the forward pass, but it does not send gradients back along the loss and it does not update the parameters. Agents, tools and retrieval lie outside this model chain, and later Foundation lessons cover them separately.

起点</span>只默认你会加减乘除；不默认学过线性代数、微积分或机器学习。术语.en: Starting pointassumes only that you can add, subtract, multiply and divide; it does not assume you have studied linear algebra, calculus or machine learning. The terminology is built up from here.

输入框中的文字，什么时候才变成模型能计算的东西？.en: When does the text in the input box become something the model can compute with?

可以把这条路理解成“翻译格式”，但不是不断翻译成另一种人类语言。文字先成为编号，.en: This path can be understood as "translating formats", but not as translating on and on into another human language. Text becomes IDs first, then a numeric representation; the model's output is then interpreted as text or as a tool request. A file on disk sits outside this chain: only once the harness has read it and put the content into the request does the model have any chance of using it.

宿主</strong>调用模型、访问工具、管理任务的普通程序。.en: Harness an ordinary program that calls the model, accesses tools and manages the task.

模型参数</strong>已经加载的计算系数；本图中的普通推理不更新它们。.en: Model parameters the computation coefficients already loaded; ordinary inference in this figure does not update them.

中间表示</strong>模型对本次输入实际算出来的数字，不是秘密中文草稿。.en: Intermediate representation the numbers the model actually computes for this input, not a secret draft in Chinese.

输入与适用条件：</strong>教学文字为“我爱”；此图只区分对象，不给这句话.en: Input and conditions of use:The teaching text is "I love"; this figure only distinguishes the objects, and invents neither real token IDs from a commercial model nor an answer for this sentence. For the round-by-round generation of the complete small model, see F18.

按对象与证据阅读这段过程.en: Read this process through its objects and evidence

此时只有字符。界面里能读到“我爱”，不等于神经网络已经处理了它。.en: At this point there are only characters. Being able to read "I love" in the interface does not mean the neural network has processed it.

参见本步解释.en: See the explanation for this step

宿主选择要发送的信息。没有选入请求的文件，不会因为位于同一台电脑而自动进入模型。.en: The harness chooses what information to send. A file not selected into the request does not reach the model automatically just because it sits on the same computer.

教学分词器给两个片段编号。编号1和2只表示词表项目，不携带“谁更重要”的大小关系.en: The teaching tokenizer numbers the two fragments. The IDs 1 and 2 only stand for vocabulary entries; they carry no "which matters more" ordering.

查表成为向量.en: The lookup turns it into a vector

编号被当作行号，取出向量。查表已经属于模型表示计算，不是到Attention才第.en: The ID is treated as a row number and a vector is taken out. The lookup is already part of computing the model's representation; the input does not first enter the model at attention.

模型计算下一项.en: The model computes the next item

同样的参数作用于这次向量，得到候选分数。这步改变的是临时结果，不是训练好的参数。.en: The same parameters act on this vector and give the candidate scores. What this step changes is a temporary result, not the trained parameters.

如果输出是工具请求，必须由宿主执行并拿回结果；模型提议本身不能证明环境已经改变。.en: If the output is a tool request, the harness has to run it and bring the result back; the model's proposal alone is no proof that the environment has changed.

分清对象，才能查出“没提供信息”和“提供了却没用好”两类不同故障。.en: Only by keeping the objects apart can you find the two different faults: "the information was never supplied" and "it was supplied but used badly".

分别追踪用户文字、实际请求、模型输出、工具结果四份记录。.en: Track four separate records: the user's text, the actual request, the model output and the tool result.

把一段流畅回答当作文件已被修改的证据，会跳过真实执行与验证。.en: Taking a fluent answer as evidence that the file has been modified skips the actual execution and verification.

如何判断是否做对.en: How to tell whether it was done right

用一个从未发送的测试文件提问，检查宿主是否真的读过它。.en: Ask about a test file that was never sent, to check whether the harness really read it.

。数值和运行场景为本书明确设定的教学例；资料出处不代替本页中文解释。.en: . The numbers and the run setting are a teaching example explicitly specified by this book; the cited source does not replace the explanation on this page.

从信息对象认识AI系统.en: Getting to know an AI system through its information objects

理解一个AI系统的运行，首先要知道每一步处理的<strong>是什么东西</st.en: To understand how an AI system runs, the first thing to know is what kind of thing each step handles. The text in the input box, the request sent to the server, the numbers inside the model and the code file on disk are not the same object. They convert into one another, but their names cannot be used interchangeably.

关键区别：</strong>聊天窗口写下的只是一部分；是否附上源码、工具定义和历.en: Key difference: what is typed in the chat window is only part of it; whether the source, the tool definitions and the history are attached is decided by the surrounding program.

容易误解：</strong>不能因为模型说“已阅读”就认定真实文件已经被它读到。.en: Easy to misread: the model saying "read" is no ground for concluding that it has really read the file.

先看一个没有数学门槛的任务：“读一下文件，告诉我函数为什么报错。”编辑器可以直接.en: Take a task with no mathematical barrier first: "read the file and tell me why the function is erroring." The editor can attach the code you selected straight to the request, or it can send the question alone and read the file only after the model asks for it. Both can end in an answer, but the way the evidence is gathered differs.

人能阅读的一串字符.en: A string of characters a person can read

程序组织的信息包.en: A packet of information organized by a program

问题、历史、工具说明放在一起.en: The question, the history and the tool descriptions put together

用于找到某个条目的整数.en: An integer used to find an entry

编号17代表词表里的一个文本片段.en: ID 17 stands for one text fragment in the vocabulary

模型计算中使用的表示.en: The representation used in the model's computation

训练时调整、推理时通常固定的一组数.en: A set of numbers adjusted during training and usually fixed during inference

决定如何变换输入的权重.en: The weights that decide how the input is transformed

外部环境中的真实内容.en: Real content in the external environment

系统记录的当前进展.en: The current progress as recorded by the system

这里的“对象”只是<strong>当前被处理的信息或实体</strong>，不要.en: "Object" here means no more than the information or entity currently being handled; it does not require you to learn object-oriented programming first.

模型不是一位住在电脑里、直接看见所有文件的人.en: The model is not a person living in the computer who sees every file directly

模型</strong>可以先理解为一个很大的、由许多数字和计算规则组成的函数。函.en: A model can be understood, to begin with, as a very large function made up of many numbers and computation rules. A function is simply "something that, given an input, produces an output by a rule". With the rule "multiply the input by 2", 3 gives 6; a language model is far more complicated, but its input and output are still joined by an actual computation.

模型不是一位住在电脑里、直接看见所有文件的人：逐项辨别.en: The model is not a person living in the computer who sees every file directly: item by item

工具执行：真实读文件.en: Tool execution: really reading the file

关键区别：</strong>这里有三种不同对象：用户意图、模型计算和外部环境的真.en: Key difference: there are three different objects here: the user's intent, the model's computation, and a real change in the external environment.

容易误解：</strong>模型输出“已修改”不等于磁盘文件实际变化。.en: Easy to misread: the model outputting "modified" does not amount to an actual change in the file on disk.

推理</strong>是使用已有参数计算输出；<strong>训练</stron.en: Inference is computing an output with the parameters already there; training is adjusting the parameters according to examples and error. Putting new information into this turn's input in ordinary chat does not amount to rewriting the model's parameters permanently. Whether it still knows when you ask again later depends on whether the history or an external memory supplies it again.

Agent宿主程序</strong>是调用模型、读取文件、执行命令、保存状态的外.en: An agent harness is the surrounding program that calls the model, reads files, runs commands and saves state. The model can output "please call the file-reading tool", and only after the harness has checked the arguments and the permissions does it really read and hand the result to the model. Get to know this relationship first; the protocols themselves are set out from F22 onwards.

本书到底在解释什么.en: What this book is actually explaining

“模型推理”这个词容易同时指两件事：一是运行已有模型产生输出的.en: The term "model inference" easily covers two things at once: one is the running of an existing model to produce output,

，二是解决复杂问题时的多步.en: ; the other is the multi-step kind that goes into solving a complex problem,

。本书首先讲第一件事：文字怎样真正经过数值计算，训练又怎样把参数变成可用的参数。.en: . This book takes the first of these first: how text really passes through numeric computation, and how training turns parameters into usable parameters. Long thinking, tool calls and search strategies are all built on top of it, and none of them replaces this layer of computation.

大语言模型不是一份固定答案目录，也不是一次聊天临时写出的程序。先把它看成一个函数.en: A large language model is not a fixed catalog of answers, nor a program written on the spot during one chat. Take it first as a function: a string of IDs goes in, computation is done against many parameter tables, and a score for every candidate ID comes out. <strong>The structure says how to compute, the parameters decide what is computed, and the current input decides who is handled this time.

三件事不能混为一件.en: Three things that must not be run together as one

本书中的具体对象.en: The concrete object in this book

1层因果Decoder、4维表示、1个注意力头、8维前馈层.en: 1 causal decoder layer, 4-dimensional representation, 1 attention head, 8-dimensional feed-forward layer

建模型时确定；改变结构往往要重新匹配权重.en: Fixed when the model is built; changing the structure usually means matching the weights up again

当前输入算出的Q/K/V、隐藏状态、分数、概率.en: The Q/K/V, hidden states, scores and probabilities computed from the current input

输入不同，或参数版本不同，结果就可能不同.en: A different input, or a different parameter version, and the result can differ

举一个暂不属于语言模型的标量暖身：规则是.en: Here is a scalar warm-up that does not belong to a language model yet: the rule is

。结构是“相乘”，参数是w，输入是x。w=2时，x=3得到6；w=4时，相同x得.en: . The structure is "multiply", the parameter is w and the input is x. With w=2, x=3 gives 6; with w=4, the same x gives 12. Changing only the input does not amount to learning new parameters, and merely computing a result does not amount to finishing training.

为什么要先讲共通计算，再讲训练，最后讲推理.en: Why the shared computation comes first, then training, and inference last

训练本身也需要一次前向计算。没有先解释乘法、归一化、注意力和输出分数，就无法解释.en: Training itself needs a forward pass too. Without first explaining multiplication, normalization, attention and the output scores, there is no way to explain where a prediction went wrong. But "learning the forward pass" is not the same as "already being in the inference chapters".

本书的顺序是：<strong>认识数据与参数 → 用初始参数做一遍共通前向 →.en: The order in this book is: get to know the data and the parameters → run the shared forward pass once with the initial parameters → compute the loss against the real labels → compute the gradients and update the parameters → save the training artifacts → load the training artifacts → run inference token by token. The forward computation is the engine both paths share; the loss, backpropagation and the optimizer belong to the training path; sampling, stopping and the KV cache belong to the inference path here.

训练时“预测”与推理时“预测”哪里不同.en: Where "prediction" during training differs from "prediction" during inference

两者都可以产生下一Token分数。训练时，教材已经知道正确的下一项，可以评价分数.en: Both can produce scores for the next token. In training, the material already knows the correct next item, so it can judge whether the scores gave the probability to the right object; in inference there is no reference answer to tell you what the next item should be, so the result can only be produced from the distribution or by a selection rule.

训练通常不需要先把每个位置抽成文字再求损失。直接拿连续可微的logits计算交叉.en: Training usually does not need to sample each position into text before computing the loss. Only when the cross entropy is computed directly from the continuous, differentiable logits can the gradient travel back along the computation graph.

选中的整数不是这个标准训练目标的必要输入。.en: picks an integer, and that integer is not a necessary input to this standard training objective.

贯通算例固定哪一个模型.en: Which model the worked calculation fixes

我们使用 <strong>贯通模型</strong>，它是一层很小的、可实际训练.en: We use the worked model: a very small, genuinely trainable one-layer causal language model. It is not a scaled-down parameter copy of GPT, Llama or any commercial system. Its purpose is to let every table be shown in full, and to let training, the backward pass and inference line up against one and the same file.

它有8项词表、4维隐藏表示、1个注意力头、8维ReLU前馈层、3处RMSNorm.en: It has an 8-item vocabulary, a 4-dimensional hidden representation, 1 attention head, an 8-dimensional ReLU feed-forward layer, RMSNorm in 3 places, and learned absolute positions. There is no bias and no dropout, and the input embedding and the output head do not share weights. These choices are made first so that fewer variables appear at once on a first reading; RoPE, GQA, SwiGLU and dropout are compared separately later, and <strong>the main worked example will not be quietly swapped for another architecture

这里的“学会”只意味着什么.en: What "learning" here means, and only that

训练语料只有“我爱学习！”和“你爱学习！”两条固定序列。这足够验证损失、梯度、更.en: The training corpus is only the two fixed sequences "我爱学习！" and "你爱学习！". That is enough to verify the chain of loss, gradient, update, saving, loading and continuation; it is not enough to judge natural language understanding, generalization, factuality or safety. When the generated result comes out right, ask at the same time: has the model merely fitted these two sequences? For this experiment the answer is: it is mainly there to demonstrate exactly that kind of fitting.

用三个容易混淆的句子检查边界.en: Checking the boundary with three sentences that are easy to confuse

“模型说文件已修改”只是一份输出；“文件内容确实改变”是环境事实；“新文件通过对.en: "The model says the file has been modified" is only an output; "the file's contents really changed" is a fact about the environment; "the new file passes the matching test" is a fact of verification again. The third does not follow from the first. Only by keeping these objects apart can you see why an agent needs tool results and tests rather than its own confirmation alone.

关键区别：</strong>想证明Bug修好，必须接上环境检查；语言输出本身不是.en: Key difference: to prove a bug is fixed, a check against the environment has to be wired in; language output is not itself a test result.

容易误解：</strong>测试的版本必须是最终提交或交付的代码版本。.en: Easy to misread: the version tested has to be the version of the code finally committed or delivered.

同理，“请求包含了一段材料”不保证模型正确利用它；“有一个会话编号”不保证旧消息.en: In the same way, "the request included a piece of material" is no guarantee that the model used it correctly; "there is a session ID" is no guarantee that the old messages are there forever; "a cache exists" is no guarantee that its contents suit the current model and the current task.

后文用很小的词表和向量做手算。<strong>词表</strong>是文本片段与.en: What follows works by hand with a very small vocabulary and small vectors. So that the computation can be seen clearly, the book sets the numbers by hand; they are not the parameters of any commercial model, nor real semantics.

容易误解：</strong>不要拿Token编号的大小表示语义强弱。.en: Easy to misread: do not let the size of a token ID stand for how strong a meaning is.

例如写“我→1、爱→2”，只说明本教材演示用这样的编号。现实分词器可能把一个字拆.en: Writing "我→1, 爱→2", for instance, says only that this book demonstrates with these IDs. 默认你会加减乘除、能阅读普通程序式步骤；不默认你会线性代数、微积分、概率论或深度.en: It is assumed that you can add, subtract, multiply and divide and can read ordinary program-like steps; it is not assumed that you know linear algebra, calculus, probability or deep learning. The code is a second way of expressing the process, there to help you check it; the main text can be read right through without running any code.

BPE是一类常见的子词构建方法。先从基础符号出发，在训练语料中反复统计相邻符号组.en: BPE is a common family of subword construction methods. Starting from basic symbols, it counts adjacent symbol combinations in the training corpus over and over, then picks a combination and merges it. If, for instance,

经常相邻，就可以增加.en: are often adjacent in the corpus, the item

这一项，再重新统计下一轮组合。这一阶段产生词表和合并规则。.en: can be added, and the next round of combinations counted again. This stage produces the vocabulary and the merge rules.

关键区别：</strong>第一步决定切分边界，第二步才根据词表给片段取整数编号.en: Key difference: the first step decides the split boundaries; only the second gives the fragments integer IDs from the vocabulary.

容易误解：</strong>编号是地址，1不意味着比3更重要。.en: Easy to misread: an ID is an address; 1 does not mean more important than 3.

使用已经准备好的分词器时，不会每收到一句话都重新统计整个世界的文本。它按固定规则.en: When a tokenizer that has already been prepared is used, it does not recount all the text in the world every time a sentence arrives. It splits the new input into existing fragments by fixed rules and looks their IDs up. A real implementation also has pre-tokenization, special markers and possibly normalization steps; it is not to be read as splitting words at will.

为什么代码很难按字符数估算Token？因为.en: Why is it so hard for code to estimate tokens from a character count? Because

的可用子词组合不同；换行、缩进和空格也可能影响切分。<strong>实际预算要使.en: have different subword combinations available; newlines, indentation and spaces can affect the split too. A real budget has to use the counting rules of the model in question; the teaching vocabulary is only there to explain the mechanism.

聊天角色怎样成为输入的一部分.en: How a chat role becomes part of the input

聊天原来是带角色的消息，比如“用户问什么”“助手答什么”。<strong>聊天模.en: Chat starts out as messages with roles — "what the user asks", "what the assistant answers". A chat template is what organizes those roles and the body into the form the model knew during training. The template may add control markers for the start of a role and the end of a message, and those markers can take up tokens too.

关键区别：</strong>BPE等方法先学规则，再使用规则；在线推理一般不是当.en: Key difference: methods such as BPE learn the rules first and then use them; online inference generally does not retrain the vocabulary on the spot.

容易误解：</strong>遇到新词不会每次重排已有词表编号。.en: Easy to misread: meeting a new word does not reorder the existing vocabulary IDs each time.

普通字符串里写“system:”不自动等于真正的系统角色；模型接口如何组织消息，.en: Writing "system:" in an ordinary string does not automatically make it a real system role; how the model interface organizes messages decides how the service handles it. Concatenating the chat bubbles a person sees, word for word, is no ground for claiming to have reproduced a commercial service's final input.

编码后还没发生什么.en: What has not happened yet once encoding is done

时，只是找到了编号；还没有得到每个位置的上下文表示，没有计算下一Token概率，.en: , all that has been found is the IDs; there is no contextual representation for each position yet, no next-token probability has been computed, and no external file has been read. Tokenization converts the representation; it is not "understanding completed".

编码后还没发生什么：逐项辨别.en: What has not happened yet once encoding is done: item by item

关键区别：</strong>这些内容由宿主按消息角色和模型接口组织后，再进入模型.en: Key difference: the harness organizes this content by message role and by the model interface, and only then does it enter the model's input sequence.

容易误解：</strong>聊天气泡没有显示的内容不应被猜成具体厂商内部模板。.en: Easy to misread: what the chat bubbles do not show should not be guessed at as a particular vendor's internal template.

反向解码也要注意边界：有的处理会折叠大小写或规范化文本；有的Token单独解码不.en: Decoding back has its boundaries too: some processing folds case or normalizes the text, and some tokens decoded on their own are not complete characters. In code tasks, keep "means the same" apart from "the same original bytes".

把“我爱学习”编码，再原样解码.en: Encode "我爱学习", then decode it back unchanged

输入与条件。</strong>固定教学词表：.en: Input and conditions. A fixed teaching vocabulary:

；本例明确把“学习”视为一个Token。它不代表某家模型的真实分词。.en: ; this example explicitly treats "学习" as one token. It does not stand for any particular model's real tokenization.

“我爱学习”切成“我／爱／学习”.en: "我爱学习" is split into "我/爱/学习"

四个汉字、三个Token，字符数与Token数不同。.en: Four Chinese characters, three tokens: the character count and the token count differ.

依次查词表.en: Look each one up in the vocabulary in turn

，还没有查Embedding。.en: , and the embedding has not been looked up yet.

；两句话里的“爱”编号相同。.en: ; "爱" has the same ID in both sentences.

反向查词表.en: Look the vocabulary up in reverse

按本例拼接规则恢复“我爱学习”。.en: Joining by this example's rule restores "我爱学习".

“我”的UTF-8字节是十六进制.en: The UTF-8 bytes of "我" in hexadecimal are

这是字符存储，不是Token编号1，也不是Embedding的特征。.en: This is character storage; it is not the token ID 1, and it is not an embedding feature.

把过程连起来。</strong>先给分词规则，再给词表编号，才能知道列表究竟代表.en: Join the steps up. The tokenization rule has to be given first, then the vocabulary IDs, before you can know which sentence a list actually stands for. Do not guess at the meaning of text from the size of the integers.

边界与反例。</strong>真实分词器还涉及空格、字节、特殊Token及规范化.en: Limits and counterexamples. A real tokenizer also involves spaces, bytes, special tokens and normalization; this example verifies only the encoding chain of this one explicit vocabulary.

BPE合并时，为什么不是总选左边那一对.en: When BPE merges, why the pair on the left is not always the one chosen

输入与条件。</strong>输入字符序列[a,b,c]。假定已学习到两条合并规.en: Input and conditions. The input character sequence is [a,b,c]. Suppose two merge rules have been learned: b+c at priority 0 and a+b at priority 1, the smaller number taking precedence. In the vocabulary a has ID 1 and bc has ID 5.

当前相邻对为(a,b)和(b,c).en: The adjacent pairs at this point are (a,b) and (b,c)

分别查到优先级1和0。.en: Their priorities come out as 1 and 0.

序列变成[a,bc]，不能同时再用原来的(a,b)，因为b已经被合入bc。.en: The sequence becomes [a,bc]; the original (a,b) cannot be used as well, because b has already been merged into bc.

假设没有该合并规则，停止。.en: Supposing there is no merge rule for it, this stops.

输出[1,5]，不是[编号ab,编号c]。.en: The output is [1,5], not [ID of ab, ID of c].

把过程连起来。</strong>BPE推理使用已经学到的规则顺序；原始相邻位置不.en: Join the steps up. BPE at inference time uses the order of the rules it has already learned; the original adjacency is not the merge priority. After each merge, which candidates are adjacent changes.

边界与反例。</strong>字符是教学基本单位，实际byte-level BP.en: Limits and counterexamples. The character is the basic unit for teaching here; a real byte-level BPE may start from bytes, and it still has to respect special tokens and pre-tokenization rules.

“学习”在教学词表占一个Token，现实所有模型也一样吗？.en: "学习" takes one token in the teaching vocabulary — is that so for every real model too?

不一样。具体切分依赖对应分词器和上下文规则，不能由这个演示推断。.en: No. The actual split depends on the tokenizer in question and on its context rules, and cannot be inferred from this demonstration.

Token编号5和编号1的距离是4，能说明语义距离吗？.en: The distance between token ID 5 and ID 1 is 4 — does that say anything about semantic distance?

不能。编号用于定位词表条目，语义表示由后续参数和计算决定。.en: No. An ID is for locating a vocabulary entry; the semantic representation is decided by the parameters and the computation that follow.

“我爱学习”和“你爱”的长短句只用于理解补齐，PAD并不增加真实文字。贯通训练固.en: The long and short sentences "我爱学习" and "你爱" serve only to explain padding; PAD adds no real text. The worked training run always uses the two complete samples "我爱学习！" and "你爱学习！", with BOS/EOS added; they are the same length. The complete samples, the inputs and the labels are all set out explicitly below, and the IDs of the padding example are never treated as the training record of another model.

为了整齐补上的PAD，会不会被模型误当成内容？.en: Will PAD, added to make things tidy, be mistaken by the model for content?

组批像把几张试卷一起送进机器，但每张试卷仍单独计算。补齐让它们占用同样多的位置；.en: Batching is like feeding several exam papers into the machine together, yet each paper is still marked on its own. Padding makes them occupy the same number of positions; the table of valid positions tells the model which cells are only filler. A tidy array shape is no substitute for the real length information.

本批几条输入。.en: How many inputs there are in this batch.

数组为每条输入安排了多少位置。.en: How many positions the array allots to each input.

占位符，不是原文中新增的词。.en: A placeholder, not a word added to the original text.

输入与适用条件：</strong>B=2，T=3，右侧补齐。可见性、取输出位置必.en: Input and conditions of use:B=2, T=3, padding on the right. Visibility and the choice of output position have to agree with this convention.

组批没有把两句话混成一句：长度不同.en: Batching does not blend two sentences into one: the lengths differ

第一句三个位置，第二句两个位置。两句话仍各自独立。.en: The first sentence has three positions, the second two. The two sentences still stand apart from each other.

许多张量运算要求规则形状，组批可提高设备利用。.en: Many tensor operations require regular shapes, and batching can improve device utilization.

短句补位，同时携带真实长度和匹配的mask；生成接口的左右补齐要求应另行核对。.en: Short sentences are padded out while still carrying their true length and a matching mask; which side a generation interface requires padding on must be checked separately.

只补0却不屏蔽；或者无条件取最后一列，都可能改变短句结果。.en: Padding with 0 but not masking, or taking the last column unconditionally, can each change the result for a short sentence.

把同一句分别单独推理和混合长度组批，核对其有效位置输出。.en: Runs the same sentence alone and then in a batch of mixed lengths, and checks its output at the valid positions.

“组批”就是让若干条输入一起处理.en: "Batching" means letting several inputs be processed together

一次只处理“我爱学习”，是单条输入。把“我爱学习”和“你爱”放在同一次计算中，叫.en: Processing "我爱学习" on its own is a single input. Putting "我爱学习" and "你爱" into the same computation is called a batch. This batch holds 2 inputs, so the batch size is B=2

关键区别：</strong>组批是把多条输入组织在同一次设备运算里；不是把两条句.en: Key difference: Batching organizes several inputs into one device computation; it does not join two sentences into a single one.

容易误解：</strong>同批的不同用户输入不能因此共享注意力上下文。.en: Easy to misread: Different users' inputs in the same batch do not thereby share an attention context.

它们还是两条独立输入，不是把第二句话接到第一句话后面。批轴提供“一起调度”的组织.en: They are still two independent inputs; the second sentence is not appended to the first. The batch axis provides a way of organizing them to be "scheduled together", and the standard independent-sample computation does not let two samples read each other's content. Batching is never a reason to mix different users' contexts together.

上一课的两条编号是：.en: The two ID sequences from the previous lesson are:

如果要放成规则的矩形表，每一行需一样长。我们把本批安排的长度设为T=3，给第二条.en: To lay them out as a regular rectangular table, every row has to be the same length. We set the length allotted for this batch to T=3 and pad the second row with one placeholder ID 0:

Padding（补齐）</strong>是在短输入中增加占位项，不是在原话中补出.en: Padding adds placeholder items to a short input; it does not add meaningful new content to the original words. ID 0 happens to be PAD in this book; a real model may use a different PAD ID, and may need it handled according to the model configuration.

真实长度与安排长度不是一回事.en: A true length and an allotted length are not the same thing

第二条真实长度仍是2，表里安排了3个位置。若生产系统把本批都补到128，形状就会.en: The second row's true length is still 2, while the table allots 3 positions. If a production system padded this whole batch to 128, the shape would be

；这不证明两条原话都含128个Token。.en: ; this is no proof that either original sentence contains 128 tokens.

关键区别：</strong>把短句补到相同长度，得到[[1,2,3],[4,2,.en: Key difference: Padding the shorter sentence to the same length gives [[1,2,3],[4,2,0]].

容易误解：</strong>PAD是占位，不是原句里的文字。.en: Easy to misread: PAD is a placeholder, not text from the original sentence.

逐格算清：两句话组批后，哪里是真实内容，哪里只是占位.en: Worked out cell by cell: once the two sentences are batched, which cells are real content and which are only placeholders

两行三列的批次，第二句末尾是PAD，不是原文.en: A batch of two rows and three columns, where the end of the second sentence is PAD, not original text

步骤 1</span><span>第一句“我／爱／学习”有三个真实Token：编.en: Step 1The first sentence, "我/爱/学习", has three real tokens: IDs [1,2,3].

步骤 2</span><span>第二句“你／爱”只有两个真实Token：编号[.en: Step 2The second sentence, "你/爱", has only two real tokens: IDs [4,2].

步骤 3</span><span>为组批补一个PAD，得到[4,2,0]；PAD.en: Step 3One PAD is added for batching, giving [4,2,0]; the PAD is not part of the original text.

步骤 4</span><span>有效位置标记分别是[1,1,1]与[1,1,0.en: Step 4The valid-position markers are [1,1,1] and [1,1,0] respectively.

第二行原文只有“你／爱”，末尾PAD帮助对齐计算形状，不计入真实Token长度。.en: The second row's original text is only "你/爱"; the PAD at its end helps align the shape of the computation and does not count toward the true token length.

为了告诉后续计算哪些位置是真实内容，另配一张标记表：.en: To tell the later computation which positions are real content, a second marker table goes with it:

这里1表示真实位置，0表示填充位置。这是后面<strong>padding ma.en: Here 1 marks a real position and 0 a padding position. This is the basis of the padding mask that comes later. For now, read "mask" as a marker that decides whether an item may take part in a computation; the full attention mask has to wait until F12 for its rows and columns to be explained properly.

两句话怎样变成十道训练题.en: How two sentences become ten training questions

input_ids：送入前向计算的编号.en: input_ids: the IDs fed into the forward computation

整数表，不是Embedding，也不是概率。.en: A table of integers — not an embedding, and not probabilities.

targets：各输入位置需要预测的下一项.en: targets: the next item each input position has to predict

标签不作为同位置的输入；它在前向得到分数后才参与损失计算。.en: A label is not the input at the same position; it enters the loss computation only after the forward pass has produced the scores.

我（另一条样本为你）.en: 我 (你 in the other sample)

BOS 我 爱 学习.en: BOS 我 爱 学习

。两者都能表达“你爱”，但真实位置所在列不同。.en: . Both can express "你爱", but the real positions sit in different columns.

补左边和补右边有什么区别：逐项辨别.en: What difference does padding on the left or the right make: item by item

关键区别：</strong>真实有效长度与占位后的数组宽度都要保留；掩码依赖有效.en: Key difference: Both the true valid length and the array width after padding have to be kept; the mask depends on the valid positions.

容易误解：</strong>数组有3列不代表第二句有3个真实Token。.en: Easy to misread: An array with 3 columns does not mean the second sentence has 3 real tokens.

如果程序总取“最后一列的预测”继续生成，右补齐行的最后一列是PAD，就可能取错位.en: If a program always takes "the prediction in the last column" to continue generating, the last column of a right-padded row is PAD, and the wrong position may be taken. Some decoding flows therefore require left padding, or require the last valid position to be selected by the true length. Which strategy is correct depends on the generation code and the model's conventions, so neither side can be called the universally best approach.

本书基础算例用右补齐，因为对初读者直观；若用于生成，明确取每行最后一个有效位置，.en: This book's foundation examples use right padding because it is intuitive for a first reading; when generating, take the last valid position of each row explicitly, and do not simply copy

补齐不等于截断，更不等于上下文压缩.en: Padding is not truncation, and still less is it context compaction

补齐增加占位；<strong>截断</strong>删掉过长输入的部分内容；<s.en: Padding adds placeholders; truncation deletes part of an over-long input; summary compaction tries to replace a long history with a shorter description. Deleting real content can make a rule or a piece of evidence disappear; padding has no such purpose.

补齐不等于截断，更不等于上下文压缩：逐项辨别.en: Padding is not truncation, and still less is it context compaction: item by item

位置与读出位置不同.en: The positions and the read-out position differ

关键区别：</strong>补齐方向改变有效Token在数组中的下标，解码时需要.en: Key difference: The padding side changes the index of a valid token in the array, and decoding has to handle that accordingly.

容易误解：</strong>不该盲目取最后一列当成最后有效Token。.en: Easy to misread: The last column should not be taken blindly as the last valid token.

组批也不总要把所有请求凑成同一个长方形。高性能推理可以采用长度分组或变长组织方式.en: Batching also does not always have to force every request into the same rectangle. High-performance inference can group by length or organize variable lengths. This lesson uses an ordinary dense table to explain shape, and does not dress it up as the real internal storage of every service.

为什么组批可能快，也可能让一个人等更久.en: Why batching can be faster, and can also make one person wait longer

同一套参数能够在多条输入上一起运算，可能更充分利用硬件。但为了凑够一批而等待，会.en: One set of parameters can compute over several inputs at once, which may use the hardware more fully. But waiting to fill a batch adds to the waiting time of some request. There is another kind of waste: padding one input of length 2 and one of length 1000 both to 1000 produces a great many padding positions.

为什么组批可能快，也可能让一个人等更久：逐项辨别.en: Why batching can be faster, and can also make one person wait longer: item by item

Truncation：丢一段内容.en: Truncation: drop a stretch of content

关键区别：</strong>三个操作都可能改变输入长度，但丢失信息的机制完全不同.en: Key difference: All three operations can change the input length, but they lose information by entirely different mechanisms.

容易误解：</strong>不要把“短了”就统一称为压缩。.en: Easy to misread: Do not call everything that "got shorter" compaction.

因此B、T不是越大越好。B说明并行组织了多少条，T影响每条安排多少位置；后续还要.en: So larger B and T are not simply better. B says how many inputs are organized in parallel; T affects how many positions each one is allotted. Hardware, caches and queues come into the discussion later. For now it is enough to be able to write out the ID table and the valid-position table from a real input.

为什么“你爱”最后有个0，但没有多出一个词.en: Why "你爱" has a 0 at the end without gaining an extra word

输入与条件。</strong>第一句“我爱学习”是.en: Input and conditions. The first sentence, "我爱学习", is

。希望把它们放进同一个两行表。.en: . We want to put them into the same two-row table.

两句分别有3和2个Token.en: The two sentences have 3 and 2 tokens

统一安排长度3，不能把真实长度都改记成3。.en: Allot a common length of 3; the true lengths must not both be recorded as 3.

第二行末尾放PAD编号0.en: Put PAD, ID 0, at the end of the second row

CPU与GPU可先理解成不同的计算场地。数据必须到达实际执行算子的设备，才能参与.en: The CPU and the GPU can be taken, to begin with, as different places where computation happens. Data has to reach the device that actually runs the operator before it can take part in the computation; moving it there does not make it cleverer. The data type decides how each number is stored, what range it can represent and at what precision — it is not enough to say "the number is still the same number".

字节</strong>内存占用的计量单位。.en: Byte the unit in which memory use is measured.

精度</strong>数值表示的细致程度；低精度会有舍入。.en: PrecisionHow finely a value is represented; low precision brings rounding.

数据搬到GPU，改变的是位置而不是含义：先数对象.en: Moving data to the GPU changes where it is, not what it means: count the objects first

编号表与特征表不是同一种数据：这里6个整数编号、24个浮点特征。.en: A table of IDs and a table of features are not the same kind of data: here there are 6 integer IDs and 24 floating-point features.

当速度被搬运限制时，继续加计算核心可能收益很小。.en: When speed is limited by movement, adding more compute cores may gain very little.

分开数参数、激活、缓存和传输；再测算子与数据传输耗时。.en: Count parameters, activations, cache and transfer separately; then measure how long the operators and the data transfers take.

低精度不保证所有算子更快；异步GPU未同步时的计时还会低估真实耗时。.en: Low precision does not make every operator faster, and timing an asynchronous GPU without synchronizing underestimates the real time taken.

核对字节数、数据类型、设备位置，并用正确的同步方式测量。.en: Check the byte count, the dtype and the device location, and measure with the correct synchronization.
