的数据，要分别问：它怎么排列（shape）、每个数怎样存（dtype）、存在哪里.en: and ask, separately: how is it laid out (shape), how is each number stored (dtype), and where does it live and what computes it (device). None of the three can stand in for another.

同一个数有三种不同的问题：逐项辨别.en: One and the same number raises three different questions: item by item

关键区别：</strong>同一个值可以用不同类型保存，也可以位于不同设备；它们.en: Key difference: One value can be stored in different types and can sit on different devices; these are separate properties.

容易误解：</strong>搬到GPU不会自动把整数变成语义向量。.en: Easy to misread: Moving something to the GPU does not automatically turn an integer into a semantic vector.

是执行通用程序的处理器；.en: is the processor that runs general-purpose programs;

擅长在合适的运算上并行处理大量数字。<strong>设备device</stro.en: is good at processing large quantities of numbers in parallel on suitable operations. Device is the notion a computing framework uses to identify where execution or storage happens, for example the CPU or a particular GPU. Putting data on the GPU does not automatically make it more meaningful; it only lets that hardware carry out the computation that follows.

整数编号与浮点特征为何类型不同.en: Why an integer ID and a floating-point feature have different types

Token ID用于找表中哪一行，通常采用框架支持的整数类型；Embedding.en: A token ID is used to find which row of a table, and usually takes an integer type the framework supports; embedding weights and outputs commonly use a floating-point type. A floating-point number is a way of approximating a value with a fractional part using a finite number of bits; it is not a real number of arbitrary precision.

整数编号与浮点特征为何类型不同：逐项辨别.en: Why an integer ID and a floating-point feature have different types: item by item

关键区别：</strong>编号用于索引，参数和激活用于乘加，常见数据类型由用途.en: Key difference: IDs are for indexing while parameters and activations are for multiply-add, and the usual data type follows the use.

容易误解：</strong>不是所有模型数据都是一个dtype，也不是所有东西都.en: Easy to misread: Not all of a model's data shares one dtype, and not everything sits in VRAM.

表示每个整数用64位，即8字节；.en: means 64 bits per integer, that is 8 bytes;

通常每个数用32位，即4字节；FP16和BF16各用16位，即2字节，但指数和有.en: usually uses 32 bits per number, that is 4 bytes; FP16 and BF16 each use 16 bits, that is 2 bytes, but they arrange the exponent and the significant digits differently, so the range and the fineness cannot be read off the bit count alone. Which types an operator actually supports depends on the implementation.

改变类型会改变内存与数值误差；改变shape是改变排列解释；改变device是改.en: Changing the type changes the memory use and the numeric error; changing the shape changes how the layout is read; changing the device changes where execution happens. These are not the same act.

对较大规模的表示算一遍存储.en: Work the storage out for a larger representation

共有256个编号。按int64存储，仅编号数据为.en: holds 256 IDs in all. Stored as int64, the ID data alone comes to

关键区别：</strong>先算元素数量再乘每个元素所占字节，得到这份激活张量占.en: Key difference: Count the elements first, then multiply by the bytes each element takes, to get what this activation tensor occupies.

容易误解：</strong>这个2MiB只描述一份张量，不能代替整个模型显存预算.en: Easy to misread: This 2 MiB describes one tensor only and cannot stand in for the whole model's VRAM budget.

有1,048,576个数。若每个占2字节，仅这份结果为2,097,152字节，即.en: holds 1,048,576 numbers. At 2 bytes each, this result alone comes to 2,097,152 bytes, that is 2 MiB. MiB counts in units of 1024, with 1 MiB=1024×1024 bytes; a decimal MB is 1,000,000 bytes.

这不是整个模型只需2 MiB。</strong> E本身、所有层权重、中间结果、.en: This does not mean the whole model needs only 2 MiB. E itself, all the layer weights, the intermediate results, the KV cache and the runtime workspace have yet to be counted. Estimating memory means listing the objects, not inferring total VRAM from the size of one tensor.

一次常见执行的实际顺序.en: The actual order of one common execution

程序先准备模型参数和计算环境，再把本批ID与必要标记交给计算框架。对于独立显存的.en: The program first prepares the model parameters and the computing environment, then hands this batch's IDs and the necessary markers to the computing framework. For a GPU with its own VRAM, the data taking part in the computation has to be arranged onto a compatible device; otherwise the framework may report a device mismatch rather than quietly doing every move for you.

一次常见执行的实际顺序：逐项辨别.en: The actual order of one common execution: item by item

把参数/数据放到执行设备.en: Put the parameters and data on the executing device

关键区别：</strong>“放设备”和“查表”是可拆开的操作；实际实现和内存移.en: Key difference: "Putting it on the device" and "looking it up" are separable operations; the actual implementation and the memory-movement strategy differ between frameworks.

容易误解：</strong>不要写死“先复制所有数据然后才开始算”作为所有系统唯.en: Easy to misread: Do not fix "copy all the data first, then start computing" as the one flow every system follows.

随后调用Embedding操作：根据ID读取权重表对应行，生成本批表示。接着运行.en: The embedding operation is then called: it reads the matching rows of the weight table by ID and produces this batch's representation. The network's matrix computations follow. Once generation is over, some results are fetched back to the CPU for text processing or display in the interface.

这只是常见逻辑次序，不是所有底层系统都真的进行同样的物理复制。统一内存、模型分片.en: This is only the common logical order; not every underlying system really performs the same physical copies. Unified memory, model sharding and offloading change the details. This lesson establishes the idea that "a computation needs access to the data" first.

数据类型和设备是实现条件，不是语义.en: Data type and device are implementation conditions, not meaning

本模型在CPU使用float64，方便手算与有限差分核对；并不是语言模型部署都应.en: This model uses float64 on the CPU, which makes hand calculation and finite-difference checks easy; it is not that every language model deployment should use float64. IDs are integers; parameters and activations are floating point. Putting them on the GPU only changes where the computing happens, whereas quantization changes the numeric representation; the two are not the same operation.

本实验没有偏置，没有Dropout，没有输入输出权重共享。后续公式中看不到b不是.en: This experiment has no bias, no dropout and no shared input-output weights. The absence of b from the formulas that follow is not an omission; if the model is changed to a real one that includes these modules, the computation has to be completed accordingly. The configuration and the weight file must be read together: the single name "Transformer" is not enough to settle the structure.

为什么小任务放GPU有时不快.en: Why putting a small task on the GPU is sometimes not faster

传输、调度和启动一次运算都有成本。若真正的计算只有几个数字，准备与搬运可能比计算.en: Transfer, scheduling and launching a computation all cost something. If the real computation is only a few numbers, the preparation and the moving can cost more than the computation itself. Strong GPU throughput does not mean low latency for every small operation.

为什么小任务放GPU有时不快：逐项辨别.en: Why putting a small task on the GPU is sometimes not faster: item by item

GPU计算需传输/调度.en: A GPU computation needs transfer and scheduling

总耗时可能不降.en: The total time may not come down

关键区别：</strong>GPU单次算得快，但小任务的启动、搬运和同步可能占主.en: Key difference: A single GPU computation is fast, but for a small task the launch, the moving and the synchronization can dominate.

容易误解：</strong>单看理论算力不能预测端到端请求延迟。.en: Easy to misread: Theoretical compute alone does not predict end-to-end request latency.

还有一个常见计时陷阱：某些GPU调用是异步的，即CPU发出指令后即可继续，GPU.en: There is another common timing trap: some GPU calls are asynchronous, so the CPU can carry on as soon as it has issued the instruction while the GPU has not finished. Timing only up to the function's return may measure the time to "queue the instruction" rather than the time to finish computing. Measuring performance requires waiting as the framework prescribes, or using a device timing mechanism.

现在把“组批、放设备、查表”连起来.en: Now join up "batching, putting it on the device, looking it up"

组批解决“这次一起算哪些输入”；补齐和标记解决“不同长度怎么摆”；device解.en: Batching settles "which inputs are computed together this time"; padding and markers settle "how different lengths are laid out"; device settles "where it is computed"; dtype settles "how each number is stored"; embedding settles "which row of numbers an ID corresponds to". Each step has a different job, so each kind of error is diagnosed differently.

48字节，只算数据本体。.en: 48 bytes, counting the data itself only.

96字节；维度和dtype共同决定占用。.en: 96 bytes; the dimensions and the dtype together decide the footprint.

把相同数据搬到另一设备.en: Move the same data to another device

；搬运不等于自动增加语义。.en: ; moving it does not add meaning by itself.

本体48字节，但小数可能发生舍入；这与单纯搬设备不同。.en: 48 bytes for the data itself, but the decimals may be rounded; this differs from simply moving devices.

ID有256个整数；输出有1,048,576个数，FP16为2,097,152字.en: The IDs are 256 integers; the output is 1,048,576 numbers, which in FP16 is 2,097,152 bytes, that is 2 MiB.

把过程连起来。</strong>先问存几个数，再问每数几字节，最后问在哪个设备；.en: Join the steps up. Ask first how many numbers are stored, then how many bytes each number takes, and last which device they are on; these three must not be rolled into one "the dimensions got bigger".

边界与反例。</strong>估算不包括张量对象、分配器、模型权重、缓存和中间结.en: Limits and counterexamples. The estimate excludes the tensor objects, the allocator, the model weights, the cache and the intermediate results; it is not the VRAM needed to run the whole model.

shape[2,3,4]的float32数据本体多少字节？.en: How many bytes is the data itself for float32 with shape [2,3,4]?

24个数，每个4字节，共96字节；不含对象元数据或其他模型存储。.en: 24 numbers at 4 bytes each, 96 bytes in all; object metadata and the model's other storage are not included.

把CPU数据搬到GPU会改变Token编号的语义吗？.en: Does moving CPU data to the GPU change what a token ID means?

不会。它改变计算位置。精度转换可能改变浮点值，但设备迁移本身不是语义学习。.en: No. It changes where the computation happens. A precision conversion can change a floating-point value, but moving devices is not itself semantic learning.

关键区别：</strong>没有非线性的多个线性层可以合并成一次仿射变换，表达能.en: Key difference: without a nonlinearity, several linear layers can be merged into one affine transformation, which limits the expressive power.

容易误解：</strong>ReLU不是“只为了把负数删掉”的任意装饰。.en: Easy to misread: ReLU is not an arbitrary decoration "just there to delete the negative numbers".

常用定义是GELU(x)=xΦ(x)，Φ是标准正态分布的累计概率函数。它让负输入.en: The common definition is GELU(x)=xΦ(x), where Φ is the cumulative probability function of the standard normal distribution. It keeps negative and positive inputs to different degrees; it is not random sampling. An implementation may also use an approximate formula.<span class="concept-micro">Independent micro-example: Φ(0)=0.5, so GELU(0)=0. Φ here is not a learnable parameter table of the model.

实际Transformer常用GELU、SiLU或带门的前馈结构。先懂“为什么要.en: Real Transformers commonly use GELU, SiLU or a gated feed-forward structure. Understand "why there has to be a nonlinearity" first and read the particular function afterwards; there is no need to memorize every formula the first time you meet the name.

隐藏状态不是隐藏的中文草稿.en: The hidden state is not a hidden draft in words

是一次计算结果，不是一句被藏起来的“我想到了答案”。语言模型里，一个Token通.en: is the result of one computation, not a hidden "I have thought of the answer". In a language model, the row of numbers a token comes out with after passing through a layer is also called a hidden state. It carries information useful to the computation that follows, but each coordinate cannot be translated directly into a sentence of explanation.

隐藏状态不是隐藏的中文草稿：逐项辨别.en: The hidden state is not a hidden draft in words: item-by-item distinctions

关键区别：</strong>内部数值表示、固定参数和人能看到的句子属于不同阶段。.en: Key difference: the internal numeric representation, the fixed parameters and the sentence a person can see belong to different stages.

容易误解：</strong>不能把隐藏状态解释成“模型已经写好的中文草稿”。.en: Easy to misread: a hidden state must not be read as "a draft the model has already written out in words".

d表示每个位置的隐藏宽度；L常表示层数；参数总量与所有矩阵的尺寸和共享方式有关。.en: d is the hidden width at each position; L usually stands for the number of layers; the total number of parameters depends on the sizes of all the matrices and on how they are shared. d=4096 does not mean there are only 4096 parameters. A single

同一个W可以作用于同批每条输入、每个Token位置，叫共享权重。它不意味着共享各.en: The same W can be applied to every input in a batch and to every token position; that is called weight sharing. It does not mean the computed results are shared between positions. With different inputs, the intermediate states still differ.

“冻结参数”表示训练时不更新某些参数；“推理使用固定权重”表示本次计算不执行更新.en: "Freezing parameters" means some parameters are not updated during training; "inference uses fixed weights" means this computation performs no update. Some model services do train a new version at some other time, but correcting a mistake in an ordinary conversation is not the same thing as online training.

为什么注意力前面先处理一排数.en: Why a row of numbers is processed before attention

隐藏状态的数值尺度会变化。归一化层按每个位置内部的特征统计量调整尺度，让后续模块.en: The numeric scale of a hidden state varies. A normalization layer adjusts that scale from the feature statistics inside each position, so that the modules after it face a more controlled input; it does not turn the row into probabilities, and it does not make the four numbers add up to 1. The range RMSNorm normalizes over is the feature axis, not the whole sentence, and certainly not the whole batch.

本模型采用pre-norm：先对X做RMSNorm，再送入注意力；保留的残差主路.en: This model uses pre-norm: RMSNorm is applied to X first and the result is fed into attention; the residual main path that is kept is still the original X, which is not replaced outright by the normalized values.

对“爱”这一行完整算一次.en: Working the row for 爱 through once in full

，d=4，ε=0.00001，初始缩放g1全是1。.en: , with d=4, ε=0.00001, and the initial scaling g1 all ones.

四个数分别平方。.en: Square each of the four numbers.

相加再除以4，得到平方的平均值。.en: Add them and divide by 4 to get the mean of the squares.

加ε，再开平方，得到r。.en: Add ε and take the square root to get r.

每个原值除以r，再乘对应可学习缩放g1[j]。.en: Divide each original value by r, then multiply by the matching learnable scaling g1[j].

r是本次输入算出的中间值；ε是为数值稳定设置的常数；g1是参与训练的参数。三者来.en: r is an intermediate value computed from this input; ε is a constant set for numerical stability; g1 is a parameter that takes part in training. The three come from different places. With the next input, r is computed again; ordinary inference does not update g1 because r changed.

LayerNorm的“均值、方差”多做了什么.en: What the "mean and variance" of LayerNorm do beyond that

下面是<strong>独立的二数对照</strong>，只为比较统计规则，不接续.en: What follows is an independent two-number comparison, only for comparing the statistical rules; it does not continue the worked model. The fixed input is

，不再改成另一组数。均值μ=2，偏差是[-1,1]，平方偏差[1,1]，总体方差.en: , and is not changed to another set of numbers. The mean is μ=2, the deviations are [-1,1], the squared deviations [1,1], and the population variance is their mean, 1; the standard deviation is 1 when ε is not added.

LayerNorm先减μ，再除.en: LayerNorm subtracts μ first, then divides by

，初始gamma=1、beta=0时约为[-0.999995,0.999995].en: , which with the initial gamma=1 and beta=0 gives about [-0.999995,0.999995]. RMSNorm does not subtract the mean; the mean of the squares is 5, and the result is about [0.447213,1.341639]. That is why everything can still be positive after RMSNorm: it never promised a zero mean.

同一输入[1,3]，两种规则不是同一个运算.en: The same input [1,3]: the two rules are not the same operation

[1,3] → 减均值2 → [-1,1] → 除sqrt(1+ε) → 再乘g.en: [1,3] → subtract the mean 2 → [-1,1] → divide by sqrt(1+ε) → then multiply by gamma and add beta.

[1,3] → 计算sqrt((1²+3²)/2+ε) → 用原值去除 → 再乘.en: [1,3] → compute sqrt((1²+3²)/2+ε) → divide the original values by it → then multiply by g.

这里ε统一为1e-5。贯通模型只采用RMSNorm，LayerNorm数据仅作为.en: ε is 1e-5 throughout here. The worked model uses RMSNorm only; the LayerNorm numbers serve as an independent comparison and nothing more.

为什么不能把它当作softmax.en: Why it must not be treated as a softmax

softmax在候选轴上产生非负份额，和为1；RMSNorm允许负数，也不要求和.en: softmax produces non-negative shares along the candidate axis that sum to 1; RMSNorm allows negative numbers and requires no sum of 1. The softmax over an attention row distributes the read shares among the visible keys; the softmax at the output distributes predicted probability among the vocabulary candidates. Both may be called "normalization", yet their goal and their axis are entirely different.

训练与推理是否重新计算统计量.en: Whether training and inference recompute the statistics

本模型两者都按每个位置当前的四个特征计算r。RMSNorm和LayerNorm不.en: In this model both compute r from the four features the position currently has. RMSNorm and LayerNorm do not depend on a cross-sample running mean of the kind BatchNorm uses.

不代表它们停止算统计量，只代表切换那些<strong>确实具有训练／评估行为差别.en: does not mean they stop computing statistics; it only switches the mode of those modules that really do behave differently in training and in evaluation.

反向时r也依赖x，不能把它当常量只算.en: On the backward pass r depends on x as well, so it cannot be treated as a constant and computed as just

。系统机制中的对应推导会解释梯度里为什么多出一项。先牢记：x影响自己的分子，也影.en: . The matching derivation under System mechanisms explains why there is an extra term in the gradient. For now, hold on to this: x affects its own numerator, and it also affects the denominator shared by every feature.

追问：LayerNorm、RMSNorm和softmax都是归一化，为什么不可交.en: Follow-up: LayerNorm, RMSNorm and softmax are all normalization, so why are they not interchangeable?

归一化的轴、统计量与输出性质不同。norm处理每位置的隐藏特征尺度；softma.en: Normalization differs in its axis, its statistics and the nature of its output. A norm handles the scale of the hidden features at each position; softmax turns position scores or candidate scores into a non-negative distribution that sums to 1. Swapping them changes both the forward pass and the gradient.

为什么教材可以先给权重再讲训练.en: Why a textbook can give the weights before it teaches training

为了看懂内部运行，先拿已知权重走完前向。权重如何从大量例子中得到，放在第52—5.en: To follow what happens inside, take known weights and walk one forward pass through to the end. How those weights come from a large number of examples is explained in lessons 52–54. It is like understanding how an existing calculator produces its result before understanding how it was designed.

小模型数值例子能证明你理解了运算，但它没有经过语言数据训练，不能生成有意义的回答.en: A numeric example on a small model can show that you understand the operations, but it has not been trained on language data and cannot produce a meaningful answer. Do not call a network worked by hand "a reproduction of large-model intelligence".

固定参数做前向，与学习参数是两件事.en: A forward pass with fixed parameters and learning the parameters are two different things

输入与条件。</strong>一个小网络：输入x，第一层.en: Input and conditions. A small network: input x, first layer

。参数2、−3、4、1预先给定。.en: . The parameters 2, −3, 4 and 1 are given in advance.

ReLU把负数变为0，因此h=0。.en: ReLU turns the negative number into 0, so h=0.

h=1，输出y=5。.en: h=1, and the output is y=5.

两次使用同一组2、−3、4、1.en: Both times use the same 2, −3, 4 and 1

结果改变来自输入改变，不是网络刚刚更新了权重。.en: The result changed because the input changed, not because the network has just updated its weights.

x=2时希望y接近4.en: At x=2 we want y to be close to 4

还要计算损失和梯度，才能决定参数往哪边更新。.en: The loss and the gradient still have to be computed before it can be decided which way to update the parameters.

把过程连起来。</strong>前向是在已有规则下算结果；训练是在目标和误差指导.en: Join the steps up. The forward pass computes a result under the rules it already has; training changes those rules, guided by a target and an error. The h in between is a number, not a passage of hidden explanation.

边界与反例。</strong>ReLU示例只是两层标量网络，不是完整Transf.en: Limits and counterexamples. The ReLU example is only a two-layer scalar network, not a complete Transformer; a small network was chosen so that every step could be worked out exactly.

输入x变化时，w一定跟着变化吗？.en: When the input x changes, must w change along with it?

推理中通常不会。w是已有参数，变化的是中间状态和输出。训练才会根据损失更新参数。.en: Usually not, during inference. w is a parameter the model already has; what changes is the intermediate state and the output. Only training updates the parameters, according to the loss.

在正文二维网络x=[1,2]、第一层未激活值[3,-1]、第二层W2=[[2],.en: In the two-dimensional network in the main text, with x=[1,2], pre-activation values [3,-1] in the first layer and W2=[[2],[1]] in the second, what is the output once ReLU is removed? (Not the scalar worked run.)

隐藏值为[3,-1]，第二层得到3×2+(-1)×1=5。这说明激活函数实际改变.en: The hidden values are [3,-1], and the second layer gives 3×2+(-1)×1=5. This shows that the activation function really does change the computation.

把每条样本的全部T×d个数一起求RMS，和每位置沿d求RMS一样吗？.en: Is taking the RMS over all T×d numbers of a sample together the same as taking the RMS along d at each position?

不一样。前者使一个位置的尺度受到其他位置、甚至未来内容影响，改变了模型结构和因果.en: No. The first lets one position's scale be influenced by other positions, even by future content, which changes the structure of the model and its causal character. This model takes the statistics along the four features separately, for each sample and each position.

第46课｜Attention逐步计算：先算相关分数，再混合内容 — AI系统工程.en: Lesson 46｜Attention step by step: compute the relevance scores, then mix the content — AI Systems Engineering

。用同一行N1分别乘它们，才产生本次运行的Q、K、V。参数表不是当前读到哪些位置.en: . Multiplying the same row of N1 by each of them is what produces the Q, K and V of this run. A parameter table is not the shares of which positions are currently read; the shares are computed separately, once Q and K have been matched.

下面固定第0条训练输入.en: Below, training input 0 is fixed as

，观察位置2“爱”。这一行只能读取0、1、2三个位置；“学习”和“！”在张量中，.en: , and position 2, 爱 ("love"), is the one watched. That row can read only the three positions 0, 1 and 2; 学习 and ！ are in the tensor, but the current position is not allowed to peek at them. Every number comes from the same set of initialized weights, and is not mixed with the two-dimensional demonstration or with weights after training.

它想解决什么问题.en: What problem it is trying to solve

一个Token先由Embedding表换成一排数，但这还不够。“苹果很好吃”和“.en: A token is first turned into a row of numbers by the embedding table, but that is not enough. "Apples taste good" and "Apple released a computer" have to draw on different contexts. Attention is a stretch of numeric computation: for the current position it computes how much information to take from each readable position, and then mixes the information by those shares. It is not the model's eyes, and it is not three more agents that talk.

先抓住两件事：<strong>匹配时用什么来打分；打完分后实际拿什么来混合。</.en: Hold on to two things first: what is used to score the matching, and what is actually taken to be mixed once the scoring is done. Query, Key and Value are simply the numbers that carry those two separate jobs. What follows gives where they come from, and then works the whole process out. Source: the mechanism described in the original attention paper

Query、Key、Value各做哪一件事.en: What each of query, key and value does

现在把名字与对象连起来：.en: Now connect the names to the objects:

在当前计算中的职责.en: Its job in the current computation

当前接收信息的位置生成的一排数.en: A row of numbers produced by the position currently receiving information

分别与各位置的Key比较，为“读多少”打分.en: Compared with the key at each position, to score "how much to read"

不是用户输入的问句，也不是搜索字符串.en: Not a question typed by the user, and not a search string

每个可读位置生成的一排数.en: A row of numbers produced by each readable position

接受Query的比较，为这个位置提供匹配特征.en: Takes the query's comparison, supplying the matching features for this position

不是密钥，也不是从文字里直接摘出的关键词.en: Not a cryptographic key, and not a keyword lifted straight out of the text

每个可读位置生成的另一排数.en: Another row of numbers produced by each readable position

在份额确定后，提供真正参与加权求和的内容.en: Once the shares are fixed, supplies the content that actually enters the weighted sum

不是标准答案，也不是最终输出Token.en: Not the correct answer, and not the final output token

同一个位置可以<strong>同时当接收者和信息提供者</strong>。例如计.en: One position can be a receiver and a supplier of information at the same time. When the new representation for position 2, 爱, is computed, for instance, its query is compared with the keys of BOS, 我 and 爱, and the values of those three positions are then mixed by the resulting shares.

小写q、k、v是一行；大写Q、K、V是把所有位置各自的行摆成的表。</stron.en: Lowercase q, k and v are one row; uppercase Q, K and V are the tables made by laying out every position's own row. In the worked model each table has shape [2,5,4]: two samples, five positions, four features per position. They are intermediate representations obtained from the same N1 through different parameter transformations.

“分成三套参数”不意味着数学上不允许它们恰好相等。某些教学特例会设成相同矩阵；有.en: "Split into three sets of parameters" does not mean the mathematics forbids them from happening to be equal. Some teaching cases do set them to the same matrix, and some research architectures share parameters too. But the usual separate design lets the three paths learn different transformations. Whether the numbers are the same, and whether they are shared, has to be read off the particular example or model.

进入这一步时手里到底有什么.en: What exactly is in hand when this step begins

我们已经有整批X，并在F10的RMSNorm算例算出第一处归一化N1。现在并没有.en: We already have the whole batch X, and the first normalization N1 was computed in the RMSNorm example of F10. There is no user-question string "Query" here, no database key "Key", and no final answer "Value"; all that is in hand are tables of numbers. To compute "which positions the current position reads, and which features it takes back", the model multiplies that same N1 by each of three parameter tables.

初始化后参与训练的参数.en: A parameter that is initialized and then trained

把当前特征变成Query.en: Turns the current features into a query

把可读位置特征变成Key.en: Turns a readable position's features into a key

把可读位置特征变成Value.en: Turns a readable position's features into a value

N1分别乘上述参数的本次结果.en: This run's result of multiplying N1 by each of the parameters above

分别用于打分、被比较、提供混合内容.en: Used, respectively, to score, to be compared, and to supply the content for mixing

参数下标q、k、v只是用途名称，不表示再乘一个小写字母。<strong>这里Q=.en: The subscripts q, k and v on the parameters are only names for their use; they do not mean multiplying by another lowercase letter. Here Q=N1Wq, not X multiplied by Wq without normalization. Some conceptual formulas call "the representation fed into attention" X across the board, which can leave a reader thinking it must be the original embedding; this book always says which table it is.

Q/K/V逐路计算：同一输入，三张参数表.en: Q/K/V computed path by path: one input, three parameter tables

。先逐项计算每张参数表的第0列，再按同样规则计算其余三列：.en: . Compute column 0 of each parameter table term by term first, then compute the other three columns by the same rule:

q：用于发起匹配.en: q: used to initiate the matching

k：用于接受匹配.en: k: used to receive the matching

v：供后续混合的内容.en: v: the content supplied for the mixing that follows

为什么不是把原来一排数复制三份.en: Why it is not three copies of the original row of numbers

三张参数表不同，乘出来的特征组合就不同。模型可以分别学习：哪些特征适合判断相关性.en: The three parameter tables differ, so the feature combinations they produce differ. The model can learn separately which features suit judging relevance and which suit passing information on. The division of labor is fixed by the computation path; what the particular numbers do is formed by training — an engineer does not hard-code "syntax", "subject" or "emotion" into some dimension.

“q像一个请求、k像被查对象的匹配标签、v像可读取内容”只解释分工。实际并没有先.en: "q is like a request, k like the matching tag on the thing being looked up, and v like the content that can be read" only explains the division of labor. Nothing actually generates a search term in words first, and nothing looks up a database key by an exact string match. What comes next is a dot product giving continuous scores, and then several values mixed by their shares — not one single hit taken on its own.

一行与整张表的区别.en: The difference between one row and the whole table

Self-Attention的self指什么.en: What the self in self-attention refers to

它表示Q、K、V来自同一条序列的表示，不表示每个位置只能看自己。因果Decode.en: It means that Q, K and V come from the representation of one and the same sequence; it does not mean each position can see only itself. In a causal decoder, seeing only itself and earlier positions comes from an additional causal mask. Cross-attention can have Q from one sequence and K/V from another, a different relationship between the data sources, so this model's cache is no proof that it carries over unconditionally.

The four features are dotted along the feature axis, giving the score for one pair of positions; the different pairs form a row of scores, and softmax then runs along the key-position axis. The two sums run over different ranges.

第一条输入的五个位置是BOS、我、爱、学习、！。第2行正在为前缀“BOS 我 爱.en: The five positions of the first input are BOS, 我, 爱, 学习 and ！. Row 2 is building the representation for the prefix "BOS 我 爱", so s=0, 1 and 2 may be read and s=3 and 4 are forbidden.

注意力分数是模型计算.en: An attention score is the model's computation

Value是被混入的内容.en: Value is the content mixed in

关键区别：</strong>Mask不代表新的语义，而是限制哪些位置的分数能参与.en: Key difference: a mask does not stand for new meaning; it limits which positions' scores can take part in the softmax.

容易误解：</strong>把Mask当作新的词向量，会混淆规则和内容。.en: Easy to misread: taking a mask for a new word vector confuses the rule with the content.

填充标记、注意力可读关系、训练损失计分位置都可能被称为mask，但用途不同。看见.en: Padding markers, attention readability and the positions scored by the training loss can all be called a mask, yet they are put to different uses. When you see the word mask, ask first what it controls, rather than just memorizing a set of 0s and 1s.

因果限制怎样防止读未来.en: How the causal restriction prevents reading the future

三个位置0、1、2，在自回归训练和推理所用的因果注意力中，常见允许关系是：.en: For three positions 0, 1 and 2, the usual allowed relationship in the causal attention used by autoregressive training and inference is:

关键区别：</strong>因果掩码形成下三角“可见性表”，阻止未来信息泄漏。.en: Key difference: a causal mask forms a lower-triangular "visibility table" that stops future information from leaking.

容易误解：</strong>真实缓存时必须按绝对位置对齐，而不是机械复用左上三角.en: Easy to misread: with a real cache, alignment must follow absolute position, not reuse the upper-left triangle mechanically.

叫“因果”是因为当前位置不能依赖尚未发生的后续Token，不是在声称模型学到了现.en: It is called "causal" because the current position cannot depend on later tokens that have not happened yet, not because the model is claimed to have learned causal relationships in the real world. During training the whole answer can be fed in at once; the mask limits each position to its prefix, and the target is usually to predict the next token.

为什么完整句子都在内存里，却没有偷看答案.en: Why the whole sentence is in memory and yet the answer is not peeked at

把所有输入位置一次送入设备，是为了并行计算。因果掩码规定第t行只能读到.en: Feeding every input position to the device at once is for parallel computation. The causal mask lays down that row t can read only the positions

的Key。在预测“学习”的t=2行，t=3的“学习”虽然在同一批张量里，但<s.en: as its keys. At row t=2, which predicts 学习, the 学习 at t=3 is in the same batch of tensors but cannot be read by this row through attention. The per-position RMSNorm and FFN do not mix across positions either, so there is no detour through those modules to peek at the future.

同一时间准备好数据，不等于每个位置都能读取全部数据.en: Having the data ready at the same time is not the same as every position being able to read all of it

在t=2：BOS／我／爱。.en: At t=2: BOS / 我 / 爱.

在t=3、4：“学习／！”是未来输入位置。掩码把对应注意力分数设为−∞。.en: At t=3 and 4: 学习 / ！ are future input positions. The mask sets the corresponding attention scores to −∞.

targets[0,2]=3（学习）。它只在损失阶段用来选中一个候选概率。.en: targets[0,2]=3 (学习). It is used only at the loss stage, to select the probability of one candidate.

前向产生8项分数；损失评价第3项的概率高不高。.en: The forward pass produces 8 scores; the loss judges whether the probability of item 3 is high.

训练数据完整是宿主知道；某个位置是否可读是模型计算的约束。.en: That the training data is complete is something the harness knows; whether a given position can be read is a constraint of the model's computation.

PAD、attention mask和loss mask不要合并.en: Do not merge PAD, the attention mask and the loss mask

本书两条训练输入都长5，暂时没有PAD。为了处理不同长度，另一个实现可以补齐：这.en: Both training inputs in this book are 5 long, so there is no PAD for the moment. To handle different lengths another implementation can pad, and then three things have to be right separately: not reading the padding keys, recording the semantic positions correctly, and keeping the padding labels out of the loss. <strong>Not computing loss on PAD does not automatically forbid other tokens from reading PAD.

忽略损失标签；-100不是词表项，不能拿它去查Embedding。不同库可能在.en: to ignore a loss label; -100 is not a vocabulary item and cannot be used to look up an embedding. Some libraries shift the labels automatically inside, so read the interface's contract when using them, and do not shift already-shifted labels a second time.

填充限制与因果限制怎样合在一起.en: How the padding restriction and the causal restriction go together

填充限制与因果限制怎样合在一起：逐项辨别.en: How the padding restriction and the causal restriction go together: item-by-item distinctions

因果与PAD限制取交集.en: The intersection of the causal and the PAD restriction

关键区别：</strong>两个掩码限制的原因不同，可以同时存在。.en: Key difference: the two masks restrict for different reasons and can exist at the same time.

容易误解：</strong>允许的集合是两者同时允许，不是相加后自动扩大范围。.en: Easy to misread: the allowed set is what both allow at once, not a sum that automatically widens the range.

PAD查询行本身不是本次有意义的输出，不用它继续生成，也不让其预测计入正常损失。.en: A PAD query row is not itself a meaningful output this time: it is not used to carry on generating, and its prediction is not counted in the normal loss. How a real kernel avoids the numerical problem of a fully masked row has to follow the semantics of the interface; do not blindly fill a whole row with negative infinity.

批量输入还有样本边界；第0条不能因为同在一个batch就读到第1条。若将多个样本.en: Batched input also has sample boundaries: sample 0 must not read sample 1 merely because they share a batch. If several samples are packed into one sequence, the cross-sample readability has to be handled separately; inserting an end token on its own does not create isolation in the matrix by nature.

一个常见数学表达是在禁止位置的分数加上负无穷，使其指数为0；允许位置加0，保留原.en: One common way to express it mathematically is to add negative infinity to the score at a forbidden position, so that its exponential is 0, and to add 0 at an allowed position, keeping the original score; one row is then normalized.

关键区别：</strong>被禁止项的exp变0，剩下项再重新归一化。.en: Key difference: the exp of a forbidden entry becomes 0, and the remaining entries are then renormalized.

容易误解：</strong>所有项都被禁止时会有无效归一化风险，必须特殊处理。.en: Easy to misread: when every entry is forbidden there is a risk of an invalid normalization, which has to be handled specially.

若先对所有位置softmax，再把禁止项清零而不重新归一化，剩余权重总和会小于1.en: Running softmax over every position first and then zeroing the forbidden entries without renormalizing leaves the remaining weights summing to less than 1, which is usually not the attention that was wanted.

全行没有任何允许项时，softmax没有正常的有限候选可归一化，朴素计算可能出现.en: When a whole row has no allowed entry, softmax has no ordinary finite candidates to normalize over, and a naive computation may produce

，即“不是有效数值”。工程实现要明确处理或避免这种行，而不是让NaN悄悄传下去。.en: , that is, "not a valid number". An engineering implementation has to handle or avoid such a row explicitly, rather than letting a NaN quietly travel on.

不同API可能用布尔True表示允许，也可能表示屏蔽；也可能接受加性浮点mask.en: A different API may use boolean True for allowed, or for masked out, and may also accept an additive floating-point mask. <strong>Do not take the 1=allowed of this text as any library's general boolean convention.

已有缓存时，表为什么不再是小正方形.en: Why the table is no longer a small square once there is a cache

先把缓存理解为“之前算好的中间结果”，详细内容在F19。假设已有3个历史位置，新.en: For now, take a cache to be "intermediate results computed earlier"; the details are in F19. Suppose 3 past positions are already there and 2 new positions are being computed. There are only 2 queries this time, but 5 keys can be read:

关键区别：</strong>每个新Query可看它自己的绝对位置及更早位置；不是.en: Key difference: each new query can see its own absolute position and the earlier ones; it does not see only the upper-left 2×2.

容易误解：</strong>形状正确也可能错位，尤其是Q长度与K长度不同时。.en: Easy to misread: the shape can be right and the alignment still wrong, especially when the Q length and the K length differ.

缓存解码的允许表：比较绝对位置，不比较局部行号.en: The allow table for cached decoding: compare absolute positions, not local row numbers

放大图解：缓存解码的允许表：比较绝对位置，不比较局部行号.en: Enlarged figure: the allow table for cached decoding: compare absolute positions, not local row numbers

。第一行并不是只能读第一列，因为它的真实位置已经是3。规则是“Key逻辑位置不大.en: . The first row does not read only the first column, because its real position is already 3. The rule is "the logical position of the key is not greater than the logical position of the current query", not simply drawing a little triangle in the upper-left corner of a 2×5 table.

Loss mask又是什么.en: And what is a loss mask

训练样本含问题与回答时，可能只给回答部分的下一Token预测计损失。.en: When a training sample contains both a question and an answer, loss may be computed only for the next-token predictions in the answer part.

决定读取哪些条件。不给用户问题计损失，不意味着模型不能读用户问题。.en: decides which conditions are read. Not computing loss on the user's question does not mean the model cannot read it.

这一差异以后用于解释训练：模型可以借助问题预测答案，即使问题本身不是本批直接评分.en: This difference is used later to explain training: the model can use the question to predict the answer, even when the question itself is not what this batch scores directly.

3个历史位置加2个新位置，掩码怎样展开.en: How the mask opens out with 3 past positions plus 2 new ones

输入与条件。</strong>历史位置为0、1、2；新输入为位置3、4。现在只有.en: Input and conditions. The past positions are 0, 1 and 2; the new input is at positions 3 and 4. There are only 2 queries now, but 5 keys in all to compare with. "May read / may not read" is used here to avoid confusion over the boolean polarity of different APIs.

所有列均包含真实位置，不是五个新输入。.en: Every column holds a real position; these are not five new inputs.

绝对位置3只能看≤3的位置.en: Absolute position 3 can see only positions ≤3

把禁读列分数设为负无穷再softmax.en: Set the scores of the may-not-read columns to negative infinity, then softmax

该列权重变0；不能只把原始分数乘0。.en: The weight of that column becomes 0; it is not enough to multiply the original score by 0.

对2×5表直接套左上角小三角.en: Applying the upper-left triangle straight to a 2×5 table

第1行只能读位置0，错误丢掉历史位置1、2和当前位置3。.en: Row 1 would read only position 0, wrongly dropping the past positions 1 and 2 and the current position 3.

把过程连起来。</strong>因果判断比较绝对位置，不能拿新块中的第几行直接当.en: Join the steps up. A causal judgment compares absolute positions; the index of a row within the new block cannot be taken directly as its position in the whole sequence.

边界与反例。</strong>全被屏蔽的一行没有标准softmax分布，教学程序.en: Limits and counterexamples. A fully masked row has no standard softmax distribution, and the teaching program rejects it explicitly; a production kernel may have conventions of its own.

追问：训练已知道答案，为什么还要因果mask？.en: Follow-up: training already knows the answer, so why is a causal mask still needed?

知道答案的是训练数据与损失计算；负责某一位置预测的前向不能读取它应预测的未来To.en: What knows the answer is the training data and the loss computation; the forward pass responsible for the prediction at a position cannot read the future token it is supposed to predict. Otherwise training would depend on information that is not available at inference, and a low loss would not mean the real autoregressive prediction is good.

已经有2个历史Token，只新增1个Token，新的Query应能读几个Key？.en: With 2 past tokens already there and only 1 new token added, how many keys should the new query be able to read?

在无额外窗口或填充限制的因果设定下，可读3个：2个历史和当前自己。.en: In a causal setting with no extra window or padding restriction, 3: the 2 past ones and itself.

只对助手答案算损失，是否应把用户问题在attention里屏蔽？.en: If loss is computed only on the assistant's answer, should the user's question be masked out in attention?

不应由此前提推出。答案需要用户问题作为条件。计分范围和读取范围不同。.en: That does not follow from the premise. The answer needs the user's question as its condition. What is scored and what is read are different ranges.

这只是二维旋转的教学频率。实际RoPE对Q/K成对分量使用不同频率；作用在匹配表.en: This is only a teaching frequency for a two-dimensional rotation. Real RoPE uses different frequencies for the paired components of Q/K; it acts on the matching representation, and does not simply add the position ID to the token ID.

让顺序信息参与匹配，而不把词表编号当成位置编码。.en: Lets order information take part in the matching, instead of treating vocabulary IDs as a positional encoding.

“我爱你”和“你爱我”使用类似的片段，但顺序不同。Token ID标识它是词表哪.en: 我爱你 ("I love you") and 你爱我 ("you love me") use similar fragments in a different order. A token ID identifies which vocabulary item it is; a position ID identifies its logical position in the sequence.

Position ID：位于第几位.en: Position ID: which place it is in

向量：这一位的数值表示.en: Vector: the numeric representation of that place

关键区别：</strong>“谁”和“在哪里”是两类信息，模型需要把它们结合起来.en: Key difference: "which" and "where" are two kinds of information, and the model has to bring them together to handle them.

容易误解：</strong>相同Token在不同位置不必产生相同注意力行为。.en: Easy to misread: the same token at different positions need not produce the same attention behavior.

，数组列号为0、1、2，而两个真实Token的逻辑位置可以是0、1。PAD位置怎.en: , the array column numbers are 0, 1 and 2, while the logical positions of the two real tokens can be 0 and 1. 位置编号不必是一段交给用户看的文本；它可能作为单独参数传入，也可能由模型代码根据.en: A position ID need not be text handed to the user to read; it may be passed in as a separate argument, or worked out by the model code from the input length and the cache.

为什么不能只靠查Embedding.en: Why an embedding lookup is not enough on its own

相同Token按固定表查到同一排数。若一个没有任何位置机制的注意力系统只是对集合.en: The same token looks up the same row of numbers in a fixed table. If an attention system with no position mechanism at all merely compares and aggregates a set, it cannot encode every difference of order in general. A causal mask supplies part of the before-and-after constraint, but that is no reason to leave the position mechanism out of the model design.

容易误解：</strong>并非所有位置编码都通过简单加法写入Embedding.en: Easy to misread: not every positional encoding is written into the embedding by simple addition.

一种方案给每个位置准备额外向量，并与Token表示相加；另一种常用机制RoPE将.en: One approach prepares an extra vector for each position and adds it to the token representation; another common mechanism, RoPE, applies position to Q/K. 角度也可用<strong>弧度</strong>表示：π弧度等于180度，π/2.en: An angle can also be given in radians: π radians is 180 degrees, and π/2 is 90 degrees. cos and sin are the functions that describe the rotation relationship; on the unit circle, the horizontal and vertical coordinates after a rotation by θ are cosθ and sinθ.

这不是说位置只剩距离、内容被丢掉了。原始Q和K仍在，旋转调制了内容匹配；实际公式.en: This does not say that only distance is left of position and the content has been thrown away. The original Q and K are still there, and the rotation modulates the content matching; the actual formula includes their components.

为什么缓存位置不能每次从0开始.en: Why cached positions cannot start from 0 every time

前缀已经处理3个位置0、1、2，下一Token的逻辑位置应继续为3。如果把它误写.en: The prefix has already handled the 3 positions 0, 1 and 2, so the logical position of the next token should continue at 3. Written as 0 by mistake, the rotation angle of Q/K is wrong, and so is the relationship to the cached history.

关键区别：</strong>缓存继续生成时，位置编号与历史长度必须一致。.en: Key difference: when generation continues from a cache, the position IDs have to agree with the length of the history.

容易误解：</strong>每轮从位置0重新计数会破坏新旧K/V的一致性。.en: Easy to misread: counting again from position 0 each turn breaks the consistency between the old and the new K/V.

在典型RoPE缓存实现里，历史K可能已经按原位置旋转后保存。读取它不应再对同一份.en: In a typical RoPE cache implementation, the past K may already have been rotated by its original position before being saved. Reading it should not blindly rotate that same already-rotated result again. Which stage of representation the cache holds has to be read off the contract of the particular interface.

位置编号、缓存槽和模型窗口不能混.en: Position IDs, cache slots and the model window must not be mixed up

缓存槽是数据存在容器中的位置；逻辑位置是Token在序列中的位置；允许上下文长度.en: A cache slot is where the data sits in a container; the logical position is where the token sits in the sequence; the allowed context length is a limit of the model or the service. After a sliding window discards the early cache, the logical positions are not necessarily reset to 0 either.

把上下文最大长度从32K改成128K不会自动保证模型在新长度上表现正确。位置缩放.en: Changing the maximum context length from 32K to 128K does not automatically guarantee that the model behaves correctly at the new length. Position scaling, the distribution of training lengths, and numeric and task evaluation all bear on it. The basic aim here is to read "which step position takes part in", not to infer effective capability from a configuration number.

把位置旋转看成可以画在方格纸上的坐标变化.en: Seeing positional rotation as a change of coordinates you could draw on graph paper

输入与条件。</strong>先用一对二维坐标演示旋转，规定教学角度：位置0为0.en: Input and conditions. The rotation is demonstrated first on one pair of two-dimensional coordinates, with teaching angles laid down as 0° for position 0 and 90° for position 1. Real RoPE usually uses a different frequency for each pair of coordinates; only one pair is isolated here.

位置1的Q与位置0的K点积.en: The Q at position 1 dotted with the K at position 0

；位置差改变了匹配。.en: ; the difference in position changed the matching.

新Token本应在位置1，却从0编号.en: The new token should be at position 1 but is numbered from 0

它的Q误成.en: Its Q is wrongly taken to be

，与历史K的点积变成1，不再是0。.en: , and its dot product with the past K becomes 1 instead of 0.

把过程连起来。</strong>旋转没有把“第几个”附加成一个新词，而是在匹配坐.en: Join the steps up. Rotation does not attach "which one it is" as a new word; it expresses the positional relationship in the matching coordinates. Position IDs have to be consecutive and consistent with the cache.

边界与反例。</strong>90°用于手算，不是把所有模型的RoPE频率设置成.en: Limits and counterexamples. The 90° is for working by hand; it does not set the RoPE frequency of every model to 90°. The norm is preserved under rotation.

二维向量[2,3]逆时针旋转90度变成什么？.en: What does the two-dimensional vector [2,3] become when rotated 90 degrees counterclockwize?

代入cos=0、sin=1，得到[-3,2]。长度平方仍是13。.en: Substituting cos=0 and sin=1 gives [-3,2]. The squared length is still 13.

缓存已有5个真实Token，零起始编号的新Token通常是什么位置？.en: With 5 real tokens already in the cache, what position does a new token usually get under zero-based numbering?

在连续位置的基本设定下是5，而不是0。具体带填充或滑动窗口时按接口逻辑处理。.en: In the basic setting of consecutive positions, 5, not 0. When padding or a sliding window is involved, follow the logic of the interface.

可以把一层分成“从上下文取信息”和“在本位置加工信息”两段。残差提供原表示的直接.en: A layer can be split into two parts: "take information from the context" and "process information at this position". The residual provides a direct path for the original representation and the new computation provides the increment; normalization tidies up the numeric scale of each row, but it does not wash every meaning into the same thing. The feed-forward network is usually computed for each position separately, and no longer weights directly across positions the way attention does.

深层网络需要稳定的数值与梯度通路，同时具备上下文读取和局部变换能力。.en: A deep network needs stable numerical and gradient paths, together with the ability to read context and to transform locally.

一种常见的pre-norm Decoder层可这样读：先归一化输入，再算Atte.en: One common pre-norm decoder layer can be read like this: normalize the input, compute attention, and add the result back onto the original input; then normalize again, pass through the feed-forward network, and add it back again.

关键区别：</strong>Transformer层既有跨位置读取，也有逐位置的.en: Key difference: A Transformer layer has both cross-position reading and a position-by-position nonlinear transformation.

容易误解：</strong>注意力不是整层网络的全部。.en: Easy to misread: Attention is not the whole of the layer.

表示归一化在子层变换之前。其他架构可能使用不同位置或变体，本课给一个具体模型骨架.en: means the normalization comes before the sublayer transformation. Other architectures may place it elsewhere or use variants; this lesson gives one concrete model skeleton and does not claim that every network has the same order.

容易误解：</strong>Pre-Norm与Post-Norm不是一个固定不变.en: Easy to misread: Pre-Norm and Post-Norm are not one fixed order.

这样子层可以学习在已有表示上如何调整，而不必每次从零重建一切。它也影响反向传播的.en: This lets a sublayer learn how to adjust an existing representation instead of rebuilding everything from scratch each time. It also affects the path taken by backpropagation; the detailed gradients are in F15. The addition requires compatible dimensions, so attention usually returns to the original hidden width d through an output projection.

残差不是把“原话”保存一份中文副本，而是在数字表示上相加。.en: A residual does not keep a Chinese copy of the "original words"; it adds on the numeric representation.

本模型只有一头，因此混合结果直接右乘Wo[4,4]。多头时通常先拼各头输出再投影.en: This model has only one head, so the mixed result is multiplied on the right by Wo[4,4] directly. With several heads the usual step is to concatenate the head outputs first and then project. Wo turns the attention output into the combination of features the main network uses; the width in this model is still 4, but the numbers have been recombined.

残差不是把两份Token列表拼接，也不是换成平均值。它是同形状的对应格子相加。主.en: A residual is not two token lists concatenated, and not an average taken instead. It is an addition of corresponding cells in the same shape. The main path keeps one direct route and the branch supplies the adjustment; this helps information and gradients travel through a deep network, but it is no guarantee that "once a residual is added everything stays stable forever".

从[1,3]逐步得到均值、方差与标准差.en: From [1,3] step by step to the mean, the variance and the standard deviation

这里统计的是同一排两个特征，不跨样本也不跨Token；计算方差用平均平方偏差，不.en: What is counted here is two features in the same row, not across samples and not across tokens; the variance is computed from the average squared deviation, not from the average of the squares of the original numbers. The normalization denominator then adds ε as well.

同一[1,3]：LayerNorm和RMSNorm的两个分母.en: The same [1,3]: the two denominators of LayerNorm and RMSNorm

两种输出性质不同，不把它们都称为“把分数变成概率”。.en: The two outputs are different in nature, so they are not both called "turning scores into probabilities".

平方是为了不让正负偏差互相抵消，方差描述波动大小。标准差与原数值有同样的量纲。这.en: Squaring keeps positive and negative deviations from canceling each other out, and the variance describes the size of the fluctuation. The standard deviation has the same dimension as the original values. The division here is by the number of elements, as a population average; the division by n−1 used in other statistical settings must not be carried over indiscriminately.

LayerNorm实际规范化哪一排数.en: Which row of numbers LayerNorm actually normalizes

在典型Transformer中，对每个位置的隐藏特征独立计算均值与方差，再执行：.en: In a typical Transformer, the mean and the variance are computed independently over the hidden features of each position, and then:

LayerNorm：每一格沿同一特征排计算.en: LayerNorm: every cell is computed along the same feature row

仍用[1,3]，不换输入。减均值2后为[−1,1]，除sqrt(1+ε)，再分别.en: Still [1,3]; the input does not change. Subtracting the mean 2 gives [−1,1], which is divided by sqrt(1+ε) and then multiplied by γ and added to β. γ and β are trainable parameters, μ and the variance are statistics of this input, and ε is a stabilizing constant. That setting changes only where γ and β are explicitly changed here.

在LayerNorm式子中，γ是一排可学习乘法系数，β是一排可学习加法系数；ε是.en: In the LayerNorm expression, γ is a row of learnable multiplicative coefficients and β a row of learnable additive ones; ε is a small positive number set by hand, placed in the term involving the denominator to avoid division by zero and similar problems. The mean μ and the variance σ² that are computed are in turn statistics of this data.<span class="concept-micro">γ=1 and β=0 usually mean that every feature uses 1 and 0; they are not the meaning of an input word. The β in DPO refers to a coefficient of the objective function, and the sense it has here does not carry over.

ε是很小的正数，防止除以0等问题；γ、β是可学习的缩放与偏移参数。先忽略很小ε并.en: ε is a very small positive number that prevents division by 0 and similar problems; γ and β are learnable scale and shift parameters. Ignoring the very small ε for now and setting γ=1 and β=0, the example above

关键是<strong>按每个Token的特征轴计算</strong>，不是把本批.en: What matters is to compute along the feature axis of each token, rather than taking a mean over all the tokens of all the sentences in the batch. If you change the scope of the normalization, both the model's behavior and the premise under which a cache can be reused change with it.

常用均方根.en: commonly uses the root mean square

缩放，不减均值。对[1,3]，忽略ε，r=√5，结果约[0.4472,1.341.en: to scale, without subtracting the mean. For [1,3], ignoring ε, r=√5, and the result is about [0.4472,1.3416], different from LayerNorm. Both names contain Norm, which does not make them the same operation.

前馈网络FFN</strong>通常对每个位置独立做“升维线性变换→非线性→降维.en: The feed-forward network, FFN usually does "a linear transformation up in dimension → a nonlinearity → a linear transformation back down" independently at each position. For example d=4, an intermediate width of 8, and back to 4:

FFN：同一位置扩宽、激活，再压回.en: FFN: widen at the same position, activate, then squeeze back

FFN本身不读取其他Token；它处理的输入已可包含Attention聚合的上下.en: The FFN itself does not read other tokens; the input it handles may already contain the context attention has gathered. For the full four-dimensional model computation, see Completing one forward pass: residuals, the feed-forward network and vocabulary scores.

它不在这个步骤中直接对不同Token求和，但输入已经由Attention带入上下.en: It does not sum over different tokens directly at this step, but attention has already brought context into its input, so it can work on the mixed information. It is not a decorative layer with no effect, nor can it simply be taken for a database of facts that can be queried item by item.

类门控结构用一个分支调节另一个分支，常含逐元素乘。这和矩阵乘不同，回看F07即可.en: -style gated structures use one branch to modulate another, and often include an element-wise product. This is not the same as matrix multiplication; looking back at F07 is enough to tell them apart.

FFN负责哪种信息加工.en: Which kind of information processing the FFN is responsible for

注意力把不同位置的信息混合，FFN则对<strong>每个位置自己的特征</st.en: Attention mixes information from different positions, while the FFN applies the same nonlinear processing to each position's own features. It has no new cross-token score table. Many positions can be computed at once, but they share the same W1 and W2.

非线性和门控的设计会影响表达能力和计算特性。SwiGLU有两路投影与逐元素乘，不.en: The design of the nonlinearity and of the gate affects both expressive power and computational properties. The onehot here only expresses "which column is the real target"; it is not a token embedding, and the code is not required to construct it explicitly first.

第0条t=2：从概率到logits的梯度.en: Item 0, t=2: the gradient from the probabilities to the logits

正确候选那一格梯度为负，做梯度下降会倾向于提高它的logit；其他格通常为正，倾.en: The gradient in the cell of the correct candidate is negative, so gradient descent will tend to raise its logit; the other cells are usually positive, which tends to lower theirs. What is actually adjusted, though, are the shared parameters, not this row of logits directly and permanently. The gradients of different training questions with respect to the same parameter also add up.

logits平移与梯度行和有什么关系.en: How shifting the logits relates to the row sums of the gradient

本行Gz加起来应为0：概率和1，onehot和1，相减再除N仍为0。若把所有lo.en: This row of Gz should sum to 0: the probabilities sum to 1, the onehot sums to 1, and subtracting and then dividing by N still gives 0. If all the logits are increased by the same number, the probabilities do not change and the loss does not change, so the rate of change along the "all-ones direction" is 0. It is a good numerical self-check, but passing it does not prove that the whole model implementation is correct.

参数尚未更新.en: The parameters have not been updated yet

到这里得到了标量loss和对logits的局部梯度。要让Wq、Embedding.en: At this point we have a scalar loss and the local gradient with respect to the logits. Making Wq, the embedding and the rest change requires propagating this effect back along the forward dependencies. The complete backward chain is in the training chapter of the system mechanisms, tracing from the output head all the way to the embedding; this section goes on to check how the optimizer uses these gradients.

把一个优化步写完整.en: Write one optimization step out in full

梯度累积</strong>是先对若干小批计算并累积梯度，再更新一次，以模拟更大的.en: Gradient accumulation computes and accumulates the gradients over several small batches before updating once, so as to simulate a larger effective batch; it does not make the activation storage for one extremely long input disappear by itself. How the gradients are scaled has to correspond to the way the loss is averaged.

关键区别：</strong>训练一次更新有明确顺序；累积梯度时清零与缩放尤其重要.en: Key difference: One training update has a definite order; when gradients are accumulated, zeroing and scaling matter especially.

容易误解：</strong>零梯度与更新参数不要在步骤图中互换。.en: Easy to misread: Zeroing the gradients and updating the parameters must not be swapped in the step diagram.

本节的训练记号：</strong>g是当前参数的梯度；m是梯度的滑动平均；v是平.en: The training notation in this section: g is the gradient of the current parameter; m is a moving average of the gradient; v is a moving average of the squared gradient; β₁ and β₂ are the smoothing coefficients that are set; t is the optimization step number; a hat, as in m̂, denotes a bias-corrected quantity. The lowercase v here is not attention's Value, and β is not the shift parameter in LayerNorm. m and v are updated as the training steps proceed and take up extra storage; they are not token features of this input.

Adam为什么会保存额外状态：逐项辨别.en: Why Adam keeps extra state: item-by-item distinctions

关键区别：</strong>Adam维护梯度历史统计，不只是直接减去本轮梯度。.en: Key difference: Adam maintains statistics of the gradient history; it does not just subtract this round's gradient directly.

容易误解：</strong>Adam附加状态会增加训练内存，不能只按权重字节估算.en: Easy to misread: Adam's extra state increases training memory, which cannot be estimated from the weight bytes alone.

最简单梯度下降只用当前梯度g。.en: The simplest gradient descent uses only the current gradient g.

还保存梯度的平滑平均m和平方梯度的平滑平均v，帮助调整各参数步幅。示意式为：.en: also keeps a smoothed average m of the gradient and a smoothed average v of the squared gradient, which help adjust the step size for each parameter. Schematically:

β是0到1之间的平滑系数，不是模型学到的词义。因为初值常为0，开始时平均偏小，所.en: β is a smoothing coefficient between 0 and 1, not a word meaning the model has learned. Because the initial value is often 0, the average is too small at the start, so a bias correction is applied. At the first step with g=2 and β1=0.9, for instance: m=0.2, and dividing by 1−0.9 gives the corrected 2.

随后用修正m除以修正v的平方根再更新。.en: The corrected m is then divided by the square root of the corrected v, and the update follows.

把权重衰减作为解耦操作处理。完整公式在高级章节；本课先解释“为什么要多存m和v”.en: treats weight decay as a decoupled operation. The complete formula is in the advanced chapters; this lesson explains "why m and v have to be stored as well" first, which also shows that training VRAM cannot be counted from the weights alone.

先说明哪个阶段真的改变了模型.en: First say which stage really changed the model

loss.backward计算梯度；optimizer.step应用更新。它们通.en: loss.backward computes the gradients; optimizer.step applies the update. They are usually two calls. If the gradients have merely been computed without a step, generation behavior will not change by itself just because "the model has seen the answer".

，η是学习率、g是当前参数梯度。负g使w增加，正g使w减少；“下降”说的是试图降.en: , where η is the learning rate and g is the current gradient of the parameter. A negative g increases w and a positive g decreases it; "descent" refers to the attempt to lower the loss, not to every parameter having to get smaller.

一次训练更新的状态边界.en: The state boundaries of one training update

放大图解：一次训练更新的状态边界.en: Enlarged figure: the state boundaries of one training update

仍使用初始Wq[0,0]=0.2和刚算出的梯度.en: Still using the initial Wq[0,0]=0.2 and the gradient just computed,

这不是本实验实际训练的第一步</strong>，也不能把它接到后面的AdamW历.en: This is not the first step the experiment actually trains, and it cannot be attached to the AdamW history that follows.

实际训练选用AdamW：学习率0.03，β1=0.9，β2=0.999，ε=1e.en: The actual training uses AdamW: learning rate 0.03, β1=0.9, β2=0.999, ε=1e−8, weight_decay=0.01. Putting all the parameters in one group is a choice made for teaching; production training often uses different decay groups for certain parameters, so this configuration must not be called a universally best one.

AdamW多保存了哪两张表.en: Which two extra tables AdamW keeps

每个参数格都对应两个历史状态：m为梯度的指数移动平均；v为梯度平方的指数移动平均.en: Every parameter cell has two corresponding pieces of history: m, an exponential moving average of the gradient, and v, an exponential moving average of the squared gradient. The closer β is to 1, the more history is usually retained. What v stores is the squared gradient, not the variance of the parameter, and not a Value matrix.

m/v起始为0，早期平均偏向0，偏差修正分母用于抵消这个初始化影响。ε防止分母为.en: m and v start at 0, so early averages are biased towards 0, and the bias-correction denominator serves to cancel this effect of the initialization. ε prevents the denominator from being 0. Decoupled weight decay shrinks the parameters independently; it does not add λw into the gradient first and then compute m and v, which would be a different algorithm.

把Wq[0,0]的前两步写全.en: Write out the first two steps for Wq[0,0] in full

第一步m̂恰好等于当前g，v̂恰好等于g²；因g为负，自适应“扣除”是负数，所以.en: At the first step m̂ is exactly the current g and v̂ is exactly g², and because g is negative the adaptive "deduction" is negative, so w grows by about 0.03 while being shrunk slightly by the decay. From this it can be understood that the size of Adam's first step is not η multiplied by the raw gradient.

第二步的梯度来自<strong>所有参数更新一次后重新前向和反向</strong.en: The gradient of the second step comes from a fresh forward and backward pass after every parameter has been updated once; it is not the first step's g reused. If only one cell of Wq were changed and the other parameters left alone, the next step's gradient would no longer be the experimental value in the table either.

参数更新后，临时结果要重新计算.en: Once the parameters are updated, the intermediate results have to be recomputed

第一步更新后整批loss由.en: After the first update, the loss for the whole batch falls from

。下次Q/K/V、RMS分母、份额、logits都要用新参数重新算；旧计算图不能.en: . The next Q/K/V, RMS denominators, shares and logits all have to be recomputed with the new parameters; the old computational graph cannot be taken as the backward record for the new parameters.

梯度累积是有意让多个微批贡献合并；它与忘记清梯度导致的意外累积要区分。.en: Gradient accumulation deliberately merges the contributions of several micro-batches; it has to be told apart from the unintended accumulation caused by forgetting to clear the gradients.

学习率、梯度裁剪与AMP分别做什么.en: What the learning rate, gradient clipping and AMP each do

学习率控制优化器更新步幅；梯度裁剪限制梯度整体幅度；混合精度改变数值表示与计算。.en: The learning rate controls the size of the optimizer's update step; gradient clipping limits the overall magnitude of the gradients; mixed precision changes the numeric representation and the computation. Under AMP loss scaling, the official procedure is to unscale before clipping, or the threshold acts on gradients that have been artificially enlarged.

贯通模型用CPU float64，没有启用AMP或裁剪。这里说明生产边界，不把未.en: The worked model uses CPU float64, with neither AMP nor clipping enabled. What is described here is the production boundary; a GPU process that was not run is not dressed up as an experimental result.

学会训练不等于已经学会泛化.en: Learning to train is not learning to generalize

训练集</strong>用于更新参数；<strong>验证集</strong>用.en: The training set is used to update the parameters; the validation set is used to choose approaches and tune settings; the test set is used to evaluate relatively independently. Putting the test answers into training, or repeatedly tuning the prompt against test results, contaminates the evaluation.

在固定小序列上loss降很低，只说明这个训练过程学会了该分布，不能据此声称模型能.en: Driving the loss very low on a fixed short sequence only shows that this training process learned that distribution; it is no grounds for claiming that the model can understand arbitrary language. A real engineering result also depends on new tasks, new data, stability and cost.

把三个训练位置逐一评分，不让PAD混入平均数.en: Score the three training positions one by one, and keep PAD out of the average

输入与条件。</strong>真实序列是“我／爱／学习／EOS”，输入.en: Input and conditions. The real sequence is "我/爱/学习/EOS", and the input

。假设三个正确目标的预测概率分别为0.8、0.5、0.25。.en: . Suppose the predicted probabilities of the three correct targets are 0.8, 0.5 and 0.25.

看到“我爱”，目标是“学习”.en: Sees "我爱", the target is "学习"

看到“我爱学习”，目标是EOS.en: Sees "我爱学习", the target is EOS

三项相加再除3.en: Add the three items and divide by 3

平均约0.767528，不是先平均概率再取负对数。.en: The average is about 0.767528 — not the average of the probabilities with the negative log taken afterwards.

若后面还有2个PAD且不计分.en: If there are 2 more PAD afterwards that are not scored

仍除以3；除以5会把损失假装压低。.en: Still divide by 3; dividing by 5 would pretend the loss was lower.

把过程连起来。</strong>训练标签向后错一位，含义就从“预测下一个Toke.en: Join the steps up. If the training labels are off by one slot, the meaning changes from "predict the next token" to a different objective. A falling loss is no proof that the alignment is right either.

边界与反例。</strong>使用自然对数；概率是构造的。表中结果由程序计算，未.en: Limits and counterexamples. Natural logarithms are used; the probabilities are constructed. The results in the table are computed by a program, with no real model trained.

padding位置不计损失，分母也必须一起变.en: Padding positions do not count towards the loss, and the denominator has to change with them

输入与条件。</strong>安排4个预测位置，其中1个是PAD。3个有效标签的.en: Input and conditions. Four prediction positions are arranged, one of which is PAD. The probabilities of the correct token for the 3 valid labels are 0.8, 0.5 and 0.25; no sample weights are used.

逐项算负对数.en: Take the negative log of each item

PAD不贡献loss，也不贡献有效数量.en: PAD contributes no loss and no valid count

有效数量是3，而不是安排位置数4。.en: The valid count is 3, not the 4 positions arranged.

只把PAD的loss置零，却仍除以4.en: Zeroing only the PAD's loss while still dividing by 4

得到0.575646，数值变小但模型没有变好。.en: That gives 0.575646 — a smaller number, with no better model.

接到变长批次.en: Carried over to a variable-length batch

不同补齐比例若用错分母.en: Using the wrong denominator with different padding proportions

仅改变组批策略，就可能使训练曲线产生虚假的改善。.en: Changing nothing but the batching strategy can produce a spurious improvement in the training curve.

把过程连起来。</strong>忽略标签不只是“让那一格等于0”，还要保持聚合与.en: Join the steps up. An ignored label is not just "making that cell equal 0"; the aggregation and the normalization basis have to stay correct as well.

边界与反例。</strong>这里采用无权重有效标签均值；带类别权重、样本权重或.en: Limits and counterexamples. What is used here is an unweighted mean over the valid labels; in an implementation with class weights, sample weights or a custom reduction, the denominator may be defined differently.

不是演示一遍公式就宣布学会.en: Running through the formula once is no grounds for declaring it learned

现在把数据准备、前向、损失、反向和AdamW放进真实循环。实验固定两条序列，每步.en: Now data preparation, the forward pass, the loss, the backward pass and AdamW go into a real loop. The experiment fixes two sequences and uses this same small batch at every step; there is no hidden data augmentation, and no pre-written continuation rule is passed off as model output.

下面是核心调用逻辑摘录（TinyLM、MODEL_SPEC、jval和数据准备见.en: What follows is an extract of the core call logic (for TinyLM, MODEL_SPEC, jval and the data preparation, see the same source file); the full runnable source is on the local programs page, rather than being given as pseudocode alone:

训练贯通模型需要PyTorch；普通离线阅读不需要。另有只用Python标准库的.en: Training the worked model needs PyTorch; ordinary offline reading does not. There is also a forward-inference program that uses only the Python standard library, which can read the saved tables of numbers directly to check the generation, with no need to install PyTorch.

这不是累计loss平均曲线，而是在这些指定步数记录本批当前loss。它下降只说明.en: This is not a curve of the cumulative average loss, but a record of the current loss for this batch at these particular step numbers. Its falling only shows that the objective of fitting these two training samples is improving; with no independent natural-language test set, it is no grounds for saying it has real Chinese understanding or generalization.

为什么停在0.139附近，而不是0.en: Why it stops near 0.139 and not at 0

本节前面的数据分析已指出BOS后存在等频“我/你”两种目标，下界是.en: The data analysis earlier in this section already pointed out that BOS is followed with equal frequency by the two targets "我/你", so the lower bound is

，二者接近。其他位置基本被拟合，BOS处仍需要保留两种可能。.en: , and the two are close. The other positions are essentially fitted, while two possibilities still have to be kept at BOS.

最终每个监督位置的损失.en: The final loss at each supervised position

这里“下界”针对这份数据、这种单一条件分布目标与足够表达能力。不要把log2/5.en: The "lower bound" here is for this data, this single conditional-distribution objective and sufficient expressive power. Do not take log2/5 for a standard loss in all language model training.

同一个“爱”的Embedding参数行，训练前后对照.en: The same embedding parameter row for 爱, before and after training

同一张Wq，训练后数表.en: The same Wq, as a table of numbers after training

同一个输入经过这些参数会产生不同Q/K/V、概率。并不是给Token编号2改了一.en: The same input passed through these parameters will produce different Q/K/V and different probabilities. It is not that token ID 2 was given a new ID, nor that only the final answer was written into some separate memory cell.

保存训练产物：权重必须配什么.en: Saving the training artifacts: what the weights must come with

，包含模型配置与参数数组。选择JSON是为了可检查每个数字，并让标准库推理也能加.en: , which contain the model configuration and the parameter arrays. JSON was chosen so that every number can be inspected and so that the standard-library inference can load them too; it is not a recommendation to use JSON instead of an efficient weight format for large-scale models.

实际部署至少核对词表/分词器、特殊Token、层数与宽度、位置机制、归一化ε、权.en: A real deployment checks at least the vocabulary and tokenizer, the special tokens, the number of layers and the width, the position mechanism, the normalization ε, the weight naming and the transpose convention. With parameter shapes that happen to match but a different vocabulary order, a system may run and still output the wrong text.

可复现不等于跨所有机器逐位一致.en: Reproducible does not mean bit-identical on every machine

、CPU、float64、单线程、固定种子23与确定性设置。不同平台、精度和内核.en: , CPU, float64, single-threaded, with a fixed seed of 23 and deterministic settings. Different platforms, precisions and kernels may round differently, so checking should be done to a reasonable tolerance.

随包记录初始和最终参数指纹、逐步loss、参数更新、全量前向中间表、解析反向及自.en: The package records the initial and final parameter fingerprints, the step-by-step loss, the parameter updates, the full table of forward intermediates, the analytic backward pass and the differences from automatic differentiation. A fingerprint serves to confirm which set of weights is being compared; it does not prove what that set is capable of.

从训练跨入推理必须过一道真实边界.en: Crossing from training into inference means crossing a real boundary

后面的生成从<strong>保存文件重新加载</strong>参数，不直接在内存.en: The generation that follows reloads the parameters from the saved file, rather than carrying on directly in memory with an object that still holds training state, and it does not adjust the probabilities to fit an expected answer. This experiment also recomputes with a second forward program that does not depend on PyTorch, reducing the risk that both ends share the same error and "verify" each other.

先区分训练、验证与推理三种使用方式.en: First distinguish the three ways of using it: training, validation and inference

训练有标签、求梯度、更新参数；验证也可有标签并计算loss，但不更新参数；生成推.en: Training has labels, computes gradients and updates parameters; validation may also have labels and compute a loss, but does not update parameters; generative inference usually has no labels and selects the next token from a prefix. All three can call the same forward function.

验证样本真实前缀.en: Real prefix of a validation sample

用户前缀＋已生成内容.en: User prefix + what has been generated

常规全序列训练通常不用.en: Usually unused in ordinary full-sequence training

eval()不等于关闭梯度.en: eval() is not the same as turning gradients off

切换模块的training标志，例如Dropout不再随机丢弃，BatchNor.en: switches a module's training flag, so that dropout, for instance, no longer drops at random and BatchNorm uses its corresponding evaluation behavior. It is not an autograd switch.

控制梯度记录或更严格的推理优化；它们也不会自动把所有模块切到eval。.en: control the recording of gradients or a stricter inference optimization; they do not switch every module to eval by themselves either.

本模型无Dropout、无BatchNorm，因此train/eval数值一致，.en: This model has no dropout and no BatchNorm, so train and eval give the same numbers, which does not mean every real model does. The package also has an independent dropout test: adding no_grad alone still zeroes at random; eval can make dropout behave as the identity; and gradient computation can still be enabled under eval.

Dropout为什么会改变“相同输入同样输出”.en: Why dropout breaks "the same input gives the same output"

独立规则：训练时以概率p置零部分激活，保留项通常按1/(1−p)缩放，使期望不变.en: An independent rule: during training a proportion p of the activations are zeroed, and the items kept are usually scaled by 1/(1−p) so that the expectation is unchanged. At evaluation time there is no random zeroing and no further scaling up. One random forward pass and a forward pass without dropout cannot be required to agree cell by cell.

SDPA是函数接口，它的dropout_p由调用者传入。即使外层模块处于eval.en: SDPA is a function interface, and its dropout_p is passed in by the caller. Even when the enclosing module is in eval, the correct value of 0 still has to be passed to disable it; it cannot be assumed that the function reads the enclosing state by itself.

梯度累积为什么常在分母出错.en: Why gradient accumulation so often gets the denominator wrong

独立损失例：微批A有效2题，总损失4，平均2；微批B有效8题，总损失8，平均1。.en: An independent loss example: micro-batch A has 2 valid questions, a total loss of 4 and an average of 2; micro-batch B has 8 valid questions, a total loss of 8 and an average of 1. The correct average over all 10 questions is

。对应梯度的相对权重也被改变。.en: . The relative weights of the corresponding gradients are changed too.

分子与分母必须对应同一组有效目标.en: The numerator and the denominator must correspond to the same set of valid targets

先各自平均，再等权平均2和1，得到1.5。.en: Average each one first, then take an equal-weight average of 2 and 1, giving 1.5.

这是独立算术对照，不是贯通模型某一实际训练步的loss。.en: This is an independent arithmetic comparison, not the loss at some actual training step of the worked model.

分布式训练还要知道梯度同步是求和还是平均、框架是否已经做了缩放。不要多除一次世界.en: Distributed training also requires knowing whether gradient synchronization sums or averages, and whether the framework has already applied the scaling. Do not divide by the world size or the number of accumulation steps a second time. Hugging Face has publicly explained a fix for this kind of gradient-accumulation normalization; this book takes it as a historical lesson and does not claim the current library still has that defect.

验证什么，才能知道模型没有偷看.en: What to validate in order to know the model has not peeked

固定一个前缀，改变更晚Token，前缀位置的logits应不变；同一条样本单独跑.en: Fix a prefix and change a later token: the logits at the prefix positions should not change; running the same sample on its own and putting it into a separate batch should give the same result; swapping the order of the batch should swap the results correspondingly. These check causality and sample isolation; they do not assess semantic ability.

本模型的负控制会故意关闭因果mask，确认“未来改变不影响前缀”的测试能抓住错误.en: This model's negative control deliberately turns the causal mask off, to confirm that the test for "a change in the future does not affect the prefix" catches the error. A correct implementation passing is not enough on its own: it also has to be known that the test fails when it meets a broken implementation.

验证集、过拟合和本实验边界.en: The validation set, overfitting and the limits of this experiment

正式训练应有隔离的验证任务、数据泄漏控制、目标域评测和可复现数据处理。贯通模型反.en: Formal training should have an isolated validation task, control of data leakage, evaluation on the target domain and reproducible data processing. The worked model uses two sentences over and over and has no credible generalization score. This book does not dress up the continuation accuracy on those same two sentences as a validation-set success rate.

追问：参数W到底怎样被语言数据“教会”？.en: Follow-up: how exactly is the parameter W "taught" by language data?

一句话形成多个真实前缀和下一Token标签。当前W影响前向的概率，交叉熵评价标签.en: One sentence forms several real prefixes and next-token labels. The current W affects the probabilities in the forward pass, cross entropy scores the probability of the label, the backward chain rule computes the local effect of every cell of W on this loss, and the optimizer updates step by step according to those effects. No single step writes the meaning of a word directly into a column of labels.

正确项概率从0.25升到0.5，负对数损失是上升还是下降？.en: When the probability of the correct item rises from 0.25 to 0.5, does the negative-log loss rise or fall?

下降，从约1.3863降到0.6931。这里使用自然对数。.en: It falls, from about 1.3863 to 0.6931. Natural logarithms are used here.

为什么恢复训练可能还需优化器状态而不只是权重？.en: Why might resuming training need the optimizer state as well, and not just the weights?

Adam等优化器保存历史平滑量，此外步数和学习率状态也会影响后续更新。只恢复权重.en: Optimizers such as Adam store smoothed history, and the step count and the learning-rate state also affect later updates. Restoring the weights alone does not necessarily continue the same training trajectory.

可以让input_ids和targets完全相同，并去掉shift吗？.en: Could input_ids and targets be made exactly the same, with the shift removed?

那会主要训练“给当前Token预测它自己”，不是本书要学的下一Token条件概率.en: That would mainly train "predict the current token from itself", not the next-token conditional probability this book is about. The relationship between the input position, the visible prefix and the target position has to be explicit; the shift is usually done only once.

若两个微批分别有2和8个有效Token，直接平均两个微批的平均loss是否等于总.en: If two micro-batches have 2 and 8 valid tokens respectively, does averaging the two micro-batches' average losses equal the average over all 10 questions?

一般不等。正确是把两批的有效损失总和相加再除10；两批平均值应按2/10与8/1.en: Generally not. The correct way is to add the two batches' valid loss sums and divide by 10; the two batch averages should be weighted by 2/10 and 8/10. An equal-weight average gives each token of the shorter micro-batch a larger weight.

保存模型参数就能精确续训AdamW吗？.en: Does saving the model parameters make it possible to resume AdamW training exactly?

通常不够。还要保存优化器m/v、步数、调度器、必要随机状态和数据进度等。只有推理.en: Usually not. The optimizer's m and v, the step count, the scheduler, any necessary random state, the data progress and so on also have to be saved. Only loading for inference can do without this training state.

训练集loss降低、同样两句能续写，能否证明部署到其他句子也会成功？.en: If the training-set loss falls and the same two sentences can be continued, does that prove a deployment to other sentences will also succeed?

不能。这个实验没有一般语言的训练覆盖和独立评测；它用于验证计算和文件生命周期，而.en: No. This experiment has neither training coverage of language in general nor an independent evaluation; it serves to verify the computation and the file life cycle, not to prove generalization.

为了省内存，在真实训练前向套no_grad，再对loss.backward()，.en: To save memory, wrapping the real training forward pass in no_grad and then calling loss.backward() on the loss — can all the parameters still be learned normally?

通常不能；所需计算图已被禁用，梯度链路断开。省训练显存应使用明确的混合精度、检查.en: Usually not; the computational graph needed has been disabled and the gradient path is broken. Saving training VRAM should use explicit methods such as mixed precision, checkpointing or sharding, with the gradients verified, rather than simply turning off the differentiation that is needed.
