为什么一块算力更高的GPU，不一定让任务同比变快？.en: Why does a GPU with more compute not necessarily make a task proportionally faster?

把GPU想成工厂只适合记住一个有限类比：运算像加工，读写像运输。加工设备翻倍但运.en: Thinking of a GPU as a factory is only good for holding on to one limited analogy: computation is like machining, reads and writes are like transport. Doubling the machines while transport is still blocked does not make the whole thing proportionally faster. Real analysis has to go back to the number of operations, the bytes moved, the device's rates and the measurements, not to some advertised peak.

计算量</strong>要做的运算总数。.en: ComputeThe total number of operations to be done.

带宽</strong>单位时间能搬运的字节数。.en: Bandwidth the number of bytes that can be moved per unit of time.

吞吐</strong>单位时间完成多少工作；不同于一条请求要多久。.en: Throughput how much work is completed per unit of time; not the same as how long one request takes.

通信</strong>数据在设备之间交换产生的成本。.en: Communication the cost that arises when data is exchanged between devices.

输入与适用条件：</strong>固定教学任务与理想速率。第二、三帧是各自恢复基.en: Input and conditions of use:A fixed teaching task and an ideal rate. Frames two and three are independent comparisons that each return to the baseline and then change one factor only; no claim is made about real run times.

算得慢，可能是东西搬得慢：逐步运行图解.en: Slow computation may mean things are being moved slowly: step-by-step figure

1 / 4 · 先问算力和搬运谁更慢.en: 1 / 4 · First ask which is slower, the computing or the moving

算得慢，可能是东西搬得慢：先问算力和搬运谁更慢.en: Slow computation may mean things are being moved slowly: ask first which is slower, the computing or the moving

教学任务：1,000,000次浮点运算；8,000,000字节搬运。假定算力10.en: Teaching task: 1,000,000 floating-point operations and 8,000,000 bytes moved. Assume a compute rate of 1 billion operations per second and a bandwidth of 1 billion bytes per second.

先定位主导瓶颈，才知道该优化矩阵计算、显存读写还是调度。.en: Locate the dominant bottleneck first; only then do you know whether to optimize matrix computation, VRAM traffic or scheduling.

用分账估计指导Profile，再用同任务实测检查。.en: Let the per-account estimate guide the profiling, then check it by measuring the same task.

提高吞吐可能增加单请求排队；分片省内存可能增加网络通信。.en: Raising throughput can add queueing for a single request; sharding to save memory can add network traffic.

观察端到端时间及各阶段Trace，避免只测某一个最快算子。.en: Watch the end-to-end time and the trace of each stage, rather than measuring only the single fastest operator.

全部步骤与解释</a><a href=\"../visual/O04.html\.en: All steps and explanationsO04 · FlashAttention: accumulate while reading, without materializing the whole tableO05 · PagedAttention: logically contiguous, physically chunkedO06 · Continuous batching: when a seat frees up, take the next oneO09 · Activation checkpointing: store less, recompute on the backward pass

先区分三本账.en: Start by separating the three accounts

计算量</strong>是需要做多少次运算；<strong>存储量</stron.en: The amount of computation is how many operations have to be done; the amount of storage is how much data has to be kept; the amount of data movement is how much data has to be moved between storage levels or devices. Storing less does not necessarily mean computing less, and adding parallelism does not necessarily make one request faster.

先区分三本账：逐项辨别.en: Start by telling three ledgers apart: the items distinguished

计算量：做多少运算.en: Amount of computation: how many operations

存储量：占多少字节.en: Amount of storage: how many bytes it occupies

搬运量：读写多少字节.en: Amount of movement: how many bytes are read and written

关键区别：</strong>算得快、装得下、搬得动是三本账，瓶颈可能完全不同。.en: Key difference: Computing fast, fitting in memory and moving data are three ledgers, and the bottleneck may be an entirely different one in each.

容易误解：</strong>减少参数量不一定成比例减少端到端耗时。.en: Easy to misread: Cutting the parameter count does not necessarily cut end-to-end time in proportion.

是每秒浮点运算数量。二者差一个S，却分别是工作量与速率。一次乘加是否计为两次FL.en: is the number of floating-point operations per second. One S apart, yet one is an amount of work and the other a rate. Whether one multiply-add counts as two FLOP depends on the counting convention.

复杂度Big-O</strong>描述输入规模变大时工作量增长的级别。若T个查询.en: Big-O complexity describes the order at which the amount of work grows as the input gets larger. If T queries each have to be compared with T keys, there are T² pairings. Double T and the number of pairings becomes four times as large, which is why the attention-score part is commonly said to grow quadratically in T.

关键区别：</strong>这里说的是注意力分数配对数随长度的增长，不是所有计算.en: Key difference: What is meant here is the growth in the number of attention-score pairings with length, not that every computation becomes exactly four times as much.

容易误解：</strong>Big-O描述增长级别，不是实际运行秒数。.en: Easy to misread: Big-O describes the order of growth, not the seconds a run actually takes.

这不是说某实现必然花T²秒，也不保证端到端时间刚好变4倍，因为硬件、隐藏宽度、内.en: This does not say that some implementation must take T² seconds, nor does it guarantee that the end-to-end time becomes exactly four times as long, because the hardware, the hidden width, memory movement and the other layers all play a part. When a complexity is written down, say which variable is growing and what is held fixed for the moment.

为什么存储足够也可能算不快.en: Why enough storage may still not mean fast computation

硬件有计算能力上限，也有每秒读取数据的<strong>带宽</strong>上限.en: Hardware has an upper limit on compute capability, and also an upper limit on the bandwidth at which it reads data per second. If a lot of data is read for only a few operations, bandwidth may be the limit; if the data can be reused while a great deal is computed, compute capability may be the limit.

为什么存储足够也可能算不快：逐项辨别.en: Why enough storage may still not mean fast computation: the items distinguished

总耗时至少受较大者约束.en: The total time is bounded below by the larger of the two

关键区别：</strong>想优化前先问真正瓶颈是运算能力还是内存带宽。.en: Key difference: Before optimizing, ask whether the real bottleneck is compute capability or memory bandwidth.

容易误解：</strong>实际还会有排队、调度与同步开销。.en: Easy to misread: In practice there is also the overhead of queueing, scheduling and synchronization.

逐格算清：Roofline的直觉：时间由哪块短板决定.en: Worked out cell by cell: the intuition behind roofline: which weak link decides the time

搬运下界比计算下界大十倍，瓶颈不在纯算力.en: The movement lower bound is ten times the computation lower bound, so the bottleneck is not raw compute

步骤 1</span><span>假设计算操作的理论耗时下界是0.01秒。.en: Step 1Suppose the theoretical lower bound on the time for the computation is 0.01 seconds.

步骤 2</span><span>同一任务数据搬运的理论耗时下界是0.10秒。.en: Step 2The theoretical lower bound on the time to move the data for the same task is 0.10 seconds.

步骤 3</span><span>实际耗时至少不小于两者中更大的0.10秒。.en: Step 3The actual time is at least the larger of the two, 0.10 seconds.

步骤 4</span><span>只把计算速度翻倍，可能仍被数据搬运瓶颈限制。.en: Step 4Doubling the computation speed alone may still leave it held back by the data-movement bottleneck.

在这一假想条件下，搬运至少需要0.10秒，单纯把计算速度翻倍不一定明显改变整体耗.en: Under these hypothetical conditions the movement takes at least 0.10 seconds, so simply doubling the computation speed need not change the overall time noticeably. A real measurement also has to count queueing and synchronization.

用粗略下界估算：任务做C次运算、移动M字节，计算速率R、带宽BW，耗时至少受到.en: Estimate with a rough lower bound: a task does C operations and moves M bytes, at a computation rate R and a bandwidth BW, so the time is at least constrained by

约束。这类思路属于<strong>Roofline（屋顶线）</strong>分.en: . This line of thinking belongs to roofline analysis. In practice there is also queueing and synchronization overhead, so it cannot be taken as an exact timing formula.

普通概念实现会显式形成很大的T×T分数或权重表。FlashAttention通过.en: A plain conceptual implementation forms a large T×T table of scores or weights explicitly. By means such as tiling, FlashAttention manages local blocks and the normalization statistics as it computes, so that the whole intermediate table is not written to and read from external VRAM over and over.

关键区别：</strong>FlashAttention重排计算和数据访问，避免.en: Key difference: FlashAttention rearranges the computation and the data access so that the whole attention matrix is not stored and read repeatedly.

容易误解：</strong>它不是“只读前几个Token”的近似注意力。.en: Easy to misread: It is not an approximate attention that "reads only the first few tokens".

它没有简单把精确注意力变成只读几个Token，也不等于KV缓存。前者安排单次注意.en: It does not simply turn exact attention into reading a few tokens, and it is not the same as a KV cache. The first arranges the reads and writes of one attention computation; the second reuses the past K/V across generation steps. Advanced Q027 derives the online softmax; for now, understand it as "the same target, with a different intermediate storage and access order".

分页</strong>把缓存切成固定大小的块，用映射表记住每条序列的逻辑块对应哪.en: Paging cuts the cache into fixed-size blocks and uses a mapping table to remember which physical block each sequence's logical block corresponds to, which helps manage requests of different lengths and shared prefixes. The management idea resembles that of operating-system paging, but the object here is KV data, not all the memory of a whole program.

关键区别：</strong>PagedAttention让逻辑位置连续、物理块可.en: Key difference: PagedAttention keeps the logical positions contiguous while letting the physical blocks be scattered, which cuts waste in allocation.

容易误解：</strong>它不等于把整个神经网络都放进操作系统分页。.en: Easy to misread: It is not the same as putting the whole neural network into operating-system paging.

连续组批continuous batching</strong>允许某个请求完成.en: Continuous batching lets a request release its slot once it finishes so that a new request can join, rather than requiring the whole batch to end together. It can raise resource utilization, but prefill, decode, and long and short requests still have to be scheduled against one another.

多GPU到底切哪部分.en: What exactly is split across multiple GPUs

你需要追踪的代价.en: The cost you have to keep track of

多份模型处理不同样本.en: Several copies of the model handle different samples

训练时同步梯度等.en: Synchronizing gradients and the like during training

拆矩阵或算子到多个设备.en: Split a matrix or an operator across several devices

层内通信与组合.en: Communication and combination within a layer

分摊训练参数、梯度或优化器状态.en: Spread the training parameters, gradients or optimizer state

取用和同步开销.en: The overhead of fetching and synchronizing

更多设备不是无条件加速。如果一次通信时间大于省下的计算时间，可能更慢。训练分片与.en: More devices is not an unconditional speed-up. If one round of communication takes longer than the computation it saves, the result can be slower. Nor can sharding in training and separating services in inference be covered by the same word.

训练保存、推理缓存与检查点.en: Training saves, inference caches and checkpoints

训练为求梯度可能保留激活；.en: Training may keep activations in order to compute gradients;

保存部分节点、在反向时重算其他部分，用计算换内存。KV缓存则用内存换重复推理计算.en: saves some nodes and recomputes the rest on the backward pass, trading computation for memory. A KV cache, by contrast, trades memory for repeated inference computation. The two even embody opposite resource trade-offs.

磁盘上的模型检查点保存恢复所需权重或训练状态；Agent任务检查点保存工作进展。.en: A model checkpoint on disk saves the weights or training state needed to restore it; an agent task checkpoint saves how far the work has got. Both are called a checkpoint, yet what they save is entirely different.

先数计算与搬运，再决定是不是GPU算力不够.en: Count the computation and the movement first, then decide whether the GPU is short of compute

输入与条件。</strong>假想操作要做1,000,000次浮点运算，并搬运8.en: Input and conditions. A hypothetical operation does 1,000,000 floating-point operations and moves 8,000,000 bytes. The hypothetical device peaks at 100GFLOP/s with a bandwidth of 10GB/s, in decimal units.

算纯计算下界.en: Compute the pure computation lower bound

算纯搬运下界.en: Compute the pure movement lower bound

理想充分重叠时取max.en: With ideal full overlap, take the max

至少约800微秒，而不是10微秒。.en: At least about 800 microseconds, not 10 microseconds.

若融合操作只需4MB.en: If a fused operation needs only 4MB

搬运下界约400微秒；算力没变也可能更快。.en: The movement lower bound is about 400 microseconds; it can run faster even with the compute unchanged.

注意力位置对从10,000变40,000，不是只多一倍。.en: The attention position pairs go from 10,000 to 40,000, not merely double.

把过程连起来。</strong>“省内存读写”和“减少数学配对数量”是不同优化。.en: Join the steps up. "Saving memory reads and writes" and "cutting the number of mathematical pairings" are different optimizations. A high GPU peak figure is no reason to overlook the movement.

边界与反例。</strong>这些是理想化下界，不是实际性能；还未计调度、通信、.en: Limits and counterexamples. These are idealized lower bounds, not actual performance; scheduling, communication, kernel launches, cache hits and imperfect overlap are not yet counted.

输入T翻倍，T×T关系数怎样变？是否代表整个系统必然慢4倍？.en: If the input T doubles, how does the number of T×T relationships change? Does that mean the whole system must be four times slower?

关系数变4倍；端到端耗时还取决于其他计算、硬件和调度，不能直接保证倍率。.en: The number of relationships becomes four times as large; the end-to-end time also depends on the other computation, the hardware and the scheduling, so no factor is guaranteed directly.

FlashAttention、KV Cache和量化能互相替代吗？.en: Can FlashAttention, KV cache and quantization substitute for one another?

不能。它们分别改变注意力中间计算与读写、历史计算复用和数字表示精度，作用对象不同.en: No. They change, respectively, the intermediate computation and the reads and writes inside attention, the reuse of past computation, and the precision of the numeric representation; they act on different objects.

同一句用户任务，为什么可能调用模型不止一次？.en: Why can one user task call the model more than once?

LLM生成下一步提议，宿主执行获准的动作，把结果再交给LLM。这是外层任务循环；.en: The LLM generates the next proposal, the harness carries out the approved action and hands the result back to the LLM. That is the outer task loop; inside each model call there is still token-by-token generation. One outer round of tool action is not the same as generating one token inside, and the two kinds of "loop" must not be conflated.

调用标识</strong>把某次工具请求与其结果连接的ID。.en: Call IDThe ID that links one tool request to its result.

工具结果</strong>程序实际执行后返回的内容。.en: Tool result what the program returns after it actually runs.

上下文</strong>本轮明确交给模型的信息，而非整个电脑状态。.en: Context the information explicitly handed to the model this turn, not the whole state of the computer.

输入与适用条件：</strong>构造的只读教学任务：文件config.txt含.en: Input and conditions of use: A constructed read-only teaching task: the file config.txt contains timeout=30. The swimlanes show where responsibility ends; no real commercial API is claimed to have been called, and the data and the order of actions are fixed.

把一个Agent任务拆成真正发生的几轮：逐步运行图解.en: Break one agent task into the turns that actually happen: a step-by-step run figure

1 / 8 · 1. 用户任务：读config.txt中的timeout.en: 1 / 8 · 1. User task: read the timeout in config.txt

模型尚未看到磁盘文件。先区分用户给的任务与环境真实内容。.en: The model has not seen the file on disk yet. Keep the task the user gave apart from what the environment actually contains.

模型可以借助工具获得新证据，而不把一切都塞入参数。.en: A model can obtain new evidence through tools instead of stuffing everything into its parameters.

按请求、校验、执行、结果回填、继续决策组织循环。.en: Organizes the loop as request, validation, execution, writing the result back, and deciding whether to carry on.

忘记回填工具结果会让模型重复请求；把输出文本当执行证明会误报完成。.en: Forgetting to write the tool result back makes the model request it again; treating the output text as proof of execution reports completion falsely.

对照每轮模型输入和工具日志，确认结果与call_id匹配。.en: Cross-checks each turn's model input against the tool log and confirms that the result matches its call_id.

读取—发现缺口—再读取：让一次工具结果决定下一步.en: Read, find the gap, read again: let one tool result decide the next step

输入与条件。</strong>用户问“为什么超时？”教学仓库中config写.en: Input and conditions.The user asks "why did it time out?" In the teaching repository the config says

，单位均在文件头声明为秒。.en: , both declared as seconds in the file header.

任务＋read_file工具说明.en: The task + the read_file tool description

只能确认配置，还不能知道真实请求是否超时。.en: It can confirm the configuration only; whether a real request times out is still unknown.

提议读取日志，而不是直接猜网络坏了。.en: Proposes reading the log instead of guessing straight away that the network is broken.

日志耗时5秒.en: The log says it took 5 s

有了配置与运行记录两个证据。.en: Now there are two pieces of evidence: the configuration and the run record.

对齐同一请求和同一版本.en: Align on the same request and the same version

5大于3，可说明本次请求超过配置时限；仍不能仅据此确定为何耗时5秒。.en: 5 is greater than 3, which does show that this request went past the configured limit; on its own it still does not settle why it took 5 seconds.

把过程连起来。</strong>Agent循环的价值是根据已取得证据确定缺什么，.en: Join the steps up. The value of the agent loop is deciding what is missing from the evidence already obtained, not mechanically asking the model a few more times.

边界与反例。</strong>动作序列是教学构造，不是实测模型自动选择；这里证据.en: Limits and counterexamples. The action sequence is a teaching construction, not a measured model choosing for itself; the evidence here supports only "it went over the time limit", not a guess at some deeper root cause.

把这一页的具体对象分清之后，再进入系统机制：<a href=\"../chapt.en: Once this page's concrete objects are clear, go on to the system mechanism: One answer has finished — so why is the task still not done?. Knowing the full source first is not required; being able to retell from the state table what happened at each step is.

证据与理解边界：</strong>模型响应结束只证明本次生成结束；工具结果和最终.en: Evidence and the limits of understanding: the end of the model's response proves only that this generation has ended; the tool result and the final acceptance remain two separate pieces of evidence. A stop-hook check is no substitute for a real test either.

为什么看到半段JSON时绝对不能执行？.en: Why must you never execute on half a JSON?

网络像分批送到的纸条，分割点不遵守汉字或JSON边界。接收端先重组字节和字符，再.en: The network is like notes delivered in instalments, and the split points respect neither Chinese-character nor JSON boundaries. The receiving end first reassembles bytes and characters, then reassembles events according to the streaming protocol, and finally parses the structure and confirms whether that output represents a complete action. Balanced braces are not enough, because a string can contain braces too.

把字符表示成字节序列的编码。.en: An encoding that represents characters as a byte sequence.

以事件形式持续传送文本数据的一种协议。.en: A protocol that delivers text data continuously, in the form of events.

描述字段和类型约束的结构规范，不保证字段事实正确。.en: A structural specification that describes the fields and their type constraints; it does not guarantee that a field is factually correct.

输入与适用条件：</strong>真实编码了一个小SSE文本事件，故意把“爱”的.en: Input and conditions of use: A small SSE text event is genuinely encoded here, with the three UTF-8 bytes of 爱 deliberately split across two pieces. The example does not use any vendor-specific event naming.

字符完整、事件完整、工具参数完整是三道关：逐步运行图解.en: Complete characters, complete events and complete tool arguments are three separate gates: a step-by-step run figure

1 / 4 · 收到第一段字节.en: 1 / 4 · The first stretch of bytes arrives

字符完整、事件完整、工具参数完整是三道关：收到第一段字节.en: Complete characters, complete events and complete tool arguments are three separate gates: the first run of bytes arrives

网络片段可以停在一个汉字的UTF-8编码中间。现在只有“爱”的第一个字节，不能把.en: A network chunk can stop in the middle of a Chinese character's UTF-8 encoding. Right now only the first byte of "爱" has arrived, so the chunks cannot each be decoded on their own as a complete string.

让网络分片方式不影响语义与执行次数。.en: Keeps the way the network splits data from affecting the meaning or the number of executions.

增量解码→组装事件→解析JSON→检查完成状态→按类型分派。.en: Incremental decoding → assemble the event → parse the JSON → check the completion state → dispatch by type.

提前执行、重复事件未去重、调用ID错配，都可能把一次动作变成多次副作用。.en: Executing too early, failing to deduplicate repeated events, and mismatching call IDs can each turn one action into several side effects.

把同一字节串在每个切分点拆开，解析后的事件都应一致。.en: Splits the same byte string at every split point; the parsed events should be identical in each case.

证据与理解边界：</strong>一个工具项完整，不等于整条响应结束；已记入历史.en: Evidence and the limits of understanding: one tool item being complete is not the whole response ending; a call that is already in the history but was canceled still has to have a corresponding result, and a fragment of the arguments must not be taken for a complete action.

“模型知道做过”与“系统能恢复”有什么区别？.en: What is the difference between "the model knows it did it" and "the system can recover"?

一次任务至少有目标、当前环境和执行记录。模型上下文可能被截断，但系统仍需要知道动.en: A task has at least a goal, a current environment and an execution record. The model's context may be truncated, but the system still needs to know whether an action really took effect. An event record describes what happened and a snapshot describes the state at one moment; neither carries the same responsibility as the paragraph you get back from "please summarize this".

事件</strong>一次可记录的状态变化，例如文件替换完成。.en: Event one recordable change of state, for instance a file replacement completing.

快照</strong>某个时刻对任务状态的保存。.en: Snapshot a saved copy of the task state at one moment.

不能确认成功或失败的状态，不等于已经失败。.en: A state in which neither success nor failure can be confirmed is not the same as having failed.

输入与适用条件：</strong>构造的文件更新恢复轨迹。v7/v8是本例的版本.en: Input and conditions of use: A constructed recovery trace for a file update. v7/v8 are this example's version labels, not model versions; it explains recovery semantics only, and does not claim that the file system and the database share a transaction.

任务状态不是聊天里的一句总结：逐步运行图解.en: Task state is not a one-line summary in the chat: the run, step by step

文件已更新与宿主已确认，属于两条不同状态线.en: The file having been updated and the harness having confirmed it are two different state lines

目标：更新配置；当前版本v7.en: Objective: update the configuration; current version v7

避免长任务在中断或压缩后重复、漏掉、覆盖已经完成的工作。.en: Keeps a long task from repeating, skipping or overwriting work already finished after an interruption or a compaction.

持久化必要状态；遇到未知结果先核对环境，再决定重试或继续。.en: Persists the necessary state; on an unknown result it checks the environment first and only then decides whether to retry or carry on.

所有动作都做重型日志可能过度工程；但有不可重复副作用时仅靠聊天记录又不够。.en: Heavy logging for every action may be over-engineering; but where a side effect cannot be repeated, a chat record alone is not enough either.

故意在执行与回执之间中断，恢复后检查动作次数与最终环境。.en: Deliberately breaks off between execution and the receipt, then after recovery checks how many times the action ran and what the final environment is.

连接、发现、模型可见和实际授权分别发生在哪里？.en: Where do connection, discovery, model visibility and actual authorization each happen?

把MCP想成工具之间的共同接口语言，而不是新大脑。Host负责应用级选择与控制，.en: Think of MCP as a common interface language between tools, not as a new brain. The Host handles application-level selection and control, the Client handles the protocol connection, and the Server provides the capability. Once the wiring is done it still has to be decided which tools are exposed to the model, which resources may be accessed, and which actions need confirmation.

承载模型、任务与权限策略的应用。.en: The application that carries the model, the task and the permission policy.

Host中的协议客户端。.en: The protocol client inside the host.

提供工具、资源等能力的服务。.en: A service that provides capabilities such as tools and resources.

授权</strong>允许某个身份在某个范围执行某个动作。.en: Authorization allowing one identity to perform one action within one scope.

输入与适用条件：</strong>按公开架构画逻辑流程，省略具体传输和认证字段。.en: Input and conditions of use:The logical flow is drawn from the published architecture, with the specific transport and authentication fields omitted. For the capability details of different protocol versions, the project's own statements govern.

MCP连起接口，不自动交出权限：逐步运行图解.en: MCP connects interfaces; it does not hand over permissions on its own: step-by-step run figure

1 / 7 · 1. Host建立连接，Client与Server协商能力.en: 1 / 7 · 1. The host opens the connection; client and server negotiate capabilities

Host是承载AI应用的宿主；Client是其连接特定Server的协议客户端。.en: The harness is what carries the AI application; the client is its protocol client for connecting to a particular server. Establishing a connection does not approve every operation automatically.

减少每个工具都单独设计集成方式的成本。.en: Reduces the cost of designing a separate integration for every tool.

先发现能力，再由宿主形成模型可见集合，最后在执行边界检查权限。.en: Capabilities are discovered first, then the harness forms the set the model can see, and permissions are checked last, at the execution boundary.

外部Server的权限不会因为本地Shell受沙箱保护而自动受同样限制。.en: An external Server's permissions are not automatically under the same limits just because the local shell is protected by a sandbox.

分别测试“未暴露”“未授权”“参数不合法”“业务拒绝”，观察是否被准确区分。.en: Test "not exposed", "not authorized", "invalid argument" and "rejected by the business rules" separately, and watch whether they are told apart accurately.

证据与理解边界：</strong>直接、延迟发现和代码调用是不同暴露面；注册、可.en: Evidence and the limits of understanding: direct exposure, delayed discovery and a code call are different exposure surfaces; registered, visible, callable and authorized are not equivalent to one another.

为什么“读得越多”有时反而越容易误解？.en: Why does "reading more" sometimes make misreading more likely?

模型这轮只能使用被提供的材料。资料过少会缺依据，过多又会引入旧版本、重复结论或无.en: This turn the model can use only the material it is given. Too little material leaves it without a basis; too much brings in old versions, repeated conclusions or irrelevant rules. The point is not to fill the space with every piece of information available, but to prepare the minimally sufficient material that can support the next action, while leaving room for generation.

预算</strong>本轮允许使用的资源额度。.en: Budget the resource allowance this turn is permitted to use.

必要证据</strong>缺少它就无法可靠判断的原始信息。.en: Necessary evidence the original information without which no reliable judgment is possible.

来源</strong>这段材料是谁给的、何时有效、能支持什么结论。.en: Source who supplied this material, when it is valid, and what conclusion it can support.

输入与适用条件：</strong>100单位的教学预算，不是真实Tokenize.en: Input and conditions of use:A teaching budget of 100 units, not a measurement from a real tokenizer: rules 20, task 10, tools 15, evidence 20, output reserve 20. The same configuration throughout.

每轮上下文像一份有边界的工作资料：逐步运行图解.en: Each turn's context is like a working file with a boundary: step-by-step run figure

每轮上下文像一份有边界的工作资料：加入规则.en: Each turn's context is like a working file with a boundary: the rules are added

先固定不可省略的规则；外部资料不是同等级指令。.en: Fix the rules that cannot be dropped first; external material is not an instruction of the same rank.

控制成本与上下文干扰，同时避免省掉关键约束。.en: Controls cost and context interference while avoiding the omission of a key constraint.

先保证目标和证据依赖完整，再对可重新读取的细节按需加载。.en: First make sure the goal and the evidence it depends on are complete, then load the details that can be re-read on demand.

删除一条否定条件或其适用版本，可能让短摘要比长原文更危险。.en: Dropping one negative condition, or the version it applies to, can make a short summary more dangerous than the long original.

让模型用本轮材料回答关键约束与下一步证据问题，检查是否需要重新取证。.en: Have the model use this turn's material to answer the key constraints and the question of what evidence the next step needs, to see whether the evidence has to be gathered again.

证据与理解边界：</strong>某次请求的工具字段为空，可能是增量协议，而非定.en: Evidence and the limits of understanding: an empty tool field on one request may be the delta protocol rather than a lost definition. Check it against the history and the actual protocol.

把一百轮历史压成几句话，最容易丢什么？.en: What is most easily lost when a hundred turns of history are compacted into a few sentences?

像交班给另一位同事：对方最需要目标、禁止事项、已经做完的事、还没核实的事，以及到.en: It is like handing a shift over to a colleague: what they need most is the goal, what is forbidden, what has already been done, what has not been verified, and where to look at the original evidence. The raw log can be kept elsewhere, but the distinctions that decide the next action must not be flattened. A summary is also not an execution database; it should not be used to decide whether a non-repeatable action has already completed.

截断</strong>直接删掉一部分上下文。.en: Truncation simply deletes part of the context.

摘要压缩</strong>用新文本概括旧信息，可能引入改写错误。.en: Summary compaction sums old information up in new text, which can introduce rewriting errors.

快照</strong>明确字段的当前状态记录。.en: Snapshot a record of the current state of explicitly named fields.

证据引用</strong>重新获取原文的定位信息。.en: Evidence citationThe locating information needed to fetch the original text again.

输入与适用条件：</strong>构造的exclude修复场景；有意保留“集成测.en: Input and conditions of use: A constructed exclude-fix scenario; the negative state "the integration test has not been run yet" is kept deliberately. The faulty summary serves only as a counterexample and must not be treated as a recommended template.

压缩要保留行动所依赖的事实：逐步运行图解.en: Compaction must keep the facts an action depends on: the run, step by step

1 / 5 · 原历史有很多噪声.en: 1 / 5 · The original history has a lot of noise

压缩必须保留否定与未完成状态，而不只是主题词.en: Compaction must keep negations and unfinished states, not only the topic words

工具输出、失败尝试和重复讨论可以很长。压缩的目标是减少历史占用，不是美化成“进度.en: Tool output, failed attempts and repeated discussion can run long. The aim of compaction is to reduce how much the history occupies, not to dress it up as "good progress".

有限窗口无法一直保留全部原始对话，但任务需要连续推进。.en: A finite window cannot keep the whole original conversation indefinitely, yet the task has to keep moving.

保留必要状态与引用，压缩后核对，再从原始来源恢复细节。.en: Keep the necessary state and references, check after compaction, then restore the details from the original source.

摘要重写可能把猜测变结论，多轮摘要还可能累计偏移。.en: Rewriting as a summary can turn a guess into a conclusion, and summarizing over several rounds can accumulate drift.

比较压缩前后允许的下一步动作是否一致，而不只是文本相似度。.en: Compare whether the next actions permitted before and after compaction are the same, not just the textual similarity.

证据与理解边界：</strong>候选只覆盖旧前缀，安装必须核验身份并保留实时后.en: Evidence and the limits of understanding: the candidate covers only the old prefix, so installing it must verify identity and keep the live suffix; accepted in memory and persisted successfully are different boundaries.

倒排索引和向量索引分别在帮什么忙？.en: What does an inverted index help with, and what does a vector index help with?

倒排像书后索引：从一个词跳到包含它的页面。向量检索则尝试把表达相近的内容放得接近.en: An inverted index is like the index at the back of a book: from one word you jump to the pages that contain it. Vector retrieval instead tries to place content worded in similar ways close together, which helps find candidates when you do not know the exact name. Neither of them confirms permissions, versions or factual correctness for you; the evidence still has to be read and checked.

索引</strong>为快速找候选而建立的数据结构。.en: IndexA data structure built to find candidates quickly.

召回</strong>从大集合中找出可能相关的候选。.en: Recall finding the possibly relevant candidates in a large set.

近似搜索</strong>以少检查部分候选换速度，可能漏掉真实近邻。.en: Approximate search trades examining only part of the candidates for speed, and may miss a true nearest neighbor.

输入与适用条件：</strong>三个文档为本书构造；倒排关系可精确核验，语义搜.en: Input and conditions of use:The three documents are constructions of this book; the inverted-index relationships can be checked exactly, while the semantic search only illustrates the process, and no measured scores from a vector service are invented.

检索先找候选，再判断能否回答：逐步运行图解.en: Retrieval finds candidates first, then judges whether they can answer: step-by-step run figure

1 / 4 · 先有原文，不是先有向量.en: 1 / 4 · The original text comes first, not the vector

检索先找候选，再判断能否回答：先有原文，不是先有向量.en: Retrieval finds candidates first, then judges whether they can answer: the original text comes first, not the vector

三份短文档都有自己的标识。索引是为查询服务的辅助结构，原文和版本仍应保留。.en: Each of the three short documents has its own identifier. An index is an auxiliary structure that serves queries; the original text and its version must still be kept.

避免每次全库扫描，但保持原文可追溯。.en: Avoids scanning the whole store every time, while keeping the original text traceable.

按合适粒度建索引，保持文档ID、内容、版本和权限关联。.en: Builds the index at a suitable granularity and keeps the document ID, content, version and permissions tied together.

切块丢标题条件、索引未更新、相似度与权限混用都会出错。.en: Chunking that drops the heading's condition, an index that was never updated, and mixing similarity up with permissions all go wrong.

用已知相关文档检查召回，并单独测试版本更新和撤权后的可见性。.en: Check recall with documents known to be relevant, and test visibility after a version update and after a permission is revoked separately.

把这一页的具体对象分清之后，再进入系统机制：<a href=\"../chapt.en: Once this page's concrete objects are clear, go on to the system mechanism: Relevant is not the same as usable: from recall to evidence closure. Knowing the full source first is not required; being able to retell from the state table what happened at each step is.

证据与理解边界：</strong>排名高不等于证据覆盖问题。本书RRF小算例不是.en: Evidence and the limits of understanding: a high rank does not mean the evidence covers the question. The small RRF worked example in this book is not an official production query; chunk context and the original evidence have to be kept apart.

“相关”与“足以回答”中间还差哪几步？.en: How many steps still lie between "relevant" and "enough to answer"?

多个检索入口可能互补。融合处理“哪些候选值得优先看”；重排对少量候选作更细比较；.en: Several retrieval entry points can complement each other. Fusion handles "which candidates deserve to be read first"; reranking makes a finer comparison over a small number of candidates; evidence verification handles "does this passage really support the present conclusion". The three stages have different goals, and one similarity score cannot stand in for all of those judgments.

通过名次而非原始分数融合候选列表的方法。.en: A method that fuses candidate lists by rank rather than by raw score.

重排</strong>对召回后的候选重新作相关性排序。.en: Reranking sorts the recalled candidates by relevance again.

证据充分性</strong>材料能否支持问题要求的结论和条件。.en: Evidence sufficiencyWhether the material can support the conclusion and the conditions the question requires.

输入与适用条件：</strong>本图独立排名算例：关键词[A,B,C]、语义[.en: Input and conditions of use: An independent worked ranking for this figure: keyword [A,B,C], semantic [B,C,A], k=60. The candidates never change at any point, and no ranking data from other chapters is carried in.

从两个候选列表，走到可用证据：逐步运行图解.en: From two candidate lists to usable evidence: the run, step by step

1 / 5 · 两种搜索给出不同名次.en: 1 / 5 · The two searches give different rankings

从两个候选列表，走到可用证据：两种搜索给出不同名次.en: From two candidate lists to usable evidence: the two searches give different ranks

固定三个候选：关键词排名A、B、C；语义排名B、C、A。两种原始分数不在同一量纲.en: Three candidates are fixed: by keyword the ranking is A, B, C; by meaning it is B, C, A. The two sets of raw scores are not on the same scale and cannot be added blindly.

精确词项与语义线索各有盲区，组合能提供互补候选。.en: Exact terms and semantic cues each have blind spots; combining them gives complementary candidates.

先融合候选，再核实原文与元数据，必要时补查缺失证据。.en: Fuse the candidates first, then verify the original text and the metadata, and look up the missing evidence where necessary.

提高Top-k可能把更多无关内容塞入上下文；检索器成绩提升不一定带来任务成功率提.en: Raising top-k can push more irrelevant content into the context; a better retriever score does not necessarily raise the task success rate.

分别测召回、排名和最终回答支持度；不要只测最终一项或只测搜索分数。.en: Measure recall, ranking and how well the final answer is supported separately; do not measure only the last of them, nor only the search score.

grep、AST、LSP、调用图各自看到什么？.en: What does each of grep, AST, LSP and the call graph see?

同一个函数名可能出现在注释、字符串、不同模块的同名函数中。文本搜索先定位线索，语.en: One and the same function name can appear in a comment, in a string, and in identically named functions in different modules. Text search locates the clue first, syntax analysis tells the structure apart, a language service helps resolve the specific symbol, and only running it and testing it tell you whether this path is really taken. They are checks from different angles, not a set to be run through in full on the principle that more is better.

按语言语法组织的代码结构树。.en: A tree of code structure organized by the language's grammar.

让编辑器查询符号、引用和诊断等信息的协议。.en: The protocol that lets an editor query symbols, references, diagnostics and similar information.

调用图</strong>以函数为节点、可能的调用为边的关系图。.en: Call graphA graph with functions as nodes and possible calls as edges.

输入与适用条件：</strong>以foo为教学符号，不指向用户仓库。调用图可能.en: Input and conditions of use:foo is used as a teaching symbol and does not point at the user's repository. A call graph can be affected by dynamic calls, conditional compilation and run-time configuration.

搜索命中不代表命中的是实际执行的函数。.en: A search hit does not mean the hit is on the function that actually runs.

“# foo”是注释，不应算成调用。.en: "# foo" is a comment and should not be counted as a call.

同名函数需要结合模块、导入和类型环境判断。.en: Identically named functions have to be judged together with the module, the imports and the type environment.

调用图提供候选影响范围；动态语言可能有静态分析看不到的边。.en: A call graph gives a candidate range of impact; a dynamic language may have edges that static analysis cannot see.

旧commit的引用关系不能当成当前工作区的事实。.en: The reference relationships in an old commit cannot be taken as facts about the current working tree.

读到代码是证据的一种；执行路径与回归结果能进一步排除错误解释。.en: Having read the code is one kind of evidence; the execution path and the regression results can rule out further wrong explanations.

用代码自身结构减少无关阅读与误定位。.en: Use the code's own structure to cut irrelevant reading and mislocation.

从最便宜且准确的路径/符号检索开始，证据不足再扩大。.en: Start from the cheapest accurate path or symbol retrieval, and widen it only when the evidence is not enough.

一上来全库语义扫描可能漏精确符号，同时浪费上下文。.en: A semantic scan of the whole repository right at the start can miss the exact symbol and waste context at the same time.

对已知缺陷记录实际入口、定义、调用者、版本和失败测试是否一致。.en: For a known defect, records whether the actual entry point, definition, callers, version and failing test agree.

证据与理解边界：</strong>读取、补丁和测试需要绑定工作树版本；最终文件再.en: Evidence and the limits of understanding: reads, patches and tests have to be bound to a working-tree version; once the final file changes again, the old test no longer covers the new result.

新事实出现后，旧记忆怎样更新而不毁掉历史？.en: When a new fact appears, how is old memory updated without destroying the history?

记忆要同时回答：这条信息说的是什么范围、何时有效、系统何时得知、依据在哪里。最新.en: A memory has to answer all of these at once: what scope this piece of information covers, when it is valid, when the system learned of it, and where the basis for it is. The most recently written record does not necessarily describe the most recently effective fact. Only by keeping the times and the sources can you both answer the current question and explain the past accurately.

有效时间</strong>事实在现实或业务规则中适用的时间。.en: Valid time the time over which a fact applies in reality or under business rules.

记录时间</strong>系统收到或保存该信息的时间。.en: Recorded timeThe time the system received or stored the information.

作用域</strong>信息适用的项目、用户、版本或环境。.en: Scope the project, user, version or environment the information applies to.

输入与适用条件：</strong>独立配置案例；月份只用于展示时间顺序，不涉及真.en: Input and conditions of use: An independent configuration case; the months only show the order in time and say nothing about any real product's current parameters. The 30 seconds and the 20 seconds belong to different validity periods.

长期记忆不是永远正确的小纸条：逐步运行图解.en: Long-term memory is not a note that is always right: step-by-step run figure

长期记忆不是永远正确的小纸条：1月1日 生效.en: Long-term memory is not a note that is always right: takes effect 1 January

跨会话复用有效知识，减少重复查找和重复错误。.en: Reuse valid knowledge across sessions, so the same lookups and the same mistakes are not repeated.

保存范围、来源与两个时间；使用前核验；过期、冲突与撤销显式处理。.en: Store the scope, the provenance and both times; verify before use; handle expiry, conflict and revocation explicitly.

把一次模型猜测写成通用规则，会在后续检索中放大错误。.en: Writing down one model guess as a general rule amplifies the error in later retrieval.

同时测试当前查询、历史查询、错误范围查询和来源已失效查询。.en: Test a current query, a historical query, a query with the wrong scope and a query whose source has expired, all of them.

语义记忆保存事实，情景记忆保存经历，程序性记忆保存有条件的方法；工作记忆服务当前.en: Semantic memory keeps facts, episodic memory keeps experiences, procedural memory keeps conditional methods; working memory serves the current task. CoALA is a framework for analyzing this kind of cognitive architecture, and MemGPT studies how a limited context and external storage are organized.<span class="concept-micro">"Patch p7 failed because a test was missing" is an experience; "Windows has to be supported for now" is a fact; "check the separator when changing path rules" is a conditional procedure, and must not be promoted straight into running the full test suite for every task.

记忆一句“超时是3”，缺了什么才会在下次出错.en: Remembering "the timeout is 3": what is missing that makes it go wrong next time

输入与条件。</strong>项目A旧配置timeout=3秒，项目B配置tim.en: Input and conditions.Project A's old configuration has timeout=3 seconds and project B's has timeout=8 seconds; project A changed to 5 seconds on 10 October, and the memory service only recorded it on 12 October.

不能只存“超时3秒”而不存项目。.en: "Timeout 3 seconds" must not be stored without the project.

区分什么时候有效与什么时候才知道。.en: Separates when something is in effect from when it became known.

选A且适用当前日期.en: Filter on A and on the current date

返回5秒并附来源。.en: Returns 5 seconds, with its source attached.

返回8秒，不能拿最相似的A记忆。.en: Returns 8 seconds; it must not reach for the most similar memory from A.

旧事实仍有用，不能无条件全覆盖。.en: The old fact is still useful; it must not be overwritten wholesale and unconditionally.

把过程连起来。</strong>有效记忆保存的是带适用范围和时间的命题，不是只保.en: Join the steps up. What effective memory stores is propositions with their scope and their time, not just a sentence.

边界与反例。</strong>时间与配置均为构造例；真实纠错策略还要区分更正错误.en: Limits and counterexamples. The times and the configuration are both a constructed example; a real correction policy must also tell correcting a wrong record apart from an ordinary version update.

证据与理解边界：</strong>生成产物后还要关停工作者、核验内容、确认租约与.en: Evidence and the limits of understanding: once the artifact has been produced you still have to shut the workers down, verify the content, confirm the lease and record completion; long-term memory is not the model's parameters updating themselves.

从“安装了技能”到“写出了更好的代码”，中间经过什么？.en: From "the skill is installed" to "better code was written": what happens in between?

技能像可按需展开的工作说明，不是新训练的一层神经网络。只有它被发现、匹配、读取，.en: A skill is like a work instruction that can be opened on demand, not a newly trained layer of a neural network. Only when it is discovered, matched, read and actually influences the action can it improve the outcome. Treating "loaded successfully" as capability applied hides several intermediate failures.

路由</strong>决定当前任务调用哪份能力或资源。.en: RoutingDeciding which capability or resource the current task calls on.

渐进加载</strong>先提供描述，相关时再读完整内容和资源。.en: Progressive loading supply the description first, then read the full content and resources when they are relevant.

有效应用</strong>能从行动或结果中观察到技能要求的落实。.en: Effective application the skill's requirements can be observed being carried out in the actions or the results.

输入与适用条件：</strong>通用Skill运行示意，不假定Codex、Cl.en: Input and conditions of use: A generic illustration of a skill running; it does not assume that the implementation details of Codex, Claude Code and Copilot are identical.

文件没在搜索路径里，下一步就可能看不到。.en: If the file is not on the search path, the next step may not see it.

描述太泛会误触发；太窄会漏掉本应适用的任务。.en: Too broad a description triggers wrongly; too narrow a one misses tasks it should apply to.

任务相关性要结合实际需求和证据，不应按单个关键词机械决定。.en: Task relevance has to be judged against the actual need and the evidence; it should not be decided mechanically from a single keyword.

加载了描述不代表完整操作要求已经进入上下文。.en: Loading the description does not mean the full operating requirements have entered the context.

检查具体动作是否遵守规则，而不是只看输出里是否出现技能名称。.en: Check whether the actual actions follow the rule, rather than only whether the skill's name appears in the output.

多花Token却未提升质量的规则应重新评估，不把流程长度当专业性。.en: A rule that spends more tokens without improving quality should be reassessed; length of process is not expertise.

在需要时提供专业步骤，避免所有规则常驻上下文。.en: Supplies expert steps when they are needed, so that not every rule has to sit in the context.

按发现→匹配→加载→执行→验证逐段诊断。.en: Diagnoses stage by stage: discovery → match → load → execute → verify.

过度加载引入冲突和成本；漏加载导致关键专业要求缺失。.en: Loading too much brings conflict and cost; failing to load leaves a key professional requirement missing.

用该加载与不该加载的真实任务双向测路由，再测最终工程质量。.en: Test the routing in both directions, with real tasks that should load it and real tasks that should not, then test the final engineering quality.

证据与理解边界：</strong>技能正文保留、工具许可延续和子Agent预载各.en: Evidence and the limits of understanding: keeping a skill's text, carrying tool permissions forward and preloading a sub-agent each have their own conditions; a file existing, or an earlier call succeeding, is not enough to prove it was applied this turn.

Handoff是把控制权交给另一个Agent；agent-as-tool把子Ag.en: A handoff gives control to another agent; agent-as-tool treats a sub-agent as a callable component whose result returns to the current controller. An orchestrator is the coordinating program or agent responsible for distributing and integrating the work.<span class="concept-micro">Delegation needs the task, the boundaries, the evidence and the completion conditions; it does not require copying the whole history of the main session across.

为什么自动重试有时会把一次工作做两遍？.en: Why does an automatic retry sometimes do the same work twice?

外部服务可能已经完成动作，只是成功消息没回到调用方。此时“未知”是精确状态，不是.en: The external service may already have completed the action; only the success message never came back to the caller. Here "unknown" is a precise state, not a sign that the system is not clever enough. For actions with side effects such as creating a new record or sending a message, recovery needs a stable operation identifier, a result check, or idempotent semantics supported by the service. Retrying a read-only query usually needs no design of the same complexity.

幂等</strong>重复同一逻辑操作不产生额外副作用。.en: Idempotency repeating the same logical operation produces no extra side effect.

操作ID</strong>标识同一次逻辑动作，重试不随意换新ID。.en: Operation ID identifies one and the same logical action; a retry does not casually switch to a new ID.

事务</strong>在某个明确系统边界内保证一致性的机制。.en: Transaction a mechanism that guarantees consistency within one clearly stated system boundary.

输入与适用条件：</strong>构造的外部写入场景；不承诺跨数据库、文件系统和.en: Input and conditions of use: A constructed external-write scenario; it does not promise that a database, a file system and a remote API naturally share an "exactly once" transaction.

超时告诉你没收到，不告诉你没发生：逐步运行图解.en: A timeout tells you nothing arrived, not that nothing happened: step-by-step figure

超时告诉你没收到，不告诉你没发生：请求 op-1.en: A timeout tells you nothing arrived, not that nothing happened: request op-1

创建一条记录；客户端等待回执.en: A record is created; the client waits for the receipt

在不可靠网络下维持正确副作用次数。.en: Keeping the number of side effects correct over an unreliable network.

先判断操作是否可重复，再决定重试、查状态、对账或人工确认。.en: First judge whether the operation is repeatable, then decide between retrying, checking the state, reconciling, or asking a person to confirm.

只在本地记一个成功标志，不能消除“远端已提交、本地未记录”的窗口。.en: Recording a success flag locally does not remove the window in which "the remote side has committed and the local side has not recorded it".

故意丢回执并重试，核对最终仅存在一条逻辑记录。.en: Deliberately drops the receipt and retries, then checks that only one logical record exists in the end.

证据与理解边界：</strong>失败、取消和结果未知不能合并成一种状态；重试安.en: Evidence and the limits of understanding: failure, cancellation and an unknown result cannot be merged into one state; safe retrying depends on downstream idempotence or verification, and the experiments in this book are not a product's exactly-once guarantee.

为什么“测试都通过”仍可能交付错东西？.en: Why can "all the tests pass" still mean the wrong thing is delivered?

测试只能验证它实际检查的行为和版本。一条只断言“不报错”的测试无法证明排除规则正.en: A test can only verify the behavior and the version it actually checks. A test that only asserts "no error is raised" cannot prove that the exclusion rule is correct. A good test is built around the requirement, with input that can hit the error; and once the code changes, an old green result no longer automatically belongs to the new version.

反例</strong>能让错误实现暴露问题的具体输入。.en: Counterexample a concrete input that makes a wrong implementation show the problem.

回归</strong>修改破坏了本来成立的行为。.en: Regression a change has broken behavior that previously held.

交付证据</strong>当前版本对应的检查命令、结果与范围。.en: Delivery evidence the check commands, results and scope that match the current version.

输入与适用条件：</strong>本图独立约定：按项目相对路径，只排除根目录ve.en: Input and conditions of use: An independent convention for this figure: paths are taken relative to the project, and only files under the root-level vendor/ are excluded; myvendor/ is not. It is a teaching task for explaining counterexample tests, and it does not rewrite the definitions of the other independent wildcard examples in the main text.

不先说匹配对象与目录语义，无法判断哪个输出才正确。.en: Without first saying what is being matched and what the directory means, there is no telling which output is the correct one.

每个样本都针对一种可能的边界。.en: Each sample targets one possible boundary.

能复现旧缺陷，才能确认后续修复没有仅仅改掉测试本身。.en: Only if the old defect can be reproduced can you confirm that the later fix did not simply change the test itself.

问题明确时直接修补与验证，不必反复设计完整架构。.en: When the problem is clear, patch and verify directly; there is no need to keep designing a complete architecture.

测试要能区分正确实现和有意破坏的实现。.en: A test has to tell a correct implementation from a deliberately broken one.

提交前确认测试对应当前文件与环境，报告尚未检查的范围。.en: Before submitting, confirms that the tests match the current files and environment, and reports what has not been checked.

减少返工和虚假完成，而非让审查循环无限增长。.en: Reduces rework and false completion, rather than letting the review loop grow without end.

围绕可观察行为、反例和当前版本组织验证。.en: Organize the verification around observable behavior, counterexamples and the current version.

测试与实现共用同一错误假设、只测顺利路径、频繁审查无实际修复。.en: Tests and implementation share the same wrong assumption, only the happy path is tested, and frequent reviews bring no actual fix.

故意引入一处已知错误，测试应失败；恢复后再通过。.en: Deliberately introduces one known error; the test should fail, and should pass again once it is undone.

证据与理解边界：</strong>长任务角色和重置策略并非越多越好；模型升级后应.en: Evidence and the limits of understanding: more roles and reset policies for a long task are not better; after a model upgrade, compare against a trimmed-down mechanism instead of always applying the longest process.

为什么精确率高不等于证据找全了？.en: Why does high precision not mean all the evidence has been found?

分子看起来都是“找对了多少”，分母却在回答不同问题。精确率从已拿回的内容看浪费；.en: The numerators all look like "how many were found correctly", but the denominators answer different questions. Precision looks at the waste among what has been brought back; recall looks at what was missed among what was really needed. An agent's task success rate is a result at yet another level, so a retrieval metric cannot be taken directly as the success rate of the whole task.

该选且确实选中的项。.en: Items that should have been selected and indeed were.

不该选却选中的项。.en: An item that was selected when it should not have been.

应该选却漏掉的项。.en: Items that should have been selected but were missed.

评测单位</strong>一次任务、一次运行、一个文档或一个位置，必须先定清。.en: Unit of evaluationOne task, one run, one document or one position — it has to be settled first.

输入与适用条件：</strong>本图始终TP=6、FP=2、FN=4；未定义T.en: Input and conditions of use:Throughout this figure TP=6, FP=2 and FN=4; TN is undefined, so accuracy is not computed. Percentages from different samples in other chapters cannot be joined directly to these.

读指标，先问它的分母是谁：逐步运行图解.en: When reading a metric, first ask what its denominator is: step-by-step figure

1 / 4 · 四种结果先分开.en: 1 / 4 · Keep the four outcomes apart first

读指标，先问它的分母是谁：四种结果先分开.en: When reading a metric, first ask what its denominator is: separate the four outcomes first

实际应该命中的10项里找到6项，漏4项；另有2项不应命中却被选中。.en: Of the 10 items that should have been hit, 6 were found and 4 missed; another 2 were selected that should not have been hit.

用准确的指标发现遗漏或浪费，而不被单个漂亮百分比误导。.en: Use accurate metrics to find what was missed or wasted, instead of being misled by one pretty percentage.

明确任务集与单位，再计算分子分母，同时看下游任务表现。.en: State the task set and the units, then compute the numerator and the denominator, and look at downstream task performance at the same time.

一题跑十次不是十道独立题；重试成功率与单次成功率也不同。.en: Running one question ten times is not ten independent questions; and a success rate with retries is not the same as a single-attempt success rate.

从原始记录重算指标，逐项检查是否重复计数或遗漏失败。.en: Recompute the metric from the original records, checking item by item for double counting and for missed failures.

精确率看返回结果中有多少相关；召回率看应找相关中找到了多少；MRR平均第一个正确.en: Precision looks at how many of the returned results are relevant; recall looks at how many of the relevant items that should have been found were found; MRR averages the reciprocal rank of the first correct item; nDCG takes the degree of relevance and the position in the order into account, and normalizes against the ideal ordering.<span class="concept-micro">Independent example: 5 documents should be found, 4 are returned and 3 of them are relevant, so precision is 3/4 and recall 3/5. Do not swap these two denominators.

把这一页的具体对象分清之后，再进入系统机制：<a href=\"../chapt.en: Once this page's concrete objects are clear, go on to the system mechanism: Why can pass@k, pass^k and a single-attempt success rate not be used interchangeably?. Knowing the full source first is not required; being able to retell from the state table what happened at each step is.

证据与理解边界：</strong>分别记录任务、一次尝试、执行轨迹与环境结果；资.en: Evidence and the limits of understanding: record the task, a single attempt, the execution trace and the environment's result separately; resource limits and state that was not reset both confound a comparison.

一次实验怎样区别真实改进与偶然波动？.en: How does one experiment tell a real improvement from chance variation?

像给同一组题换两种解法：同题对照能减少题目难度不同带来的干扰。统计方法帮助表达不.en: It is like giving the same set of problems two different solutions: comparing on the same problems reduces the interference from problems differing in difficulty. Statistical methods help express the uncertainty; they do not tell you by themselves whether a regression is acceptable or whether the cost is worth it. The real decision still comes back to the type of task, the severity of a mistake and how the behavior repeats.

配对</strong>同一任务同时有新旧方案结果。.en: Paired the same task has results from both the new and the old approach at once.

百分点</strong>两个百分率直接相减，如70%−60%=10个百分点。.en: Percentage pointTwo percentages subtracted directly, as in 70%−60%=10 percentage points.

随机波动</strong>在相同条件下多次运行也可能有不同结果。.en: Random variation several runs under the same conditions can still give different results.

输入与适用条件：</strong>构造的20题配对表：10都成、4新成旧败、2旧.en: Input and conditions of use: A constructed paired table of 20 questions: 10 where both succeed, 4 where the new one succeeds and the old one fails, 2 where the old one succeeds and the new one fails, and 4 where both fail. Do not take it for a real model's win rate.

涨了10个百分点，为什么还不能急着下结论？：逐步运行图解.en: It went up ten points — so why can we not conclude anything yet? Step-by-step run figure

1 / 5 · 同20题，两版各跑一次.en: 1 / 5 · The same 20 questions, each version run once

涨了10个百分点，为什么还不能急着下结论？：同20题，两版各跑一次.en: It went up ten points — so why can we not conclude anything yet?: the same 20 questions, each version run once

配对意味着旧版和新版面对同一题。先列出两者在每道题上的成功与失败关系，而不是只看.en: Pairing means the old version and the new version face the same question. Start by listing, question by question, how the two relate in success and failure, instead of looking only at the two totals.

避免因一个小样本的好看结果就把优化推向全部任务。.en: Avoid pushing an optimization onto every task just because one small sample gave a good-looking result.

固定题集、版本和预算，配对重复，记录退化，并检查置信区间等不确定性。.en: Fix the question set, the version and the budget, repeat in pairs, record the regressions, and examine the uncertainty, such as the confidence interval.

只保留成功重跑、反复调参又用同一评测集验收，会高估能力。.en: Keeping only the runs that succeeded, tuning repeatedly and then accepting on the same evaluation set overstates the capability.

重算全部配对原始记录，报告净提升、退化和成本，而不是只报均值。.en: Recompute every paired raw record and report the net gain, the regressions and the cost, rather than the mean alone.

为什么“模型被劝住”不能作为唯一防线？.en: Why can "the model was talked out of it" not be the only line of defense?

外部网页、源码注释和工具结果都是要分析的数据。它们可能包含看起来像命令的句子，但.en: External web pages, source comments and tool results are all data to be analyzed. They may contain sentences that look like commands, but that cannot change the authorization the user granted. A model's understanding of instructions is probabilistic; the actual read, write and network capability still has to be controlled by program boundaries.

可信边界</strong>不同来源与权限之间不能随意跨越的分界。.en: Trust boundary the dividing line between different sources and permissions that must not be crossed at will.

沙箱</strong>对执行环境某些资源进行隔离的机制。.en: Sandbox a mechanism that isolates certain resources of the execution environment.

最小权限</strong>只给当前任务需要的能力范围。.en: Least privilege granting only the range of capability the current task needs.

输入与适用条件：</strong>只展示无实际执行的教学注入句“忽略原任务”；不.en: Input and conditions of use:It only shows the teaching injection sentence "ignore the original task", which is never actually executed; no external system is accessed and no dangerous action is performed.

资料能影响模型，不代表获得了权限：逐步运行图解.en: Material can influence a model without thereby gaining permission: step-by-step figure

外部资料可以提供证据，但不能签发工具权限.en: External material can supply evidence, but it cannot issue tool permissions

读到一条命令样式的句子，不意味着这是新的用户请求。.en: Reading a sentence in the shape of a command does not mean it is a new user request.

限制错误或恶意输入能造成的真实损害。.en: Limits the real damage that mistaken or malicious input can do.

源信息分层与执行隔离配合，按操作风险决定人工确认。.en: Layering source information works together with execution isolation; human confirmation is decided by the risk of the operation.

只有文件隔离没有网络限制，或只限制Shell却忽略外部MCP，都可能留下空隙。.en: File isolation with no network restriction, or restricting the shell while ignoring an external MCP, can each leave a gap.

用受控的越权尝试检查实际边界，并验证正常任务仍可完成。.en: Check the real boundary with a controlled over-privileged attempt, and verify that normal tasks can still be completed.

证据与理解边界：</strong>外部上下文标记不是恶意识别证明；提示、执行权限.en: Evidence and the limits of understanding: marking external context is no proof that malice was detected; the prompt, execution permissions, the sandbox, remote authorization and logs are separate lines of defense.

为何优化一个最显眼的步骤，整体却没变快？.en: Why does optimizing the most conspicuous step leave the whole no faster?

执行轨迹像工程里的时间账，但更重要的是依赖关系。串行阶段会相加，并行阶段往往取关.en: An execution trace is like a time ledger in engineering, but what matters more is the dependencies. Serial stages add up, while parallel stages usually take the critical path; only by knowing what the next step is waiting for can you know where optimizing is worthwhile. Queueing, inference, tools, verification and retries also have to be kept apart rather than all charged to a slow model.

一条任务中各步骤及关联关系的记录。.en: A record of the steps in one task and how they relate to each other.

墙钟时间</strong>从任务开始到结束真正经过多久。.en: Wall-clock time how much time really passes from the start of the task to its end.

关键路径</strong>决定完成时间的依赖链。.en: Critical path the chain of dependencies that decides when the work finishes.

吞吐</strong>单位时间完成多少任务。.en: Throughput how many tasks are completed per unit of time.

输入与适用条件：</strong>固定教学秒数，无真实产品耗时数据。第4帧只改变.en: Input and conditions of use:Fixed teaching seconds, with no real product timing data. Frame 4 changes only the duration of tool A; all other conditions stay the same.

Trace要告诉你因果，不只是时间戳：逐步运行图解.en: A trace should tell you causation, not just timestamps: step-by-step run figure

Trace要告诉你因果，不只是时间戳：先看一条完整任务.en: A trace should tell you causation, not just timestamps: start with one complete task

构造的任务从0到16秒：排队2秒、第一次模型3秒、并行工具A3秒/B8秒、第二次.en: The constructed task runs from 0 to 16 seconds: 2 s queued, 3 s for the first model call, tools A and B in parallel at 3 s and 8 s, 2 s for the second model call and 1 s to verify.

把优化投入到确实支配成本或完成时间的环节。.en: Spend the optimization effort on the link that really dominates cost or completion time.

按依赖关系画时间线，再用同负载实测对照。.en: Draws the timeline from the dependencies, then compares it against a measurement under the same load.

只看平均值会隐藏长尾；把并行跨度相加会错误夸大总耗时。.en: Looking only at the average hides the long tail; adding up parallel spans wrongly inflates the total time.

按时间戳与依赖重算16秒，检查是否把等待和重试遗漏。.en: Recomputes the 16 seconds from the timestamps and the dependencies, and checks whether waiting and retries were left out.

证据与理解边界：</strong>当前上下文长度、已消耗用量和可恢复日志长度不同.en: Evidence and the limits of understanding: the current context length, the usage already spent and the length of the recoverable log are different things; a discarded summary and a failed attempt can cost resources too.

为什么看得懂截图，也可能点错按钮？.en: Why can a screenshot be understood and the wrong button still be clicked?

图像编码解决“把视觉信息变成可计算表示”；界面控制解决“在真实软件的当前状态做正.en: Image encoding solves "turning visual information into a computable representation"; interface control solves "taking the right action in the real software's current state". The coordinates in a static picture, the page's current layout and the result of the click have to be connected up. However fluent the model's description of a picture, it is no substitute for confirming after the action.

图像被切分出的一小块。.en: A small patch cut out of the image.

视觉编码器</strong>把像素处理成模型可用表示的网络。.en: Vision encoderA network that turns pixels into a representation the model can use.

把指令对象定位到具体界面元素或坐标。.en: Grounds the object of the instruction in a concrete interface element or coordinate.

输入与适用条件：</strong>仅4×4灰度像素与构造界面流程；不代表所有多模.en: Input and conditions of use:Only 4×4 greyscale pixels and a constructed interface flow; this does not represent the preprocessing of every multimodal model, nor does it pass itself off as the result of really driving a browser.

图像表示与界面行动，是两层不同问题：逐步运行图解.en: Image representation and interface action are two different problems: the run, step by step

1 / 4 · 图像也是规则数字表.en: 1 / 4 · An image is a regular table of numbers too

图像表示与界面行动，是两层不同问题：图像也是规则数字表.en: Image representation and interface action are two different problems: an image is also a regular table of numbers

独立的4×4灰度教学图，每格是一个像素值。真实彩色图还会有颜色通道；像素值不等于.en: An independent 4×4 greyscale teaching image, each cell one pixel value. A real color image also has color channels; a pixel value is not a text token ID.

让模型处理非文本信息，同时让实际界面动作可核验。.en: Let the model handle non-text information while keeping the actual interface actions verifiable.

区分表示链与行动链；可靠API存在时优先用结构化接口。.en: Separate the representation chain from the action chain; where a dependable API exists, prefer the structured interface.

裁剪缩放坐标错位、截图过期、视觉幻觉、点击重试副作用。.en: Misaligned coordinates from cropping and scaling, a stale screenshot, visual hallucination, and the side effects of retrying a click.

核对像素块顺序与坐标变换；每次行动后观察环境变化。.en: Check the order of the pixel patches and the coordinate transformation; observe how the environment changes after every action.

证据与理解边界：</strong>截图与动作都依赖当时状态；本书坐标失效场景是教.en: Evidence and the limits of understanding: both the screenshot and the action depend on the state at that moment; this book's scenario of coordinates going stale is a teaching counterexample, not a reproduction of a closed-source product's internal algorithm.

什么时候该改Prompt、检索、记忆或模型？.en: When should the prompt, retrieval, memory or the model be changed?

一个错误答案可以来自不同原因。模型根本没拿到新版本时，增加推理时间不能补出缺失事.en: One wrong answer can come from different causes. When the model never received the new version, more inference time cannot make up the missing fact; when retrieval did fetch the new version but old memory overwrote it, the context and the rules for using memory are what need fixing. Which layer to repair should follow the evidence, rather than adding another agent at the sight of a failure.

归因</strong>用证据判断导致现象的环节。.en: Attribution using evidence to decide which link caused the phenomenon.

消融</strong>改变或移除一个因素，看现象如何变化。.en: Ablation changing or removing one factor and seeing how the phenomenon changes.

最小有效修复</strong>能处理已确认问题而不扩大无关复杂度的改动。.en: The smallest effective fix a change that handles the confirmed problem without widening unrelated complexity.

输入与适用条件：</strong>独立诊断例：当前版本r8的timeout=30.en: Input and conditions of use: An independent diagnostic example: the current version r8 has timeout=30 and the older r7 has 10; check whether the error happens in the sync, retrieval, summary or generation layer, and do not take a single improvement for proof of cause.

先写清楚哪句话错、正确证据是什么，避免只说“感觉变差”。.en: Write down which sentence is wrong and what the correct evidence is, instead of only saying "it feels worse".

若原始证据没进入系统，先处理数据链路，不责怪模型不会推理。.en: If the original evidence never entered the system, deal with the data path first instead of blaming the model for not reasoning.

查排名、权限、有效时间和版本标签。.en: Check the ranking, the permissions, the valid time and the version tags.

区分“记录得晚”与“实际最新生效”；检查是否错把旧总结提升为事实。.en: Separate "recorded late" from "actually the latest in effect"; check whether an old summary has been wrongly promoted to a fact.

保持模型和其他环节不变，修一个被证据支持的环节。.en: Hold the model and the other stages unchanged, and fix the one stage the evidence supports.

检查相关场景改善，也检查新版本过滤是否损害历史查询。.en: Check that the relevant cases improve, and also check whether the new version's filtering harms historical queries.

避免无目的地叠Prompt、规则、模型和审查环节。.en: Avoid piling up prompts, rules, models and review steps with no purpose.

按原文→索引→检索→上下文→推理→行动→核验逐段定位。.en: Locates the problem stage by stage: original text → index → retrieval → context → inference → action → verification.

同时改变多个因素后只看总成功率，无法解释哪项改动起作用。.en: Changing several factors at once and then looking only at the overall success rate explains nothing about which change worked.

同任务、同版本、同预算对照，保留失败样本与可复查轨迹。.en: Compare at the same task, the same version and the same budget, keeping the failure samples and traces that can be re-checked.

证据与理解边界：</strong>多个转述同一原始来源并不构成独立证据；结论要回.en: Evidence and the limits of understanding:Several retellings of the same original source do not amount to independent evidence; a conclusion must be traced back to the original text actually obtained, and to its conditions.

主题导读</a><a href=\"#section-2\">领域讲义</a><.en: Topic guideField lecture notesSupporting material

观察一组简单语料如何决定字符对合并。训练规则与应用规则分开，保留原文本可逆。例子.en: Watch how a simple corpus decides which character pairs merge. Learning the rules is kept separate from applying them, and the original text stays recoverable. The example deliberately does not implement a real model's byte encoding, special tokens or preprocessing.

先运行默认样例，再改变语料或合并次数。相同文本可能得到不同教学Token数，说明.en: Run the default sample first, then change the corpus or the number of merges. The same text can come out with a different teaching token count, which shows that counting depends on the tokenizer. Do not use the result to work out billing for a commercial model.

以下结果由随包脚本产生。它们不是LLM或产品性能数据。.en: The results below are produced by the scripts shipped with this book. They are not LLM or product performance data.

计算稳定softmax、缩放点积注意力和Value加权。自检修改未来位置的Val.en: Computes a numerically stable softmax, scaled dot-product attention and the weighting of values. The self-check alters the value at a future position and confirms that the outputs of earlier positions are unaffected.

比较有无因果掩码，并改变分数差距。softmax([0,1,2])约为[0.09.en: Compare with and without the causal mask, and vary the gap between the scores. softmax([0,1,2]) is about [0.0900,0.2447,0.6652]; this is not confidence in a fact.

使用注明条件的标准注意力估算式，比较8与32个KV头。另用离散列表演示共同前缀，.en: Uses the standard attention estimate with its conditions stated, comparing 8 KV heads with 32. A separate discrete list demonstrates the shared prefix; no vendor cache server is simulated.

默认例子分别得到1与4 GiB。加入批大小后观察线性项；真实内存还含权重、分配器.en: The default example gives 1 and 4 GiB respectively. Add the batch size and watch the linear term; real memory also holds the weights, the allocator and other state, and a special architecture may not fit this at all.

对合成排名融合，并计算Precision、Recall、单查询倒数排名和nDCG.en: Fuses the synthetic rankings and computes Precision, Recall, the per-query reciprocal rank and nDCG. The relevance labels are assigned by hand in this book.

需要A、B却只返回A、X、Y时，Precision@3为1/3，Recall@3.en: When A and B are needed but only A, X and Y come back, Precision@3 is 1/3 and Recall@3 is 1/2. Add noise or swap the ordering, and watch how the different metrics react.

把原始任务标成结构化命题，与故意错误的压缩状态比较，检查缺失、确定性、执行状态和.en: Marks the original task up as structured propositions and compares them with a deliberately wrong compacted state, checking for omissions and for differences in certainty, execution state and version.

错误样例会缺少public_api，并出现4处字段变化。它不是自然语言理解器；真.en: The faulty sample is missing public_api and shows four field changes. It is not a natural-language understander; a real summary has to extract the propositions reliably first, and then go on to verify the task.

在进程内保存带证据的记忆，按项目与版本查询，排除过期内容，遇到相反结论返回冲突而.en: Keeps memories with their evidence in process, queries them by project and version, excludes stale content, and on a contradictory conclusion returns a conflict instead of quietly picking one.

固定教学日期为2026-10-17。修改项目或版本观察隔离；新增冲突证据后应返回.en: The teaching date is fixed at 2026-10-17. Change the project or the version to observe the isolation; once conflicting evidence is added, it should return conflict. This script does not access any real user's memory.

用确定性模拟模型依次提出读取、修改、测试。执行器检查工具和作用域，记录幂等操作，.en: A deterministic simulated model proposes read, modify and test in turn. The executor checks the tool and the scope, records idempotent operations, and the final state depends on verification.

完整任务只有一次模拟写入，重复同一操作ID不重复写。未授权publish被拒绝。.en: The whole task makes only one simulated write, and repeating the same operation ID does not write again. The unauthorized publish is refused. No real LLM is called, and no real project files are read or written.

计算pass@k、独立重复假设下的至少一次与全部成功概率，并对合成配对任务做Bo.en: Compute pass@k and, under an assumption of independent repetitions, the probability of at least one success and of every attempt succeeding; then demonstrate a bootstrap on a synthetic paired task.

p=0.8、k=3得到0.992与0.512。所有任务结果和费用是虚构的；区间不.en: With p=0.8 and k=3 the results are 0.992 and 0.512. All the task outcomes and costs are invented; the interval is not a statistical conclusion about any product.

定义一个虚构的字面目录前缀匹配契约，展示仅比较顶层目录的基线缺陷，以及规范化后的.en: Defines a fictional contract for literal directory-prefix matching, showing the baseline defect of comparing only the top-level directory and the fix after normalization.

明确区分src/generated与src/generated2，保持大小写敏感.en: Distinguish src/generated from src/generated2 explicitly, stay case-sensitive, and reject parent-directory traversal and globs. It does not represent the matching semantics of any real build system.

在人工构造的叶子Span上计算墙钟时间、操作时长总和及峰值并发。相邻区间按左闭右.en: Computes wall-clock time, the sum of the operation durations and peak concurrency over artificially constructed leaf spans. Adjacent intervals are treated as closed on the left and open on the right.

默认墙钟9、操作总量12、峰值并发2。不要同时把父Span与子Span重复加总，.en: By default the wall clock is 9, total work 12 and peak concurrency 2. Do not add a parent span and its child spans up twice over, and do not take a synthetic time for an actual performance measurement.
