数字与输入表示</a><a href=\"#group-2\">模型计算、生成与.en: Numbers and input representationModel computation, generation and stoppingTraining and compute resourcesAgents, protocols and contextRetrieval, memory, collaboration and reliable deliveryEvaluation, security and productionThe reasons for optimizing, the methods and the cost

Q/K/V：先算从哪读，再算读进多少：同一输入，三条参数路径.en: Q/K/V: first compute where to read from, then how much to read in: one input, three parameter paths

Query、Key、Value各自是什么数，为什么分三条路径？.en: What numbers are the query, the key and the value, and why are there three separate paths?

GQA/MQA：减少的是K/V组数：MHA：每个查询头有自己的K/V.en: GQA/MQA: what is reduced is the number of K/V groups: MHA: every query head has its own K/V

为什么查询头数没变，缓存却可以变小？.en: Why can the cache shrink when the number of query heads has not changed?

量化：省存储，也引入近似：原来的四个浮点数.en: Quantization: saves storage, and introduces approximation: the original four floating-point numbers

为什么“4bit”不等于所有模型内存都缩到八分之一？.en: Why does "4bit" not mean that all of a model's memory shrinks to an eighth?

LoRA：冻结大表，学习小增量：原权重并没有被删除.en: LoRA: freeze the large table, learn a small increment: the original weights have not been deleted

减少的是整个模型，还是需要更新的参数？.en: Is it the whole model that is reduced, or the parameters that need updating?

FlashAttention：一边读一边累计，不攒整张表：普通写法先想象整张分数.en: FlashAttention: accumulate while reading, without materializing the whole table: the ordinary way starts by imagining the whole score table

不把完整注意力表存下来，怎样仍算出同一输出？.en: Without storing the whole attention table, how is the same output still computed?

PagedAttention：逻辑连续，物理可以分块：初始：A仅3个位置.en: PagedAttention: logically contiguous, physically chunked: to begin with, A has only 3 positions

缓存为什么不必为每个请求找一大块连续显存？.en: Why does the cache not need one large contiguous block of VRAM for every request?

连续组批：有座位空出来，就接下一位：普通批次等待整体结束.en: Continuous batching: when a seat frees up, take the next one: an ordinary batch waits for the whole of it to end

为什么设备更忙，不代表每条请求都更快？.en: Why does a busier device not mean every request is faster?

推测解码：草稿可以快，但必须正确校验：草稿分布与目标分布不同.en: Speculative decoding: the draft may be fast, but it must be verified correctly: the draft distribution differs from the target distribution

为什么“让小模型先写，大模型点头”还不够准确？.en: Why is "let the small model write first and the large model nod" still not accurate enough?

MoE：每个Token选部分计算路径：先算路由分数.en: MoE: each token takes part of the compute path: compute the routing scores first

为什么总参数很多，但每Token不用计算所有专家？.en: Why, with so many parameters in total, does each token not have to compute every expert?

Activation Checkpointing：少存一点，反向时重算：普通保存.en: Activation checkpointing: store less, recompute on the backward pass: saving as usual

为什么有的优化是用时间换内存，而KV缓存恰好相反？.en: Why do some optimizations trade time for memory, while the KV cache does exactly the opposite?

压缩、检索与Prompt Cache：三种不同的“省”：不区分内容，全塞进来.en: Compaction, retrieval and prompt cache: three different kinds of saving: no distinction by content, everything stuffed in

上下文短了、检索准了、缓存命中了，为什么不能混为一谈？.en: A shorter context, more accurate retrieval, a cache hit — why can these not be lumped together?

多Agent：可并行的工作，比Agent数量重要：顺序完成两个独立子任务.en: Multi-agent: work that can run in parallel matters more than the number of agents: two independent subtasks completed in sequence

为什么任务拆得更细，有时完成得更慢、更差？.en: Why does splitting a task more finely sometimes finish slower and worse?

模型路由：便宜一次，不一定便宜一项成功任务：先给全部20题用便宜模型.en: Model routing: cheaper per call is not cheaper per successful task — start by using the cheap model on all 20 questions

怎样判断换小模型是优化，还是把成本挪到返工？.en: How do you tell whether switching to a smaller model is an optimization, or just moves the cost into rework?

动态图解</span><span>约 1.1 千字</span><span>图表.en: Step-by-step figuresabout 1.1k charactersFigures with item-by-item notes

以下解释全部展开，与播放器使用同一份数据；不是另换输入的第二个算例。.en: Every explanation below is expanded and uses the same data as the player; it is not a second worked example with different input.

“你爱”只有两个真实位置，先用PAD占一个格。现在有两行，每行三个编号，所以是[.en: "你爱" has only two real positions, so PAD takes one cell for now. There are now two rows with three IDs each, hence [2,3].

选中第二条输入的“爱”，取到编号2，再去Embedding表取第2行。原来的一个.en: Select "爱" in the second input, which gives ID 2, and then fetch row 2 of the embedding table. What was one cell is now represented by four feature cells.

每句话成为一张表：三行对应三个位置，四列对应四个特征。两句话就是两张这样的表，因.en: Each sentence becomes one table: three rows for the three positions and four columns for the four features. Two sentences are two such tables, which is written [2,3,4].

“学习”在本例是一项。这里展示结果，不假称来自某个商业分词器。.en: "学习" is one item in this example. The result is shown here; no claim is made that it comes from some commercial tokenizer.

查对应表得到行号；“你”的4比“我”的1大，不代表语义更强。.en: Look the row number up in the corresponding table; 4 for "你" being larger than 1 for "我" does not mean its meaning is stronger.

短句暂时只有两个编号；补齐是下一步的组批选择，不属于原句本身。.en: The short sentence has only two IDs for now; padding is a batching choice at the next step and is not part of the sentence itself.

反向查同一词表，按顺序拼片段。“你爱”不能把PAD还原成普通可见文字。.en: Look the same vocabulary up in reverse and join the pieces in order. For "你爱", PAD cannot be turned back into ordinary visible text.

本图拆的是表示关系。真实聊天还可能有角色标记等特殊Token，不应按汉字数估算总.en: What this figure takes apart is the representation relationship. A real chat may also carry special tokens such as role markers, so the total token count should not be estimated from the number of Chinese characters.

短句末尾放PAD编号0，占位而不增加真实内容。.en: PAD, ID 0, is placed at the end of the short sentence to hold the place without adding real content.

用1标记真Token，用0标记PAD。该表帮助后续计算排除填充位置。.en: Mark a real token with 1 and PAD with 0. This table helps later computation exclude the padded positions.

需要为“你爱”预测下一项时，应从“爱”的位置取结果，而不是从右侧PAD位置取。.en: To predict the next item for "你爱", take the result from the position of "爱", not from the PAD position on the right.

编号2定位Embedding表的第2行，得到[-0.3, 0.8, 0.1, 0.en: ID 2 locates row 2 of the embedding table, giving [-0.3, 0.8, 0.1, 0.5]. This row represents the token "爱" in this example, and does not switch to another row just because the batch contains other sentences.

编号3定位Embedding表的第3行，得到[0.6, 0.2, -0.4, 0.en: ID 3 locates row 3 of the embedding table, giving [0.6, 0.2, -0.4, 0.9]. This row represents the token "学习" in this example, and does not switch to another row just because the batch contains other sentences.

编号4定位Embedding表的第4行，得到[0.1, -0.5, 0.9, 0.en: ID 4 locates row 4 of the embedding table, giving [0.1, -0.5, 0.9, 0.3]. This row represents the token "你" in this example, and does not switch to another row just because the batch contains other sentences.

先取“我”，再取“爱”，最后取“学习”，组成三行表示。“你爱”同样处理；PAD行.en: Fetch "我" first, then "爱", and "学习" last, which makes a three-row representation. "你爱" is handled the same way; the PAD row is set to all zeros for teaching purposes here only, and still has to be masked later.

教学约定编号int64每数8字节；特征float32每数4字节。分别是48和96.en: By the teaching convention, IDs are int64 at 8 bytes per number and features float32 at 4 bytes per number. That is 48 and 96 bytes respectively.

把24个特征改成每数2字节，其存储变成48字节；ID仍用原来的48字节。.en: Change the 24 features to 2 bytes per number and their storage becomes 48 bytes; the IDs still use the original 48 bytes.

模型参数、临时激活和KV缓存都另外占空间。不要用这份96字节特征表代替整个模型的.en: The model's parameters, the temporary activations and the KV cache all take space of their own. Do not let this 96-byte feature table stand for the whole model's memory account.

选择X的第0行和W的第1列，沿三个特征一一配对、相乘，再相加。其他输出格子各算各.en: Take row 0 of X and column 1 of W, pair them up one by one along the three features, multiply, then add. Every other output cell is computed on its own and must not borrow another row.

选择X的第1行和W的第0列，沿三个特征一一配对、相乘，再相加。其他输出格子各算各.en: Take row 1 of X and column 0 of W, pair them up one by one along the three features, multiply, then add. Every other output cell is computed on its own and must not borrow another row.

选择X的第1行和W的第1列，沿三个特征一一配对、相乘，再相加。其他输出格子各算各.en: Take row 1 of X and column 1 of W, pair them up one by one along the three features, multiply, then add. Every other output cell is computed on its own and must not borrow another row.

保持1到6的先后顺序，每两个数成一行。结果是[[1,2],[3,4],[5,6].en: The order of 1 to 6 is kept, with every two numbers forming a row. The result is [[1,2],[3,4],[5,6]].

恢复原矩阵，再把原来的列变成新的行。得到[[1,4],[2,5],[3,6]]，.en: Restore the original matrix, then turn the old columns into the new rows. The result is [[1,4],[2,5],[3,6]]: the shape is still [3,2], but the content is arranged differently.

再次恢复原矩阵，给第一行都加10、第二行都加20，得到[[11,12,13],[.en: Restore the original matrix again, add 10 to the whole first row and 20 to the whole second, and the result is [[11,12,13],[24,25,26]]. This is not a rearrangement but a numeric operation.

三项都减去最大值2。相对差值没有变；这一步是数值稳定处理，不是改变温度。.en: The maximum, 2, is subtracted from all three. The relative differences are unchanged; this step is for numerical stability, not a change of temperature.

指数把各项变成正数。这些数还不等于概率，因为它们的和约为1.503215。.en: The exponential turns every entry into a positive number. These numbers are not probabilities yet, because they sum to about 1.503215.

三项都除以刚才的指数总和，才成为总和为1的概率。此处候选顺序始终是A、B、C。.en: All three are divided by the exponential sum just computed, which is what makes them probabilities summing to 1. The candidate order here is always A, B, C.

把0到1分成三段。给定随机数0.70落在B区间，因此这次抽到B；贪心取最大则会选.en: Divide 0 to 1 into three intervals. The given random number 0.70 falls in B's interval, so B is sampled this time; taking the maximum greedily would have chosen A. There is no contradiction in that.

第一列得到3；第二列先为1，加偏置−2后成为−1。.en: The first column gives 3; the second is 1 at first and becomes −1 once the bias of −2 is added.

只对负的第二格置0。第一格3保持不变。.en: Only the second cell, which is negative, is set to 0. The first cell stays 3.

把[3,0]交给第二层，计算3×2+0×1=6。.en: Hand [3,0] to the second layer and compute 3×2+0×1=6.

这个6不是一个Token概率，含义取决于后续任务。隐藏状态也不等于隐藏思考文本。.en: This 6 is not a token probability; what it means depends on the task that follows. Nor is a hidden state hidden text of thought.

恢复第一层的[3,−1]，不经ReLU便算3×2−1×1=5，显示非线性确实改变.en: Restore the first layer's [3,−1] and compute 3×2−1×1=5 without going through ReLU, which shows that the nonlinearity really does change the function.

计算某个位置的新表示时，它是接收者；所有可见位置都是潜在信息提供者。Query与.en: When the new representation of a position is computed, that position is the receiver; every visible position is a potential provider of information. The query and the key decide each provider's share of the reading, and the value supplies the numbers that are actually mixed. "Ask — match — fetch the content" is a way to remember the division of labor, but Q is not a natural-language question, K is not a database primary key and V is not the correct answer.

本次进入注意力的数值表示；不等于Token编号。.en: The numeric representation entering attention this time; it is not the token IDs.

已给定的三张投影参数表。.en: The three projection parameter tables already given.

X经三张表计算后的三份中间表示。.en: The three intermediate representations after X has been computed through the three tables.

先不打分。两行输入分别代表“我”和“爱”；Wq、Wk、Wv是三张乘法系数表。它们.en: No scoring yet. The two input rows stand for 我 and 爱; Wq, Wk and Wv are three tables of multiplication coefficients. They are not three further pieces of text.

计算XWq、XWk、XWv。“爱”这行依次得到q=[1,0]、k=[0,1]、v.en: Compute XWq, XWk and XWv. The "爱" row gives q=[1,0], k=[0,1] and v=[0,20] in turn. The parameters of the three paths are fixed, but the results change with the input.

用“爱”的q分别与“我”“爱”的k做点积，得到1和0。当前是位置1，所以因果规则.en: Take the dot product of the q of "爱" with the k of "我" and of "爱", which gives 1 and 0. The current position is 1, so the causal rule allows reading position 0 and itself.

先除以√2，再对[0.707107,0]做softmax，得到来自“我”的份额约.en: Divide by √2 first, then take the softmax of [0.707107,0], which gives a share of about 0.669762 from "我" and about 0.330238 from "爱". The algorithm is the same as in F09, but the objects and the input are different.

对第一格：0.669762×10+0.330238×0；对第二格：0.66976.en: For the first cell: 0.669762×10+0.330238×0; for the second: 0.669762×0+0.330238×20. The result is [6.697615,6.604769], still one row of numbers.

让匹配特征与被传递内容分开学习，给模型不同的变换能力。.en: It lets the matching features and the content being passed along be learned separately, which gives the model different powers of transformation.

先分别投影每行，再跨位置打分、屏蔽、softmax、混合V。.en: Project each row separately first, then score across positions, mask, softmax and mix V.

“注意力最大”不直接证明模型最终回答的因果原因；若只有一个可见Key，softm.en: "Attention is highest here" is no direct proof of the causal reason for the model's final answer; with only one visible key, softmax is always 1, which cannot be used to show competition.

核对六行投影、两项分数、份额和输出；改变Wv不应在本层直接改变由Q/K算出的份额.en: Check the six rows of projections, the two scores, the shares and the output; changing Wv should not directly change the shares computed from Q/K in this layer.

如果把被禁分数改为0，exp(0)=1，它仍会得到份额。加性掩码用负无穷表达被禁.en: If a forbidden score is set to 0, then exp(0)=1 and it still gets a share. An additive mask expresses a forbidden entry as negative infinity, which makes its exponential contribution 0.

已有位置0、1、2；本轮增加位置3、4。两行新Query应分别能读前4项和前5项.en: Positions 0, 1 and 2 are already there; this round adds positions 3 and 4. The two new rows of queries should be able to read the first 4 and the first 5 entries respectively, not use one small triangle starting from 0.

两个旋转向量的点积取决于角度差。共同再旋转相同角度，不会改变点积。这个性质帮助相.en: The dot product of two rotated vectors depends on the difference of their angles. Rotating both by the same further angle does not change the dot product. This property is what lets relative position information enter the matching.

本段从允许的位置读取信息。归一化改变数值尺度，不替代mask或位置机制。.en: This part reads information from the permitted positions. Normalization changes the scale of the numbers; it does not replace the mask or the position mechanism.

相加要求对应形状一致。这里的加法保留直接通路，不是将两份向量拼成更长向量。.en: Addition requires the corresponding shapes to match. The addition here keeps a direct path open; it does not join two vectors into a longer one.

FFN按各位置自己的特征进行非线性加工。参数共享不等于所有位置的结果相同。.en: The FFN processes each position nonlinearly using that position's own features. Sharing parameters does not mean every position gets the same result.

第二条残差同样逐格相加。输出仍是每个位置的一排数。.en: The second residual is likewise added cell by cell. The output is still one row of numbers per position.

多层把这样的加工继续下去，最后才由词表输出头给候选Token打分。.en: Several layers carry this processing on, and only at the end does the vocabulary output head score the candidate tokens.

首次前向处理两个已知Token，缓存长度由0变2。处理结束时，最后一个有效位置已.en: The first forward pass processes the two known tokens and the cache length goes from 0 to 2. By the end of it, the last valid position can already give the scores for the next item.

同一个输出头根据当前最后表示算出分布，最高概率约0.7700。按贪心规则选出“学.en: The same output head computes a distribution from the current last representation, with a highest probability of about 0.7700. By the greedy rule, "学习" is selected. Selecting it did not run the embedding again, so it has not yet entered its own K/V cache.

界面可以先显示“学习”，但模型还没有加工这个新Token。下一轮才会把它送进模型.en: The interface can display "学习" right away, but the model has not processed this new token yet. Only in the next turn is it fed to the model to predict the candidates that follow it.

把上一步刚选出的“学习”作为新输入，追加它的K/V；历史2个位置的K/V直接复用.en: Take "学习", just selected in the previous step, as the new input and append its K/V; the K/V of the 2 earlier positions is reused directly. This is not a matter of looking only at the new token and forgetting the history.

同一个输出头根据当前最后表示算出分布，最高概率约0.7700。按贪心规则选出“！.en: The same output head computes a distribution from the current last representation, with a highest probability of about 0.7700. By the greedy rule, "！" is selected. Selecting it did not run the embedding again, so it has not yet entered its own K/V cache.

界面可以先显示“！”，但模型还没有加工这个新Token。下一轮才会把它送进模型，.en: The interface can display "！" right away, but the model has not processed this new token yet. Only in the next turn is it fed to the model to predict the candidates that follow it.

把上一步刚选出的“！”作为新输入，追加它的K/V；历史3个位置的K/V直接复用。.en: Take "！", just selected in the previous step, as the new input and append its K/V; the K/V of the 3 earlier positions is reused directly. This is not a matter of looking only at the new token and forgetting the history.

第三次前向后选出结束Token EOS。宿主看到这个结束标记后停止；不会再为了预.en: After the third forward pass the end token EOS is selected. The harness stops once it sees this end marker; it does not process EOS in order to predict another token. EOS is not displayed as visible text.

本次显示的追加文字为“学习！”。EOS是此教学序列的停止标记；达到长度上限或取消.en: The text appended for display this time is "学习！". EOS is the stop marker for this teaching sequence; reaching the length limit or being canceled are different reasons for stopping, and not every one of them can be claimed as task completion.

选出了新Token t3，但它尚未经过各层。缓存仍有三个位置，t3单独处于待处理.en: The new token t3 has been selected, but it has not been through the layers yet. The cache still holds three positions, and t3 sits on its own, waiting to be processed.

t3进入每一层，用自己的新Q与该层的历史K/V加上新K/V一起计算。缓存逐层扩到.en: t3 enters every layer and is computed with its own new Q against that layer's past K/V plus the new K/V. Layer by layer the cache grows to four positions.

现在才能用t3的最终表示预测t4。历史K/V没有重算，但t3仍要读取它们；缓存不.en: Only now can t3's final representation be used to predict t4. The past K/V was not recomputed, but t3 still has to read it; a cache does not turn attention into something that ignores the history.

把t1换成另一项会影响它及后续位置的各层状态。至少需要使受影响后缀失效并重新计算.en: Replacing t1 with something else affects the state of every layer at that position and after it. At minimum the affected suffix has to be invalidated and recomputed; the old cache cannot be carried on with as though this were only an append.

损失对w的梯度是−4：w略微增大时，损失在此处会减小。反向传播算这个变化率，但不.en: The gradient of the loss with respect to w is −4: increase w slightly and the loss here goes down. Backpropagation computes that rate of change, but it does not update the parameters on the optimizer's behalf.

学习率0.2，w新=1−0.2×(−4)=1.8。重新前向得到预测3.6、损失0.en: With a learning rate of 0.2, the new w=1−0.2×(−4)=1.8. A fresh forward pass gives a prediction of 3.6 and a loss of 0.08. The original loss figure is not just written down smaller.

恢复初始w=1，只把学习率改为0.6。新w=3.4，预测6.8，损失3.92，大.en: Restore the initial w=1 and change only the learning rate, to 0.6. The new w is 3.4, the prediction 6.8 and the loss 3.92, which is larger than the original 2; the direction being right is no guarantee that a bigger step is better.

目标已存在于训练样本，但mask仍禁止当前位置读后续输入。可以并行计算四个位置的.en: The targets are already present in the training sample, but the mask still forbids the current position from reading later input. The loss at all four positions can be computed in parallel; at inference the future tokens are unknown, so this parallel condition cannot simply be carried over.

独立评分小例：真实目标“学习”的预测概率是0.5，交叉熵为−ln0.5≈0.69.en: An independent small scoring example: the predicted probability of the true target "学习" is 0.5, so the cross entropy is −ln0.5≈0.693147; at a probability of 0.25 it is about 1.386294 — the less confidence a wrong answer leaves for the right one, the heavier the penalty.

另设三个目标位置，其中第三项是无效PAD；前两项损失0.4与0.8。总损失1.2.en: Take a separate case with three target positions, the third of which is an invalid PAD; the losses of the first two are 0.4 and 0.8. The total loss of 1.2 should be divided by the 2 valid positions, giving 0.6, not by the array length 3.

反向传播将误差影响传回参数，优化器再利用梯度更新。下一轮是否清零或累积梯度，应依.en: Backpropagation carries the error's influence back to the parameters, and the optimizer then uses the gradients to update them. Whether the next round zeroes the gradients or accumulates them should follow an explicit training strategy; old gradients must not be mixed in unintentionally.

动态图解</span><span>约 1 千字</span><span>图表与逐.en: Step-by-step figuresabout 1k charactersFigures and item-by-item notes

仅把计算速度翻倍；计算时间下界变0.0005秒，搬运仍为0.008秒，所以瓶颈没.en: Only the compute speed is doubled; the lower bound on compute time becomes 0.0005 s while movement stays at 0.008 s, so the bottleneck has not changed.

恢复原算力，只减少一半数据搬运。此时两个下界是0.001与0.004秒，才改变主.en: Restore the original compute and halve the data movement alone. The two lower bounds are then 0.001 and 0.004 s, which does change which limit dominates.

max(计算下界,搬运下界)只给出理想限制；排队、同步、调度和未重叠部分还会增加.en: max(compute lower bound, movement lower bound) gives only an ideal limit; queueing, synchronization, scheduling and whatever does not overlap add to the real time.

工具定义告诉模型可以提议什么，不授予无限访问权限。.en: A tool definition tells the model what it may propose; it grants no unlimited access.

这只是请求，尚不能宣称文件已读取。调用标识把后续结果与此请求对应。.en: This is only a request; it cannot yet be claimed that the file has been read. The call identifier matches the later result to this request.

路径、权限和参数检查通过后，由程序执行读文件；不是模型直接打开磁盘。.en: Once the path, permission and argument checks have passed, the program performs the file read; the model does not open the disk itself.

本例预设文件确实含timeout=30。返回结果可用于回答，但读取成功不意味着文.en: This example presupposes that the file really does contain timeout=30. The returned result can be used to answer, but a successful read does not mean the file was modified.

同一个用户任务发生了第二次模型调用。新增的是实际证据，不需要重新假装猜测。.en: A second model call happens within the same user task. What has been added is actual evidence, so there is no need to go back to pretending and guessing.

这份回答有本例工具结果作依据，不只是依据模型参数里的常识。.en: This answer rests on the tool result in this example, not merely on general knowledge in the model's parameters.

最终消息结束此演示任务；输出完成与其他带副作用任务是否成功要分别判断。.en: The final message ends this demonstration task; whether the output is complete and whether other tasks with side effects succeeded have to be judged separately.

增量解码器补齐该字符；这时字符已完整，但仍须遵循协议的事件边界，不能见到一个右括.en: The incremental decoder completes the character; the character is now whole, but the protocol's event boundaries still have to be respected — a closing brace in sight is no reason to run the tool.

本例空行结束一个SSE事件。先组装事件数据，再解析其中JSON；真实流可能有多种.en: In this example a blank line ends one SSE event. Assemble the event data first, then parse the JSON inside it; a real stream may carry several event types.

得到对象{\"text\":\"爱\"}。这是一段文本事件，不是工具调用。只有明.en: This yields the object {"text":"爱"}. It is a text event, not a tool call. Only an explicit, complete tool-call object that passes validation can be executed.

operation_id=op1；尚未确认环境改变.en: operation_id=op1; the change to the environment is not yet confirmed

本地文件已替换为新内容v8.en: The local file has been replaced with the new content v8

成功回执没到；宿主只知道结果不确定.en: No success receipt arrived; all the harness knows is that the result is uncertain

按操作ID和文件内容核对，确认v8已存在.en: Check against the operation ID and the file content, and confirm that v8 is already there

记录成功；不再次盲目写入.en: Record the success; do not blindly write again

发现回答“有哪些接口”；不回答“本次任务是否应该用它”。.en: Discovery answers "which interfaces are there"; it does not answer "whether this task should use one".

Schema描述输入形状。Server承诺能处理的工具，也可能因业务条件拒绝某次.en: The schema describes the shape of the input. A tool the server has undertaken to handle may still refuse a particular call on business grounds.

工具存在、连接成功、模型看得到、实际被授权是四个独立问题。.en: The tool existing, the connection succeeding, the model being able to see it and it actually being authorized are four separate questions.

身份、权限和输入检查应落在可执行边界上，不能只靠Prompt说“请谨慎”。.en: Identity, permission and input checks belong at an enforceable boundary; a prompt saying "please be careful" is not enough.

结果要带回本次调用的关联信息；错误、超时和业务拒绝需要区分。.en: The result has to carry back the correlation information for this call; errors, timeouts and business refusals have to be told apart.

模型使用结果继续任务；协议本身不会自动创造持久记忆或提升模型参数。.en: The model uses the result to carry the task on; the protocol itself does not create persistent memory or improve the model's parameters by itself.

保留用户的实际目标与约束，不能只留下一个关键词。.en: Keep the user's actual goal and constraints; a single keyword is not enough to leave behind.

把本轮需要的工具Schema算入预算；不需要的工具不必全部堆进来。.en: Count the schemas of the tools this turn needs against the budget; the tools it does not need do not all have to be piled in.

放入足以支持下一步决策的证据，保留来源、条件和版本。.en: Put in evidence sufficient to support the next decision, keeping the source, the conditions and the version.

窗口不能全塞满输入。本例输入65，预留输出20，还剩15；实际服务的计费、隐藏状.en: The window cannot be filled entirely with input. In this example the input is 65 and 20 is reserved for output, leaving 15; a real service may bill, keep hidden state and define its limits differently.

“不改公开API”是限制未来动作的约束，即使只占几个字，也比几百行旧日志重要。.en: "Do not change the public API" is a constraint on future actions; even though it takes only a few words, it matters more than hundreds of lines of old log.

测试结果必须带测试类型和版本。“单元已过、集成未跑”不能压成“已测试”。.en: A test result has to carry the test type and the version. "Unit tests passed, integration not run" cannot be compressed into "tested".

本帧故意展示错误摘要。两个看似相近的句子允许完全不同的下一步动作，说明压缩可以丢.en: This frame deliberately shows a wrong summary. Two sentences that look close permit completely different next actions, which shows that compaction can lose critical state.

新上下文依据快照继续时，还要核对文件版本与实际状态。摘要保留查证入口，但不能代替.en: When a new context continues from a snapshot, the file version and the actual state still have to be checked. A summary keeps a way in for verification, but it cannot replace the original text once that has changed.

对每个词记录它出现在哪些文档。“Docker”指向A和C，“pytest”指向B.en: For each term, record which documents it appears in. "Docker" points to A and C, "pytest" to B; there is no need to read every document from the start on each query.

语义检索把查询和文档表示成向量，比较其关系。它可能找出字面不同的表达，但相似不保.en: Semantic retrieval represents the query and the documents as vectors and compares their relationship. It may find wording that differs literally, but similarity is no guarantee of being usable, correct or current.

候选A包含部署说明，C包含构建镜像说明。根据真实问题读取对应原文与版本；标题看起.en: Candidate A contains the deployment instructions and C the instructions for building the image. Read the matching original text and version for the real question; a title that looks relevant is no substitute for evidence.

RRF把每次出现的排名变成1/(60+排名)，再相加。候选A的两个名次为[1,.en: RRF turns each appearance's rank into 1/(60+rank) and adds them up. Candidate A's two ranks are [1, 3], for a fused score of about 0.03226646.

RRF把每次出现的排名变成1/(60+排名)，再相加。候选B的两个名次为[2,.en: RRF turns each appearance's rank into 1/(60+rank) and adds them up. Candidate B's two ranks are [2, 1], for a fused score of about 0.03252247.

RRF把每次出现的排名变成1/(60+排名)，再相加。候选C的两个名次为[3,.en: RRF turns each appearance's rank into 1/(60+rank) and adds them up. Candidate C's two ranks are [3, 2], for a fused score of about 0.03200205.

固定排名下结果B、A、C。还要用原文证据、版本和权限判断适用性。排第一仅代表这个.en: With the ranks fixed, the result is B, A, C. Applicability still has to be judged from the original evidence, the version and the permissions. Coming first means only the priority this fusion rule gave it.

系统保存“自1月1日起超时30秒”.en: The system stores "timeout 30 seconds, effective from January 1"

新配置改为20秒，但系统尚未同步.en: The new configuration changes it to 20 seconds, but the system has not synchronized yet

系统读取新配置，保存有效时间与获知时间.en: The system reads the new configuration and stores both the valid time and the time it learned of it

问当前：20秒；问1月历史：30秒.en: Ask about now: 20 seconds; ask about the January history: 30 seconds

记录已真实创建，副作用已发生.en: The record really was created, and the side effect has happened

客户端超时，无法由此推断失败.en: The client timed out; failure cannot be inferred from that

换新操作ID重试，可能创建第二条.en: Retrying with a new operation ID may create a second record

使用稳定操作ID核对或幂等重试.en: Check with a stable operation ID, or retry idempotently

返回原结果，或确认未执行后再重试.en: Return the original result, or confirm it was not executed before retrying

系统选中8项，其中6项正确；精确率6/8=75%。它回答“拿回来的有多少能用”。.en: The system selected 8 items, 6 of them correct; precision is 6/8=75%. It answers "how much of what came back is usable".

真正需要10项，找到6项；召回率6/10=60%。它回答“需要的漏了多少”。.en: 10 items were really needed and 6 were found; recall is 6/10=60%. It answers "how much of what was needed was missed".

只返回最有把握的一项可能提高精确率，却漏掉大量必要证据；返回所有东西能提高召回，.en: Returning only the single most confident item may raise precision while missing a great deal of necessary evidence; returning everything can raise recall while filling the context with irrelevant material.

旧版成功=10道双方成功＋2道仅旧版成功，得到12/20=60%。.en: Old-version successes = 10 questions both versions passed + 2 only the old version passed, giving 12/20=60%.

新版成功=10道双方成功＋4道仅新版成功，得到14/20=70%。净提升是2题，.en: New-version successes = 10 questions both versions passed + 4 only the new version passed, giving 14/20=70%. The net gain is 2 questions, that is 10 percentage points.

新版改善4题，也退化2题。不能只展示改善案例；小样本的一次结果还不足以宣称稳定提.en: The new version improves 4 questions and also regresses on 2. Do not show only the improvements; one result on a small sample is not enough to claim a stable gain.

检查两道退化题是否涉及权限、任务类型、上下文或测试环境变化，再做受控重复与成本比.en: Check whether the two regressed questions involve a change of permission, task type, context or test environment, then run controlled repeats and compare costs.

摘要和转交也要保留来源，不能把引用内容提到指令层。.en: A summary and a handover also have to keep the sources; quoted content must not be promoted to the instruction layer.

安全Prompt有帮助但不是不可绕过的权限系统。.en: A safety prompt helps, but it is not a permission system that cannot be bypassed.

限定路径、网络、工具和身份；不同工具的约束可能不同。.en: Restrict the path, the network, the tools and the identity; different tools may be constrained differently.

有风险的副作用还需明确批准与核验；不能用“模型判断安全”替代所有控制。.en: A risky side effect still needs explicit approval and verification; "the model judged it safe" cannot stand in for every control.

安全不是停止一切工作，而是在授权范围内继续完成目标。.en: Security is not stopping all work; it is going on to finish the goal within what has been authorized.

A在8秒完成，但B直到13秒才完成。若下一轮需要两者结果，就由B决定等待长度。.en: A finishes at 8 seconds, but B does not finish until 13. If the next turn needs both results, it is B that decides how long the wait is.

工具工作量3+8=11秒，工具阶段墙钟却是8秒。任务墙钟是2+3+8+2+1=1.en: The tool work totals 3+8=11 s, while the wall clock for the tool stage is 8 s. The task's wall clock is 2+3+8+2+1=16 s.

若只把A从3秒缩成1秒，B仍占8秒，整体仍约16秒。这个简化图中，优化A不缩短关.en: Cutting only A from 3 s to 1 s still leaves B taking 8 s and the whole thing at about 16 s. In this simplified figure, optimizing A does not shorten the critical path.

把B缩短可能缩短任务；但更多并发也可能增加系统排队和资源争用。需要在真实负载下重.en: Shortening B may shorten the task; but more concurrency can also increase queueing and contention for resources in the system. It has to be measured again under a real load.

每个Patch展开成四个数。这里恰好有四块，而不是16个文本Token。图块顺序.en: Each patch unfolds into four numbers. There happen to be four patches here, not 16 text tokens. The order and position of the patches still have to be stated.

视觉编码器、投影或其他接口把图像信息交给语言模型。具体架构不同，视觉Token数.en: A vision encoder, a projection or another interface hands the image information to the language model. Architectures differ, so the number of vision tokens cannot be fitted to one formula from a 4×4 image size alone.

看到按钮在坐标x,y并不意味着下一时刻还在那里。截图后页面可能滚动、弹窗或变更布.en: Seeing a button at coordinates x,y does not mean it is still there a moment later. After the screenshot the page may scroll, open a dialog or change its layout; a fresh observation after the click is what confirms the actual state.

多名接收者可以共用一套提供者表示；查询仍有不同的比较方式。减少K/V组数让每个位.en: Several receivers can share one set of provider representations, while the queries still compare in different ways. Reducing the number of K/V groups means less history to store per position, but the model's structure has changed as well, so an existing model cannot be expected to produce exactly the same output without adaptation.

共享的是K/V组，不是取消查询头，也不是给旧模型随意少算几个头。结构改变通常需要.en: What is shared is the K/V groups; query heads are not dropped, and an old model is not free to compute a few heads fewer. A structural change usually needs matching model training or a conversion scheme.

GQA/MQA改变模型结构和参数关系。不能把它和保持相同数学注意力的FlashA.en: GQA/MQA change the model's structure and the relationship between its parameters. They must not be lumped together with FlashAttention, which keeps the attention mathematics the same; quality has to be verified again for the model's task.

长序列或多并发时KV内存和读取带宽压力很大。.en: With long sequences or many concurrent requests, the pressure on KV memory and read bandwidth is heavy.

使用训练/适配好的分组查询架构，并让运行时按正确组映射读取。.en: Use a grouped-query architecture that has been trained or adapted for it, and have the runtime read by the correct group mapping.

可能改变质量；若实现物理复制共享K/V，实际内存收益会被抵消。.en: It may change quality; if the implementation physically copies the shared K/V, the actual memory saving is canceled out.

分别验证组映射、内存实占、任务质量和速度；不能只看理论字节数。.en: Verify the group mapping, the memory actually occupied, task quality and speed separately; the theoretical byte count is not enough on its own.

像把精细刻度换成较粗刻度：需要的存储位数减少，但有些原值只能落到相邻刻度，还有些.en: It is like swapping a fine scale for a coarser one: fewer bits of storage are needed, but some original values can only land on a neighboring graduation and others fall outside the representable range. The scales, the grouping information, unquantized layers, activations and caches still take space, so counting the bits of the integer weights is not the total memory of a run.

量化改的是数字的表示精度，不是把Token ID变成Embedding。先把要近.en: Quantization changes the precision with which a number is represented; it does not turn a token ID into an embedding. First write down clearly what is being approximated and over what range.

本例尺度0.1，先除以0.1，再取最近整数，得到[3,−1,4,9]。这一步已经.en: The scale in this example is 0.1: divide by 0.1 first, then round to the nearest integer, which gives [3,−1,4,9]. There is already rounding error at this step.

教学4bit有符号整数取值−8到7。9超出范围，只能裁剪到7；大值误差可能远高于.en: The teaching 4-bit signed integer ranges from −8 to 7. 9 is out of range and can only be clipped to 7; the error on large values can be far greater than ordinary rounding error.

乘回尺度0.1，得到[0.3,−0.1,0.4,0.7]。最后一项相对原0.91.en: Multiplying back by the scale 0.1 gives [0.3,−0.1,0.4,0.7]. The last entry is −0.21 away from the original 0.91, which shows the risk of going outside the representable range.

减少权重或KV等对象的存储与搬运压力。.en: Reduces the storage and movement pressure from objects such as weights and KV.

选清量化对象和格式，校准范围，使用匹配内核，逐层或任务级验证。.en: Be clear about what is quantized and in what format, calibrate the range, use matching kernels, and verify layer by layer or at task level.

误差、异常值、反量化开销、缺少高效内核，都可能削弱质量或速度收益。.en: Error, outliers, the cost of dequantization and the lack of an efficient kernel can all weaken the gain in quality or speed.

对比原值与还原值；更重要的是比较真实任务表现与实测峰值内存。.en: Compares the original values with the restored ones; more importantly, it compares real task performance against the measured peak memory.

把基础权重看成已有配方。LoRA不把配方丢掉，而是用两张小表描述修改量。训练时主.en: Think of the base weights as a recipe you already have. LoRA does not throw the recipe away; it describes the amount of change with two small tables. Training mainly changes the small tables, which reduces the trainable parameters and the optimizer state that goes with them; but running it still needs the base model, and the capacity of the increment is limited by the rank.

基准W是4×4单位矩阵，共16个参数。LoRA冻结这16个数，另外准备4×1的A.en: The baseline W is the 4×4 identity matrix, 16 parameters in all. LoRA freezes those 16 numbers and adds a 4×1 A and a 1×4 B, 8 trainable numbers in all.

增量ΔW=A×B，最多只有秩1。它只表达允许的变化方向，不承诺任意完整4×4更新.en: The increment ΔW=A×B has rank at most 1. It expresses only the directions of change that are allowed; it is no promise that any complete 4×4 update can be represented this way.

固定x=[1,0,0,0]，缩放系数1。xW=[1,0,0,0]；xAB=[0..en: Fix x=[1,0,0,0] with a scaling factor of 1. xW=[1,0,0,0]; xAB=[0.1,−0.1,0.05,0]; adding them gives [1.1,−0.1,0.05,0].

适当合并增量可避免额外推理分支，但合并、精度和多适配器切换都要考虑。LoRA主要.en: Merging the increment where appropriate avoids an extra inference branch, but the merge itself, the precision and switching between several adapters all have to be considered. LoRA mainly optimizes fine-tuning resources; it is no guarantee that every end-to-end task gets faster.

全量微调所需梯度和优化器状态可能太大。.en: The gradients and optimizer state needed for full fine-tuning may be too large.

冻结基础权重，训练低秩增量，保留正确缩放和模块匹配。.en: Freeze the base weights, train the low-rank increment, and keep the scaling correct and the modules matched.

小秩可能限制能力；基础模型与适配器版本不匹配；低精度合并有数值差异。.en: A small rank can limit capability; the base model and the adapter version may not match; merging at low precision brings numeric differences.

验证x(W+AB)=xW+xAB，再做独立任务质量与资源对照。.en: Verify x(W+AB)=xW+xAB, then compare task quality and resources independently.

想象分批称重汇总：每批到来时更新“最大刻度、总重量、内容加权和”，不用把所有中间.en: Imagine weighing in batches and totaling as you go: as each batch arrives you update "the largest graduation, the total weight, the weighted sum of the contents", without writing every intermediate slip to VRAM again. When the largest graduation changes, the old running totals have to be rescaled with it. This online normalization is what explains how saving reads and writes is compatible with the same mathematical result.

截至当前分块的最大分数。.en: The maximum score up to the current block.

按当前最大值缩放后的指数总和。.en: The sum of the exponentials after scaling by the current maximum.

在长序列中，把所有查询对所有Key的分数完整存下来会产生很大的中间表。Flash.en: Over a long sequence, storing the complete score of every query against every Key produces a very large intermediate table. FlashAttention changes the blocking and the read/write organization; the aim is not to discard low-scoring positions at will.

先读C，分数0、V=[5,5]。最大值0，指数和1，加权和[5,5]。.en: Read C first: score 0, V=[5,5]. The maximum is 0, the exponential sum 1 and the weighted sum [5,5].

读A后最大值从0升为2。旧累计先乘exp(0−2)，新A按exp(2−2)=1加.en: After reading A the maximum rises from 0 to 2. The old running totals are first multiplied by exp(0−2), and A is added in as exp(2−2)=1; failing to rescale the old totals gives the wrong answer.

最后读B，最大值仍是2，加入exp(1−2)与对应V贡献。最终用累计加权和除累计.en: Read B last: the maximum is still 2, and exp(1−2) and the corresponding V contribution are added in. Finally the running weighted sum is divided by the running exponential sum, which gives the same mathematical result as the full softmax.

小例验证在线归一化的正确性；真正FlashAttention还按硬件块执行矩阵乘.en: The small example verifies that the online normalization is correct; real FlashAttention also runs the matrix multiplications and the forward and backward passes in hardware-sized blocks. It is an algorithmic and kernel-level optimization; it does not mean every attention computation becomes linear.

大中间矩阵造成显存读写与容量压力。.en: A large intermediate matrix puts pressure on VRAM traffic and capacity.

分块计算并以在线softmax维护归一化统计，减少外部显存访问。.en: Computes in blocks and keeps the normalization statistics with an online softmax, which reduces access to external VRAM.

实现复杂；数值顺序变化有舍入差异；不适用的硬件或形状收益可能很小。.en: The implementation is complex; a change in the order of operations brings rounding differences; on unsuitable hardware or shapes the gain can be small.

与完整softmax加权结果做容差对照，再在目标硬件实测而非把教学计数当加速倍数.en: Compare it against the full softmax-weighted result within a tolerance, then measure on the target hardware instead of treating a teaching count as a speed-up factor.

类似把一本书分册放在不同抽屉，目录记录第几册在哪；阅读顺序仍由目录决定。分页把K.en: It is like putting a book's volumes in different drawers, with a catalog recording which volume is where; the reading order is still decided by the catalog. Paging cuts the KV storage into blocks and maintains a mapping, which reduces the waste of reserving a contiguous region for a sequence that keeps growing. It does not truncate the context, nor does it automatically reduce the history that has to be read.

只有a0/a1/a2，第一帧的物理0仍未分配。.en: There are only a0/a1/a2; physical 0 in the first frame is still unallocated.

a3填入物理1的剩余槽位，不必搬动历史a0/a1。.en: a3 goes into the remaining slot of physical block 1; the earlier a0/a1 need not be moved.

新分配物理0来保存a4；逻辑顺序a0…a4仍不改变。.en: Physical block 0 is newly allocated to hold a4; the logical order a0…a4 is still unchanged.

释放属于B的块；不能因为物理编号乱序就改变A的Token顺序。.en: Free the blocks that belong to B; A's token order must not change just because the physical numbering is out of order.

序列动态增长，连续预留常造成空间浪费并限制并发。.en: The sequence grows dynamically, and reserving contiguous space often wastes it and limits concurrency.

用固定大小块和映射管理增长、释放及条件允许的共享。.en: Manage growth, release and, where conditions allow, sharing with fixed-size blocks and a mapping.

仍有尾页空槽和管理开销；共享页写入需正确处理引用与复制。.en: There is still an empty slot in the last page, and management overhead as well; a write to a shared page has to handle references and copying correctly.

核对逻辑顺序、页所有权、增长和释放，确保不同请求不会混用内容。.en: Check the logical order, page ownership, growth and release, so that different requests cannot mix up content.

固定批次像一车人必须一起离站；连续组批允许有人结束就补入新请求。这样减少空转，有.en: A fixed batch is like a carload of people who all have to leave the station together; continuous batching lets a new request fill in as soon as someone finishes. That cuts idle time and gives a chance of higher throughput. But the critical steps of the requests already running are not necessarily shortened, and the preprocessing, queueing and contention of new requests can add latency in places.

新请求的完整已知输入处理阶段。.en: The stage that processes a new request's complete known input.

两槽位、请求A需2步、B需4步、C需2步且等待。普通批次中A完成后空出的位置仍要.en: Two slots; request A needs 2 steps, B needs 4, and C needs 2 and is waiting. In an ordinary batch, the slot A leaves free still has to wait for B to finish before C is handled.

A在第2步完成后，第3步把C放入空槽，与B一起继续。此理想小例总步数从6降到4。.en: Once A finishes at step 2, step 3 puts C into the freed slot and it continues alongside B. In this idealized small example the total number of steps drops from 6 to 4.

B仍然做4步；改变的是空闲槽利用。真实接纳新请求还涉及prefill与排队，不能.en: B still takes 4 steps; what changes is the use of the idle slot. Really admitting a new request also involves prefill and queueing, so the ratio in this figure must not be taken for a general speed-up.

新长请求的prefill可能干扰正在decode的请求；限额、分块调度与公平性是.en: The prefill of a new long request can interfere with requests that are decoding; limits, chunked scheduling and fairness are conditions still to be tested.

不同请求长度不同，固定批次会浪费提前空出的计算位置。.en: Requests differ in length, so a fixed batch wastes the compute slots that free up early.

在迭代边界移除完成请求、纳入候选，并用预算管理prefill/decode竞争。.en: At the iteration boundary it removes finished requests, admits candidates, and manages prefill/decode contention with a budget.

吞吐提升可能伴随首Token或长尾延迟上升，不能只看平均速度。.en: A rise in throughput may come with a rise in first-token or tail latency; average speed alone is not enough.

同负载测吞吐、TTFT、逐Token延迟和尾延迟；单独报告排队。.en: Measure throughput, TTFT, per-token latency and tail latency under the same load; report queuing separately.

草稿模型先给候选，目标模型负责校验。要保持目标采样分布，接受与拒绝后的补偿必须正.en: The draft model proposes candidates first and the target model verifies them. To preserve the target's sampling distribution, acceptance and the compensation after a rejection both have to be correct; a draft must not be kept merely because it "looks reasonable". Drafting and verifying cost something extra as well, so when the draft hit rate is low or the task is very short it may not pay off.

草稿模型便宜，但会把概率分错。本例目标p=[0.6,0.3,0.1]，草稿q=[.en: The draft model is cheap, but it divides the probability up wrongly. In this example the target is p=[0.6,0.3,0.1] and the draft q=[0.4,0.4,0.2]. Draft output cannot simply be taken as target output.

草稿选到A/B/C时，分别按1、0.75、0.5接受。更可能被草稿过度提出的项，.en: When the draft picks A/B/C, they are accepted at 1, 0.75 and 0.5 respectively. An item the draft is more likely to over-propose needs a lower acceptance rate.

草稿概率乘接受率，得到[0.4,0.3,0.1]，总和0.8。还有0.2需要从拒.en: The draft probabilities times the acceptance rates give [0.4,0.3,0.1], summing to 0.8. The remaining 0.2 has to be allocated from the compensation distribution used after a rejection.

正差p−q为[0.2,0,0]。归一化后补偿只能选A，补上总质量0.2；最终恢复.en: The positive difference p−q is [0.2,0,0]. After normalization the compensation can only choose A, adding back a total mass of 0.2; the final distribution is restored to [0.6,0.3,0.1].

设草稿提出B，接受阈值0.75；给定随机数0.9则拒绝，从补偿分布选择A。不是总.en: Suppose the draft proposes B with an acceptance threshold of 0.75; the given random number 0.9 rejects it, and A is chosen from the compensation distribution. It is neither always a fresh draw from the target distribution nor an unconditional keeping of B.

用便宜草稿和批量验证减少目标模型逐Token串行负担。.en: Use a cheap draft and batch verification to reduce the target model's token-by-token serial load.

正确计算接受概率与残差分布，维护接受前缀后的缓存位置。.en: Compute the acceptance probability and the residual distribution correctly, and maintain the cache positions after the accepted prefix.

错误拒绝补偿会改变分布；草稿、校验和回退开销可能超过节省。.en: Getting the rejection compensation wrong changes the distribution; the overhead of drafting, verification and fallback may exceed the saving.

本例接受质量0.8、补偿质量0.2，合起来必须逐项等于p。.en: In this example the accepted mass is 0.8 and the compensating mass 0.2; together they must equal p term by term.

像在一层里准备多个可选择的加工单元，路由器为每个Token挑其中一部分。稀疏指本.en: It is like keeping several selectable processing units in one layer, with a router choosing some of them for each token. Sparse refers to the paths activated this time, not to the model being left with only a few experts' parameters. What an expert learns is decided by training; you cannot infer from a name that one of them must specialize in mathematics or sentiment.

只选择分数最高的两条专家路径。.en: Only the two expert paths with the highest scores are selected.

这是网络内部专家，不是四个独立聊天Agent。路由器按当前表示产生分配。.en: These are experts inside the network, not four separate chat agents. The router produces the assignment from the current representation.

本例选E1与E2，不计算E0/E3的输出；这些专家的参数仍存在于系统里。.en: This example selects E1 and E2 and does not compute the outputs of E0/E3; those experts' parameters are still present in the system.

独立指定专家函数E1(x)=2x、E2(x)=x+3。输入2得到4和5，用归一后.en: The expert functions are independently specified as E1(x)=2x and E2(x)=x+3. An input of 2 gives 4 and 5, which are combined with the normalized 0.625/0.375.

总体参数大而每Token激活较少，不等于所有设备负载均匀；路由、容量与跨设备传输.en: A large total parameter count with few activations per token does not mean the load is even across devices; routing, capacity and cross-device transfer all have to be counted.

在扩大总参数容量的同时限制每Token激活计算。.en: Enlarges total parameter capacity while limiting the computation activated per token.

按路由规则分配与合并，并配合容量和负载管理。.en: Distributes and merges according to the routing rule, together with capacity and load management.

专家拥堵、跨设备通信、路由失衡、训练不稳定都可能抵消收益。.en: Expert congestion, cross-device communication, routing imbalance and training instability can all cancel the gain out.

测实际激活分布、掉Token/溢出策略、吞吐与任务质量。.en: Measure the actual activation distribution, the dropped-token/overflow policy, throughput and task quality.

训练反向需要一些前向中间结果。全部保留速度方便但占空间；检查点方法保存少量节点，.en: The backward pass in training needs some of the forward pass's intermediate results. Keeping them all is convenient and fast but takes space; checkpointing saves a few nodes and recomputes the stretches in between when they are needed. A KV cache, by contrast, stores more history during inference in order to do less repeated work. Both are called caching or checkpointing mechanisms, yet their trade-offs run in different directions.

在此简化链中，反向额外保留中间激活a1、a2、a3，各100单位，驻留合计300.en: In this simplified chain the backward pass additionally keeps the intermediate activations a1, a2 and a3, 100 units each, 300 units resident in all. The input and the final output are not counted in this ledger.

改为只留a2，反向开始前这三项中的驻留量变为100。这里说的是预先保留，不是运行.en: Keeping only a2 instead makes the resident amount among those three items 100 before the backward pass begins. What is meant is what is reserved in advance, not that the peak during the run is only 100.

从保存的a2重算a3，再进行后半段反向。此时a2与重算a3等会临时同时占内存。.en: Recompute a3 from the saved a2, then run the backward pass for the second half. At this point a2, the recomputed a3 and the rest occupy memory together for a while.

需要前半段梯度时，从保留的输入重算a1。通过额外前向计算换取更少长期驻留激活。.en: When the gradient for the first half is needed, a1 is recomputed from the retained input. Extra forward computation is traded for fewer activations resident over the long run.

重算应对应同一次前向。Dropout随机状态、参数更新时机和含副作用运算都可能破.en: A recomputation has to correspond to the same forward pass. Dropout's random state, the timing of a parameter update and operations with side effects can all break that equivalence.

训练激活内存可能限制序列长度或批大小。.en: Activation memory in training may limit the sequence length or the batch size.

保存关键节点，反向时重建中间激活并维持相同计算语义。.en: Keep the key nodes, rebuild the intermediate activations on the backward pass, and preserve the same computational meaning.

额外计算、随机状态处理、不可重复副作用与重算峰值。.en: Extra computation, handling of random state, side effects that cannot be repeated, and the peak during recomputation.

比较开启/关闭后的损失与梯度，并分别测峰值内存和训练步耗时。.en: Compare the loss and the gradients with it on and off, and measure peak memory and training-step time separately.

摘要压缩改变模型看到的内容，可能损失信息；检索决定这次取回哪些外部证据，可能漏召.en: Summary compaction changes what the model sees and can lose information; retrieval decides which external evidence is fetched this time and can miss something in recall; a prompt cache reuses computation that already exists where the conditions are met, and the logical input length does not shrink because of it. To judge the risk, first see whether what is being changed is the content, the selection or the reuse of computation.

必要输入65单位，加40单位旧日志，再预留输出20，总计125，超过本例100窗.en: The necessary input is 65 units; add 40 units of old log and reserve 20 for output and the total is 125, over this example's window of 100.

把旧日志全删，虽然只剩85，但若日志里藏着“集成未测”，任务会失去关键状态。缩短.en: Deleting the old log entirely leaves only 85, but if "integration not tested" was buried in that log, the task loses critical state. Getting shorter is not the only goal.

把40单位旧日志替换成10单位有来源的状态说明，总计95；原文可按引用重新读取。.en: Replacing 40 units of old log with 10 units of sourced state notes brings the total to 95; the original text can be read again from the reference.

新增摘要未必正确。核对约束、已完成/未完成、来源版本，并测试下一步行动不变。.en: A newly added summary is not necessarily correct. Check the constraints, what is done and not done, and the source versions, and test that the next action is unchanged.

减少上下文占用与重复推理成本，同时保持任务连续性。.en: Reduces context usage and the cost of repeated inference, while keeping the task continuous.

选择合适的层：证据按需获取、历史有损摘要、稳定前缀计算缓存分别处理。.en: Pick the right layer: fetching evidence on demand, summarizing history lossily and caching the computation of a stable prefix are each handled separately.

把有损摘要当无损缓存；把命中缓存当作模型已永久学会；权限与版本变化后误用结果。.en: Treating a lossy summary as a lossless cache; treating a cache hit as the model having learned something for good; using the result after permissions or versions have changed.

分别比较内容保真、检索召回、缓存命中与任务成功率，而不是只报Token减少。.en: Compare content fidelity, retrieval recall, cache hits and task success rate separately, instead of reporting only the reduction in tokens.

并行能缩短独立子任务的关键路径，却增加委派、重复取证、结果整合和共享状态成本。子.en: Parallelism can shorten the critical path of independent subtasks, but it adds the cost of delegation, of gathering the same evidence twice, of integrating results and of shared state. A subagent having its own context also introduces loss at the handoff. Find the work that really can be separated first, then design an explicit handoff; a simple, self-contained task is often easier to do well with a single agent.

任务A6秒、B8秒、集成3秒，顺序耗时17秒。先假定两项确实独立、都必需。.en: Task A takes 6 s, B takes 8 s and integration takes 3 s, so in sequence it takes 17 s. Assume for now that the two really are independent and that both are necessary.

并行关键路径max(6,8)=8秒，加交接2秒与集成3秒，合计13秒；不是同时启.en: The parallel critical path is max(6,8)=8 s; with 2 s of handoff and 3 s of integration that is 13 s in total. Starting both at once does not make it 8 s.

同样任务只把交接开销改为8秒，合计8+8+3=19秒，反而比17秒慢。.en: For the same task, changing only the handoff overhead to 8 s gives 8+8+3=19 s in total, which is slower than 17 s rather than faster.

若A/B都修改同一路径，还要避免覆盖、处理冲突并重新验证集成；此前的独立假设不再.en: If A and B both modify the same path, overwriting has to be avoided, the conflict handled and the integration verified again; the earlier assumption of independence no longer holds.

利用真正独立的研究或实现方向，并隔离无关上下文。.en: Makes use of genuinely independent lines of research or implementation, and isolates unrelated context.

按依赖和写入边界分工，交接必要证据，主任务核验整合结果。.en: Divides the work along dependencies and write boundaries, hands over the necessary evidence, and has the main task verify the integrated result.

重复搜索、同文件覆盖、相关错误和过度委派会提高时间与Token成本。.en: Repeated searches, overwriting the same file, correlated errors and over-delegation all raise the time and token cost.

与单Agent同任务同预算对照，记录集成缺陷和重做次数。.en: Compare against a single agent on the same task with the same budget, and record integration defects and the number of redos.

一次调用单价低，只说明这次调用便宜。总成本还包括重试、升级、验证、人工修复和失败.en: A low unit price for one call says only that this call is cheap. The total cost also includes retries, escalation, verification, human repair and the loss from failures. Whether a cascade pays off depends above all on whether the small model is up to a class of tasks that can be identified, and on whether failures can be detected reliably.

每题成本1，总成本20；教学结果14题成功、6题经检查确认失败。成功率与检测准确.en: Each question costs 1, for a total cost of 20; the teaching result is 14 questions successful and 6 confirmed failed on checking. Success rate and detection accuracy are considered separately.

每次升级成本5，追加成本30。假设6题中5题修复成功，总成本50，总成功19。.en: Each escalation costs 5, for 30 added in all. Suppose 5 of the 6 questions are fixed successfully: the total cost is 50 and the total number of successes 19.

此教学级联成本50/19≈2.63；另设全用强模型同样成功19题，总成本100，.en: This teaching cascade costs 50/19≈2.63; separately, suppose the strong model alone also succeeds on 19 questions, for a total cost of 100 and a cost of 100/19≈5.26.

如果小模型说“完成”却实际错了，而验证器没发现，就不会触发升级。此时省钱可能以错.en: If the small model says "done" but is actually wrong and the verifier does not notice, no escalation is triggered. The money saved then may come at the price of a wrong delivery.

在不降低可接受质量的前提下降低总投入。.en: Lowering the total outlay without dropping below acceptable quality.

用可验证的任务边界路由，保留明确回退与质量门槛。.en: Route on verifiable task boundaries, keeping an explicit fallback and a quality gate.

小模型失败未被发现、复杂任务被过早分流、重试成本和等待被忽略。.en: The small model's failures go undetected, complex tasks are diverted too early, and retry cost and waiting are ignored.

报告成本/成功任务、漏检率、退化题和延迟分布；不以模型自报置信度作为唯一升级条件.en: Reports cost per successful task, the miss rate, the regressed items and the latency distribution; it does not make the model's self-reported confidence the only condition for escalation.

加入本地逐步图解、对象释义、固定条件、原因/操作/风险/检验.en: Added local step-by-step figures, object definitions, fixed conditions, and reason / action / risk / check

保留索引或代码阅读方式.en: Reading as an index or code page kept

保留索引、代码或参考性质；补导航与全书入口.en: Index, code or reference character kept; navigation and a book-wide entry added

"你爱" has only two valid positions, and PAD takes no part in the step-by-step run on this page.

查表后的初始表示 X.en: The initial representation X after the lookup

这就是文字逐Token查表后的结果；它还没有包含另一位置的内容。.en: This is what the text becomes after a token-by-token table lookup; it does not yet hold anything from another position.

第一层归一化后的输入.en: The input after the first layer's normalization

以本行自己的四个数求均值与方差，再归一化。.en: Take the mean and variance of this row's own four numbers, then normalize.

用于给当前查询与键配对打分。.en: Used to score the pairing of the current query with a key.

提供每个可读位置的Key；生成后可按层存入缓存。.en: Supplies the Key for every readable position; once produced it can be stored in the cache layer by layer.

提供最终会按注意力权重混合的内容。.en: Supplies the content that will finally be mixed by the attention weights.

每项为该头的Q与K点积除以√2；未来键位置设为−∞。例如第0个查询只能读第0个T.en: Each entry is that head's Q dotted with K and divided by √2; future key positions are set to −∞. The query at position 0, for example, can read only token 0.

每一行的可见权重和为1。掩掉的位置权重是0，而不是从打印表里省略。.en: The visible weights in each row sum to 1. A masked position has weight 0; it is not left out of the printed table.

每个输出分量都把各可见位置的对应Value分量乘权重再相加；不是直接挑一行。.en: Every output component multiplies the corresponding value component at each visible position by its weight and adds them up; it does not simply pick one row.

头0两个分量在前，头1两个分量在后；拼接本身不进行求和。.en: Head 0's two components come first and head 1's two come after; the concatenation itself performs no summation.
